english: Or, either (conjunction/adverb used to express choices, options, or alternatives)

amharic: ይሁን፣ ይደረግ፣ ይስማማልን፤ እንደዚሁ ይኹን (የፈቃድ ወይም የትእዛዝ ቃል)
english: And let it be so, may it be so, let it be (optative verb/expression)

amharic: ስጠን፣ ስጪን፣ ስጡን (ለእኛ ስጠን/ለግሰን - ከወሀበ/ውሂብ የወጣ የትእዛዝ ቃል)፡፡
english: Give us, grant us, bestow upon us (imperative form from root verb 'Wohabe/Wihib' meaning to give, combined with 1st person plural suffix '-ne').

amharic: ስጠን፣ ስጪን፣ ስጡን (ለእኛ ስጠን/ለግሰን - ከወሀበ/ውሂብ የወጣ የትእዛዝ ቃል)፡፡
english: Give us, grant us, bestow upon us (imperative form from root verb 'Wohabe/Wihib' meaning to give, combined with 1st person plural suffix '-ne').

amharic: እልፍ፣ አሥር ሺሕ ጊዜ መቶ (በጣም ብዙ)
english: A huge number, ten thousand times a hundred (a myriad)

amharic: ሆይ፣ ወዮ፣ የከበደ ወይም የተደነቀ የጥሪ ቃል
english: An exclamation meaning 'Oh!' or 'O!' used to call or express wonder
A loud cry of sadness, like saying 'Alas!' or 'Oh no!'
To return back to where one came from, or to listen closely
A command meaning 'Return!' or 'Go back!'

amharic: በውጭ በረቂቅ ጠርብ የተጌጠ የግንብ ዓምድ
english: A beautifully decorated pillar or column made of stone
Forever and ever, eternally

amharic: ሰው የሚናገረው ድምፅ ወይም ግልጽ ቃል
english: The sound of a human voice speaking words
Ab, which is the name of a month in the Jewish calendar (around August)
A snake, a scaly animal that slithers on the ground
The name of a month in the Egyptian calendar (around July)
To bloom like a flower, bear fruit, or become a father
A father, a male parent who loves and cares for his family
Fathers, or a title showing ownership and guidance
The ground hornbill, a large bird known for its deep call
An enemy or a person seeking justice for a crime
A herdsman who owns or cares for many cows
Abimelech, a name meaning 'the father of the king'
An abbot, the leading spiritual father of a monastery

amharic: ታላቅ ሊቅ፣ ሁሉን አዋህዶ የሚተረጉም መጽሐፍ
english: A wise scholar or a detailed book of explanations

amharic: የስጦታ ጌታ፣ እጅ መንሻ የሚሰጥ ሰው
english: Abishai, meaning a generous giver of gifts
An ancient book used for counting days and months
Absalom, a name meaning 'the father of peace'
A solemn oath made in the name of the holy ancestors
Paternal, relating to or coming from fathers and ancestors
Fatherhood, or acting as a great role model
The state of being an elder or a respected father figure
Abuna, a loving title for a bishop or church leader
A friendly and warm way to say 'O Father!'
The basic alphabet system (like ABCs) used for learning to read
To lose one's temper, act silly, or behave wildly
A very angry, silly, or foolish person
Someone who is acting wild, furious, or very silly
Silliness, extreme anger, or childlike playful ignorance
To make someone act silly, trick them, or look down on them
Something that drives a person wild or makes them lose control
A playful person who makes jokes and teases others
Abaddon, a place of complete ruin or emptiness
Ancient stories, histories, or tales from a very long time ago
A book containing rules and guides written by early church leaders
The act of refusing or saying 'no' to something
A stubborn person who refuses to do what they are asked
Disagreement or the act of stubbornly saying no

amharic: ወደ ወጡበት መመልስ መግባት ። መስማት እህ ማለት።
english: Returning to one's origin, entering back, or listening carefully and agreeing.

amharic: ማበብ ማፍራት የዕፀዋት ። አበባ መልበስ መቀዳጀት የመርዓዊና የመርዓት ። አባት መኾን ዘር መስጠት ውልዶ ማሶለድ የወንድ የተባት ።
english: Blooming or blossoming of plants; dressing beautifully like a bride and groom; or becoming a father.

amharic: ወገን ቅጽልወይም ሙሻዘር ውስጠ ዘ ዘአበው እንተ አበው ። በጽሐ ጊዜ ተራኅርኆ ሣህል አባዊት ላዕለ ልሕኵት አዳማዊት (ይዕ ዘእል ። ገድ አዳ) ። ተዓድዎ አበዋዊት (ማር ይሥ፳፪ ።
english: Paternal or relating to ancestors and fathers.

amharic: ማበድ መቈጣት አእምሮ ማጣት መወግሸት መነሣሣት አፈና አፈና ወፈፍ ወፈፍ ማለት መስነፍ ሞኝ አላዋቂ መኾን መጥፋት መበላሸት የልብ የናላ፡፡ ተአብዲኑ፡፡ ተአብድኑ ጳውሎስ፡፡ ወአብደ መራዕይ፡፡ የአብዱ (ግብ፲፪ ፲፭፡፡ ፳፮፡፡ ፳፬፡፡ ማር፭ ፲፫፡፡ ዲድ፮)፡፡ ወእንዘ ይፈቅዱ ይጥብቡ አብዱ፡፡ እስመ አብዱ ኖሎት፡፡ ኢየአብድ እምኔክሙ ሰነፈ (ሮሜ፩ ፳፪፡፡ ኤር፲ ፳፩፡፡ ኢዮ፲ ፫ ፪)፡፡
english: Becoming foolish, losing one's mind, getting angry, or behaving unwisely.

amharic: የሚያሳብድ የሚያሰንፍ አስናፊ አጥፊ፡፡ ቀታሌ ሰብእ ማእበዲ (ኪዳ ፩)
english: Something that makes someone act silly, drives them crazy, or causes ruin.

amharic: ቃሉ በዕብራይስጥ ነው ዕብራይስጡ ወሀድባሪም አቲቂም ያለውን ጽርኡ እንዳለ በጥሬው ወስዶታል፡፡ ወእሉ ዜናት ቀደምት ነገራት ቀደምት ማለት ነው አንቲካ ወሬ እንደ ማለት (፩ዜና ፬ ፳፪)፡፡ ዜናት ያላቸውም በኦሪት ዘኁልቍ ይገኛሉ (ም፳፭ ፩-፱) ፡፡
english: Ancient stories, chronicles, or historical events from long ago.

amharic: እንቢ ማለት አበያ እንቢተኛ መኾን መጓደድ የሰጡትንና የያዙትን የለመኑትን አለመቀበል አለመስማማት አለማድረግ ዕሺ በጎ ይኹን አለማለት፡፡ እንብየን ተመልከት የዚህ ዘር ነው ን፡ ሰሯጽ ኹኖ ስለ ሚገባበት ወደዚያ ኺዷል፡፡ ተአበዩ፡ ትእዛዝየ፡ ሰሚዐ፡ ወሕግየ፡፡ አበየት ሰሚዖቶ፡፡ አበዩ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ ንጉሥ፡፡ ኢየአቢ፡ ስእለትኪ፡ አበየ፤ ዝናም፡ ተውህቦ፡ ለምድር፡፡ ኢይእበይ፡ ባዕል፡ ከመ፡ ኢመጠመቅ፡ ምስለ፡ ነዳይ፡፡ እመ፡ ጸውዐከ፡ ኢትእበዮ፡ (ዘፀ ፲፮፡ ፳፰፡፡ አስቴ፩፡ ፲፪፡፡ ዮዲ፩፡፡ ኩፋ፡ ፴፭፡፡ ፵፪፡፡ ፍ፡ ነ፡ ፫፡፡ ሢራ፲፫፡፱) ፡፡
english: Saying no, refusing, or being stubborn and unwilling to agree.

amharic: እንቢ እሰኘ አሰኘ እንቢታ አስተማረ እንቢ በል አለ፡፡
english: To make someone refuse, to teach refusal, or to command to say no.

amharic: እንቢ ተባለ ተጠላ ተስለቸ ተጠገበ ፍቅሩ ለእግዚነ ኢይትአበይ (አዋል)፡፡
english: To be refused, rejected, or to become full.
Growing stronger, multiplying, or increasing step by step.

amharic: ብልት የገላ ክፍል በየስሙና በያንጻሩ እኩያ አምሳያ ያለው ክራስ ጠጕር እስከ እግር ጥፍር በየክፍሉ በያንዳንዱ በየማውዱ ያለ ሥጋ ሕዋስ አካል ገላ፡፡ አከለንና ሌለየን ተመልከት የዚህ ጎር ነው፡፡ ከመ አብላ ውስተ መቅፁት፡፡ መተሮ ለበግዕ በበ አባላቱ፡፡ እንዘ፡ ንስቲት አባል አንቲ፡፡ ወተዐጽፈ አባለ መንፈስ ረቂቅ፡፡ ለእመ ሐመ አሐዱ ዘፈወሰ አባለ ሙሱነ፡፡ አባለ ዘርዕ፡፡ ኢይኩን ዕሩቅ አባል ቅድመ መኑሂ፡፡ ብእሲት አባሉ ለብእሲ (ሚክ፫ ፫ ዘሌ፰ ፳፡፡ ቅዳ፡ ሕር፡፡ ዮሐ ፩ቆሮ ፲፪ ፲፮፡፡ ዲድ፳፭ ፊልክ ፯፡፡ ፈ መ ፴፪ ፫፡፡ ዲድ ፲)፡፡ አባሎ የሚሉት ብርቱ የቄላ ዕንጨት ስሙ ከዚህ የወጣ ነው፡፡
english: A part of the body, like a limb, organ, or physical member from head to toe.

amharic: የገንዘብ ስም ታናሽ ገንዘብ ፭ ሳንቲም የዲድርክም ኻያኛ በዕብራይስጥ ጌራ ይባላል ኻያው ጌራ ፩ ሰቅል እንዲኾን ኻያው አቦሊ አንድ ዲድርክም ነው፡፡ ዕሥራ አቦሊ ለአሐሪ ዲድርክም (ዘሌ፳፯ ፳፭፡፡ ዘኁ፫ ፵፯፡፡ ዘፀ፴ ፲ ፫፡፡ ፩ነገ ፪ ፴፮)፡፡
english: A small unit of money or coin, similar to a cent.

amharic: ታናሽ ወንዝ ፈፋ በዱር በዛፍ ውስጥ ያለ፡፡ የግንብ ደጃፍ የድልድይ በር፡፡ ወሀሎኩ አነ በኡባል ኡላይ (ዳን፰ ፪)፡፡ ኡላይ የወንዙ ስም ነው፡፡
english: A small river, brook flowing through a forest, or a bridge gateway.

amharic: ጨረቃ የጨረቃ ስም፡፡ ወቦቱ ለወርኅ አርባዕቱ አስማት አሶንያ እብላ ብናሴ ኤራስ (ሔኖ፸፰ ፪፡፡ ስንክ ነሐ፲፯)
english: An ancient name for the moon.

amharic: ሽቱ የሽቱ ስም ቅመም ቀረፋ የጢስ ዕንቀጨት ቅጠላም ያይዶለ፡፡ ቀረፋ ኹለት ዐይነት ነው ቅመምና ሽቱ የሚኾን (ራእ፲፰ ፲ ፫፡፡ ዘፀ፴ ፳፬፡፡ ሕዝ፳፯ ፲፱) ፡፡ ቀንምስን እይ ከዚህ ጋራ አንድ ነው፡፡
english: A sweet-smelling spice, perfume, or fragrant wood like cinnamon.

amharic: ደንጊያ ድንጋይ በአፍኣ በውስጥ ከምድር የሚገኝ የምድር ዐጥንት ዕንቍ፡፡ ለዕንጨት ብዙ ዐይነት እንዳለው ኅሱር ግብዝና ብርቱ፡፡ እብን ዐቢይ፡፡ ጽላት፡ ዘእብን፡ (ዐቢይ፡፡ ዘፀ፴፪ ፲፭፡፡ ኢሳ፱ ፲)፡፡
english: A stone, rock, or precious gem found in the earth.

amharic: ድንጎች ደንጊያዎች ድንጋዮች አዕናቍ፡፡ እስመ ሠምሩ እበኒሃ አእባን ዐበይት አእባናት፡፡ አእባነ ወርቅ፡፡ አእባነ ህንደኬ፡፡ አእባን ክቡራት በበ፡ ሕበሪሆሙ (መዝ፻፩፡፡ ኤር፶ ፱፡፡ ስንክ የካ፱ግን ፰ መቃ ገ፳፭፡፡ ፩ዜና ፪)፡፡ እባን ኹለት ወይም ጥቂት አእባን ብዙ አእባናት የብዙ ብዙ ይባላል ባለቅኔዎች ግን እበንን የብዙ ብዙ ይሉታል እያሰኘም እደውንና እገርን ተመልከት፡፡
english: Stones, rocks, or precious gemstones.

amharic: እብነ ረድኤት የረድኤት ደንጊያ፡፡ (፩ነገ ፯ ፲፪) ፡፡
english: Ebenezer, which means "the stone of help."

amharic: ርሳስ ገንዚዎች ሕንጻ የሚለኩበት ብረና ደንጊያም ይኾናል (ቅዳ ሕር)፡፡
english: A heavy lead stone used by builders to measure straight lines.

amharic: የውርጭ ደንጊያ የረጋው ግግሩ፡፡ ወይም ውርጭ የሚመስል ጽሩይ የብርሌ ጡብ ዐይነት ደንጊያ (ሔኖ፸፩ ፭)፡፡
english: A hailstone or a clear, icy-looking crystal.

amharic: በቁሙ የበረደ ደንጊያ እንዳረር እንደ ጠጠር ያለ ከዚያም የሚበልጥ ራስ የሚሰብር የሚቀጠቅጥ (ኢሳ፲ ፲፩፡፡ ሢራ፵፫ ፲፮፡፡ ፵፮ ፭፡፡ ሕዝ፵፰ ፳፪፡፡ ሔኖ፲፬ ፪)
english: A large hailstone or falling ice pebble.

amharic: ነጭ ደንጊያ በረድ የሚመስል የበረዶ ዐይነት
english: Marble, a beautiful smooth white stone that looks like clean ice.

amharic: ጥሩ ጠንካራ ኀይለኛ ደንጊያ የማይሰበር የማፈነከት አልማስ አለት (ዘዳ፰ ፲፭፡፡ ሮሜ፱ ፴ ፫፡፡ ኢዮ ፵፩ ፲፱፡፡ ሕዝ ፫ ፰)፡፡
english: A very strong, precious, and unbreakable rock like a diamond.

amharic: የማእዘን ድንጊያ ማጠፊያውና መቀነፊያው ኹለቱን ማእዘን የሚይዝና የሚያያይዝ ኹለት ክንፍ ያለው (፩ጴጥ፪ ፮)
english: A cornerstone that holds two walls of a building together.

amharic: የሚዛን፡ ደንጊያ ልክነት ያለው ሌላውን በርሱ መመዘኛ ማስተካከያ (ሕዝ፭ ፩)፡፡
english: A balance weight stone used for accurate measuring on scales.

amharic: የፈተና ደንጊያ ታላቅ ከባድ ክብ እንክብል ድንብልብል ጐበዛዝት ርሱን በማንሣት በመሸከም ጕልበታቸውን የሚፈትኑበት (ሢራ፮ ፳፪)፡፡
english: A heavy round stone used by youths to test their physical strength.

amharic: የወንጭፍ ደንጊያ ታናሽ ኵረት እንደ ፍላጻና እንደ ጥይት ርቆ የሚኼድ እሚወረወር (ዘካ፱ ፲) ፡፡
english: A small, smooth stone thrown from a slingshot.

amharic: የሚዛን ደንጊያ ታላቁም ታናሹም በየስሙና በያይነቱ ተሰብስቦ በኪስ ከረጢት የሚከተት (ምሳ፲፮ ፲፩) ፡፡
english: Small weight stones kept in a pouch for measuring items on a scale.

amharic: ሰንፔር የሚባል ዕንቍ ክቡር ደንጊያ (ኢዮ፳፰፡ ፮፡፡ ፩ቆሮ ፫ ፲፪) ፡፡
english: Sapphire, a beautiful and precious blue gemstone.

amharic: የነገየ ደንጊያ ኾነ ወደ ደንጊያነት ተለወጠ ደረቀ ከረረ ፈዘዘ፡፡
english: To turn into stone, or to become very hard and stiff.

amharic: አደነገየ ደንጊያ አደረገ፡፡ እግዚ አእበና ወሜጠ ህላዌሃ ለከዊነ ሐውልት (መጽምስ፡፡ ዘፍ፲፱ ፳፮) ፡፡
english: To petrify or turn something into solid stone.

amharic: የወንዝ አሞራ በወንዝ ዳር በባሕር ጠረፍ የሚኖር ነጭ አፈ ረዥም ትሎችን ተሐዋስያንን የሚለቃቅም ከዚህ የተነሳ ግብጻውያን ያምልኩት ነበረ ይላል (ዘሌ፲፩ ፲፯፡፡ ዘዳ፲፬ ፲፮)፡፡ ዕብራስጡ ግን ያንሹፍ ይላል ጕጕት ማለት ነው፡፡
english: A white river bird with a long beak (like an ibis), or an owl.

amharic: ዞጲ ጥሩ ጠንካራ ዕንጨት መልኩ ጥቍር ዋጋው ክቡር በህንድና በሱዳን አገር በኢትዮጵያ የሚገኝ ከክቡርነቱም የተነሳ በሚዛን የሚሼጥ፡፡ ወገብረ፡ መጥቅዐ፡ እምዕፀወ፡ አብኖስ፡ (ቀሌ፡፡ ገድ፡ አዳ)፡፡ ዞጲን፡ ተመልከት፡፡
english: Ebony, a strong, dark, and highly valuable wood.

amharic: በቁሙ ጸበል ትቢያ ዐቧራ ቅንቅን በነፋስ የሚባን ደቃቅ ነገር ኹሉ፡፡
english: Chaff, fine dust, or tiny particles blown by the wind.

amharic: ታመመ ተደወየ ዐከከ ወከከ ነጣ ገረጣ ቈሸሸ ተበላሸ፡፡ አበቅ ለበሰ አበቅ መሰለ ኾነ፡፡
english: To become sick with skin irritation or to grow pale and dirty.

amharic: ያክክ ዕከካም ቈሻሻ ቋቍሻም ድውይ (ዘሌ፳፩፡ ፳፡፡ ፳፪፡ ፳፪)፡፡
english: A person suffering from itchy skin rashes or sores.

amharic: መጽሐፍ የመጽሐፍ ስም፡፡ ቃሉ ኹለት ነው ቅጽልና ባለቤት ፡፡ እፖ ሩቅ ረቂቅ ስውር ድብቅ ኅቡእ ክቡት ካሊፕሲስ ራእይ ትንቢት፡፡ ራእየ ዮሐንስ፡ አቡቀለምሲስ፡፡ ዮሐንስ ጸሐፈ ወንጌለ ወአቡቀለምሲስ፡ ዘርእየ ውስተ ደሴተ፡ ፍጥም፡ (ስንክ ታኅ፩፡፡ ጥር፬) ፡፡ እንዳረቡ ቃል በአብ ዘይቤ ሲፈታ ግን ባለ መጽሐፉ ስምና ቅጽል ይኾናል፡፡
english: The Book of Revelation (Apocalypse), containing visions of hidden future events.

amharic: ጭማሪ ተውሳከ የቍጥር ማማያ ማስተካከያ፡፡ ተረፈ ዓመት የቀመር ትራፊ ትርፍ ፍድፋጅ፡፡ አበቅቴ ፀሓይ፡፡ አበቅቴ ወርኅ፡፡ አበቅትያት ሠርዐ ሐሳበ አበቅቴ (አቡሻ ፳ ፫፡፡ ፳፭፡፡ ፴፩፡፡ ስንክ ጥቅ፲፪) ፡፡
english: The extra days added to the calendar year to balance the solar and lunar cycles.

amharic: እሾኽ ቀጭን ሹል መርፌ የሚመስል፡፡ ዕፀ ግረት እንዘ ቈጽለ ዕፁ ኢይትንገፍ ወአባሪሁኒ ኢይጸድፉ፡ (መጽ፡ ምስ) ፡፡
english: Thin, sharp thorns or needles found on plants.

amharic: ገበጣ የገበጣ ጨዎት (ፍ ነ ፵፫ ፲፪)፡፡
english: A traditional board game played with small seeds or stones, similar to mancala.

amharic: ታላቅ ቆሞስ የኤጲስቆጶስ ተከታይ (ፍ ነ ፭)፡፡
english: A high-ranking priest or assistant to a bishop.

amharic: መጽሐፍ የመጽሐፍ ስም ግብረ ሐዋርያት የሐዋርያት ሥራ ዜና ታሪክ፡፡ የታሪክ መጽሐፍ፡ አብረክሲስ ( ፍ ነ ፪)፡፡
english: The Acts of the Apostles, an ancient book recording the deeds and history of Jesus' followers.

amharic: ትእዛዝ አንቀጽ ብርክ አስተብርክ ስግድ አምኅ ግነይ ባርክ፡፡ ዮሴፍ በተሾመ ጊዜ ለሰብእ ግብጽ የተነገረ የፈርዖን ዐዋጅ ነው (ዘፍ፵፩፡ ፵ ፫) ፡፡
english: A royal command to bow down or show deep respect.
The month of April.

amharic: ስመ ነገድ የኵሉ ልጅ የሳባ ሳብዓይ የናምሩድ ተከታይ፡፡ ፪ኛ ስሙ ከለው ይባላል ፪ቱም በታሪክ እንጂ በቅዱስ መጽሐፍ አይገኙም፡፡ የሳባ ክፍል ሳባ እንደ ተባለች የአቢስም ክፍል አቢሲንያ ተብላለች፡፡ አቢሲን አቢሳውያን አቢሲኔ አቢሳዋ አቢሲንያ ሀገረ አቢስ ማለት ነው እስክንድርያ እንደ ማለት ነው፡፡
english: A historical name for Abyssinia (Ethiopia), representing its ancient heritage and people.

amharic: ማብላት ማጥገብ መቀለብ መመገብ ማሥባት ማወፈር ከብትን ሰውነትን፡፡ ወይም በቁሙ ማበስ መጥረግ አብዝቶ መብላት መጋፈፍ እንደ እንስሳ መቀለብ መሥባት መወፈር፡፡ ከዚህ የተነሣ ማበስ መበደል ኅጢአት መሥራት ዐውቆ ደፍሮ ኾነ ብሎ፡፡
english: Feeding and fattening; or doing something wrong on purpose.

amharic: የሚያብስ የሚበድል በዳይ በደለኛ ያዋቂ አጥፊ ደፋር ጥጋበኛ፡፡ ኃጥእ ወአባሲ አባሲ ዝንቱ ሕዝብ አበሳ ዐቢየ (አርጋ፡፡ ዘፀ፴፪ ፴፩) ፡፡
english: Someone who breaks a rule or behaves wrongly on purpose.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ በደለኛ፡፡ ዘይስሕት በአሐቲ፡ ኮነ መአብሰ በኵሉ፡፡ መአብስ ውእቱ ላዕለ እግዚነ (ያዕ፪ ፲፡፡ ፍ ነ ፲ ፫) ፡፡
english: A wrongdoer or someone who commits a mistake or offense.

amharic: ያበሰ የበደለ አበሰኛ ኃጥእ ወንጀለኛ፡፡ እቡሰ ትሬስዮሙ፡፡ እቡሳነ ልብ፡፡ ተሰቅለ ከመ እቡስ፡ (ምሳ፲ ፫ ፮፡፡ መጽ ምስ፡፡ ስንክ መጋ፳፯) ፡፡
english: A person who has committed an offense or a wrong deed.

amharic: ማበስ መበደል አበዳደል በደላ በደል ኅጢአት ክሕደት፡፡ ወእምዝ በርሕቀተ መዋዕል ተእኅዘ ልማደ እብስት ወርስዐት (ጥበ፲፬ ፲፮) ፡፡
english: An offense, sin, or bad behavior.

amharic: በቁሙ ፅዳ በደል ኅጢአት ክህደት፡፡ አልብየ አበሳ፡፡ አብሳ ዘኢኮነ ለሞት እስመ ቦ አበሳ ዘለሞት፡፡ ኅድግ ለነ አበሳነ፡፡ ወዘይመስሎ ለዝንቱ እምአበሳት፡፡ ገባርያነ አበሳት (ኢዮ፴፬ ፮፡፡ ፩ዮሐ ፭ ፲፮፡፡ ፈ መ ፮ ፩፡፡ ፍ ነ መቅ) ፡፡
english: A mistake, fault, or wrong action.

amharic: አላበሰ አስበደለ አጢኣት አሠራ፡፡ እንተ ታኤብስ ምድረ (ኩፋ ፳ ፫) ፡፡
english: To cause someone to do wrong or commit an offense.
A person who encourages or leads others to do something wrong.

amharic: መምህር አበ ማኅበር አበ ምኔት የገዳም አባት (ሥር ጳኵ) ፡፡ አባስ ካህነ ሮሜ (ታምረ ማር) ፡፡
english: An abbot or spiritual leader of a monastery.

amharic: መዘምር ዘማሪ አወዳሽ ደብተራ (ፍ ነ ፱) ፡፡
english: A singer, chanter, or choir member in church ceremonies.

amharic: የፍታት ቃል የፍታት ሥርዐት፡ ናዛዥ ለተናዛዥ የሚያሰማው ቃል እፈትሐከ ኩን ፍቱሐ ፍትሐት ዘወልድ ይህን የመሰለ። የፍታት ዜማ ለሙታን የሚጸለይ ጸሎት በግንዘት ያለ ቃል ፍትሐት ወንጽሕተ ረስያ የመሰለው ኹሉ፡፡ አብስልዋጥስ ይትበሀል በዜማ ግንዘት (ግንዘ) ፡፡
english: A prayer of absolution or forgiveness spoken by a priest.

amharic: ከኹለት አንድ የኾነ አምላክና ሰው ፩ አካል፡፡
english: The union of divine and human natures in one person.

amharic: ማበት ሸብ ማድረግ ወይም መማገር አጥብቆ ማሰር አብታረግ እንዲሉ ኹሉም ዐማርኛ ነው፡፡
english: Tying something tightly or securing it with a rope.

amharic: በቁሙ ማገድ መከልከል መግታት፡፡ መስበር መቀልጠም መክፈል መለያየት የሥጋና ያጥንት፡፡
english: Blocking, preventing, or breaking and separating things apart.

amharic: እግር ዛል ጭን ማኽል አገዳ ቅልጥም የእጅና የእግር መደበኛ ዐጥንት፡፡ ዘቦ አገዳ መልዕልተ እገሪሁ፡፡ አገዳሁ ዘየማን፡፡ ያንጉዕ አገዳሆን፡፡ ተሰብረት አሐቲ አገዳ እግሩ፡፡ ሌዊ እኅወ ይሁዳ ዘሀብተ ክህነቱ አገዳ፡፡
english: The shin or long bone of the arm or leg.
To complete, finish, or make perfect.
Halves, divided parts, or portions of something.

amharic: መቍረጥ መክፈል ማሥመር የሊጥ መገመት ይህን ያኽል ማለት የዋጋ፡፡ አገና ዋጋ ገዥና ሽያጭ የሚስማሙበት (ዐማርኛ) ፡፡
english: Kneading dough, dividing, or agreeing on a fair price for goods.
Soft, kneaded dough or batter.
Nasal dirt or mucus.
The inner or interior part of a place.

amharic: መኼድ መራመድ መሮጥ መፈርጠጥ እግራም እግረኛ መኾን፡፡ በቁሙ ማገር መገርገር ማወክ መከልከል ከመንገድ ከሥራ ማስተጓጐል፡፡
english: Walking, running, or blocking someone's path.

amharic: እግረኛ ሯጭ ገሥጋሽ ኻያጅ ተራማጅ ዕድሜው ኻያ ዓመት የመላ ከዚያም በላይ እስካርባ ዓመት ያለ ጐበዝ ጕልማሳ ወታደር ሰልፈኛ ዘማች ባዋጅ በቱልቱላ የተጠራ የተሰበሰበ፡፡ ስላ እልፍ አጋር፡፡ አጋሮሙ፡፡ አጋርያን፡፡ ዐሠርቱ ምእት አጋር፡ ብእሲ (ዘፀ፴፯፡፡ ዘኁ፲፩ ፳፩ ዮዲ፯ ፳፡፡ ፪ ፲፱፡፡ ፬ነገ ፲ ፫ ፯)፡፡
english: A foot soldier, runner, or active young person traveling on foot.
A shield or a protective cover for a shield.

amharic: በቁሙ መቆሚያ መርገጫ መኼጃ መራመጃ ከጭን እስከ ስኰና እንደ እጅ ፫ ክፍል ያለው፡፡ ኪደተ እግረ ብእሲ፡፡ ከመ እግር ሙቁሕ፡፡ እግር ቦሙ ወኢየሐውሩ፡፡ እግረ ሰብእ ወእንስሳ ክልኤ እግር፡፡ ዘአርባእቱ እግሩ (ሱቱ ዕዝ፭ ፯፡፡ ሢራ፳፩ ፲፱፡፡ መዝ ፻፲፫፡፡ ሕዝ ፳፱ ፲፩፡፡ ዓሞ፫ ፲፪፡፡ ዘፀ ፱)፡፡
english: A foot or leg used for standing and walking.

amharic: እግሮች ለብዙም ለጥቂትም ባንድ ገላ ላሉ ላራቱም ለኹለትም ብቻ ከዚያም ለሚበዙ ላምሳና ለሺሕ ይነገራል፡፡ ሺ እግር ዐምሳ እግር እንዲሉ፡፡ ወይቀውማ እገሪሁ፡፡ እገሪሆሙ ይረውጻ፡፡ ወድቀ ውስተ አገሪሁ ለዮዲት፡፡ ርቱዕ እገሪሆሙ፡፡ ዘብዙኅ እገሪሁ (ዘካ፲፬ ፬) ምሳ፩ ፲፮፡፡ ዮዲ፲፬ ፯፡፡ ሕዝ፩ ፯፡፡ ዘሌ፲፩ ፵፩) ፡፡
english: Feet or limbs of animals and humans.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ እግሮች፡፡ አእጋራት የብዙ ብዙ፡፡ ኦ አእጋር እለ አንሶስዋ ውስተ ገነት ተቅነዋ በቅንዋት፡፡ ሰላም ለአእጋሪክ ጠብዓ ለቀዊም፡፡ (ቅዳ አፈ፡፡ ደራሲ)፡፡
english: Many feet or multiple steps.

amharic: የሕፃናት መንገድ የልጆች አካኼድ አረማመር እቱ ሥግራ ታቱ ሥግራ ማለት ምስጢሩ ጕዞና ማዝገም ነው (ዘፍ፴፫ ፲፬) ፡፡
english: Walking slowly, matching the gentle steps of little children.

amharic: የኪሩቤል ስም ያራቱ ኹሉ፡፡ ዘይቤው ያልጋ ሸንኰር የዙፋን እግር ምስጢሩ ጸወርተ መንበር (ድጓ መዋሥ) ፡፡ ቅዱስ ያሬድ እንዲህ ማለቱ ጌታን በንጉሥ መንበረ መንግሥትን በኮር በግላስ ሰማይ ውዱድን ባልጋ በፈረስ ኪሩቤልን ባራት እግሮቹ መስሎ ነው፡፡ (ሕዝ፩ ፳፮፡፡ መዝ፲፯ ፲፩) ፡፡
english: The legs of a throne or bed, symbolically representing the guardians of a royal seat.

amharic: የመክፈቾች እግር መያዣቸው መንጠልጠያቸው ቀለበቱ ወይም ሳንቆች የሚቆሙበት መድረክ የመዝጊያ ቍላ የወንዴው (አዋል) ፡፡
english: A keyring, latch, or a holder for keys.

amharic: እግራም እግረኛ ዘዋሪ እግረ ብዙ ሺ እግር ዐምሳ እግር የሚሉት ቍጥር ትል
english: A walker, pedestrian, or a multi-legged insect like a centipede.

amharic: አጋራውያን የይስማኤል ልጆች በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ያሉት፡፡ ፈለገ አግሪም (፩ዜና ፭ ፭ ፲፱፡፡ ፪ዜና ፳፭ ፲፩) ፡፡ ጽርኡና ዕብራይስጡ ግን ፈለገ ጼው ይላል የባሕረ ጼው ዱሓ ሸለቆ ወደ ባሕረ ጼው የሚፈስ ወንዝ ማለት ነው፡፡
english: The Hagrites, an ancient group of people descended from Hagar.

amharic: ፬ እግር ያለው አሞራ፡፡ ወሀሎ ዖፍ ዘይሰመይ አግሪጳስ በሀገረ ቃራት ወአርባዕቱ አእጋር ይመሥጥ ሶረ ወይሰርር መልዕልተ አየር እንቢይነ ጽንዑ (ጊ ወ ሐ ገ፳፪) ፡፡ ፪ኛም የሰው ስም ይኾናል (ግብ፳፭ ፲ ፫) ፡፡
english: Agrippa, a historical name, or a mythical four-legged bird mentioned in old stories.

amharic: መሸከም መጫን ማንገት ማዘል መደብለል ተሸካሚ መኾን በዠርባ፡፡ በቁሙ ማደግ መመንደግ ቁመትና ጐን መጨመር ለሸክም ለጭነት መብቃት የሰው የከብት፡፡
english: Carrying a heavy load, or growing big and strong enough to carry things.

amharic: ተሸካሚ የጭን የጭነት የኮርቻ ከብት አህያ አጋሰስ በቅሎ ፈረስ ገመል ዝኆን፡፡ ስምነቱ የግብር ነውና ለኹሉም ይኾናል ልማዱ ግን ላህያ ብቻ ነው፡፡ አድግ ወላሕም፡፡ አድገ ጸላኢከ ወተገድፉ አእዲጊሁ ለቂስ፡፡ አእዱግ ፍኖቶሙ (ቅዳ፡፡ ዘፀ፳፫ ፭፡፡ ፩ነገ ፱ ፫፡፡ ቅኔ)፡፡
english: A pack animal, most commonly a donkey or donkey-like helper.

amharic: የዱር የባዳ አህያ ሠጋር ጠጕር መልካም ነብርማ ሽልምልም ሽመልመሌ ዐይነት፡፡ ሐለስትዮን እይ፡፡ ወኮንኩ ከመ አድገ ገጻም፡፡ በበዓሎሙ፡፡ ለአእዱገ ገዳም (ኢዮ፳፬ ፭፡፡ ኢሳ፴፪ ፲፬፡፡ ሔኖ፹፱ ፲፩) ፡፡
english: A wild donkey or a striped animal like a zebra.

amharic: ዖፈ መረብ የበዳ ርኩም ቀቀኖ ወይም የርኩም ዐይነት መረቦ ጋጋኖ የባሕር ዶሮ፡፡ እሊህ ኹሉ አንድ ወገን ናቸው ይመስላሉ ቀቀኖንና መረብን ተመልከት አድግ ማለት ግን የመላሽ ስሕተት ነው (መዝ፻፩ ፯፡፡ ዘሌ፲፩ ፲፰) ፡፡ ማሕረጻ አድግ ቢል የወፍጮ ግልገል ማለት ነው፡፡ አድግ ታችኛው እናቱ ተሸካሚው ማሕረጽ ላይኛው ልጁ መጁ፡፡ ባለሐዲሶች ግን አህያ የሚያዞረው የመዘውር ወፍጮ ይሉታል፡፡ (ማቴ፲፰ ፮) ፡፡
english: A large waterbird, like a pelican or cormorant.
An adversary, opponent, or rival.

amharic: መጥረግ፡ መጋፍ፡ መግፋት፡ ማስገለል፡ መኰስተር መሰብሰብ፡ ዐፍሦ፡ መጣል፡ መወርወር፡ ማሽቀንጠር፡ የጕድፍ፡፡ ወነሥኣ፡ ደናግል፡ ማእድወ፡ ወአደዋ፡ ወአውፅኣ፡ ኵሎ፡ መሬት፡ እምዐውደ፡ ማኅፈድ፡ (ሄሮማ) ፡፡
english: Sweeping, clearing away dirt, or throwing away trash.

amharic: አጃም ባልእጅ መኾን እጀ ሥራ፡ ማወቅ በተግባረ እድ መሠልጠን ራቀቅ፡፡ መያዝ መጨበጥ እጅ ማድረግ ከእጅ ማግባት፡፡
english: Having great skill with your hands, craftsmanship, or holding onto something.

amharic: የሚጠርግ ጠራጊ ባለወግ የከተማ የቤተ ክሲያን፡፡
english: A cleaner or sweeper who keeps a church or town tidy.

amharic: ጕድፍ ጥራጊ ሐመድ ርካሽ ሣር ገለባ ዐዛባ፡፡ ገደፍኩ ኵሎ ውረሰይክዎ ከመ እዳው፡፡ ይከውን ኵሉ ዓለም በኅቤሁ ከመ እዳዋት ወከመ ኵስሕ፡፡ ኢይገብሩ እዳዋተ (ፊልክ፫ ፰፡፡ አፈ ተ፲፰፡፡ ፍ ነ ፴፯፡፡ ኢሳ፴ ፳፪) ፡፡
english: Trash, dust, sweepings, or dry grass and debris.

amharic: እጅ የገላ ክንፍ መሥሪያው መሣሪያው ከመት ክፍት እስከ አጽባዕት እንደ እግር ፫ ክፍል ያለው ጡንቻ ክንድ መዳፍ፡፡ እዴየ ከ ኪ ሁ ሃ እዴነ ክሙ ክን ሆሙ ሆን እያለ እንደ ኅበ በኃምስ ይዘረዘራል፡፡ ምስጢሩ ሥራን መደብ አድርጎ ኅይልና ሥልጣንን ያሳያል፡፡ አትሕቲ ርእሰኪታሕተ እዴሃ ጽንዕት፡፡ እድ ፅቡስ፡፡ ኵሉ እድ ይደክም፡፡ እድ ቦሙ ወኢይገሱ፡፡ ደይ እዴከ ላዕለ እዴየ፡፡ መጥወኒ እዴከ ወመጠዎ እዴሁ፡፡ ከለባት ይበልዕዋ ለበትረ እዴነ ኤልዛቤል (ዘፍ፲፮ ፱፡፡ ዘፀ፮ ፩፡፡ ፬ነገ ፩ ፲፭ ቅኔ) ፡፡
english: A hand, arm, or the power and authority to do things.

amharic: እጆች የገላ ቅጥዮች ዐጽቆችና ክንፎች፡፡ እደው ኹለት አእዳው ብዙ አእዳዋት የብዙ ብዙ፡፡ እበን ፅፀው ቍየጽ እገር ፅዮን እዘን እንደዚህ ያለ ይህን የመሰለ ስም ኹሉ መነሻው ሳድስ ኹኖ መካከሉ ግእዝ ዘውግ ይባላል፡፡ ኹለትም አራትም ቢኾኑ ከዚያም ቢበዙ ተባብረው ተጫፍረው ተነጻጽረው ባንድ ቦታና ባንድ ገላ ብቻ ያሉትን ያሳያል፡፡ ቀነዉኒ እደውየ ወእገርየ፡፡ ስፍሐ እደዊሁ ለሕማም፡፡ ኦ አእዳው እለ ለሐኳሁ ለአዳም ተቀነዋ በቅንዋት (መዝ ፳፩፡፡ ቅዳ ዲዮ፡፡ አፈ) ፡፡
english: Hands or wings.

amharic: ታላቅ ሐውልት አቤሴሎም ለስሙ ማስጠሪያ ያቆመው ኋላም የተቀበረበት፡፡
english: A grand monument or pillar built by Absalom to preserve his name.

amharic: ድጋፍ መከዳ የመንበረ መንግሥት ጌጥ የንጉሡ እጆች የሚረክሱት የሚመረኰዙት፡፡
english: An armrest, cushion, or support decorative piece on a throne or lectern.

amharic: የብረት እጅ፡፡ በሰው እጅ አምሳል የተሠራ ብረት የሰማዕታት መሣቀያ፡፡
english: An iron hand-shaped tool, historically used as an instrument of torture.

amharic: የቀኝ እጅ የቀኝ ወርች ጫፉ አንጻር ያለ፡፡
english: The right hand or the right side.

amharic: የጦር አንደበት ቅጠሉ ጫፉ ሹሉ ወልቢልቢቱ ወይም ዛቢያው ሶማያዊ፡፡
english: The sharp tip, blade, or head of a spear.

amharic: የመዝጊያ እጀታ ወይም የመወርወሪያው ለመክፈት ለመዝጋት የሚያዘው፡፡
english: A door handle, latch, or bolt used for opening and closing.

amharic: አፈ ሰይፍ ስለት አንደበት ወይም ውላጋ እጀታ መክድ፡፡
english: The hilt or the sharp edge of a sword.

amharic: ፍንጅ የሰንሰለት እጅ እስርና ቍራኛ በየክንዳቸው የሚያገቡት፡፡
english: Handcuffs or chain links placed around the wrists.

amharic: ጐን ሕፅን ቅርብ አጠገብ የቦታ አዋሳኝ ጎረ ቤት ድንበረተኛ ቀበሌ አውራጃ ድግም ገደማ፡፡
english: A side, border, neighborhood, or nearby region.

amharic: ዐቢይና ደቂቅ አገባብ፡፡ ፍችውን በወእድ ተራ ተመልከት፡፡
english: A phrase referring to great and small parts, or portion by portion.

amharic: ደወል ዙሪያ አውራጃ ሰበካ ገጠር ታናናሽ አገር ጕልት ግዛት፡፡
english: A district, province, surrounding territory, or parish.

amharic: መቅላት ቀይ መኾን ደም መምሰል ዐለላ እንሶስላ መግባት በቀይ ስባቅ መነከር መታለል የነት የልብስ፡፡
english: To turn red, blush, or be dyed with a reddish pigment.

amharic: ቅጽልና ጥሬ፡፡ ቀይሕ ቀይሓዊ ደምማ ዐረብ አንቀልባ ነት የገባ ቈርበት፡፡
english: Red, reddish, or red-dyed leather.

amharic: የዔሳው ስምና ሀገር ቀይሕ ማለት ነው፡፡
english: Edom: The land and nickname of Esau, meaning red.

amharic: ምድር የብስ ገራህት በቀይ መሬት መረሬ ቅላቱ ሸክላ ሕጕሬ ብስል በርበሬ ያፈር ወይዘሮ፡፡
english: Earth, dry land, red clay, or fertile ground.

amharic: ያፈር ቤት ግድግዳው የግንብ ጣራው የንጨት ኹኖ ክዳኑ ዐፈር መሬት እንደ ትግሬና እንዳደሬ ሥራ፡፡ የግንብ ዐጥር ቅጥር መካበቢያ ወይም ዐፈር ቃም ካብ፡፡
english: An earthen house with stone walls and a flat, earth-covered wooden roof.

amharic: በቁሙ መዠመሪያ ሰው የሰው ኹሉ አባት ጐበዝ ጕልማሳ ወንድ ተባት፡፡
english: Adam: The first man, father of all humanity; can also refer to a young man.

amharic: የአድማ ዘር ሰው ወይም ባሕርዩና ግብሩ ተፈጥሮው፡፡
english: Human, of the race of Adam, or having a mortal nature.

amharic: የአድማ ዘር ሰው ወይም ባሕርዩና ግብሩ ተፈጥሮው፡፡
english: Relating to human nature or the lineage of Adam.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ የሚያምር፡፡ እለ ሠናይ ራእዮሙ ወመአድም ሥኖሙ፡፡
english: Beautiful, charming, or lovely in appearance.

amharic: ያማረ ያጌጠ የተዋበ ውብ መልካም ደመ ግቡ፡፡
english: Adorned, decorated, handsome, or beautiful.

amharic: ያማረ ያጌጠ የተዋበ ውብ መልካም ደመ ግቡ፡፡
english: To be beautiful, decorated, handsome, or well-fashioned.

amharic: ናእክ ርሳስ ወይም ብረት የሐዲስ ሕንጻና የማእዘን ልክ መወዘኛ ማስተካከያ... የምድር ዳር ዙሪያዋ ክበቧ ቅጥሯ ዳር ድንበሯ ይሉታል፡፡
english: A plumb line, corner marker, or the horizon/outer boundary of the earth.

amharic: ግእዛኣዊ ወልደ እግዚእ ዘቦቱ እግዚእና፡፡ ዓመለኛ ባለዱኛ ዘመናይ፡፡
english: Lordly, noble, or relating to the Lord; also used for a prosperous person.
Dirt, stain, rust, or impurity.

amharic: የሴቶች ግዳጅ እክቶ፡፡ ተርታ መናኛ እኽል ንፋሽ ገለባ ሐሠር ያለው፡፡
english: Impurity, chaff, waste from sifted grain, or a woman's cycle.

amharic: የዕብራውያን ወር መጋቢት የጥቅምት ፮ኛ የሚያዝያ ፲፪ኛ መሠግር ጊዜ ፲፫ኛ... ፍችው ዕበይ ርሕብ ልዕልና ማለት ነው፡፡
english: Adar: The twelfth month of the Hebrew calendar, meaning greatness or height.

amharic: እሾኻም እንጨት ጋሬጣ እሾኹ እንደ ችንካር ያለ መርዛም፡፡
english: A thorny wood, poisonous spike, or sharp thorn.

amharic: አደርማ ቀኖት የቀኖት ስም አራተኛ ቀኖት የቀኝ እግሩ፡፡ ሳዶር አላይር ዳናት አዴር ሮዳስ ኅምስቱ ቅንዋተ መስቀል፡፡
english: Ader: One of the five holy nails used during the Crucifixion.

amharic: እሾኻም እንጨት ጋሬጣ እሾኹ እንደ ችንካር ያለ መርዛም፡፡
english: A sharp, poisonous thorn or thorny wood.

amharic: የላይ ልብስ ታላቅ ሰፊ ጀርባ ካባ መጐናጠፊያ ኀይል ጽንፅ፡፡
english: A large cloak, wide mantle, or outer garment.
Myrtle: A sweet-smelling, aromatic wood or evergreen shrub.
Myrtles: Multiple sweet-smelling myrtle trees.

amharic: ንኡስ አገባብ፡፡ የሐዘን የጭንቅ ያሉታ የነቀፌታ ቃል መታመም መጐሰም... ኹለተኛም አንክንሮ ብሰዓን የደስታ ቃል ይኾናል፡፡
english: An exclamation of sorrow, pain, or sighing; can also express wonder or joy.

amharic: ነባር አንቀጽና ንኡስ አገባብ፡፡ ያዎንታ ቃል ፍችው አወን እውነት በውነት፡፡
english: Yes, indeed, truly, or in truth.

amharic: ነባር አንቀጽና ንኡስ አገባብ፡፡ ያዎንታ ቃል ፍችው አወን እውነት በውነት፡፡
english: Yes, truly, or indeed (an expression of affirmation).

amharic: ጊሜ የምድር ላቦት እንፏሎት የጉም ሽንት እንደ ጤፍ ቅንጣት ያለ ባለቅነዎች ግን ጤዛ ይሉታል፡፡
english: Mist, vapor, heavy dew, or fine fog.
Blessed be the Lord.

amharic: ቅእዛዝ አንቀጽ ባርክ፡፡ መነኮሳት ግን ቃለ ጽዋዔ ይሉታል... ፍችውም ክፍት ማለት ነው፡፡
english: A word of blessing meaning 'Bless!'; also used as a welcoming monk's greeting.

amharic: ስመ ነገድ የሰው ስም የካም የልጅ ልጅ የኵሽ ኹለተኛ ልጁ የሳባ ታናሽ... ምድረ ኤውላጦን... እንዳሾዋ የሚታፈሥበት ካባይ በመለስ ያለ...
english: Havilah: A biblical land known for pure gold; also a personal and tribal name.
A deep valley or a low, hot plain.

amharic: ጥኑ ጠንካራ ዕንጨት ብርቱ ዛፍ በሉጥ፡፡
english: Oak tree: A strong, hard, and sturdy tree.

amharic: የሰው ስም ፪ኛም የይሁዳ ልጅ... አውስቦ አውናን የአውናን ፅምረት ሩካቤ አውናናዊ ሥራ ፈቃድን ፈጽሞ ዘር ሩካቤ አለመስጠት፡፡
english: Onan: A biblical name, also associated with avoiding natural offspring.

amharic: ፀሓይ ስመ ፀሓይ ሥዕለ ፀሓይ ጸዳሉ ብርሃኑ ቀርኑ ምዕዛሩ ያሬስ ሰሌዳው ክበቡ፡፡
english: The sun, its bright radiance, disk, or rays.

amharic: ብርቱ ነፋስ ባሕር የሚደርጥ የሚያናውጥ መርከብ የሚንጥ የሚገለብጥ፡፡
english: A tempestuous wind, hurricane, or severe sea storm.
Radiance, bright light, gleam, or a flash of light.

amharic: ንስር የጥንብ አሞራ አስቀድሞ ዐይን የሚነቍር ፊት የሚሟጭር የሚጐፈጭር ዐይን ሳያወጣ የማይበላ፡፡
english: An eagle or vulture; a large bird of prey.

amharic: ምልክት ፊደል ታምራት ገቢረ ኅይል፡፡ የዮሐንስ መጥምቅ ስምና በዓል ምልከታም ባለምልክት ማለት ነው፡፡
english: A sign, letter, miracle, or landmark; also refers to a festival of St. John.
To borrow, obtain, receive, or be blessed with a portion.

amharic: የቦታ ስም የጸሎት የትምርት ቤት መጋቢያ መሰብሰቢያ መካነ ጉባኤ፡፡
english: A place of assembly, house of prayer, school, or gathering place.

amharic: መፍሰስ መንዣረር መንፎክፎክ ፊር ፊር ጭርቅ ጭርቅ ጠብ ጠብ ማለት የሽንት የዘር የወተት የደም የፈሳሽ ኹሉ፡፡
english: To drip, run, trickle, or flow (used for liquids).
To urinate, sprinkle, or spray liquid.
A gutter, water channel, canal, or drain.
The male reproductive organ.

amharic: መርጫ የቀንበጥ ችቦ ታናናሽ ቀጫጫን ቀንበጥ ሐረግ መልካም ሽታ ያለው...
english: Hyssop: A sweet-smelling herb or plant used for sprinkling and purification.

amharic: ማዘዝ መናዘዝ (ጥና) መናዘዝ በሥራ ላይ ወይም በገንዘብ በርስት ቍርጥ ቃል መስጠት አድርግ አታድርግ ይኹን አይኹን ማለት በቃል በጥፈት የሹም የቄስ ያባት የባለቤት፡፡
english: To command, order, dictate rules, or make a final will.

amharic: የሚያዝ የሚናዝዝ አዛዥ ናዛዥ ሠራዒ መጋቢ፡፡
english: A commander, director, administrator, or executor of a will.

amharic: አሳዘዘ እዘዝ ናዝ እለ አዛዥነት ሾመ ወክሊ፡፡
english: To delegate authority, order, or appoint as a commander.

amharic: ታዘዘ ሰማ ተቀበለ ዕሺ በጎ እለ ተገዛ አገለገለ፡፡
english: To obey, listen, serve, submit, or agree.

amharic: የሚታዘዝ፡ ታዛዥ፡ ተለኣኪ፡ አገልጋይ፡ ዕሺ፡ ባይ፡ ፈቃደኛ፡፡
english: Obedient, helpful, willing, or a servant.

amharic: በቁሙ የታዘዘ የተገባ የተሠራ የተወሰነ የተጣፈ የተነገረ፡፡
english: Commanded, decreed, prescribed, or set by law.
To command one another, mutually agree, or coordinate rules.

amharic: ሻፎ ብልጩት ደንጊያ ቦረቦጭ ሲሰብሩት ስለታም ሡፋጭ ራስ የሚላጭ እብነ እዝኅ፡፡
english: Flint: A sharp stone or obsidian used as a blade.

amharic: የማእዝን ስም ንኡስ ማእዝን የአፍሪቃ ወገን በምዕራብ በደቡብ መካከል ያለ የደቡብ ግራ ምዕራብ የመስፅ ትይዩና አንጻር ፊት ለፊት፡፡
english: South, southwest, or the southern wind.

amharic: ማደግ መጐልመስ ለጌጥ ለመሣሪያ መድረስ መጐልበት መግነን ኅይለኛ መኾን፡፡
english: To grow, mature, become strong, powerful, or fully developed.
A traveler, runner, messenger, or swift walker.

amharic: መቀቀር መቀፈር ዦሮ መስጠት ማቅረብ ለመስማት፡፡
english: To listen, pay attention, or incline one's ear to hear.

amharic: ዦሮ መስሚያ ማድመጫ መያዣ መጨበጫ የመጣዕም በጕረሮ፡፡
english: The ear (organ of hearing) or a handle of a container.

amharic: ዦሯም ዥሯማ ቄሪፍ ባለዠሮ ዦሮ ወዳድ፡፡
english: Having large ears or listening attentively.

amharic: በቁሙ የቦታ ክፍል ለብቻው አንድ ወገን የተለየ እንደ ዦሮ ተመሳሳይ አንጻር ኹለተኛ ያለው... አራት ማዕዘን...
english: A corner, angle, direction, or side of a building or the earth.
The sides or directions around a person (front, back, right, and left).

amharic: የተማዘነ አራት ገጽ ያለው ባላራት ማእዝን፡፡
english: Symmetrical, four-sided, or square.

amharic: አንድ ማድረግ ማዋደድ ማስማማት አንዱን ካንዱ ጋራ ማዛመድ ማዋሐድ ምንታዌን ማጥፋት፡፡
english: To unite, make into one, harmonize, or reconcile.
Unifying, uniting, or making into one.

amharic: ኅብረት አንድነት፡፡ የተዋሐደ ኅቡር አንድነቱ በራስ ቅሉ ብቻ ያይዶለ ብዙነት ያለው አንድ እንደ ሰው ባሕርይ የተቀመመ የተጠራቀመ፡፡
english: Unity, oneness, or a complex whole of united parts.

amharic: የቍጥር ስም መዠመሪያ ቍጥር ከኹለት እስከ ምእልፊት ላለ ቍጥር ኹሉ ጥንትና መሠረት መነሻ፡፡ አንድ አንዱ፡፡
english: One: the first number and the foundation of all countings.

amharic: አንደኛው መዠመሪያው መነሻው... የስም አገባብ ወይም ተውሳከ ስም ማለት ነው፡፡
english: The first, the beginning, or the definite article representing 'the one'.
The first one, or each one.

amharic: አንዱም አንዱም ራስ ራሱ አንዳንዱ ሰው፡፡
english: Each one, everyone, or one by one.
Individually, separately, or one by one.
For each one, for everyone, or individually.
One (feminine), single, or first.

amharic: አንዲቱ አንደኛይቱ መዠመሪያይቱ ወይም አንዷ አንደኛዋ መዠመሪያዋ፡፡
english: The one (feminine), the first one, or a single one.
One (feminine, in the objective case), a single one.
Together, in unity, or in one place.

amharic: አንድ ወገን አንድ ፊት ፩ እመም ገዝም ፩ አፍታ ፩ ውረራ ፩ ፈፋ ፩ አውራጃ ፩ ቃዳ ፩ ተለላ ፩ ትልም ፩ መዛሪያ ይህን የመሰለ ኹሉ፡፡
english: One side, direction, region, or fold.

amharic: አንድ ዕጥፍ አንድ እጅ አንድ ክፍል፡፡
english: A single fold, part, share, or portion.

amharic: አንድ የኾነ አንድ አንደኛ መዠመሪያ የዕለት ስም፡፡ በዕለተ እሑድ፡፡
english: Sunday: the first day of the week, meaning first or one.
Unity, oneness, or collaboration.
Once, or one time.
To be united, combined, or joined together as one.

amharic: መወንደም ወንድም ማድረግ መሳብ ማቅረብ ወንድሜ ወንድሜ ማለት
english: To treat someone as a brother, draw close to someone, or call them a brother.

amharic: ወንድም ወልደ እምየኖት ያባት ልጅ ባባትና በናት የሚገጥም በትዘይበት ተዘርቶ በበቀሉበት የበቀለ ወይም ያባት ልጅ ብቻ የናት ልጅ ብቻ እኩል ወንድም፡፡ የቅርብ ዘመድ ወገን ነገድ ባልንጀራ ወዳጅ ዐብሮ አደግ ያገር ልጅ፡፡ መናኒ ረድእ ባሕታዊ መነኵሴ፡፡
english: A brother, sibling, close relative, companion, friend, or a monk.

amharic: ውንድምነት ከዊነ እኁ ዝምድና ፅሪና ሱታፌነት፡፡
english: Brotherhood, close friendship, or a deep family relationship.
The state of being brothers, or the honorary status of brotherhood.

amharic: በቁሙ ቀጠረ ጀጐለ ከበበ ዙሪያውን ዘጋ፡፡
english: To build a fence, enclose, surround, or block a space.
A spiritual offering, sacrifice, gift, or firstfruits.

amharic: የመጽሐፍ ስም የሃይማኖት መጽሐፍ፡፡ ባለሊቃውንቶች መጽሐፈ ክፍል ወተዋሕዶ ዘትሥልስት ወዘተዋሕድ ክምቹ ማለት ነው ይላሉ፡፡
english: The name of a sacred theological book containing collections of religious writings.

amharic: ምን፡ ምንድር፡ ማን፡ ማንኛው፡ ማናቸው፡ የቱ፡ የትኛው፡፡
english: An interrogative word meaning what, who, or which one.

amharic: ምኖች ምንድሮች ማናቸዎች የችኞቹ እኔቶች እነማን እንዴት ያሉ፡፡
english: The plural form of who or what, meaning 'which ones,' 'who,' or 'what kinds of things.'

amharic: የበግ ጠቦት ወጠጤ ተባት ቀንዳ መለከት በዓለ ኅምሳ ከ፯ ሱባዔ ወይም ካ፵፱፡፡ ዓመት በኋላ ዐምሳኛው ዓመት ብዙ ጠቦት የሚሠዋበት ቀንዳ መለከት የሚነፋበት
english: The Jubilee, a special celebration every fiftieth year marked by the blowing of a ram's horn trumpet.

amharic: ስመ ሀገር የጋድ ርስት ሮቤልና ጋድ ሲማረኩ ሞአብ የወረሳት፡፡
english: The name of an ancient city or region historically associated with the inheritance of Gad.

amharic: ማጥፋት መደምሰስ መድፈን መቅበር መስጠም የጐርፍ የዝናም የማዕበል፡፡
english: To submerge, bury, drown, or destroy, especially by heavy rain or a flood.

amharic: ወረደ ከላይ ከሰማይ መጣ ዘነመ ፈሰሰ፡፡
english: To descend from above, fall from heaven like rain, or flow.

amharic: ጥፋት መጥመት የዝናም የጐርፍ የባሕር አደጋ ታላቅ ብርቱ ዝናም ዝናመ መዐት ከልክ ያለፈ የተረፈ ዝናመ ኖኅ፡፡ ማየ አይኅ፡፡
english: A great flood, deluge, torrential rain, or a natural water disaster like the great flood of Noah.
Something submerged, swept away, or destroyed by rain and floodwaters.
To resemble, match, equal, or become a likeness of something.

amharic: አምሳል አምሳያ አንጻር እኩያ አብነት መምህር መልክ ግብር፡፡
english: A likeness, peer, role model, exemplary teacher, or resemblance.

amharic: የማር እንጀራ አምሳል ዕንጐቻ በማር በስኳር የሚሠራ፡፡ የማር አምሳል ማር ማር በለስ ወይን ተምር ስኳር የመሰለው ኹሉ፡፡
english: A honey cake, honeycomb, or any sweet food resembling honey.

amharic: በቁሙ የወንድም ያጎት ሚስት የእኅትና ያክሥት ምሳሌ ባሏ አይዋ አያ የሚባል፡፡
english: A female relative by marriage, such as an aunt or a sister-in-law.
To be compared, matched, or made similar to something else.

amharic: ስመ ሳድስ ወርኅ ዕብራዊ የዕብራውያን ስድስተኛ ወር ከሚያዝያ ይኽውም መስከረም፡፡
english: The Hebrew month of Elul, corresponding approximately to September.

amharic: የመሣሪያ ስም ኮክም ክብርት ክብረት የሚሠራ የፍም መጫሪያ መተርኮሻ ያመድ የጕድፍ መጋፍያ መዛቂያ ማፈሻ ሥራው እንደ መንካና እንደ ላይዳ እንዳካፋ ያለ
english: A shovel, pan, or container used for carrying embers, scraping ash, or clearing dust.
To pamper, look after tenderly, comfort, or make comfortable.

amharic: ተከበከበ ደላው ተመቸው ባለጤና ኾነ ዕረፍት አገኘ፡፡
english: To find rest, feel comfortable, be well-cared for, or be in good health.

amharic: ሥዕል መልክአ ሥዕል በእጅ የተሣለ የተመሰለ፡፡
english: A sacred icon, painted portrait, or holy image.

amharic: በቁሙ ኅዋ ክፍት ከምድር በላይ ከጠፈር በታች ባዶው መካከሉ፡፡ ርጉዕ ነፋስ በአየር የመላ የተመላ፡፡
english: The air, atmosphere, or open sky between the earth and space.
Relating to the air, wind, atmosphere, or the upper sky.

amharic: ሰማይ ከጠፈር እስከ መንበር ያለው ሰባቱ ኹሉ ጠፈርና ኅዋም ሳይቀሩ፡፡
english: The high heavens, the sky, or the celestial sphere encompassing the stars and space.
Iyar, the second month of the Hebrew calendar, corresponding to May.

amharic: ብሩህ ሰማይ ከጠፈር በላይ ከራማ በታች ያለ፡፡ ኤረር ራማ ኢዮር እሊህ ሦስቱ ዓለመ መላእክት ይባላሉ፡፡
english: A bright, beautiful layer of heaven located above the firmament, associated with angels.

amharic: ስመ ሀገር የዳዊት መዲና የልጆቹ ኹሉ መናገሻ በምድረ ይሁዳ ያለች ጥንታዊት ከተማ፡፡
english: Jerusalem, the historic city of peace and capital of Judea.

amharic: ዐምስተኛ ሰማይ ከጠፈር ዲያቢሎስ የተፈጠረባት ርሱ ከሸፈተ በኋላ ለአዳም ልጆች የተሰጠች
english: The Heavenly Jerusalem, described as a spiritual city in the heavens.

amharic: መዛበር መጨነቅ መዋለል መስነፍ መድከም መዛል ተስፋ መቍረጥ የበሽተኛ የሐዘንተኝ፡፡
english: To feel weary, exhausted, anxious, or to lose hope due to sickness or sadness.

amharic: ስመ ተጻውዖ ዐማኑኤልን የመሰለ፡፡ መድኅን መድኅኒ መድኃኒት ቤዛ መቤዝው
english: Jesus, a holy name meaning 'Savior,' 'Redeemer,' or 'Healer.'

amharic: ዕንቍ የዕንቍ ስም ሕብሩ ሕብረ ሰማይ ጽሩይ ቅዛዝ መስታዮት የሚመስል
english: Jasper, a beautiful sky-blue gemstone that is clear and reflective like a mirror.

amharic: ቃለ ጥያቄ ንኡስ አገባብ አገባብነቱም የቦታ፡፡ ፍችው ሔት ዬት ወዴት ወደዜት፡፡
english: An interrogative word of place meaning 'where' or 'to where.'

amharic: መሸፈጥ ዐሎ ማለት ጽድቁን ባሉታ መለወጥ፡፡
english: To act falsely, rebel, deny, or twist truth into falsehood.

amharic: አስረጅ ና እንደ ባሕቱ በፊትም በኋላም ይገባል፡፡
english: A rhetorical or affirmative word meaning 'is it not?' or 'surely.'
A bright green or leaf-green color.

amharic: ዕንቍ የዕንቍ ስም ካ፲፪ቱ አዕናቍ አንዱ
english: Agate, one of the twelve precious biblical gemstones.

amharic: መክፋት መባስ ክፉ መጥፎ መኾን የጠባይ የደዌ የመልክ፡፡
english: To become bad, worsen, or grow ugly in character, health, or appearance.

amharic: መስፋት መገነን የለምጽ የቍስል የክፉ ነገር፡፡
english: The spreading or worsening of an illness, sore, or evil thing.

amharic: መብዛት ካሥር ማለፍ ካያ መኾን መባል ከኻያ መክፈል
english: To increase, exceed ten, or reach up to twenty.
Evil, bad, or wicked.

amharic: ክፋት ክፉነት መጥፎነት ልግም ተንኰል የተንኰል ሥራ፡፡
english: Wickedness, bad behavior, or a mean trick.

amharic: አከፋ አባሰ አስከፋ አስባሰ ክፉ አደረገ አስደረገ አስተነኰለ፡፡
english: To spoil, make bad, make evil, or cause harm and distress.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ አከፋ አክፋፋ አጥላላ ናቀ ነቀፈ አቃለለ ቢያክ ቢያክ አለ አብዝቶ መላልሶ ፈጽሞ፡፡
english: To criticize, belittle, mock, or continuously make something worse.
To become mutual rivals, feel sad, grow bitter, or despise one another.

amharic: የምስጋና ቃል ጳጳስ ኤጲስቆጶስ ሲሾም የሚባል፡፡ ፅሦ ፅሦ ይበጅ ያድርግ ሹመት ያዳብር እንደ ማለት፡፡
english: A Greek-derived word of praise meaning 'worthy', shouted during the ordination of bishops.

amharic: መብል ምግብ ሲሳይ የበሰለ የተዘጋጀ እንጀራ ወጥ፡፡
english: Food, nourishment, sustenance, or a prepared meal of bread and stew.

amharic: ማከል መተካከል እኩያ አምሳያ መኾን ሌላውን፡፡
english: To match, equal, resemble, or be similar to another.

amharic: ማመስገን መባረክ መመረቅ መየበብ ምስጋና ማቅረብ ማገልገል በእጅ በቃል፡፡
english: To praise, thank, bless, or express gratitude with words and deeds.
A thankful person, or one who offers praise and thanks.
To give thanks, praise, or bless.
To cause or inspire others to thank, praise, or bless.
One who inspires or causes others to give thanks and praise.
To be praised, thanked, or blessed.
Praise, thanksgiving, or acts of service and devotion.

amharic: ጸጋ ሀብት ስርየት በጥምቀት በቍርባን በንስሓ የሚሰጥ፡፡
english: Divine grace, spiritual blessing, or forgiveness granted through sacraments.

amharic: የስም ተውሳክ ከስም ጋራ የሚጨመር ቃል፡፡
english: A word prefix or article (like the Arabic 'al-') used to define a noun.

amharic: እንጂ ግን ዋዌ ዳግመኛ ስ ይኾናል እንጂ ና ግን መደበኞች የቀሩት ትርፎች ናቸው፡፡
english: A conjunction meaning 'but,' 'except,' 'rather,' or 'instead.'

amharic: ቅጽልና በቂ አብዢ የ እነ፡፡ ወቦ እለ ወረዱ፡፡
english: A plural relative pronoun meaning 'those who' or 'the ones who.'

amharic: የብዙ ወንዶች ቅጽልና ዐጸፋ እሊህ እኒህ እነዚህ እሊሆች እሊኾኞች፡፡
english: A plural demonstrative pronoun meaning 'these' (for masculine subjects).

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ የብዙ ሴቶች ቅጽልና ዐጸፋ ወንዶቹም ሴቶቹም ቅርቦች ናቸው፡፡
english: A plural demonstrative pronoun meaning 'these' (for feminine subjects).

amharic: ቃለ ብካይ ወዕውያት ቃለ ወመዐት ወዮ ቃይታ ወዮታ፡፡
english: An exclamation of sorrow, pain, or warning meaning 'Woe!' or 'Alas!'

amharic: ናስ ግንብ ዐምድ አምላከ ፈጣሪ ኤሎሄን ተመልከት፡፡
english: A pillar, tower, or column; also used to refer to God or the Creator.
A word meaning 'there is none,' 'is not,' or 'does not exist.'
A word meaning 'he has not,' 'it is not in him,' or 'does not belong to him.'

amharic: እል የዐረብ ተውሳከ ፓቴር አብ ኢሞንነ በተገናኘ አቡነ ማለት ነው፡፡
english: A phrase meaning 'Our Father' or referring to the Lord's Prayer.

amharic: የሽቱ ብልቃጥ የብርሌ የብርጭቆ ዐይነት ጥሩ ሽቱ ያለበትና የመላበት እንዳይተነፍስ ታትሞ ተገጥሞ የሚኖር
english: An alabaster jar or precious vial used to hold valuable perfumes.

amharic: ስመ ነገድ ለብቻቸው ፊደልና ቋንቋ ያላቸው መጣፉና የሚማሩ አምልኳቸው ከሰላም ከክርስቲያን የተለየ ሌላ ፩ ዐይነት ሕዝብ፡፡
english: The name of an ancient tribe or community with its own distinct language and script.

amharic: መልቀም መሰብሰብ መከመር መካብ መደርደር በላይ በላዩ መጨመር ካንድ ላይ መቄለል መጐቸት ማከማቸት
english: To gather, collect, pile up, or stack things on top of one another.
A person who gathers, collects, or stacks items.
Something gathered, collected, or piled up in a neat stack.
A storehouse, reservoir, or gathering place for items or water.

amharic: በቁሙ የመጽሐፍ ስም ዐጭር ቍርጭኝ ቅጽ ቃሉ ከብዙ መጻሕፍት ተለቅሞ ለብቻው የተጣፈ መጣፍ እንደ ፍትሕ ነገሥት እንደ ሃይማኖት አበው ያለ
english: A compendium, digest, or collection of selected religious texts compiled in one book.

amharic: በቁሙ የገንዘብ ስም ወርቅ ብር ስመ ንጉሥ መልከእ ንጉሥ ያለበት ግማሽ እኩሌታ ገንዘብ ምሉ ያይዶለ፡፡
english: An ancient coin, often representing a half-piece of money, featuring the face of a king.

amharic: ስመ ሀገር አዳምና ሔዋን የተፈጠሩበት ማእከለ ምድር ጉባኤ ኵሉ ምእላደ ኵሉ ማለት ነው፡፡
english: The legendary land or central region of the earth associated with the creation of Adam and Eve.

amharic: የቀኖት ስም ኹለተኛ ቀኖት የቀኝ እጅ፡፡
english: A term historically referring to the right hand or the right-hand side.

amharic: የግሪክ አገር ስም መላው፡፡ አንድ ታላቅ ደሴት በግሪክ አገር ውስጥ ያለ
english: Hellas, referring to Greece or the Greek islands.
A sacred title meaning 'God' or 'the Almighty.'
A prayerful expression meaning 'My God' or 'My Creator.'

amharic: ዘይታም መካነ ዘይት፡፡ ደብር ዘስሙ ኤሌዎን
english: An olive grove, or a direct reference to the Mount of Olives.
The name of a traditional game or amusement.

amharic: የተክል ዛፍ ስም ቁመቱ ረዥም ቅጠሉ ሰፋፊ ፍሬው መድኀኒት የሚኾን
english: A tall tree with broad leaves whose fruit is used for medicine.

amharic: የመርከብ ዐምድ ምሰሶ ወፍራም ረዥም የሸራና ያላማ መስቀያ
english: A thick, tall mast of a ship used to hold sails and flags.
A very tall, strong, robust, or giant-like person.
A sea eagle or osprey that dives to catch fish.

amharic: ዕፀ ዘይት ፍሬ ዘይት ቅብዐ ዘይት፡፡
english: An olive tree, its fruit, or the olive oil extracted from it.

amharic: ቅጽልና ዐጸፋ ለቅርብ ሩቆች ወንዶችና ሴቶች፡፡ እሊያ እሊያኞች እሊያኞቹ፡፡
english: A demonstrative pronoun meaning 'those ones over there' (for both male and female groups).

amharic: መሻት መፈለግ አይቴ ቤተ ዘማ ማለት ማመንዘር መቀንዘር መዝለል መከመር የተባት፡፡ እልል ማለት እንቍራሪትኛ መጮኽ የእንስት፡፡
english: To seek eagerly, yearn, jump with excitement, or make joyful shouting sounds.

amharic: የፈረስ ወይም ያህያ ስም፤ ያለ አቅም ሆድ መሙላት።
english: A wild horse or donkey; it can also mean eating too much until one's tummy is completely full.

amharic: በታላቅ ቤት ደጃፍ ወይም በቅጥሩ በር የሚሠራ በረንዳ።
english: A porch or veranda built at the entrance of a large house, palace, or gate.

amharic: አምላኬን አምላኪ፤ በታላቅ ጩኸት አምላክን መጥራት።
english: A worshipper of God, or the act of calling out to God with a loud voice during prayer.
Salt or salty water.

amharic: እንደ ባንባና ዋርካ ያለ ታላቅ ዛፍ፤ መቅዘፊያ የሚሆን የባሳን ዛፍ።
english: A very large tree, like an oak or wild fig, whose strong wood is used to carve boat paddles.

amharic: መማር፣ ፊደል መቁጠር፣ ማብዛት ወይም እልፍ ማድረግ።
english: Learning, counting letters of the alphabet, or multiplying things to make them numerous.
A student who is learning the alphabet and counting letters.
To teach someone the alphabet, to make them count, or to multiply something.
To be counted, to multiply, or to become very numerous.
Abundant, multiplied, or very numerous.

amharic: አስር ሺህ (10,000) ወይም መቶ ጊዜ መቶ።
english: Ten thousand; a very large number.
Thousands of ten-thousands; hundreds of thousands; a massive crowd.

amharic: ታላቅ ብዛት፣ አስር ሚሊዮን ወይም እልፍ ጊዜ ሺሕ።
english: Ten million; a huge number that represents an immense, uncountable crowd.

amharic: መቶ ሚሊዮን፣ ስፍር ቁጥር የሌለው እጅግ ብዙ።
english: One hundred million; an uncountable amount like the sand on a beach or stars in the sky.

amharic: የመጀመሪያው ፊደል (አ)፤ የበሬ ራስ፤ መጀመሪያ፣ ጥንት።
english: The first letter of the alphabet, symbolizing the head of an ox; it means the first, beginning, or origin.
The twenty-two letters of the ancient alphabet, named after the first letter.
A name of God meaning the Beginning or the First, often referring to Christ.
The historical land of the Philistines, located by the Mediterranean Sea.
A Philistine person; someone native to the land of Philistia.
Church gatekeepers or doorkeepers who welcome visitors and protect the doors of a sacred place.
Salt, or a very salty body of water like the Dead Sea.
A grapevine branch, vine shoot, or sprout.

amharic: እንደ መብረቅ የሚበራ፣ የሚያንጸባርቅና ዐይን የሚያፈዝ ብርሃን።
english: Something that flashes or sparkles brightly like lightning, shining so bright it dazzles the eyes.
Something that bites, snaps, or clashes together.

amharic: የዱባ ወገን የሆነ ተክል ተራ ቁጥቋጦ።
english: A type of climbing plant related to pumpkins or squashes.

amharic: በውሃ ውስጥ የምትኖር ደም መጣጭ ትል፣ አለቀት።
english: A leech; a small worm-like creature that lives in water.

amharic: ብዙ ደሴቶች ያሉበት የሀገርና የወገን ስም (ኤሊሻ)።
english: An ancient historical land or region known for having many beautiful islands.
"El Shaddai," a title of God meaning Almighty and All-Powerful.

amharic: የሾርባ ወይም የወጥ መሠረት የሆነ ሥረ ወጥ።
english: A base or root ingredient used to make soup or stew.
Truly, in absolute truth, or verily.
At the time of, when, or during.
Time, hour, season, or period.
At that very moment, then, or quickly.
From, out of, or because of.
A pillar, column, or strong vertical support.
Completely, entirely, or all together.
A horse race or the galloping of horses.
Lands, territories, or countries.
From then on, or after that.
A grandfather, grandmother, or an ancestor.

amharic: እጅ መንሳት፣ መስገድ፣ መሳለም፣ ሰላምታ መስጠት።
english: To greet warmly, bow down in respect, kiss hands, or pay homage.
A person who greets, bows, pays respect, or welcomes others.
To cause someone to greet, pay respect, or give a gift.
To be greeted respectfully or to receive a warm welcome.
A respectful greeting, bow, or gesture of honor.
A warm greeting or expression of love and peace.
To greet one another, shake hands, hug, or say goodbye.
A thorny bush, thistle, or prickly wild plant.
God, Lord, Creator, or Ruler.
To feel sick, cry out; or to care for someone like a mother.

amharic: ፊት ለፊት አቅንቶ የሚሠራ፣ ጠንካራ ሥራ።
english: Someone who works directly and straightforwardly; also means a mountain gorge.
A capital city or a major metropolis.
The lady of the house, matriarch, or hostess who manages a home.
Eve, known as the mother of all living humans.
The grave, metaphorically called the final resting place of everyone.
An Abbess or Mother Superior who leads a convent of nuns.
Mothers.
If, when, although, or perhaps.
Believing, trusting, confessing faith, or speaking the truth.
A believer, a faithful person, or a devout follower.
To convince, lead someone to faith, or teach belief.
To be trusted, to be faithful, or to prove reliable.
Trustworthy, faithful, reliable, or true.
Truly, faithfully, or without fear and doubt.
Faith, belief, trust, or religion.
Truth, or truly; something that is factual and real.
Real, true, genuine, or spiritual rather than physical.
"Truly my word" or "by my truth," used as a promise.
A believer, a faithful person, or a trustworthy companion.
To trust one another or to make a mutual promise.
To assure someone, build mutual trust, or help negotiate a promise.
Amen; "let it be so" or "it is true."
From, or from us.

amharic: አማኑኤል፣ አምላክ ከእኛ ጋር ሆነ ማለት ነው።
english: "Immanuel," meaning "God is with us."
God (derived from Coptic meaning the Lord).
A follower of Mani (a Manichaean), who taught that the physical world is an illusion.
A prayer meaning "Remember me, O Lord, in Your kingdom."
They or those (masculine).
They or those (feminine).
A threshold, doorstep, or landing at a doorway.
To point out, show, guide, or perform miracles.
An indicator, advisor, or guide who points things out.
To cause someone to see, to signpost, or to make signs and wonders.
Noted, distinguished, marked, or well-known.
An indication, reference, pointing gesture, or sign.
A sign, symbol, miracle, or wonderful token.
A miracle; an amazing, divine wonder that shows God's power.
An instrument used to point out, show, or indicate something.
A day, the sun, a specific date, or a season.
To know, understand, find out, or show love.
A female singer, poetess, or the musical strings of a harp.
A knowledgeable, wise person who understands hidden things.
Understanding, wisdom, intellect, or knowledge.
To be known, understood, or revealed clearly.

amharic: ማወቅ መታወቅ አስተዋወቅ ዕውቂያ ዕውቀት ዐዋቂነት፡፡
english: Knowledge, recognition, awareness, or the act of knowing.
To become acquainted, make friends, or share mutual affection.
To introduce people to one another or help them become friends.

amharic: ንዋየ ማሕሌት በገና ክራር ባለ፰ አውታር፡፡
english: An ancient eight-stringed musical instrument, like a harp or lyre, used for sacred songs.
The sixth month in the ancient Coptic calendar, corresponding to February.

amharic: ማወቅ መገመት ማሰብ መገምገም የዋጋ የነገር፡፡ መከንዳት በእጅ መስፈር መለካት በጣት ማሳየት ማመልከት፡፡ መግዛት መቅጠር አገልጋይ ማድረግ የሴት ልጅ፡፡
english: To estimate, calculate, measure with the arms or fingers, or to evaluate value.
To be estimated, measured, or calculated in cubits.
Estimated or measured in cubits.
The act or method of measuring something in cubits.

amharic: ክንድ ከክርን እስከ ታላቅ ጣት ጫፍ ያለው ኹለት ክፍል፡፡
english: A cubit; an ancient unit of measurement equal to the length of a forearm from the elbow to the tip of the middle finger.
A female servant or handmaid.
Amethyst; a precious purple gemstone mentioned in ancient texts.

amharic: በስምና በአካል ፈንታ የሚነገር፡፡ እኔ ራሴ፡፡
english: The personal pronoun meaning 'I' or 'myself'.
An ancient grammatical prefix used to show action or the state of being acted upon.
A grammatical helper word or particle used to connect other words.
Because of, concerning, or about.
Without, except, or excluding.
An expression of doubt, surprise, or inquiry, meaning 'who knows?' or 'indeed?'
An expression meaning 'I do not know' or 'who knows?'
While, when, or as (used to describe actions happening at the same time).
Therefore, then, or from now on.
An expression of joy, congratulations, or gratitude, similar to 'how wonderful!' or 'welcome!'
A grammatical helper word meaning 'who', 'which', or 'of' for feminine nouns.

amharic: የልክ ስም ታናሽ ገንቦ የርጥብ መሰፈሪያ መሣሪያ፡፡
english: An ancient dry or liquid measurement vessel, like a small jar.
To cause something to shine or flash brightly.
To roar, rumble, or bubble like rushing water.
To yawn.
A locust or grasshopper.
An expression of refusal meaning 'no', 'I refuse', or 'I do not agree'.
An exclamation expressing deep sorrow, regret, anger, or frustration.
Because of, on account of, or due to.

amharic: ታላቅ ዋሽንት ውስጠ ክፍት ነገሥታት መኳንንት ሲጓዙ የሚነፍቱት፡፡
english: An ancient long flute or trumpet played during royal ceremonies and processions.
A lion; a powerful wild cat known as the king of the jungle.

amharic: የነገሥታት ወገን ተቀማጭ ሥራ ፈት ድልድል ቅምጥል፡፡
english: A pampered royal person or someone living a very comfortable, quiet life.
Of noble or royal descent; belonging to a distinguished family.
A large bird of prey, similar to a vulture or an eagle.
To wander, roam, or go around aimlessly.
To wander off, stray, or lose one's way.
A guest, visitor, or traveler from another place.
The chest or breast of a person or animal.
An assembly, council meeting, or community gathering.
A church reader or assistant in ancient times.
Relating to a sacred reader or church lector.
The marrow, kernel, or soft inner core of a bone or seed.
A sweet-smelling leaf or aromatic herb used for its pleasant fragrance.

amharic: ማሰር ማጥበቅ አንድ ማድረግ፡፡ መጠፈር መጐለብ ቄርበት ማልበስ መደጐስ መሸለም ማስጌጥ የከበሮና የመጣፍ፡፡
english: To bind, tighten, cover with leather, or beautifully decorate a book or drum.
An animal hide, leather skin, or a strap used for binding.
The number one; representing single unity.
A plant or animal of mixed breed or lineage.
An expression meaning 'I don't know' or 'who can say?'.
An ancient fifteen-year time cycle used for calendar calculations.
A traditional wind instrument, like a flute or pipe.
A person who wanders around slowly or lazily; a slacker.
To lengthen, extend, or make something long.

amharic: የታች ታች መጨረሻ ታች ሲኦል ገሃነም፡፡
english: The deepest abyss, underworld, or a very low place.

amharic: አፅራረ ማርያም በማርያም ድንግልና ላይ እንደ አይሁድ ክፉ የሚያወሩ የሚናገሩ፡፡
english: An ancient term for critics who spoke against the virginity of Mary.
Onyx; a precious layered gemstone used in ancient jewelry.
A stone-crushing tool or a heavy hammer.
To admire, marvel at, wonder, or praise.

amharic: የመጽሐፍ ስም ኢጲፋንዮስ የጻፈው፡፡ መልሕቅ መልሕቃዊ ማለት ነው፡፡
english: 'Ancoratus' (The Anchored One); an ancient theological book written by Saint Epiphanius.
To roll down, tumble, or flip something over.

amharic: የሽቱ ቅጠል የባሕር ዛጐል መልካም ሽታ ያለው፡፡
english: Onycha; an aromatic sea shell or herb used to make sweet-smelling incense.

amharic: መዘርጋት ማጋደም ድሩን ዝሓውን፤ መሥራት መታታት ማቄላለፍ መስፋት መጥለፍ የፈትል የልብስ፡፡
english: To weave, spin thread, sew, or design fabrics.
A weaver, tailor, or person who embroiders beautiful fabrics.

amharic: የልብስ የፈትል ሥራ ትት ስፌት ጥልፍ ዝምዝማት ያንገትጌ የእጅጌ፡፡
english: Woven work, needlework, or fine embroidery on clothes.

amharic: ምሥሪያ መሣሪያ የሰፊ የጠላፊ የሸማኔ ዕቃ፡፡
english: A tool or instrument used for weaving, sewing, or spinning cloth.
A workshop or pit where a weaver operates a traditional loom.
To have someone weave, sew, or embroider cloth.
To be woven, sewn, or embroidered.

amharic: የተሠራ ሥር ሥረ ወጥ ጥልፍ ዝምዝም፡፡
english: A seamlessly woven, embroidered, or finely knitted garment.
Seed, offspring, or ancestral lineage.

amharic: ማናፋት በፍንጫ መጮኽ፤ መነፍነፍ፤ ማነፍነፍ ማሽተት፡፡
english: To sniff, snort, smell a scent, or blow through the nose.
The nose, used for smelling and breathing.
Noses or nostrils.

amharic: የሥልስ ወጭት ጻሕለ ኅጺን ወብርት ማኅተመ ኅብስት ኅብስት ገጽ የሚጋገርበት፡፡
english: A traditional metal pan or clay mold used for baking special loaves of bread.
A mouse or a rat.
Directly opposite, facing, or in front of.

amharic: መጮኽ ማኖቅኖቅ መንሰቅሰቅ የልቅሶ የጭንቅ፤ መንጠቅ መመንጠቅ መቀማት፡፡
english: To sob and weep in distress, or to snatch and seize something away.
A bird of prey, such as a hawk, falcon, or kite.
An ancient regional territory or city mentioned in historical texts.
A gate, doorway, or entry portal; can also mean a grammatical chapter or section.
An egg.
The uvula or throat area.
Honeycomb or bee bread made by bees to store honey.
Ancyra (modern Ankara); an ancient city mentioned in historical records.

amharic: ሰው መኾን አካል መግዛት፤ መፀነስ መወለድ፤ ማነስ ታናሽ መኾን፡፡
english: To become human, take bodily form, be born, or to grow smaller.
Smaller, junior, lesser, or a younger follower.
A man, youth, or strong male person.
Men, males, or human beings.
A woman, wife, or female.
Women or wives.

amharic: ወደ ወጡበት መመልስ መግባት ። መስማት እህ ማለት።
english: To return to where one came from, to enter, or to listen and respond with 'uh'.

amharic: ማበድ መቈጣት አእምሮ ማጣት መወግሸት መነሣሣት አፈና አፈና ወፈፍ ወፈፍ ማለት መስነፍ ሞኝ አላዋቂ መኾን መጥፋት መበላሸት የልብ የናላ።
english: To act foolishly, lose one's temper, or lack wisdom and clear judgment.

amharic: የመጽሐፍ ስም ሦስተኛው የሐዋርያት ሲኖዶስ። ፍችው ቀኖና ነው ።
english: The name of a specific book, the third Council of the Apostles, representing church rules or canons.

amharic: እንቢ ማለት አበያ እንቢተኛ መኾን መጓደድ የሰጡትንና የያዙትን የለመኑትን አለመቀበል አለመስማማት አለማድረግ ዕሺ በጎ ይኹን አለማለት።
english: To refuse, to be stubborn, to disagree, or to decline a request.

amharic: እንቢ ተባባለ በፈቃደ በግብር ተለያየ ተጣላ ተፈራረቀ አንድነት ስምምነት ዐጣ።
english: To disagree with one another, to argue, or to lack unity and harmony.

geez: አብየ ወፈረ ላቀ ዐብየ አቢል ሎት
english: To become strong, steady, and to grow or increase over time.

amharic: የገንዘብ ስም ታናሽ ገንዘብ ፭ ሳንቲም ።
english: The name of a small currency or coin.

amharic: ሽቱ የሽቱ ስም ቅመም ቀረፋ የጢስ ዕንቀጨት ቅጠላም ያይዶለ።
english: A fragrant spice, such as cinnamon, used for incense or scent.
A male child or son.
Stones or rocks.

amharic: በቁሙ ጸበል ትቢያ ዐቧራ ቅንቅን በነፋስ የሚባን ደቃቅ ነገር ኹሉ፡፡
english: Dust, fine powder, or tiny particles carried by the wind.
The name of a prophetic book of revelations or visions.
An extra amount, an addition, or a mathematical correction.

amharic: ማብላት ማጥገብ መቀለብ መመገብ ማሥባት ማወፈር ከብትን ሰውነትን ወይም ማበስ መበደል ኅጢአት መሥራት ።
english: To feed and fatten, or to commit a mistake, sin, or offense.
One who causes others to sin or leads them into trouble.

amharic: የፍታት ቃል የፍታት ሥርዐት ናዛዥ ለተናዛዥ የሚያሰማው ቃል ።
english: A prayer of absolution, forgiveness, or a ritual of release.

amharic: ማበት ሸብ ማድረግ ወይም መማገር አጥብቆ ማሰር ።
english: To tie tightly, bind, or secure something firmly.

amharic: በቁሙ ማገድ መከልከል መግታት። መስበር መቀልጠም መክፈል መለያየት የሥጋና ያጥንት።
english: To block, stop, prevent, or to separate and break apart.

amharic: መቍረጥ መክፈል ማሥመር የሊጥ መገመት ይህን ያኽል ማለት የዋጋ።
english: To cut, measure, or determine the price or value of something.

amharic: መኼድ መራመድ መሮጥ መፈርጠጥ እግራም እግረኛ መኾን፡፡ በቁሙ ማገር መገርገር ማወክ መከልከል ከመንገድ ከሥራ ማስተጓጐል፡፡
english: The act of walking, running, or moving; it can also mean to block, obstruct, or hinder someone from their work or journey.

amharic: መሸከም መጫን ማንገት ማዘል መደብለል ተሸካሚ መኾን በዠርባ፡፡ በቁሙ ማደግ መመንደግ ቁመትና ጐን መጨመር ለሸክም ለጭነት መብቃት የሰው የከብት፡፡
english: To carry, load, or shoulder a burden on one's back; also refers to growing in height and size, or becoming strong enough to carry heavy loads.

amharic: መጥረግ፡ መጋፍ፡ መግፋት፡ ማስገለል፡ መኰስተር መሰብሰብ፡ ዐፍሦ፡ መጣል፡ መወርወር፡ ማሽቀንጠር፡ የጕድፍ፡፡
english: To sweep, push away, gather, cast out, or throw away waste and debris.
Hands, limbs, or wings; parts of the body used for holding or moving.
The four sides of a person: front, back, right, and left.

amharic: መወንደም ወንድም ማድረግ መሳብ ማቅረብ ወንድሜ ወንድሜ ማለት፡፡
english: The act of treating someone as a brother, bringing them close, or calling them brother.

amharic: ወንድም ወልደ እምየኖት ያባት ልጅ ባባትና በናት የሚገጥም በትዘይበት ተዘርቶ በበቀሉበት የበቀለ ወይም ያባት ልጅ ብቻ የናት ልጅ ብቻ እኩል ወንድም፡፡
english: A brother, close relative, or someone who shares a common origin; also refers to a companion or friend.

amharic: ማጥፋት መደምሰስ መድፈን መቅበር መስጠም የጐርፍ የዝናም የማዕበል፡፡
english: To destroy, erase, cover up, or submerge, often used to describe the action of floods or waves.
Something that has been destroyed, submerged, or washed away by rain or water.
To resemble, match, or act as an equal likeness of something.

amharic: አምሳል አምሳያ አንጻር እኩያ አብነት መምህር መልክ ግብር፡፡
english: A likeness, model, equivalent, example, or image of someone or something.
To take care of, comfort, pamper, or make someone feel at ease.

amharic: መዛበር መጨነቅ መዋለል መስነፍ መድከም መዛል ተስፋ መቍረጥ የበሽተኛ የሐዘንተኝ፡፡
english: To become worried, tired, weak, discouraged, or to feel hopeless, often due to sickness or sadness.

amharic: ዕንቍ የዕንቍ ስም ሕብሩ ሕብረ ሰማይ ጽሩይ ቅዛዝ መስታዮት የሚመስል፡፡
english: Jasper, a type of clear, sky-colored, mirror-like precious stone.

amharic: መሸፈጥ ዐሎ ማለት ጽድቁን ባሉታ መለወጥ፡፡
english: To rebel, disagree, or stubbornly deny the truth.

amharic: መክፋት መባስ ክፉ መጥፎ መኾን የጠባይ የደዌ የመልክ፡፡
english: To become bad, evil, or worse, regarding behavior, illness, or appearance.

amharic: የምስጋና ቃል ጳጳስ ኤጲስቆጶስ ሲሾም የሚባል፡፡
english: An expression of praise and congratulation used during the ordination of a bishop.

amharic: ማመስገን መባረክ መመረቅ መየበብ ምስጋና ማቅረብ ማገልገል በእጅ በቃል፡፡
english: To thank, bless, praise, or show gratitude through words or service.
To cause someone else to give thanks or praise.

amharic: የብዙ ወንዶች ቅጽልና ዐጸፋ እሊህ እኒህ እነዚህ እሊሆች እሊኾኞች፡፡
english: These (plural, masculine reference).

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ የብዙ ሴቶች ቅጽልና ዐጸፋ ወንዶቹም ሴቶቹም ቅርቦች ናቸው፡፡
english: These (plural, feminine reference).

amharic: መልቀም መሰብሰብ መከመር መካብ መደርደር በላይ በላዩ መጨመር ካንድ ላይ መቄለል መጐቸት ማከማቸት፡፡
english: To gather, stack, pile up, or accumulate things together in one place.

amharic: የግሪክ አገር ስም መላው፡፡ አንድ ታላቅ ደሴት በግሪክ አገር ውስጥ ያለ፡፡
english: Hellas, the name for Greece or a large island within Greece.

geez: ኤሎሃ ሱር፡፡ ኢላህ ዐር፡፡ ኤል ዕብ፡፡
english: God (a sacred name used across ancient languages).

amharic: ቅጽልና ዐጸፋ ለቅርብ ሩቆች ወንዶችና ሴቶች፡፡ እሊያ እሊያኞች እሊያኞቹ፡፡
english: Those (referring to people or things at a distance).

amharic: መሻት መፈለግ አይቴ ቤተ ዘማ ማለት ማመንዘር መቀንዘር መዝለል መከመር የተባት፡፡ እልል ማለት እንቍራሪትኛ መጮኽ የእንስት፡፡
english: To desire, seek, or jump; it also refers to the joyous ululation sounds made by women.

amharic: ፊደል ስመ ፊደል እ፡፡ አሌፍ የዕብራይስጥ አልፍ የግእዝና የዐረብ አልፋ የጽርእ አጠራር ነው፡፡ አሌፍ ላም በሬ የቀንድ ከብት፡፡ አልፍ ፋ ቀንድ የበሬ ራስ፡፡ ምስጢሩ ቀዳማይ ርእስ በኵር ጥንት፡፡
english: The first letter of the alphabet; it symbolizes an ox, head, or beginning.
A grandparent or ancestor.

amharic: እጅ መንሣት ባንገት በወገብ በጕልበት መስገድ ጫማ ጕልበት እጅ መሳም መሳለም ሰላምታ እጅ መንሻ መስጠት ማቅረብ በቃል በእጅ፡፡
english: An act of showing deep respect, greeting, or bowing to someone.

amharic: ማመም መጮኽ መትመም፡፡ አማሚ ማኾን ያረም ያጨዳ የቍፋሮ፡፡ ማነት እናት ማድረግ እማማ ማለት፡፡
english: To feel pain or distress; also refers to motherhood or calling one's mother.

amharic: ማመን መቀበል ተስፋ ማድረግ ስለመጠራጠር መናዘዝ እውነት መናገር መመስከር እወ አማን ማለት፡፡
english: To believe, trust, have faith, or agree with truth.

amharic: በቁሙ ያመነ እማኒ የታመነ እሙን እውነተኛ ክርስቲያን ማመኛ መታመኛ እግዜር ዘመድ ወዳጅ ባልንጀር የማጠረጠር፡፡
english: A faithful, trustworthy, or loyal believer.
God or a divine being.

amharic: ማመልከት ማሳየት መጠቄም መጠንቄል ማንገር ማስተማር በእጅ በቃል፡፡ ታምራት ማድረግ፡፡
english: To show, point out, instruct, or perform a miracle.

amharic: መዓልት ፀሓይ መጋቤ መዓልት ዕለት ጊዜ ወራት አንድ፡፡
english: A day, time, or period of sunlight.

amharic: ማሳወቅ ማስረዳት፡፡ ልማዱ ግን ማወቅ መረዳት፡፡
english: To know, understand, or explain something clearly.
The sixth month of the Coptic calendar (February).

amharic: ማወቅ መገመት ማሰብ መገምገም የዋጋ የነገር፡፡ መከንዳት በእጅ መስፈር መለካት በጣት ማሳየት ማመልከት፡፡
english: To estimate, measure, calculate, or value something.

amharic: ነባር አንቀጽ እንቢታና አሉታ እንቢዮ እንቢኝ በቁሙ እንቢ አሻፈረኝ አልስማም አልቀበልም አይኾንም አይኹን፡፡
english: To refuse, say no, or disagree.

amharic: ማሰር ማጥበቅ አንድ ማድረግ ነዶ ማለት ከዚህ ወጥቷል፡፡ መጠፈር መጐለብ ቄርበት ማልበስ መደጐስ መሸለም ማስጌጥ፡፡
english: To bind, fasten, tie together, or decorate.

amharic: አፅራረ ማርያም በማርያም ድንግልና ላይ እንደ አይሁድ ክፉ የሚያወሩ የሚናገሩ፡፡
english: People who speak untruths or attack the beliefs regarding the Virgin Mary.

amharic: መዘርጋት ማጋደም ድሩን ዝሓውን በቁመት በኑኅ ማጉን ግራውን በወርድ፡፡ መሥራት መታታት ማቄላለፍ መስፋት መጥለፍ የፈትል የልብስ፡፡
english: To spread out, weave, or sew textiles.

amharic: አሠራ አሰፋ እስጢፋኖስ፡፡ አእነመ ላዕሌሁ አምሳለ ኪሩቤል፡፡
english: To construct, build, or sew something into a specific design.

amharic: ማናፋት በፍንጫ መጮኽ እንፍ ማለት መናፈጥ አፍንጫን መንፋት መቀብተት የጠብ የቍጣ፡፡
english: To sneeze or blow air through the nose, often as an expression of anger.

amharic: መጮኽ ማኖቅኖቅ መንሰቅሰቅ የልቅሶ የጭንቅ፡፡ መንጠቅ መመንጠቅ መቀማት መመንተፍ፡፡
english: To cry out, wail in distress, or snatch something away.

amharic: ሰው መኾን አካል መግዛት እንደ አዳምና እንደ ሔዋን ወንድ ተባት ሴት እንስት ኹኖ መፈጠር መገኘት፡፡
english: To be created, exist as a person, or become smaller.
Women or wives.

amharic: ሴታም ባለሴት ሴት ወዳድ ሴት አውል ጠባቂ ጐማዳ ለልብ ጃን ደረብ፡፡
english: Feminine, womanly, or related to a woman's nature.

amharic: የሴቶች ወገን ሴት እንስት የተባት ጓደኛ ኹለተኛ፡፡
english: Belonging to the group of women; feminine.
To cause to creep, crawl, or move stealthily.
The final intercalary days added at the end of the month of Nahase, known as Pagume.
A living creature that moves or walks.

amharic: የአነ ርባታ የቅርብ ወንድ በቂና ቅጽል፡፡
english: A personal pronoun meaning 'you' (singular, masculine).
A demonstrative pronoun meaning 'that one' (referring to a feminine object).
A term referring to something primary, previous, or that which was mentioned before.

amharic: የዱሮ የቀድሞ የጥንት ብዙ ዓመት የኖረ አሮጌ ብሉይ፡፡
english: Something very old, ancient, or from a long time ago.
To feel lazy, tired, sluggish, or to neglect one's duties.
To become bored, weary, or to be neglected and ignored.
The state of being lazy, idle, or neglectful.
A large measuring cup or container used for grains or liquids.

amharic: የገላ የቄርበት በሽታ ደዌ ሥጋ ዕበጥ ዕከክ ፈንጣጣ ቍስል መግል፡፡
english: A skin disease, sore, or infection causing boils, blisters, or scabs.
To follow behind, pursue, or track someone or something.

amharic: ፍለጋ ዱካ ርጋጭ መከየድ መንገድ ጥርጊያ ጐዳና ርምጃ አካኼድ አብነት፡፡
english: A footprint, trail, path, or the act of following in someone's footsteps.

amharic: የቅኔ ስም ለንጉሥ የሚሰጥ የዕጣነ ሞገር ተቀጥላ፡፡
english: A traditional honorary title or poetic name given to a king.
A wedding ceremony or a celebration of marriage.
To open or let out, often referring to releasing something from an opening.

amharic: የመሰፈሪያ ስም ታላቅ ቍና የሖሜር ዐሥረኛ፡፡
english: A traditional unit of measurement for dry goods, equal to one-tenth of a homer.
To dress oneself, wear, or gird oneself with special clothing.

amharic: ልብስ ተክህኖ ካህናት ኦሪት በተልእኮ ጊዜ የሚለብሱት ቀሚስ፡፡
english: A sacred priestly garment or robe worn by religious ministers during service.

amharic: መተንፈስ እፍ እፎይ ማለት መናገር አፍን መልቀቅ መክፈት ማፋሸግ ማዛጋት፡፡
english: To breathe, exhale, speak, open the mouth, or yawn.

amharic: የሚተነፍስ አፈኛ አፋም ለፍላፊ አፈ ሰፊ፡፡
english: Something or someone related to the mouth; talkative or expressive.

amharic: በከንፈርና በከንፈር መካከል ያለ ክፍት ኅዋ መተንፈሻና መናገሪያ የቃል የመብል የመጠጥ በር፡፡
english: The mouth; the opening used for breathing, speaking, eating, and drinking.

amharic: የምድጃ አፍ እሳቱ የሚገባበት ወይም የጢስ መውጫ፡፡
english: The opening of a furnace, stove, or oven through which fuel is added or smoke escapes.

amharic: ታናሽ ገንዘብ ስም፣ አንድ ዲድርክም ወይም የተወሰነ የጥንት የገንዘብ መለኪያ።
english: A name for a small unit of ancient money or currency.

amharic: መጽሐፍ የመጽሐፍ ስም፣ ራእይ ወይም ጥልቅ ትንቢታዊ መልእክት።
english: A book, specifically a book of visions or prophetic revelation.

amharic: የሰው የመጽሐፍ ስም ጽሩየ ቃል ነባቤ ቃል ጽሩይ፡፡
english: A name for a person with 'golden lips,' meaning they speak pure and wise words.

amharic: ራስጌ ዐንገትጌ እጅጌ እግርጌ የልብስ ክፍሎች።
english: The edges or hems of clothing like collars, sleeves, or cuffs.
The early morning, dawn, or the break of day.

amharic: በቁሙ ውጭ ዕዳሪ ደጅ በውጭ ያለ ባዕድ።

amharic: እንዴት እንደ ምን ምን ምንኛ ጥያቄ ወይም አድናቆት የሚገልጽ።
english: How, in what way, or a word used to express wonder or ask a question.

english: To turn, flip, change direction, or transform one's appearance or beliefs.

amharic: ቀለበት፣ የድንኳን ወይም የመጋረጃ ቍልፍ ማያያዣ።

amharic: ቄረጠ፣ ዐረደ፣ ቀረደደ፣ አስተካከለ፣ ወይም ያዘ።
english: To cut, trim, shape, or grasp something firmly.

amharic: የፊደል ስም፣ ፈ እፍ ማለት ነው።
english: The name of the Ge'ez letter 'Fa'.
Soil, earth, or dust.

amharic: የጥንት የወርቅ ሀገር፣ ወርቅ እንደ አሸዋ ይገኝባት የነበረች።
english: An ancient land or country historically famous for its abundant gold.
The Euphrates River, one of the great ancient rivers.
Africa.

amharic: ስመ ሀገር በታናሽ እስያ ውስጥ ያለች።
english: Ephesus, an ancient city located in Asia Minor.
A place for storing things, or a shelter for the sick.

amharic: ያንገት ጌጥ፣ እንደ ድሪና እንደ ማርዳ ያለ ጥሩ የወርቅ መሣሪያ።

amharic: የሙዚቃ መሣሪያ፣ ጣፋጭ ዜማ ወይም ምስጋና።

amharic: የሰው ስም፣ ከጥንት ነገሥታት ታሪክ ጋር የተያያዘ።

Relating to rice grain.

amharic: ታላቅና ረጅም የዛፍ ዓይነት እንደ ጥድ።

Clothing or the act of wearing clothes.

amharic: የኦሪት ሕግ ተከታይ ወይም የኦሪት መጽሐፍ።

amharic: ከአርዮስፋጎስ ጋር አንድ አይነት የፈላስፎች መሰብሰቢያ።

english: A person from Aram or a speaker of the Aramaic language.
The sixth month of the Hebrew calendar.

english: A person outside of a specific faith or culture; often described as unkind or heartless.

To cause something to be silent or still.

amharic: የአራም የግሪክ ወገን አሕዛብ አረመኔ ክፉ ጨካኝ እምነት ርኅራኄ የሌለው፡፡
english: A pagan or someone perceived as cruel and lacking compassion.

amharic: ስንት ምን ያኽል ሰፊን ሰፈነ ስፍን እስፍንት፡፡
english: How much? How many? An inquiry into amount or extent.

amharic: የፍልስፍና ስም ፈርዖን ለዮሴፍ ያወጣለት ከሣቴ ኅቡእ ማእምረ ኅቡኣት፡፡
english: A philosophical title given by Pharaoh to Joseph, meaning 'Revealer of hidden things'.
A name for a color resembling bright yellow or gold.

amharic: የወፍ በሽታ ሰውነት ወይባ የሚያስመስል ብጫ የሚያደርግ፡፡
english: A bird illness that causes yellowing of the body.

amharic: ብርቱ ትኵሳት ከልክ ከመጠን ያለፈ፡፡ የሆድ በሽታ ብጫ የሚያደርግ የሚያጠወልግ፡፡
english: An intense, excessive fever or a stomach illness that causes skin yellowing and weakness.
To have measured or surveyed in the previous year.

amharic: ክፍል ዕድል የሥጋ መቍነን አንድ ሙዳ ጉማ የልጃገረድ ጡት የሚያኽል፡፡
english: A measurement unit or portion representing a specific amount of weight or size.

amharic: ቅርጫት እንቅብ ወራንታ የእንቅብ የቀፎ የጐታ ዐይነት ከቀጫጭን ሐረግ ከለበቅ ከሽንበቆና ከቀርከሓ የሚሠራ፡፡
english: A basket or container made from woven reeds, twigs, or bamboo.

amharic: ጥሩ ሽቱ ከዕጣን ከከርቤ የሚወጣ ለትኵስ ሬሳ የሚቀባ ሬሳን እንዳይገማና እንዳይፈርስ እንዳይበሰብስ የሚያደርግ፡፡
english: A precious perfume or ointment used to preserve and scent the deceased.

amharic: በረሓ የበረሓ ስም በምድረ ግብጽ ውስጥ ያለ የመቃርዮስ ክፍል ገዳመ ሲሃት፡፡
english: A desert area in Egypt, historically known for its monasteries and hermits.
An astrolabe; a book of philosophy or the study of stars and the heavens.
A bishop; a church leader.
To tie, bind, or make a set of ten.

amharic: ስመ ነገድ ስመ ሀገር ታችኛው ሶርያ ነነዌ፡፡
english: Assyria; the name of an ancient nation and region.

amharic: ማሰር ማቄራኘት ማጣመር ማዛወግ ኹለቱም ሦስቱም ወይም ብዙውን አንድ ማድረግ፡፡
english: To bind, join, connect, or unite things together.
One who binds, connects, or unites.
To cause to be bound or imprisoned.
To be bound, connected, or united with someone or something.

amharic: የታሰረ የተሳሰረ የተቈራኘ እንድ የኾነ እስርስር፡፡
english: Bound, tied together, or physically connected.
The act of binding, imprisonment, or being tied together.
A restraint, a bond, or a place of imprisonment.
Muteness or the inability to speak.
The bondage of sin or disbelief.
The bond of peace, unity, and love.
The marriage covenant or the bond of holy matrimony.
To cause things to be connected, linked, or bound together.
Liquids or flowing substances.

amharic: ታናሽ ገንዘብ የገንዘብ ክፍል እንደ ሶልድና እንደ ቤሳ ያለች መዳብ
english: A small unit of ancient copper currency, similar to a penny.

amharic: የወይን የበለስ ቋንጣ የመጠጥ ዕቃ ብርጭቆ ጠርሙዝ
english: A glass, bottle, or vessel used for holding drinks like wine.

amharic: አስ የማድረግ ተ የመደረግና የመደራረግ ልማድ
english: A prefix used in grammar to show actions done to oneself or by others, indicating causing an action or reciprocal behavior.
Fish (plural).
The One God.
To give someone something to drink or to provide a drink.
The sky, firmament, or atmosphere.
A star, or a sparkling object in the sky.

amharic: ግዘፈ ብርሃን ሰሌዳ ክበብ ወይም ግዙፋን ብርሃናት ፀሓይ ጨረቃ ኮከብ
english: Celestial bodies like the sun, moon, or stars that shine in the sky.
Hidden or secret; a name meaning someone kept away from public view.

amharic: የሽቱ ዕንጨት እሾኻም ሥሩ ከሽቱ ጋራ የሚቀመም የሚነጠር
english: A thorny aromatic wood whose roots are used to make perfume.
A large, flat, smooth, or polished stone.
To enter, return, or come back.

amharic: የሚገባ ገቢ ተመላሽ መጪ አቻ እኩያ
english: Someone or something that enters, arrives, or is an equal counterpart.
The act of entering, returning, or the process of bringing something back.
To bring something in, cause it to enter, or return it.

amharic: መግቢያ ማግቢያ መመለሻ መምጫ ቤት አገር
english: An entrance, a place of arrival, or a place where one returns.

amharic: የማድ ቤት ፋርን ማብሰያ መጋገሪያ ምድጃ የእሳት ጕድጓድ
english: An oven, furnace, or kiln used for baking, heating, or firing pottery.

amharic: የግንብ ዐምድ ሕንጻውን ለማጽናት ዐብሮ የተሠራ ዐልፎ ዐልፎ የቆመ
english: A structural support pillar or column used to strengthen a building.
Ethiopia, a name referring to both a land and the physical characteristics of its people.
An Ethiopian or African person.
Etanim, the ancient name for the seventh month of the Hebrew calendar.

amharic: የግንብ ዐምድ ፬ ማእዘን ማእዘን ያለው
english: A pillar or column with four sides (a square column).
The name of the third month in the Ethiopian calendar, Hidar (November).
The speech of angels or a meaningful message, similar to a wise saying.
A precious stone or gem, sometimes compared to coal in color.
A throne, a bishop's chair, or a special stand for holding books in church.
To move away, separate, stay apart, or be set aside.
Something or someone that moves away, stays distant, or separates.
Someone or something that is set apart, moved away, or kept separate.
The act or state of being distant or far away.
To remove, cast away, drive out, or distance someone or something.
To be separated from each other or to become distant.
A place name in Israel where special monuments were once built.
People who claim to predict the future through signs or magic.
The wind that blows from the east.
A destructive force or someone who causes ruin.
The name of an ancient false idol.
A structural part of a doorway or the area behind a gate.
A type of long garment or robe that reaches down to the feet.
The revelation of the glory of God at the baptism of Jesus.
The name of a famous ancient church teacher and bishop from Cyprus.
The first fruits of a harvest, such as grain or grapes, offered to God.
The state of being the first-born or the initial part of something.
A church leader or bishop responsible for guiding and caring for the congregation.
The office, rank, or position of a bishop.
The second letter of the Ge'ez alphabet, representing the number two.

amharic: ነባር አንቀጽ። አለ ኖረ ነበረ ኾነ።
english: A foundational verb meaning 'to be', 'to exist', 'there is', or 'there was'.
To enter or to go inside.
The tenth month of the Coptic calendar.
Sons of Thunder, a title given to certain disciples.
Regarding, because of, or on behalf of.
To worsen, to become severe, to cause pain, or to go from bad to worse.
Something that is worsening, bad, harmful, or unpleasant.
Worse, bad, evil, or unpleasant.

amharic: መባስ መክፋት አባባስ አከፋፍ ብሶት ችግር
english: A worsening condition, sadness, or a difficult problem.

amharic: ጕልማሳ ኀይለኛ ወጣት የ፳ የ፴ ዓመት ጐበዝ ምሉ ሰው ባል ተባት ወንድ ሰውነት
english: A man, a male person, or an adult human.

amharic: ሰውዮው ሰውነቱ ይህ ሰው ያ ሰው
english: The specific man, that man, or 'his man'.
Each person, every man, or everyone individually.
A man of God, such as a prophet, saint, or apostle.

amharic: ደም አፍሳሽ ነፍሰ ገዳይ ዐርበኛ የጦር ሰው
english: A man of blood, meaning a murderer, a violent person, or a soldier.
A man of the field, meaning a hunter or someone who lives outdoors.
A strong man, a powerful or capable person.

amharic: ዐራሽ ገበሬ ጃን ገበር የርሻ ባለቤት
english: A man of the land, meaning a farmer.
A man of wickedness, a liar, or an evil person.
A beloved man, someone who is cherished or favored.
A man of peace, a peacemaker or friendly person.
A woman or a wife.

amharic: ይች ሴት ሰሚ ተጠሪ አንች ሴት ሴቶ እሜቶ ወይዘሮ
english: That woman, or a respectful term for a woman (like 'madam').
To make something worse, to spoil, or to cause dislike.
Something that causes worsening or a difficult, crooked path.

amharic: ተጣላ ተጠላላ ታገለ ተጋደለ ተሟገተ ተከራከረ
english: To argue, fight, quarrel, or compete with someone.

amharic: ብርቱ ጥል ጠብ ሙግት ክርክር ስድብ
english: A strong argument, quarrel, or serious disagreement.
To cause a disagreement, stir up trouble between people, or provoke an argument.

amharic: የሚያጣላ የሚጠላ ተጣይ ደመኛ ተዋጊ ዐርበኛ
english: A person who causes trouble, starts arguments, or acts as an enemy/warrior.

amharic: ክፉ ንፉግ ጩቅ ቡዳ ባላይነ ወርቅ
english: Describes someone who is mean, stingy, or lacks heart/kindness.
The act of entering or going inside.
A prefix meaning 'each', 'every', or 'per' (like 'every day').
A doll or a small toy used by children.
A grandfather, ancestor, or an elder figure.
A door, entrance, or gate.

amharic: ስመ ወርኅ የግብጦች ኹለተኛ ወር ጥቅምት
english: The name of the second month in the Coptic calendar (roughly October).
To move quickly, wander, or act restless.
A forbidden fruit from the Garden of Eden.
A legendary or mythical bird from stories.
The name of a place known for confusion or mixing of languages (Babel).
To get mixed up, scrambled, or scattered.
Things that are mixed, blended, or scattered.
To mix, scramble, or confuse things together.
A turtle or something hard like a stone.
A round loaf of bread or a small baked treat.
To play a musical instrument or arrange music.
A song or music, specifically a harp-like instrument.
To be a flock, or the act of being herded or led.

amharic: የምግብ ድርሻ፣ በግ ወይም ክርስቶስን የሚያመለክት ምልክት።
english: A food portion, a sheep, or a symbol used to represent Christ.
A flock of sheep, often used to refer to believers or angels.

amharic: ማደግ፣ መጐልመስ ወይም ከልጅነት ወደ ዕውቀት መውጣት።
english: To grow up, mature, or transition from childhood to adulthood.

amharic: ጐበዝ፣ ጕልማሳ፣ አካለ መጠን የደረሰ ባለአእምሮ።
english: A young man or youth who has reached adulthood and has good sense.

amharic: ነጭ፣ ነጭነት ወይም እንደ እንቁላል ያለ ቀለም።
english: White, or a color resembling that of an egg or ash.
To become sick, lost, ruined, or rusty.

amharic: ፈጣን ገዳይ በሽታ፣ ጨካኝ ወይም አጥፊ።
english: A deadly disease, or someone who is cruel and destructive.
To make rusty, to ruin, or to kill.
To frighten or to make someone tremble.
A fearful or timid person.
Someone who is foolish or lazy.
To separate, isolate, or leave someone all alone.
A skin disease that can cause blindness or be fatal.
The state of being destroyed, ruined, or becoming a desert.
Something that is lost, destroyed, or empty.
The state of being ruined, deserted, or empty.
A wilderness, a barren place, or something empty and dry.
A wilderness or an empty area.
A thicket, a bush, or a wild area.
To destroy, ruin, or leave something empty.
To be separated, scattered, or dispersed.
To change, to commit a wrong, or to do evil.
The process of becoming numb, dying, or decaying.
A dead body or a corpse.
To make something numb or lifeless like a corpse.
Never, ever, or absolutely not.

amharic: ጦር ዘገር ረምሕ የሚወረወር ዐጭር መጠነኛ፡፡
english: A short spear or javelin designed for throwing.
To fix, restore, or repair something.

amharic: የግንብ ንቃቃት ነቁ ሥንጥቁ ወይም ሊናድ የቀረበ የቤት ግንብ፡፡
english: A crack in a wall or a structure that needs fixing.
To run quickly or race to reach a destination first.
A runner or someone who is very fast.
A tool or standard used for weighing.
Long ago, in the beginning, or the ancient past.
To be chosen, honored, or to come before others.
Something or someone that is chosen, favored, or preferred.
To race or compete against someone else.
To help others race or to organize a sequence.

amharic: የልክ የመስፈሪያ ስም የርጥብ መስፈሪያ የዘይት ገንቦ፡፡
english: A container or measuring tool used for liquids like oil.
Something that is empty or released.

amharic: ቦ ነባር አንቀጽ የጥያቄ ቃል አለን አለ ይኾናል ያሰኛል፡፡
english: A question word used to ask if something exists or is true.

amharic: ማለት መንገር መናገር ፍሬ ቃል መስጠት፡፡
english: The act of saying, speaking, or telling something.
A person who is speaking or saying something.

amharic: ነገር ክርክር አባባል አነጋገር የነገር ስልት ትርጓሜ ልማድ፡፡
english: A tradition, custom, or way of speaking and behaving.
To cause someone to speak or say something.
Someone who makes others speak or encourages speech.
The method or way of speaking or saying.

amharic: ተባለ ተተነባ ተወራ ተነገረ ተጠራ ተሰየመ፡፡
english: To be called, named, or spoken about.
Something that has been said or spoken.
To discuss, argue, or talk together with others.
To cause others to argue or hold a discussion.
To become strong, to grow, or to increase in size and strength.
A small unit of currency, equivalent to one-twentieth of a drachma.

amharic: ጸበል፣ ትቢያ፣ ዐቧራ፣ ቅንቅን፣ በነፋስ የሚባን ደቃቅ ነገር።
english: Dust, fine powder, or small particles carried by the wind.

amharic: መጽሐፍ፣ ራእይ፣ ትንቢት፣ ስውር ነገርን መግለጥ።
english: A book of revelation or prophecy, or the act of revealing hidden things.
A rebel, a liar, a cruel person, or a false messiah.

amharic: ድዳ መኾን፣ አለመናገር፣ እንደ ከብት መኾን።
english: To be mute, unable to speak, or acting like a silent animal.

amharic: ድዳ፣ መናገር የማይችል፣ ፍሬ ቃል የማይሰጥ።
english: A mute person who cannot speak or provide meaningful words.
Mute; someone who has a mouth but cannot speak.
Muteness; the state of being unable to speak.
A farm animal that cannot speak or reason like a human.

amharic: በቁሙ የየብስ ዐንበሪ ከባሕር ተፈጥሮ በየብስ የሚኖር ግሩማን አራዊት የሚፈሩትና የሚገዙት ከአራዊት ኹሉ የሚበልጥ መጨረሻ ግዙፍ የእንስሳ ራስ የአራዊት ንጉሥ
english: Behemoth; a legendary, massive, king-like land animal feared and respected by all other creatures.

amharic: ድዳ አደረገ አፍ አስያዘ ዝም አሰኘ
english: To make someone mute or cause them to stop speaking.
Something that causes silence or acts as a restraint on speaking.

amharic: በነነ ቡን አለ ያዶቄት ያመድ የትቢያ
english: To turn into dust, ash, or fine particles.

amharic: መብነን መባከን ብን ብን ብንን ብንን ማለት ማነስ ማነስ መጕደል መጥፋት መበላሸት ከንቱ መኾን
english: Vanishing, wasting away, becoming useless, or turning into nothingness.
Vanished, wasted, useless, or empty.

To cry together or to mourn with others.
To make people cry or lead others in mourning.

amharic: ማብክክ ማብክት ባዶ ጠፍ ብላሽ ከንቱ ማድረግ ወይም መኾን
english: To make something empty, useless, or to render it void.

amharic: በክት ሙቶ ያደረ ባዶ ጠፍ ብቻ ከንቱ ብላሽ ዋዛ ፈዛዛ
english: Empty, void, useless, or nothing.

amharic: መብኰር መበክር መዠመሪያ መውለድ ማፍራት መውለድንና ማፍራትን መዠመር
english: To begin, to produce, or the act of being first-born.
A beginner or someone who initiates something.

amharic: አስበክረ በካር በኵር አስደረገ አስተወ ከለከለ
english: To cause something to become the first or to set something apart.

amharic: ተበኰረ በኵር ኾነ በኵር ተባለ የበኵርነት ክብር ተቀበለ
english: To become the first-born or to receive the honor of being first.

amharic: የበኰረ በኵር የኾነ የተባለ የቀረ የታጐለ
english: First-born, or something that is original or leading.

amharic: በቁሙ መዠመሪያ ልጅ ፍሬ ቀዳማዊ ታላቅ አለቃ ሹም አንጋፋ ግንባር ቀደም
english: The first-born child, the first fruit, a leader, or someone who comes first.

amharic: በኵርነት በኵር መኾን በፊት መወለድ ልቅና ቅድምት
english: The state of being the firstborn; primogeniture or seniority.
A burden, or the act of carrying something.
A command or a spoken instruction.
To grow old or become worn out.
The spring season or the early rains.
The land or country where one was born; hometown.

amharic: የዐምድ ስም ሰሎሞን በመቅደሱ ደጅ አፍ በበረንዳው በደጅ ሰላሙ ካቆማቸው ከኹለቱ አእማድ አንዱ በስተሰሜን ያለው የግራው ዐምድ
english: A specific name for the left-side pillar of the two pillars at the entrance of Solomon's Temple.
To sharpen or become sharp.

amharic: ማዳን፡ ማውጣት፡ መታደግ፡ መቤዠት፡ ከተያዙ፡ ከገቡ፡ በኋላ
english: The act of saving, rescuing, or redeeming someone from a difficult situation.
One who saves; a rescuer or savior.
To be saved, rescued, or to have escaped.
Someone who has been saved or has escaped from danger.

amharic: አስዳነ አስቤዠ አስወጣ አዳዳነ አዋጣ ዐገዘ ረዳ ለማዳን ለማውጣት
english: To cause someone to be saved, rescued, or helped.

amharic: ሰይጣን የሰይጣን ስም ለሰውም ይኾናል ክፉ ጥፋ ልክስክስ ምናምንቴ ሕገ ወጥ ቀንበር ሰበር ዳንዴ ወንበዴ ቀማኛ ሽፍታ
english: A name for Satan or a person characterized by wickedness, lawlessness, and malice.

amharic: መብላት መስላት መሾል መፍጠን ስልሹት ፈጣን መኾን
english: The process of sharpening, or the quality of being quick and swift.

amharic: የበላ የሰላ የሾለ ስል ሹል ትብ ደፋር ጨካኝ ፈጣን ብልኅተኛ ጽሩይ ረቂቅ
english: Sharp, quick, brave, or skillful.

amharic: ስለት ኹለት የሰይፍና የጦር አፍ አንደበት
english: The edge or sharp point of a sword or spear.

amharic: በቁሙ መስላት መሾል መፍጠን አሰላል አሿሿል አፈጣጠን ስለት ሹለት ፍጥነት ብልኅነት ፈጣንነት
english: Sharpness, speed, wisdom, or cleverness.

amharic: አበላ አሰላ አሾለ አፈጠነ አስፈጠነ ብልኅ አደረገ
english: To sharpen, make quick, or cause someone to become clever.
One who sharpens or a tool used for sharpening.

amharic: የብረት መሣሪያ ስለትና ኹለት ጥርስ ሌላም ብዙ ዐይነት ያለው
english: A metal tool or sharp instrument for cutting or carving.

amharic: መሳያ ማሾያ መሳል ሞረድ የመሰለው ኹሉ
english: A sharpening stone or any tool used to make things sharp.

amharic: የዛፍ ስም ጥኑ ጠንካራ ዕድሜያም ዛፍ ብዙ ሺሕ ዓመት የሚኖር
english: An oak tree; a strong and very long-lived tree.

amharic: ማርጀት ማፍጀት መለወጥ መበላሸት መበስበስ መበጣጠስ ማለፍ መቅረት ማለቅ መጨረስ መጥፋት መታጣት
english: The act of growing old, wearing out, decaying, or ending.
Something that gets old, passes away, or fades away.
Old, ancient, or from a long time ago.

amharic: ዘመኑ ያረጀ ዘመን ያስረጀው አሮጌ ሽበታም
english: The Ancient of Days; one who has existed since the beginning of time.
The state of existing before the world was created; timelessness.
The process of aging or the state of being old and worn.
To cause something to age, wear out, or become ancient.
Something that makes things old or wears them out.

amharic: ማጥፋት ማበላሸት መደባለቅ መዘባረቅ ማቀላቀል ማበስበስ
english: The act of mixing up, spoiling, ruining, or confusing things.
To mix, scramble, or cause disorder.

amharic: ቅይጥ ውጥን ነከርት የራሰ የለዘዘ ርጥብ
english: Something mixed, softened, or moistened.
The state of being old, worn out, or tattered, like an old rag.
To blaze, flicker, or burn brightly with flames.
Something that is blazing, burning, or flickering.
A flame or the bright, glowing part of a fire.
Fiery or relating to fire.
A place for bathing or washing.
A towel, cloth, or covering used for drying.
A type of tree (often identified as an oak or similar large tree).

amharic: የኵል መኳያ ሣር ወይም ሌላ ነገር ያይንን
english: The pupil of the eye; also, an instrument used for applying eye makeup.
The act of eating, biting, or chewing.
Someone or something that eats, consumes, or destroys.
