To feed someone else.
Food or something meant to be eaten.
A place or dish used for eating.
To be eaten, swallowed, or burned up.
Something that has been eaten, burned, or someone who is full.
A creature or thing that eats; a consumer or a scavenger.
The act or manner of eating.
To fight or bite one another.
To cause others to fight, bite, or destroy one another.
To grow, mature, or reach the stage of reproduction.
Something that is grown, mature, or fully developed.
A large pile of stones or a rocky cliff.
Earthly or physical nature that is weak or tiring.
Glass, crystal, or a precious jewel.
A fig tree or its fruit.
The tree of knowledge in the Garden of Eden.
A fragrant balm or perfume made from a special tree.
The state of being separated, widowed, or alone.
One who cuts, separates, or butchers meat.
A young boy, attendant, or servant.
To become separated, widowed, or left alone.
Someone who is separated, special, or alone.
A widow; a woman whose husband has passed away.
A sharp stone used as a tool to cut meat.
A cluster of stars or a specific constellation.
To mature, to reach adulthood, or to become capable of reproduction.

amharic: መበለት መለየት መነጠል ሥጋን በየብልቱ ማውጣት። ማደኽየት ድኻ ብቸኛ ማድረግ ብቻ ማስቀረት።
english: To separate, to disconnect, to isolate, or to leave someone alone.
A young servant, an attendant, or a trained youth.

amharic: የቦታ ስም ኮረብታ በተራራ ላይ የተሠራ ቤተ ጣዖት።
english: A high place, a hill, or a site traditionally used for altars.
Is it really there? or Is it truly present?
The moon.

amharic: መስጠት ማደል ማገበር በፍቅርና በክብር በፈቃድ።
english: To give, to grant, or to bestow something willingly with honor.

amharic: ዐሥራት እጅ መንሻ በረከት በፈቃድ የሚሰጥ ስጦታ።
english: A gift, a tithe, an offering, or a voluntary contribution.

amharic: ሴት ልጅ ወለት እንስት ቄብ ልጃገረድ፡፡
english: A young girl or daughter.

amharic: ማብሠር የምሥራች ማለት ሐዲስ የደስታ ወሬ ማውራት መንገር መልካም ትንቢት መናገር፡፡
english: To announce good news, share happy tidings, or declare a prophecy.

amharic: አሰበሠረ ደግ ወሬ ነጋሪ የምሥራች ባይ፡፡
english: A messenger who brings good news.

amharic: አሰበሠረ ደግ ወሬ አስነገረ ወሬኛ ላከ፡፡
english: To send word or cause good news to be announced.
One who causes news to be announced or a bearer of tidings.

amharic: በቁሙ ን መሥራች ሰማ ሐዲስ ወሬ አገኘ ሰውዮው፡፡
english: To hear or receive good news.

amharic: በቁሙ ምሥራች ሐዲስ ነገር ደስ የሚያሰኝ ወሬ ስብከት ትንቢት ወንጌል
english: Good news, happy tidings, or a joyful gospel message.
Pertaining to good news or an evangelist.
Flesh or of the flesh.

amharic: ማባድ ባዕድ ማድረግ መለየት መነጠል ማራቅ ማስገለል መለወጥ መቀየር
english: To separate, distance, or change something into something else.
Someone or something that separates, distances, or makes alien.
To cause to be separated or distanced.

amharic: ተለየ ተነጠለ ራቀ ወገደ ባዕድ ኾነ ዝምድና ዐጣ፡፡
english: To be separated, become a stranger, or lose a connection.

amharic: የተለየ ልዩ ሌላ ዐይነት ጥልቅ ረቂቅ፡፡
english: Separate, different, unique, or deep and mysterious.
Foreign, different, separate, or a stranger.
Separation, distinction, or distance.
Foreignness, distinctness, or the state of being separate.
To be apart from each other or to distance oneself.
To cause people or things to be separated or divided.
One who separates or causes things to be distinct.

amharic: ሳላ የፍየል ዐይነት የዱር የበረሖ እንስሳ ቀንዳም ቀንዱ ቀጫጭን ረዥም ቀጥ ያለ
english: A type of wild mountain animal with long, straight, horn-like antlers; also refers to an instrument made from such a horn.

amharic: መክበር መበልጠግ መጌትየት ብዙ ገንዘብ ማግኘት መላቅ መብለጥ በሀብት ማደግ፡፡
english: To become wealthy, prosperous, or rich.
A wealthy person, a rich person, or a master/owner.
People who have many faults or flaws.
Sinners who commit many small sins.

amharic: የጉባኤ ጌቶች ባለቤቶች ቅዱስን አበው ሊቃውንት
english: The masters, leaders, or holy scholars of an assembly.
A person who is wealthy or possesses much money.

amharic: የከበረ የበለጠገ የዘመነ የጌተየ ብዙ ገንዘብ ያለው
english: Someone who is rich, honored, prosperous, or holds great wealth.

amharic: በቁሙ ብልጥግና ባለጠግነት ክብር ድልብ ብዙ ገንዘብ
english: Great wealth, riches, honor, or abundance.

amharic: አክበረ አስከበረ አበለጠገ ሰውን ባዕል ዕለትን በዓል አደረገ
english: To honor, enrich someone, or to celebrate a special day.
Someone who gives honor or makes others rich.

amharic: ኵሓ ጠገራ ምዝምዝ ጥፍጥፍ የወርቅ የብር የንሓስ የብረት የማዕደናት ኹሉ ዛንጅር መንቈር ሰንሰለት እግር ብረት
english: Metal tools, chains, irons, or ornaments made of precious metals.

amharic: መክደኛ እንደ ኵሓ ያለ የብረት መግላሊት
english: A metal cover or a heavy iron lid.

amharic: መክበሪያ ገንዘብ ማግኛ የብረት የዕንጨት የደንጊያ መሣሪያ እንደ የወፍጮ ያለ
english: A tool or instrument, like a mill, used for work or gathering resources.

amharic: ባል ያላት ሴት ባለባል ክብርት ብዕልት
english: A married woman who is honored and has a husband.

amharic: ምት ባል ሚስት ያለው ወንድ የሴት ገዥ አዛዥ ጌታ ባለቤት
english: A husband, master, or owner of a house.

amharic: እጃም እጀኛ ባለእጅ እጀታ ያለው ዕቃ መሣሪያ ሠራተኛ ቀጥቃጭ ሌባ
english: A skilled worker, craftsman, or someone who uses tools.

amharic: ጋጋሪ የሀገር ዐበዛ ባለወግ ጋግሮ የሚሼጥ ወይም የሚጋግር ብቻ
english: A baker who bakes and sells bread.

amharic: ባለቤት የቤት ጌታ ሠራዒ መጋቢ አሳዳሪ
english: The head of the house, manager, or owner of a home.

amharic: ዘመናይ ሹም ባለጠጋ ንጉሥ እንደ ወደደ የሚያደርግ
english: A powerful person, ruler, or someone who controls their own time and destiny.
Someone who likes to argue, a accuser, or an opponent.

amharic: ባለቀለም ልብስ አቅላሚ ቀለም አግቢ ወይም ሽያጭ ቀማሚ
english: A dyer or someone who works with colored dyes and fabrics.

amharic: መርከበኛ ባለመርከብ የመርከብ አለቃ መሪ ቀዛፊ
english: A sailor, boat owner, or captain of a ship.

amharic: ባለኹለት ጸሪቅ የጸናጽል ሻኵራ የሚመስል ፪ የናስ ቅጠል ያላት ከዚያ በቀር ሌላ ትርፍ ገንዘብ የሌላት
english: A very poor person who gives all they have as a charitable offering.
A clever, skilled, or inventive person.
A landowner, farmer, or someone who works the land.
A treasurer or keeper of the storehouse.
An official, teacher, or church leader, such as a bishop, who holds a seat of authority.

amharic: ባለመጣፍ ጸሐፊ ዐታሚ ሽያጭ ተርጓሚ የመጣፍ መምር
english: A person involved with books, such as an author, publisher, seller, or translator.

amharic: ባለተረት ምሳሌ ዐዋቂ ኹሉን በምሳሌ የሚናገር
english: A storyteller or a wise person who speaks using parables and analogies.
Someone who lends money, borrows money, or is responsible for paying a debt.

amharic: ወጥ ቤት ወጥ ዐጥቂ ቀቃይ አብሳይ
english: A cook or chef who prepares food and manages the kitchen.
A person who lends money for profit or interest.
The 40th day after Easter, known as the Feast of the Ascension.
The 50th day after Easter, celebrating the coming of the Holy Spirit (Pentecost).
A wedding celebration or a festival for bride and groom.

amharic: የሚዞሩ የሚወጡና የሚወርዱ ወደ ላይ ወደ ታች የሚሉ
english: Movable religious feasts that shift their dates on the calendar throughout the year.
A name for Satan or the prince of demons, often associated with foulness.
To consume, burn completely, or graze the land like cattle.
An ox or cattle used for plowing fields.
Relating to an ox, or a person who works as a farmer or laborer.
The plural form of livestock, or metaphorically referring to people who are foolish or unlearned.
A plow or tool used by an ox for digging and farming.
A tool used for farming, digging, or tilling the soil.
A cave or a secluded dwelling place.

amharic: ባታም ባተ መልካም ወይም እግረ ደንዳና
english: Having to do with the calf of the leg or having strong, sturdy feet.
To fall asleep or slumber.

amharic: መድረስ መምጣት መቅረብ መለጠቅ መንካት ማግኘት
english: To arrive, reach, come near, or make contact with something.
Someone or something that is arriving or coming.

amharic: የደረሰ ያደገ የጐለመሰ የመላ የተፈጸመ ፍጹም
english: Mature, complete, perfect, or fully grown.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ ውርዝው ወሬዛ ሕፃን ብጹሐ አምጣን
english: A mature, wise, and well-behaved young person or child.
A person who has reached spiritual perfection through dedicated works and devotion.

amharic: ቀኑ የደረሰ ዕድሜ የጠገበ ሞቱ የቀረበ አሮጌ
english: Someone who is very old and nearing the end of their long life.
The act of arriving or the reaching of a destination.
A share, a portion, or one's assigned part.
To bring, deliver, or present something to someone.
One who delivers or brings something; a messenger or a provider.

amharic: መድረሻ ማድረሻ ጫፍ መጨረሻ መግቢያ ማረፊያ መጠጊያ
english: A destination, a place of rest, or a final stopping point.
To meet, join together, or become united with someone.
To bring others together or to help people meet.
A meeting place, a gathering, or an assembly.

amharic: መላጥ መምለጥ መቅረፍ መሸልቀቅ መግፈፍ መገሽለጥ መበጨቅ መጋጥ መንጨት መሳብ መጐተት
english: The act of peeling, stripping, pulling off, or removing an outer layer.
To be peeled, stripped, or scraped off.

amharic: ልጥ ቅርፍት ቅራፊ ብጫቂ ብጭቅጫቂ ዕላቂ ብጣሽ ቍራጭ
english: A peel, a shred, a scrap, or a small piece of something.

amharic: ቀይ ሽንኵርት የቀይ ሽንኵርት ዐይነት የሚላጥ የሚመለጥ ኹለንተናው ተልጦ የሚያልቅ የሚሸለቀቅ
english: A type of onion or a plant with layers that can be peeled away.
To enter or to engage in a vow or promise.

amharic: ነጭ ደንጊያ በረቅ ብሓ ብሕካ ጠመኔ ኖራ የሚመስል
english: Something white like stone, chalk, or lime.

amharic: ማሸለብ ማንቀላፋት መተኛት መጋደም ጧ ብሎ መዘርጋት መቃዠት መቀባጠር መጫዎት ማቧለት ያልኾነ ነገር መንገር
english: The act of dozing off, sleeping, lying down, or idling.

amharic: እንቅልፍ አንጕልቻ ቅዠት ጨዎታ ቧልት አለውቀት
english: Sleep, dreaming, playfulness, or idle talk.

amharic: መኝታ መተኛ ማሰተኛ ቦታ መደብ ዐልጋ
english: A place to sleep, a bed, or a resting place.

amharic: በቍረጥ መወሰን መገምገም መገመት ይህን ያኽል ማለት የዋጋ የለት በቁሙ መብፃት ብፅዐት መግባት በገንዘብ በመሧዕት ወይም በራስ በሰውነት መሳል ሳይሆን እሰጣለኹ እንዲሉ አደርጋለኹ ማለት ከዚያ በኋላ እንደ ውሉ ራስን ገንዘብ መቀደስ መለየት ለባለቤቱ ማቅረብ መስጠት የተናገሩትን መፈጸም
english: To make a solemn vow, a promise, or a pledge to dedicate something or oneself.

amharic: አከበረ አመሰገነ መረቀ አደነቀ ደስ አሰኘ በብፅዐት ሥራ
english: To honor, praise, bless, or admire someone for their good deeds.

amharic: አከበረ አመሰገነ ከበረ ተመሰገነ ተመረቀ ብፁዕ ተባለ
english: To be praised, honored, or called blessed.

amharic: ብፅዐት የገባ ባለብፅዐት የብፅዐት ልጅ የብፅዐት ገንዘብ በቁሙ የታመነ የተመሰገነ ሥራውና ልቡ የቀረና የተከናወነ ክቡር ምስጉን ምሩቅ ብሩክ ቅዱስ ጻድቅ ቸር ብእሴ እግዚአብሔር
english: Blessed, holy, righteous, and honorable; one who keeps their promises and lives a good life.

amharic: የብፁዕ ወገን ንጹሕ ወጣኒ መንፈሳዊ ወይም ብፁዕ የተባለ ብፁዕነት ያለው ማእከላዊ ፍጹም ቅዱስ
english: A person or thing that is holy, blessed, pure, and spiritually perfect.

amharic: መሳል ብፁዕ መባል ስለት የስለት ገንዘብ የብፅዐት ሥራ
english: A sacred promise, vow, or offering made to God.
The state of being blessed, holy, or honorable; holiness.

amharic: ክብር ምስጋና ብፁዕ ማለት መባል የቡራኬ ቃል
english: A word of blessing, praise, or honor.

amharic: ያልተማረ ያልሠለጠነ ሕዝብ ፊደልና ጽሕፈት ሕግና ሥርዐት የሌለው በቅሚያ የሚኖር ጭንጩ አረመኔ ሽፍታ ወያኔ
english: A term historically used to describe a group of people considered uncivilized or wild; a barbarian.
A person belonging to the Berber people.
Something that is curly, singed, or shriveled in appearance.
To plunder, loot, or raid.

amharic: ዶቢ የሳማ ዐይነት ቅጠል በድብድባ ቦታ የሚበቅል እንደ በርበሬ የሚለበልብ የሚያንገበግብ ተኳሳ ኰስኳሳ
english: A type of stinging plant with leaves that burn or irritate the skin like chili.
To be plundered, looted, or raided.
Something that has been looted, ransacked, or is empty inside.

amharic: መበርበር መበርበር አበረበር ብርበራ ብዝበዛ ዘረፋ ወረራ
english: The act of looting, plundering, or raiding.

amharic: የዛፍ ስም ብርብራ ቅጠሉና ፍሬው ዓሣ የሚያሰክር ባሕር የሚያሸብር
english: A type of tree whose leaves and fruit have strong properties.

amharic: ዐዘቅት የውሃ ወይም የእኽል ጕድጓድ ዋሻ ጉሬ መቃብር ውስጡ የተቦረቦረ
english: A pit, a deep hole, a cave, or a hollow space in the ground.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ ታላቅ ሰፊ ጕድጓድ ዕመቀ ምድር መሠረተ ምድር የጥልቅ ጥልቅ መጨረሻ ዕመቅ
english: A vast, deep pit; an abyss or the very depths of the earth.

amharic: መብረድ መቀዝቀዝ በረዶ መኾን መውረድ መርጋት የዝናም የውሃ
english: The process of cooling down, freezing, or turning into ice or frost.

amharic: የበረደ በራድ ብርዳም በረዷም በሪድ ቀዝቃዛ
english: Something that is cold, chilly, or frozen.

amharic: በቁሙ በረዶ የዝናም ደንጊያ የውሃ ጠጠር በነፋስና በደመና ወንጭፍ ከላይ ከሰማይ የሚወርድ የሚወረወር
english: Hail; pieces of ice falling from the sky during a storm.

amharic: አበረደ አስበረደ አቀዘቀዘ በረዶ አደረገ አዘነመ
english: To make something cool, to cause it to freeze, or to cause hail to fall.

amharic: በረደደ ረጋ ጸና ደነገየ በርዳዳ ኾነ
english: To become cold, hardened, stunned, or frigid.
A tool or method used for cooling; a cooler.

amharic: መብራት መበራት መታየት መገለጥ ብርሃን መኾን ደስ ማሰኘት
english: To shine, to become visible, to reveal, or to bring joy through light.
Bright, clear, white, or easy to see.
White spots or small marks on the skin.

amharic: ብርሃን ጸዳል ውጋገን እሳት ፍሕም ነበልባል
english: Light, radiance, glow, flame, or burning embers.
Light, daytime, or sources of light like the sun, moon, and stars.

amharic: ይቅርታ ቸርነት ባለሟልነት የደስታና የፍቅር ምልክት
english: A joyful and loving expression on the face; kindness or grace.

amharic: ጥሩ ዕውቀት ጥበብ ትምርት መንፈሳዊ ሀብት
english: Wisdom, understanding, or spiritual knowledge.
The flash or bright glimmer of lightning.
The clarity of vision; the pupil of the eye.
The radiant light of glory or splendor.

amharic: ብርሃናም ተፈጥሮው ከብርሃን የኾነ ንጹሕ ብሩህ ጽሩይ ጸዐዳ
english: Bright, pure, or having the nature of light.

amharic: ብራና የተፋቀ የተፈመመ ነጭ ሰሌዳ ማእስ ወይም ወረቀት
english: Parchment; a cleaned, smoothed surface used for writing.
To light up, make visible, reveal, or explain.
Something that illuminates, explains, or reveals.
A lamp, lantern, or source of light.
The place where a lamp is kept or a candle stand.
Bald, bare, or open space.

amharic: ማግለል መለየት ዕዳሪ መውጣት ለመናጻት መበረዝ መበጥበጥ
english: To mix, dilute, or separate impurities from a liquid.

amharic: ተበረዘ ተበጠበጠ ተለየ ተጣለ ሐሠሩ ጕድፉ
english: To be mixed, stirred, or have impurities removed.
Mixed, diluted, or blended.
To be mixed together or purified.

amharic: አተላ አንብላ ዝቃጭ ተራዋጭ ሐሠር ሽንት ቅዘን ዐይነ ምድር
english: Sediment, dregs, or waste matter.

amharic: በቁሙ በተሓ ለጋ ጠጅ ጌሾ ያልበዛው ያልበሰለ
english: Honey water or a mild, fresh honey-wine mixture.

amharic: መብራት መገለጥ መቦሕየት በራ መኾን መመለጥ መሸሽ ማምለጥ መሮጥ መፈርጠጥ ከዱር ከበረሓ መግባት
english: Light, revelation, the act of shining, escaping, fleeing, or entering the wilderness.

amharic: በራ መላጥ ራስ ገላጣ ጠጕር የሸሸ ከቦታው የታጣ የራሱ ቈርበት መሳልና ነት
english: Baldness, a hairless head, or something missing from its original place.
Blessing, honor, and praise.

amharic: መከፈት መለቀቅ ክፍት መኾን ዋሻ መምሰል ለመጕረሥ ለመክተት የአፍ የጕድጓድ
english: The act of opening, a gap, a cave-like hole, or a cavity such as a mouth.

amharic: የተከፈተ የተለቀቀ ክፍት ልቅ ለቃቃ አፈ ሰፊ
english: Opened, released, wide, or wide-mouthed.
The state of being open or the act of opening.
Wide-mouthed, cavernous, or something that is vocal and expressive.

amharic: እፎች ላይኛውና ታችኛው ክፍል ብቃውና አብቃው ከንፈር ካናፍር እንደ ማለት ነው
english: The upper or lower parts of the mouth, referring to the lips.
To open or to release.

amharic: ፍሽጊያ የአፍ አከፋፈት ከፈታ ከፍቻ ለቀቃ
english: The act of opening the mouth wide.

amharic: መመርመር መጠየቅ ግፍን በደልን መርምሮ ማወቅ ማሰብ መቍጠር
english: To investigate, examine, or calculate in order to judge or settle a grievance.

amharic: የሚበቀል ተበቃይ ቂመኛ ደም መላሽ ብድር ከፋይ
english: One who seeks justice, an avenger, or someone who settles a score.

amharic: በቁሙ ቅጣት የክፉ ብድራት ዕዳ ፍዳ ቂም ደም
english: Revenge, punishment, or the settlement of a debt or wrongdoing.
Instead of, on behalf of, or in place of.
To cause revenge to be taken or to make someone seek justice.
Someone who causes justice to be served or acts as an avenger.

amharic: ተጠየቀ ተመረመረ ተሠራ ተቀጣ ፍርድ ለበሰ
english: To be questioned, examined, or punished; to receive judgment.
A mule, the offspring of a donkey and a horse.
Mules, the plural form of mule.

amharic: ባለበቅሎ በቅሎ የሚያረባ የሚሼጥ የሚያከራይ ወይም ለጓሚ ባልደራስ በቅሎ ጠባቂ
english: A muleteer, a person who raises, trades, or keeps mules.
A number representing one hundred.

amharic: መብቀል ማጐንቈል ካፈር ከመሬት መዛመድ መዋሐድ መጽደቅ ሥርን ወደ ታች ቅጠልን ወደ ላይ መስደድ
english: To grow, sprout, germinate from the soil, or develop roots and leaves.
Something that sprouts, grows, or germinates.

amharic: አበቀለ አጸደቀ ቡቃያ አወጣ አቀጠለ በራሱ በጐኑ
english: To cause to sprout, to plant, or to make something grow.
To become strong, to grow, or to make steady progress.

amharic: ጸበል ትቢያ ዐቧራ ቅንቅን በነፋስ የሚባን ደቃቅ ነገር ኹሉ ።
english: Dust, fine particles, or anything blown by the wind.

amharic: ቡቃያ ችግኝ እኽል ተክል ሣር ቅጠል ሳይዘሩት የሚበቅል ማናቸውም ኹሉ ።
english: A sprout, seedling, plant, or anything that grows from the ground.

amharic: ሐረግ ዐጽቅ ለበቅ የማይሰበር እንደ ሽቦ የሚተጣጠፍ ።
english: A flexible vine or plant that can be twisted like wire.
A name meaning 'his vine' or 'his plant'.
Pertaining to plants or greenery.

amharic: ሰሌን ዘንባባ ፍሬው ተዘርቶ የሚበቅል ቁመታም ።
english: A tall tree like a palm tree.

amharic: በቁሙ ባቄላ ፉል ያበባ እኽል በቈልት የሚኾን
english: A type of flowering bean or pulse plant.

amharic: መብቃት መኾን መገባት መርባት መጥቀም ግዳጅ መፈጸም መርዳት
english: To suffice, to be useful, to help, to fulfill a duty, or to provide benefit.
Something or someone that is useful, sufficient, or helpful.
To cause to suffice or to make something useful for someone.
To benefit from something, to gain an advantage, or to receive a request.
Someone who has gained a benefit or is useful.

amharic: መብቃት ብቃት መጥቀም መጠቀም አጠቃቀም ጥቅም
english: The state of being useful, a benefit, profit, or efficiency.

amharic: ልመና ምልጃ ጸሎት በጸሎትና በልመና የሚገኝ ጥቅም
english: A humble petition, prayer, or the grace received through prayer.
Profit, a worthy reward, or a useful gain.
To plead, to intercede, or to act as an advocate for someone.
An intercessor, a mediator, or someone who asks for mercy on behalf of others.
A formal petition, prayer, or intercession used in worship.
To kindle, to burn, or to stir up a fire.
To be scorched, burned, or stirred up by fire.
Something that has been scorched, burned, or cooked by fire.
A tool or place for tending to a fire, like a hearth or shovel.
To split, tear, or clear away debris.
To hoe, till, or cultivate the soil.
To bubble up or gush forth (used for liquids).
A young man, a student, or a disciple.

amharic: ኪሩብ ገጸ ሰብእ ወልዳዊ ወልድ ስብኣዊ
english: A symbolic figure, often representing a human-like face or cherub.
A palace, a fortress, or a grand hall.

amharic: መበርበር መዝረፍ መበዝበዝ የቤትን ድልብ በቤት ገንዘብ ጐርጕሮ መውሰድ
english: To ransack, to loot, or to dig through to take someone's belongings.
A robber, an intruder, or someone who ransacks.

amharic: በራ፣ ቡሓ መኾን፣ ብርሃን፣ መላጥነት፣ ሽሽት፣ በረሓ መግባት
english: Brightness, the state of being light, or the act of escaping to a wilderness.
A desert or a wilderness area.

amharic: መለወጥ፣ መተካት፣ ማፈራረቅ፣ መግዛት፣ ባሪያ ማድረግ
english: The act of changing, substituting, alternating, or enslaving.

amharic: ተለዋወጠ፣ ተፈራረቀ፣ ተጋገዘ፣ ተራረፈ፣ ባሪያ ኾነ
english: To be exchanged, to alternate, to cooperate, or to become a servant.

amharic: ፈረቃ፣ ፈንታ፣ ተራ፣ ሰሞን፣ የጊዜ ክፍል
english: A turn, shift, or a specific period of time.

amharic: በረገገ፣ በሬኛ መገሸ፣ ደነበረ፣ ፈራ፣ ደነገጠ
english: To shy away, startle, run away, or be frightened.

amharic: ቀመር፣ የጨረቃ ወይም የፀሓይ ዑደት ዓመታት
english: A cycle or calculation of time, such as lunar or solar year cycles.
A name used for a wicked or evil spirit.
A term referring to those who are chosen or set apart.
The act of kneeling or bending the knees.
Someone who has knelt or bent their knees.
A knee or the part of the leg used for kneeling.
To cause someone to kneel or to make them bow down.
The act of giving thanks, often while kneeling in prayer.
To bless, offer a prayer of blessing, or give thanks.
To cause someone to be blessed or to cause them to give thanks.
To be blessed, to receive a blessing, or to be praised.
Blessed, praised, honorable, or fortunate.
A blessing, an act of praise, or a benediction.

amharic: ምስጋና፣ ምርቃት፣ ጸጋ፣ ሀብት፣ መልካም ነገር
english: A blessing, grace, gift, or abundance of good things.
To cause a group to exchange blessings or praise one another.
A heavy object, such as a large stone or a heavy piece of metal.
A type of flatbread cooked on hot coals that is very filling.
Crystal, a precious stone, or clear glass.
The name of a month, corresponding to April.
The name of the month of March.

amharic: አስቄጥስ የነመክሲሞስ የናርሳንዮስ ገዳም ደብረ ሮም ገዳመ ሮም ማለት ነው
english: A name for a monastery or a secluded place of worship.
Parchment made from animal skin, traditionally used for writing sacred texts.

amharic: መራድ መንቀጥቀጥ መታወክ መናወጥ መገፋት መናጥ መወዛወዝ
english: Trembling, shaking, or moving back and forth due to fear or wind.

amharic: ሸንበቆ የጐሽ መቃ የሸንበቆ ዐይነት ውስጠ ክፍት አገዳ ቅልጥም
english: A reed, stalk, or hollow stem, often used as an ancient writing tool.

amharic: የትንቢትና የስብከት የተግሣጽ ቃል ጩኾ ገንትቶ አሰምቶ የሚናገሩት
english: Proclamations of prophecy or teachings spoken aloud with emphasis.
Shining, sparkling, or polishing to make something look bright and clean.
To sparkle, glitter, or shine brightly.
White and shiny, or relating to a bright skin condition.

amharic: መብረቅ ብልጭ ማለት መፍለቅ ማንጸብረቅ መወርወር
english: Lightning, a flash of light, or the act of something shining or appearing suddenly.

amharic: አበረቀ አባረቀ አብረቀረቀ መብረት ጣለ ወረወረ አበራ ገለጠ
english: To flash, shine, or cause a sudden burst of light.

amharic: በቁሙ የእሳት ሰይፍ የእሳት ፍላጻ በዝናም ጊዜ ከደመና አፎት የሚመዘዝ የሚወረወር
english: Lightning, described as a flash of light or 'fire sword' from the clouds.

amharic: በቁሙ ነጭ ዐፈር ደንጊያ ብሕካ ጠመኔ የኖራ ዐይነት
english: White earth, chalk, or a bright powdery stone.

amharic: በቁሙ ወትሮ የማይታይ በኹሉ የማይገኝ ድንቅ ሥራ ጕድ ታምራት መንክራት
english: A wonder, something rare, miraculous, or a truly amazing sight.
White thorns or specific types of acacia trees.

amharic: መምረጥ መለየት መልቀም ማጥራት ጽሩይ ጸዐዳ ማድረግ
english: To select, separate, refine, or purify something, like precious metals.
To be selected, purified, or become refined.

amharic: የተመረጠ የተለየ ልቅም ጥሩ ነጭ ማዕድን
english: Refined, purified, or high-quality bright mineral.
To run, fly, or move very quickly.
Something that passes by or moves through; a traveler or flyer.

amharic: ጥድ የጥድ ዐይነት ዛፍ ወፍራም ረዥም መለሎ
english: A cedar or pine-like tree that grows tall and strong.
Cedar or pine trees.
The well of the oath; a significant historical place name.
A wooden box, chest, or coffin used for storage or carrying items.
A variety of legume or lentil.
A type of lentil, often used in stews; known for its distinct color and culinary value.
A type of strong, durable, and fragrant wood, similar to juniper.
A type of hard metal, such as iron, copper, or bronze.
Iron or hard metal.
An orange or a type of sweet citrus fruit.
The act of blinking, fluttering, or flickering of the eyes.
To flip, turn over, or flutter, often used for eyes or eyebrows.
A blink, wink, or a quick glance of the eye.
Lion-like or belonging to the lion family.
A female lion; a lioness.
To act like a lion or to become courageous.
A great leader or the child of a noble and strong person.
A young calf that jumps and plays.
To break, tear, or scatter.
The process of cooking, ripening, or becoming soft through heat.
To be cooked, boiled, or baked.
Cooked, boiled, or ripe.
Cooked food or a boiled dish.
A cooked meal, stew, or porridge.
To cook, roast, or prepare food using heat.
A cook or a place used for cooking, such as a kitchen.
A cooking utensil or vessel for boiling.
Cooked, tender, and delicious food.
Relating to a king or royalty.
The power, status, or kingdom of a monarch.

amharic: የሰው ስም ንጉሥ ንጉሣዊ ማለት ነው።
english: A name meaning king or royal.

amharic: የሽቱ ዕንጨት ዛፍ መልካም ሽታ ያለው ማናቸውም ኹሉ በያይነቱ።
english: A fragrant tree or plant with a pleasant scent.
The Egyptian month of May.
Good news or a joyous announcement.

amharic: መበስስ ማደን ባሳስ መኾን ማለዘብ ማለስለስ የነገር የልብስ።
english: The act of softening or making something smooth.

amharic: ክታን ልብስ ለስላሳ ወይም ፈትሉ፣ ቢሶሳት።
english: Soft linen cloth or fine thread.
A measurement container used for liquids like oil.

amharic: መበተክ መበሰክ መቍረጥ መበጠስ አበላ መምታት መንቀል መፈንቀል መናድ ማፍረስ መስበር መሠንጠር።
english: The act of cutting, breaking, tearing, or destroying something.
To cause something to be cut or torn apart.
To be cut, torn, or uprooted.
Something that has been torn, cut, or broken into pieces.

amharic: አበላ የተመታ ጥንብ ውዳቂ ታርዶ የሰነበተ።
english: Something that is ruined, damaged, or decayed.

amharic: መቍረጥ መቈረጥ መበጠስ አበጣጠሰ ብጠሳ ብጥስነት።
english: The process or state of cutting and tearing.
To remain single or lead a celibate life.

amharic: ድንግል ወንድ ያላወቃት ሴት ልጅ ልጃገረድ።
english: A young unmarried woman or virgin.

amharic: ድንግል ሴት ያላወቀ ወንድ፣ ባተሌ ፈት መዐስብ ሚስቱ ሙታ ወይም በነውር ተፈታ ብቻውን የሚኖር ድንግላይ ማለት ነው።
english: A man who has not known a woman or lives a celibate life.
To scatter or spread something out.

amharic: በቍረጥ መከርከም ማረቅ ማቅናት ቀጥ ለጥ ማድረግ የንጨት፣ መምታት መውቃት መነረት።
english: To trim, straighten, or beat something into shape.
A rod, walking stick, or staff.
A reed or hollow walking stick.

amharic: ከወርቅ የተሠራ በወርቅ የተጌጠ የጳጳስና የንጉሥ በትር።
english: A golden staff or scepter used by kings and leaders.

amharic: የብረት ዘንግ፣ ባለብረት ጅንፎ ጅንፏም በትረ።
english: An iron rod or staff.

amharic: ዐጭር ወፍራም መንዶ እንደ ጩንቻ እንደ መሮ መምቻ ያለ ዐጣቢ አግቢ ልብስ የሚመታበት።
english: A short, thick wooden tool used for beating clothes while washing.

amharic: መቅጫ ለበቅ ጨንገር ረኃብ ጦር ዐባር ቸነፈር
english: A tool of correction or divine discipline, such as famine, war, or disaster.

amharic: የነገድ አለቃ በኵር ሹም ግንባር ቀደም
english: A tribal leader, firstborn, or the foremost person in a group.

amharic: ሊቀ ጳጳስ አብ ቀዳማዊ ወይም መዠመሪያ ታላቅ ደገኛ አባት
english: A Patriarch, a primary, great, and virtuous spiritual father.

amharic: አበው ከአዳም እስከ ኖኅ ያሉ ዐሥሩ አባቶች ወይም ሌሎች
english: The patriarchs or ancestors, specifically the ten fathers from Adam to Noah.
To scatter, fall apart, fade away, or wear out like old clothes.

amharic: በቁሙ በተበተ ቦጠቦጠ ፈለፈለ ውስጥ ውስጡን በላ አቃጠለ
english: To scatter, pick apart, hollow out, or devour from within.
The third letter of the Ethiopic alphabet.
A minor grammatical particle used for emphasis.
A grammatical particle meaning 'even', 'indeed', or 'if'.
Land, country, or territory.

amharic: ማዘን መቆጣት መበሳጨት መንቀፍ መጥላት መጣላት መውቀሥ መክሰስ
english: To be sad, angry, upset, critical, hateful, or to accuse and quarrel.
One who criticizes, complains, accuses, or judges.
A person who is naggy, troublesome, or prone to arguing.

amharic: አስጠላ አስነቀፈ አስጋዘ አስጐተተ ከግዞት አስገባ
english: To cause hatred, to criticize, to pull, or to bring into exile.
To be hated, criticized, or exiled.
Exiled, hated, or criticized.

amharic: ማጋዝ መጋዝ መንቀፍ መነቀፍ አነቃቀፍ ነቀፋ ነቀፌታ ወቀሣ ከሰሳ
english: The act of criticizing, blaming, accusing, or quarreling.
To quarrel, fight, or argue with one another.
A person who quarrels, argues, or acts as an opponent.
To cause to hate, to provoke, or to incite an argument.
One who causes conflict, a contentious person, or an arguer.

amharic: ጠብ ክርክር ሙግት ንዝንዝ ስድብ ውዝግብ ጭቅጭቅ
english: Conflict, argument, dispute, nagging, or quarreling.
A Semitic and ancient ancestral language.
To travel, move forward, or become free.
To shout, cry out loudly, or struggle.
A traditional type of porridge or dough-like food.
The side or flank of the body.
A pit, a hole in the ground, or a cave.
The act of returning, coming back, or turning around.
One who returns; an assistant, worker, or servant.
Something that has returned or been brought back.
The process of entering, returning, or coming back.
A place or way to enter or return.
To cause to enter, to put in, or to bring back.
To move back and forth or travel repeatedly.
To gather things or people together.
Something that grows on the side or sprouts up naturally.
A sarcastic remark or an indirect way of insulting someone.
To collect, store, or gather items together.
To cause others to gather or collect something.
Someone who gathers or collects things.
A place or tool used for gathering.
A collection, a gathering, or things that are stored together.

amharic: ወላጅ አባት ወንድ ተባት በዘር በሩካቤ የሚወለድና የሚያሶልድ ። አክብር አባከ ውእመከ እስመ እሙንቱ ምክንያተ ፍጥረትከ (ዲድ) ።
english: A biological father, a male parent, or a progenitor who creates life.

amharic: ወገን ቅጽልወይም ሙሻዘር ውስጠ ዘ ዘአበው እንተ አበው ።
english: Pertaining to fathers, ancestors, or ancestral heritage.

geez: አብየ ወፈረ ላቀ ዐብየ፡፡ አቢል ሎት
english: To become firm, to grow strong, to increase, or to advance.

amharic: የገንዘብ ስም ታናሽ ገንዘብ ፭ ሳንቲም የዲድርክም ኻያኛ በዕብራይስጥ ጌራ ይባላል ኻያው ጌራ ፩ ሰቅል እንዲኾን ኻያው አቦሊ አንድ ዲድርክም ነው፡፡
english: A small unit of currency, a coin equivalent to a twentieth of a drachma.

amharic: ሽቱ የሽቱ ስም ቅመም ቀረፋ የጢስ ዕንቀጨት ቅጠላም ያይዶለ፡፡ ቀረፋ ኹለት ዐይነት ነው ቅመምና ሽቱ የሚኾን
english: A type of fragrant spice, cinnamon, or aromatic substance used as incense.

amharic: ወንድ ልጅ ተባት ሲያበዛ አብናእ ይላል፡፡
english: A male child or a son.

amharic: በቁሙ ጸበል ትቢያ ዐቧራ ቅንቅን በነፋስ የሚባን ደቃቅ ነገር ኹሉ፡፡
english: Dust, fine particles, or ashes scattered by the wind.

amharic: መጽሐፍ የመጽሐፍ ስም፡፡ ቃሉ ኹለት ነው ቅጽልና ባለቤት ፡፡
english: The Book of Revelation; the title of a prophetic or hidden writing.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ የካህናት አለቃ አበ ምኔት አበ ማኅበር ርእሰ ባሕታውያን
english: An archimandrite, a chief of priests, or a head of a monastery.

amharic: የፍልስፍና ስም ፈርዖን ለዮሴፍ ያወጣለት ከሣቴ ኅቡእ ማእምረ ኅቡኣት፡፡
english: A title given to Joseph meaning 'revealer of mysteries' or 'knower of secrets'.

amharic: ማባድ ባዕድ ማድረግ መለየት መነጠል ማራቅ ማስገለል መለወጥ መቀየር ሌላውን በሌላ
english: To alienate, to separate, to isolate, or to change one thing into another.

amharic: መክበር መበልጠግ መጌትየት ብዙ ገንዘብ ማግኘት መላቅ መብለጥ በሀብት ማደግ፡፡ ሚስት ማግባት ባል መኾን፡፡
english: To become rich, to prosper, to gain wealth, or to marry.
One who honors or bestows wealth.
Cypress or pine trees.

amharic: አንበሳ ኾነ አንበሳ ተባለ በጠባይ በግብር፡፡
english: To become like a lion or to act with lion-like courage.

amharic: መጥለቅ ወደ ውስጥ፡፡ መመለስ ወደ ኋላ መዞር መታጠፍ ተመልሶ መምጣት፡፡
english: To return, to turn back, to dive in, or to come home.

amharic: መሰብሰብ ማከብ ማጋበስ ማግበስበስ ማከማቸት መልቀም ማጠራቀም መክተት፡፡
english: To gather, to collect, to accumulate, or to store up.

amharic: የሚያሰበስብ አሰባሳቢ አሰባሳቢ፡፡ ልማዱ ግን ሰብሳቢ ነው፡፡
english: A gatherer, collector, or one who convenes.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ የሚሰብስብ ሰብሳቢ መሰብሰቢያ ቦታ
english: A place of gathering, an assembly point, or a collector.
Gathered, collected, assembled, or bundled together.

amharic: መሰብሰብ መሰብሰብ አሰባሰብ ስብሰባ እከባ አንድነት፡፡ መሰብሰቢያ ቦታ ገበያ ሸንጎ አደባባይ ገዳም ቤተ ክሲያን ኹሉ፡፡
english: An assembly, a congregation, a meeting place, or a marketplace.

amharic: የቅኔ ስም መዠመሪያ ቅኔ ባለ፪ ቤት፡፡
english: A name for a specific type of classical poem or song.
A meeting place, a storage area, or a gathering point.
A place or act of gathering.

amharic: መሰብሰብ ማግባት መክተት፡፡ ማቈፈር መቅበር፡፡ ማጓበብ መንጓበብ ጕባ ጐባባ መኾን እንደ ቀስት፡፡ ጕቦ መስጠት መቀበል፡፡
english: To gather, to bury, to curve (like a bow), or to give/receive a bribe.

amharic: ያይን ጕድጓድ ዋሻው ሠርጓዳው ምዕቃሉ ብርንዶው እንደ ፈርጥ የተሰካበት ወይም እንደ ውሃ የመላበት
english: The eye socket.

amharic: አዳራሽ ስቀላ በረንዳ፡፡ ሸንጎ አደባባይ ዐውድ ምቅታል፡፡
english: A hall, porch, courtyard, or assembly area.

amharic: ረዥም ቤት ሰገነት የደርብ ደርብ ዕንቍላል ግንብ፡፡
english: A high house, a balcony, or a multi-storied building.

amharic: መለካት መወሰን ዙሪያው መቍረጥ መከለል የመሬት የሕንጻ፡፡ መጐበዝ፡ መገበዝ ጐበዝ ግብዝ መኾን፡፡ መጋበዝ
english: To measure, to set boundaries, to enclose, or to become clever/deceptive.
A border, edge, or boundary.

amharic: የሆድ በሽታ ብስና ጓታ እህታ የሚቈርጥ የሚጐራብጥ የሚያስቀምጥ፡፡
english: Stomach ailment, cramps, or a digestive disorder.

amharic: ሻታ ሽንት ቅዘን ቀጭን ዐይነት ምድር፡፡
english: A type of discharge, waste, or specific type of soil.
Intestinal worm or parasitic infection.
A road, street, or marketplace.
A traveler, merchant, or market-goer.
To knead dough or mix mud/clay.

amharic: ገንዳ ከግንድ ከደንጊያ የሚሠራ ማቡኪያ ማላቈጫ የከብቶች ውሃ ማጠጫ እንደ ገበታ የተጠረበ የተፈለፈለ
english: A trough, basin, or container carved from wood or stone for watering livestock.

amharic: የተራራ ስም የገሪዛን ወንድም ቅርብ አጠገብ የርግማን ቃሎች የሚነገሩበት ከገሪዛን በስተሰሜን ያለ ፀጋማይ ተራራ፡፡
english: Mount Ebal; a mountain known for its historical and biblical significance.
To curdle milk or make cheese.

amharic: ጅብና ርጎ ዐይብ ያይብ ልጥልጥ በሚዛን የሚሼጥ፡፡
english: Curd, cheese, or dairy product.

amharic: ግብጥ ስመ ነገድ ስመ ሀገር የካም ዕፃ፡፡ መካነ ጻዕር ልሳነ ባሕር የእስያና ያፍሪቃ ወሰን ድንበር ማለት ነው፡፡
english: Egypt; a land, country, or ancient civilization.

amharic: መሥራት ማድረግ መፍጠር ያልነበረ ነገር ማስገኘት የነበረውን ማዘጋጀት ፍጥረትን ከፍጥረት ጨምሮ ሌላ ህላዌ ማቆም እንደ ሥጋና እንደ ሸክላ ቤት እንደ ምንጣፍ በሚሠሩበት ሥራ ማየል መበርታት መሠልጠን
english: To work, to create, to perform, to make, or to strengthen.
A worker, maker, creator, or performer.

amharic: መገበር ማረስ መቈፈር ገበሬ መኾን መነገድ ንግድ ማድረግ
english: To work, farm, trade, or serve as a farmer or laborer.

amharic: ገበሬ ሠራተኛ በግድ የሚሠራ ባለርስት ባሪያ
english: A farmer, worker, or someone who performs manual labor or service.
Someone who is industrious, a worker, or skilled in a craft.
A servant, a subject, or someone who is under the authority of another.
The state of being a servant, slavery, or being under submission.
To make someone work or to cause work to be done.
An employer, supervisor, or someone who gives orders.
To force, compel, or make someone do something against their will.
Someone who forces, compels, or imposes tasks upon others.
To coordinate work, oversee a task, or cause work to be accomplished.
A manager, supervisor, or the one who organizes work.
An active worker, laborer, or creator.
To be created, made, done, or prepared.
To be done as a task, to have been farmed or traded.
Something created, made, or a living being.
The act of doing, creating, or the process of making something.
A deed, an action, a creation, or a thing done.
An occupation, manual work, farming, or a trade.
The style, method, or manner of performing a task.
A tool, equipment, or instrument used for work.

amharic: ሥራ የሚገባ የማይገባ በሕግ የታዘዘ ማናቸውም
english: Conduct, character, or the way one acts (good or bad deeds).
To gather, plaster, or smooth over surfaces like walls.
A plasterer or someone who smooths or finishes a surface.
To be plastered, smoothed, or finished.
A plastered finish, a smooth coating, or mortar.

amharic: ኖራ በረቅ የደንጊያ ዐመድ ነጭ ደቃቅ
english: Lime, chalk, or fine white ash powder.
Barley (a type of grain).
A sudden action or movement.
A wooden platter, tray, or a kneading board.
The name of a book containing the Epistles of the Apostles.
An owl or a bird of the owl family.

amharic: መንቈር ቀንበር ዛንጀር የቅንጣትና ያገዛዝ መሣሪያ
english: Shackles, a yoke, or a device for binding or restraining.

amharic: መጓጓት መመኘት ተስፋ ማድረግ መጐምዠት መቸኰል መጣደፍ
english: To long for, desire greatly, hurry, or strive eagerly.
Someone who is hasty, impatient, or in a rush.
Eager, quick, hasty, or industrious.
Haste, eagerness, or a rush.
Speed, urgency, effort, or great diligence.
To hurry, rush, or prompt someone to move quickly.
Urgent or prompting haste.

amharic: መንገጽ ተግ ማለት መቆም መገታት ማፈግፈግ
english: To hesitate, retreat, or stop out of fear or shyness.
Hesitation, retreat, fear, or shyness.
The quality of being hesitant or withdrawn.
To make someone retreat, feel shy, or hesitate.
A term for cutting or casting aside.
To strike, hit, or damage.

amharic: መጐደብ ማረድ ማቈፈር ማጐድጐድ ማቍረጥ የመሬት፡፡ መመንደብ መጕረድ መጕመድ መጨፍጨፍ መመንጠር መለበድ ካንቻ መምታት የንጨት፡፡ መገደብ መወደብ መክተር ማገድ የውሃ፡፡
english: The act of cutting, carving, digging, or building a barrier for water or wood.

amharic: በቁሙ የታረደ የተቈረጠ ዕርድ ምሽግ፡፡ ማንኵት ፈፋ ውሃ የበላው መሬት፡፡
english: A fortified structure, an excavated area, or land eroded by water.

amharic: ምግዛት ገዠሞ የብረት መሣሪያ መጥረቢያ ምሣር፡፡ ኹለት አፍ ብረት ምሣርና ዶማ የሚቈርጥና የሚቈፍር እጀታው አንድ ምላሱ ጥንድ
english: A heavy metal tool like an axe or mattock with a single handle and dual blades used for cutting and digging.

amharic: በቁሙ ገደገደ አቆመ አጸና ተከለ የይሎ የድንኳን፡
english: To build, set up, strengthen, or pitch a tent firmly.

amharic: መገደድ በግድ መያዝ ማስገደድ ግድ ማለት የዳኛ የባለዳ፡፡ መወንበድ መሸፈት መጨከን የስራዊት፡፡ መባስ መታደስ ማገርሸት የደዌ የክፋት፡፡
english: The act of forcing, oppressing, acting rebelliously, or a worsening of an illness.

amharic: በግድ የተያዘ ወይም የሚይዝ የሚያስገድድ ጨካኝ ወንበዴ ሽፍታ፡፡
english: Someone who is forced, or a cruel, aggressive bandit.
Something done without choice, or a feeling of compulsion.

amharic: መገደድ ማስገደድ ግዴታ ግድ ግዳጅ ጥናት ብርታት፡፡
english: Obligation, duty, a forced task, or the strength to endure effort.

amharic: መጓደድ መቈነን ያካኼድ ያረማመድ የታቦት የዑደት ታቦት የዑደት፡፡
english: The manner of walking or a specific way of processing, often used for religious processions.

amharic: ያዛባ ጡብ የኵበት ጠገራ ከባድ ጥፍጥፍ ሲማገድ ከእሳት ሲዋሐድ የሚጓደድ ብርቱ ጠንካራ፡፡
english: Something hardened, strong, or dense, like baked clay or heavy dried material.

amharic: ደጅ መታ ቀበቀበ እጅ ጸፋ አጨበጨበ ለማስከፈት፡፡
english: To knock on a door, clap hands, or tap to get someone's attention to open.
To rumble, roar, or make a loud, thundering sound.

amharic: በቁሙ የመብረቅ ጓታ ነጐዳ ታላቅ ግሩም ድምጥ የሚያስፈራ የሚያስደነግጥ
english: Thunder; a loud, frightening, and powerful sound accompanying lightning.
To give, offer, present, or in some contexts, to withhold or restrain.

amharic: የሰው ስም ገድ ብዕል በረከት ማለት ነው
english: A name meaning wealth or blessing.
Power or strength.

amharic: መግደል ማቍሰል ማረድ መቅተል ማነቅ ገደል መጣል፡፡
english: The act of killing, wounding, slaughtering, or casting down.
A killer, someone who destroys or takes a life.
To cause someone to kill or to drop something.

amharic: ተገድለ ታረደ በሰው እጅ ሞተ ተጣለ ወደቀ ገደል ገባ፡፡
english: To be killed, slaughtered, or to fall into a deep pit.
A corpse, something that has been cast down or discarded.
A cliff, gorge, or a deep, steep drop.

amharic: በቁሙ ታገለ ተናነቀ ተማታ ተቋሰለ ተጋ ተዋጋ ተላለፈ ተቃወመ ተከራከረ ተደባደበ
english: To struggle, fight, wrestle, contend, or argue with someone.
A fighter, someone who struggles or strives for a noble goal, often used for spiritual warriors.

amharic: በቁሙ ትግል ፈተና ውጊያ ሰልፍ ድልና አክሊል አስኪገኝ ድረስ የሚደክሙት ድካም የሚሠሩት ሥራ የሚቀበሉት መከራ፡፡
english: A struggle, battle, or hard work undertaken with endurance to achieve victory or a spiritual reward.

amharic: የሚጋደል የሚታገል ታጋዳሊ፡፡ የሚጋደል የሚያስታግል አጋዳይ፡፡
english: To cause a struggle, or someone who encourages or engages others in a contest or battle.

amharic: ሐጺጽ ነቲግ ንኢስ መጕደል ማነስ ሕጹጽ መኾን፡፡
english: To lack, be deficient, become small, or insufficient.
Something that is incomplete, missing, or insufficient.
Having a deficient or incomplete quality.
To decrease, reduce, or make something less.
To lie down, rest, or be positioned horizontally.
Horizontal, across, or width-wise.
The horizontal beam of a cross.

amharic: በቁሙ ምኔት ደብር የመነኮሳት ሰፈር ታላቅ ቤተ ክሲያን በደለኛ ሸሽቶ የሚጠጋበት
english: A monastery; a remote, peaceful place where monks live or where one seeks sanctuary.

amharic: የገዳም ሰው በረኽኛ ዐዳኝ መነኵሴ ባሕታዊ፡፡
english: Relating to a monastery; a monastic or hermit-like lifestyle.
To lay something down horizontally or to put to bed.
To entwine or crisscross, often referring to legs or cords.

amharic: የሚያገድም አግድሞ የሚያይ ጠማማ ፀዋግ አግድሞ አደግ፡፡
english: Something horizontal, or a side-glance, or an oblique path.

amharic: አግድሞ አየ የተንኰል የክፋት የንቀት የስርቆት አተያየ፡፡
english: To look sideways with trickery, contempt, or evil intent.

amharic: መጕዳት መንካት መጐነጥ መምታት መደሰቅ፡፡ መሰባበር መድቀቅ፡፡ መውጋት መውገጥ መለጥለጥ፡፡
english: To harm, hit, injure, break, or strike someone.
Harmful, something that causes injury or pain.

amharic: ተጐዳ ተመታ ተነካ ተጐነጠ ተሰበረ ተፈተነ፡፡
english: To be harmed, injured, struck, or tested by hardship.

amharic: የተጐዳ የተነካ ንክ ሰባራ ከዋሻ ኰሳሳ፡፡
english: Injured, broken, or in a damaged state.

amharic: መጕዳት መጐዳት አጐዳድ አነካክ ጕዳት ንኪት ስብራት፡፡
english: Injury, damage, or the act of hurting.
To clash, collide, or engage in a fight with someone.
The chest or breast area, often used to reflect courage or depth of heart.

amharic: መግደፍ መጣል መተው መርሳት ማጥፋት የጣፊ የተማሪ
english: To abandon, cast aside, leave behind, or forget.
One who abandons, renounces, or leaves things behind.
To cast away, drop, or cause something to be abandoned.

amharic: ተገደፈ ተጣለ ወደቀ ተተወ ተረሳ ቀረ ጠፋ ታጣ
english: To be discarded, fallen, forgotten, left behind, or lost.

amharic: የተገደፈ የተጣለ የወደቀ የተኛ የተጋደመ የጠፋ የታጣ የረከሰ የተናቀ
english: Something that is discarded, fallen, neglected, or cast away.

amharic: በቁሙ መግደፍ መጣል መገደፍ አገዳደፍ ገደፋ ርሳታ ዝንጋታ ነዳፍነት
english: The act of discarding, neglect, or a mistake due to forgetfulness.

amharic: በቁሙ ጥራጊ ውዳቂ ዝብል ተጠርጎ የሚጣል
english: Refuse, debris, or trash that is swept away.
To become dirty, stained, or messy.
A wall, fence, or stone enclosure.

amharic: ወራሪ ዘራፊ ፋኖ ወያኔ የሽፍታ ሰራዊት የወንበዴ ጭፍራ
english: An invader, raider, or a band of outlaws or bandits.
A young female cow that has not yet had a calf.
Dawn or the first light of day.
To distance, separate, or block something.

amharic: መጋድ መገለጥ መታየት ግልጥ ገሃድ መኾን መታወቅ መረዳት
english: The act of revealing, becoming clear, or being understood.

amharic: በቁሙ የሚጋድ የሚገለጥ ተገላጭ ተገላላጭ ግልጥ
english: Something clear, evident, or easily revealed.

amharic: ተልጦ ተገልጦ ግልጥ ኾኖ በግልጥ በገሃድ
english: Openly, clearly, or publicly.

amharic: የተጋደ የተገለጠ ግልጥ የታየ የጐላ የተረዳ ጕልሕ
english: Something revealed, visible, or clearly understood.
The state of being revealed or manifestation.

amharic: በቁሙ የልደት የጥምቀት ዋዜማ እንዳርብና ረቡ የሚጦም
english: The eve of a religious festival like Christmas or Epiphany, characterized by fasting.

amharic: አጋደ ገለጠ አስገለጠ አሳየ አስረዳ ገልጦ ነገረ
english: To reveal, show, demonstrate, or explain clearly.
One who reveals or something that serves as evidence.
An explanation, a sign, or proof.

amharic: መብራት ማብራት መጽደል መምላት መተካከል ምሉእ ፍጹም መሆን መድመቅ
english: Illumination, shining, or the process of becoming perfect and bright.
To hide or to make a loud sound like wailing or humming.
One who hides something or someone who makes a loud sound.
Hidden, concealed, or secret.

amharic: በቁሙ ዐቢይ ዜማ ስልት ያለው ጩኸት ጉማ ተመማ ወፍራም ድምጥ
english: A deep, resonant sound or melodic chanting.
To shout together, clamor, or speak aloud.
To cause a commotion, make others shout, or chant together.

amharic: ሲኦል መቃብር የእሳት ጕድጓድ ዐዘቅት መካነ ኃጥኣን
english: Hell, the place of punishment or the fiery pit.
Pertaining to hell or its fires.
To strive, assemble, or migrate.

amharic: መሳት መሳሳት ከሕግ ከሥርዐት ከመንገድ መውጣት ከጽድቅ መራቅ
english: To stray from the path, commit an error, or deviate from the law.

amharic: የሚያባክን የሚባክን በካን በከንካና ዘዋሪ ተላዋጭ
english: Someone who is wasteful, aimless, or constantly moving about.
Wasteful, aimless, or scattered.
Wastefulness, aimlessness, or confusion of the heart.

amharic: ብክነት ሁከት ቅብዝብዝታ ቍጣ ብስጭት የቅለት ሥራ
english: Waste, confusion, restlessness, or agitation.
A vast multitude or army moving in a crowd.
A name related to the tribe of Gog.

amharic: የብዙ ብዙ ማጎግ የብዙዎች ህዝቦች ስም
english: A term referring to a vast multitude or nations.

amharic: ጥራዝ የመጽሐፍ ነዶ ገና ያልተሰፋ ያልተጠረዘ
english: A bundle of pages or a book not yet bound.

amharic: ኮከብ ስመ ኮከብ ከ፲፪ መናዝል አንዱ
english: The star sign Gemini, one of the twelve constellations.

amharic: በቁሙ የታወቀ የተክል ዛፍ ስም የፍሬው ዐጥንት ደረቅ ጠንካራ
english: A walnut or similar nut-bearing tree.

amharic: መጎሕ መውገግ መፍገግ ወገግ ፈገግ ማለት የንጋት ምልክት
english: The breaking of dawn or the appearance of morning light.
Dawn, the first light appearing before sunrise.
To shine, radiate light, or be revealed.

amharic: ማጠር መቅጠር ዘለላ መጣል መካብ መክበብ
english: To fence, wall, or enclose an area.
A cattle shed or pen.
Gilgal, a proper name of a place.

amharic: መካነ ርእስ መካነ ድማኅ፡፡ የአዳም ራስ ቅል የተቀበረባት ቀራንዮ ናት፡፡
english: Golgotha; the place of the skull, where tradition says Adam was buried and Jesus was crucified.

amharic: መልክ ሕብር ዐይነት አንጻር አርኣያ አምሳል፡፡ በቁሙ ጐን ገቦ፡፡
english: A side, appearance, or likeness; often referring to the side of a body or an object.

amharic: ህላዌ ጠባይዕ ገላ ግዙፍ ሥጋ ሬሳ የሚታይና የሚዳሰስ ማናቸውም ግዙፍ ነገር ኹሉ፡፡
english: Any physical, solid, or tangible object; body or substance.

amharic: መቅረብ መጠጋት ቅርብ አጠገብ ጥገኛ በቤት በቦታ፡፡
english: Being near, close by, or in the immediate vicinity.

amharic: ጓሮ የቤት ኋላ፡፡ በቁሙ ጎረ ቤት ቤቱ ቅርብ ጎን ሕፅን አጠገብ የኾነ የርስት የመሬት የቦታ አዋሳኝ ደንበረተኛ በዙሪያ ላለ ለቅርብ ኹሉ ይነገራል፡፡
english: A backyard, neighboring area, or the space adjacent to a house or property boundary.
Neighbors or those who are close by.
To become neighbors, to come together, or to be close to one another.

amharic: ያንበሳ ግልገል የዥብ የተኵላ የውሻ የናቱን ጡት አጥብቆ የሚመጠምጥ፡፡
english: A young animal (such as a lion, wolf, or puppy) that suckles from its mother.

amharic: ዐገመ ዐከመ ጠባ ሳበ መጠመጠ ደምን እንደ ወተት ለማውጣት፡፡
english: To suck, drain, or draw out, similar to how an animal draws milk or blood.
A practitioner who performs cupping or bloodletting.

amharic: ነጣቂ ወፍ አሞራ ጭላት የጭላት ዐይነት፡፡
english: A bird of prey, such as a hawk or vulture.

amharic: የቃ ቤት ግምጃ ቤት ጐተራ የብዕል የገንዘብ መክተቻ ማድለቢያ ማሰብሰቢያ የቤተ መዛግብት፡፡
english: A treasury, storehouse, or granary where valuable items and wealth are kept.

amharic: ስመ ሀገር የይሁዳ ክፍል ካምስቱ አህጉረ ኢሎፍሊ አንዲቱ የፍልስጥዔም ደቡብ በባሕር ጠረፍ ያለች፡፡
english: Gaza, an ancient coastal city in the region of the Philistines.

amharic: መግዛት መዋጀት መጌትየት ጌታ መኾን በገንዘብ በዜጋ መሠልጠን፡፡
english: To rule, govern, own, or manage; to be in a position of authority.

amharic: የሚገዛ ገዥ ጌታ ሹም ባለቤት፡፡ የሚሰጥ የሚናኝ ቀጅ አሳላፊ ዐዳይ የድግስ አገልጋይ፡፡
english: A ruler, master, owner, or someone who provides and serves.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ ገዥ ዐዳይ ቀላቢ ሐፃኒ መጋቢ ሞግዚት፡፡
english: A guardian, provider, or caretaker.

amharic: ፍሪዳ ሰንጋ ድልብ ቅልብ ኰርማ ገች ሙክት የሥጋ ከብት፡፡
english: Fattened livestock intended for food, such as a steer or fatted calf.

amharic: አስገዛ እጌትየ ጌታ አደረገ ሾመ አሠለጠነ ራሱን ወይም ሌላውን፡፡
english: To appoint as a master, to rule over, or to establish authority.

amharic: ጌታ ገዥ አዛዥ ሹም ባለቤት መምህር አያት ታላቅ ወንድም፡፡
english: A lord, master, ruler, teacher, or elder.

amharic: እመቤት ወይዘሮ ሴት አያት ታላቅ እኅት፡፡
english: A lady, mistress, grandmother, or elder sister.
An Empress; the wife of a King.
Pertaining to the Lord; divine or godly.

amharic: ሥልጠና ሹመት መብት፡፡ በቁሙ ገዥነት ጌትነት እግዜርነት፡፡
english: Authority, mastership, lordship, or divine rule.

amharic: የጩኸትና ያቤቱታ የምልጃ የልመና ቃል አቤቱ እግዜር ሆይ ጌታ ሆይ፡፡
english: A cry for help or prayer; 'O Lord,' used in supplication.
God; the Creator and Ruler of the world.
Godly nature or divine character.
To be ruled, to be subject to, or to obey.

amharic: ግዙ የተገዛ ተገዥ ዜጋ ገብር ገባር፡፡
english: A subject, a citizen, or one who is ruled.

amharic: መግዛት መገዛት አገዛዝን ግዙነት ግዛት ይዞታ ርስት ጕልት፡፡
english: Authority, domain, rule, or territory.

amharic: ጋሬዳ ድግስ መሰናዶ ፍሪዳ ያለበት የመብል የመጠጥ የምሳ በዓል፡፡
english: A feast, banquet, or sacrificial meal.

amharic: የተለየ የተወሰነ ሰዓት ዕለት ወርኅ ዓመት ዘመን ዕድሜ፡፡
english: Time, a specific moment, day, month, year, or a period of one's life.
To cut, prune, or trim.
To spread out, prepare, or arrange (like a bed or mat).

amharic: ዐልጋ በቁሙ ጕዝጓዝ ስፍር ስጋጃ ምንጣፍ የሴት ልብስ ልሐፍ፡፡
english: A mat, rug, bed covering, or carpet.

amharic: መግዘዝ መሸለት መቍረጥ መቈራረጥ ማጨድ መጨርገድ የጠጕር የፀምር የሳር የቅጠል፡፡
english: To prune, shear, cut, or trim (hair, wool, grass, or plants).
One who prunes or cuts; a cutter.

amharic: መጋረጃ ዐጥር ቅጥር ከለላ ጀጐል ጋራ ተራራ ገመገም፡፡
english: A curtain, fence, partition, or barrier.
To cause to be cut or trimmed; to build a partition.

amharic: መግዘም መቍረጥ መጐንደብ መመንደብ መመልመል መጨፍጨፍ ድል መንሣት ማሸነፍ፡፡
english: To cut down, hack, destroy, defeat, or conquer.

amharic: በቁሙ ቃዳ ተለላ ፈፋ እመም መዛሪያ ትልም በዘርና ባረም ባጨዳ ጊዜ ሠራተኞች ከዳር እስከ ዳር የሚያወጡት ክፍል፡፡
english: A reaper or one who clears land for harvesting.
To have something cut or harvested.
To be cut down, hacked, or destroyed.
Cut, hacked, or trimmed.

amharic: መግዘም መገዘም አገዛዘም አቈራረጥ ቈረጣ ምልመላ ጭፍጨፋ፡፡
english: The act of cutting, pruning, or destruction.
A scrap, fragment, or piece that has been cut off.
A treasury or storehouse.
To saw, cut, or shred using a saw-like action.
A saw or tool used for cutting.

amharic: ጕንደ ዕፅ ካሥር በላይና ከዐጽቅ በታች በመካከል ያለው አፅጹቅ እንደ ዐምድ ኹኖ የሚሸከም
english: The sturdy main part of a plant or tree trunk that stands like a pillar supporting its weight.

amharic: መግዘፍ መወፈር መደንደን መዳጐስ መሥባት ወፍራም ደንደሳም መኾን
english: The state of becoming thick, solid, heavy, or sturdy.

amharic: የገዘፈ ወፍራም ደጓሳ ደንዳና ጕልሕ ሥጋዊ
english: Describing something that is thick, large, heavy, or solid.

amharic: በቁሙ ዝኒ ከማሁ ይኩን ልብሶሙ እምፀምር ግዙፍ
english: Describing something that is thick, coarse, or made of heavy material.

amharic: መግዘፍ መወፈር አወፋፈር ወፍራምነት ውፍራ ወፍር ውፋሬ ድንዳኔ
english: The quality of being thick, heavy, or solid; thickness.
Thickness, heaviness, or solid mass.
To make something thick, solid, or heavy.
To make thick, solid, or heavy.
Something used to thicken or make an object solid.

amharic: መግዘር መግረዝ የብልት ሽንኰፍ ቈርጦ መጣል ወይም በጭራሽ መስለብ
english: The act of circumcision or cutting off a small part.
One who performs a circumcision or a skilled cutter.
To have someone circumcised or cause an act of circumcision.
To be circumcised or cut.
One who has been circumcised.

amharic: በቁሙ መግዘር መገዘር አገዛዘር ገዘራ ግዙርነት ግዝራት
english: The act or practice of circumcision.
Circumcision or the state of being circumcised.

amharic: ደሴት የየብስ ቍራጭ ባሕር ያጠረው የከበበው መሬት አገር
english: An island; land surrounded by water.
An act of forbidding, blaming, or banishment.
The feeling of fear, anxiety, or the act of rising early.

amharic: ሽኮኮ አሽኮኮ እንደ ጥንቸል ያለ ሣር ቅጠል ቡቃያ የሚበላ
english: A small rabbit-like animal (a rock hyrax) that eats plants and makes noises at dawn.
To weed, remove, or clear away plants.

amharic: ዐረም እሾኻም ቅጠል ኵርንችት ዐቃቅም አሜከላ ሙጃ የመሰለው ኹሉ
english: Weeds, thorns, or unwanted prickly plants.

amharic: ማፍረስ መጣስ ማቃጠል መተኰስ የሕቅ የቅጥር የቤት መስረቅ መቀማት መውረር መዝረፍ
english: The act of destroying, burning down, robbing, or stealing.

amharic: ክፉ አድራጊ ሌባ ቀጣፊ ዳንዴ ወንበዴ ቀማኛ የቀን ወራሪ የሌት ሰባሪ ቤት አቃጣይ ነፍሰ ገዳይ
english: A thief, criminal, wrongdoer, or an evildoer.

amharic: ሸነገለ አታለለ ዋሸ ዐበለ ከዳ ተተነኰለ
english: To deceive, betray, tell lies, or plot against someone.

amharic: የሚሸነገል የሚያታልል ሸንጋይ አታላይ ዋሾ ዐባይ ዕላዊ ከዳተኛ ተንኰለኛ
english: A deceptive, dishonest, or treacherous person.
To be deceived or be a victim of trickery.
To be tricked, deceived, or cheated.

amharic: የተታለለ የተሸነገለ ሽንግል ድልል ሌሎች ያታለሉት የሽነገሉት
english: One who has been deceived or tricked.

amharic: መታለል ማታለል አታላይነት ሽንገላ ልብለባ ክዳት ተንኰል
english: Deception, trickery, betrayal, or dishonesty.
To cause betrayal or to lead someone into treachery.

amharic: መግባት ማረፍ ማደር መጠጋት መምጣት መቅረብ
english: To enter, rest, arrive, or draw near.

amharic: የሚገባ ገቢ መጪ የሚርቅ የሚያገል አግላይ ፈቅቅ ባይ መናኒ
english: One who arrives or one who keeps away and lives in seclusion.

amharic: የገባ የመጣ የራቀ ያገለለ የተለየ ልዩ ፍጹም ባሕታዊ በረኸኛ
english: Someone who has entered, arrived, or chosen to live a life of seclusion.

amharic: መግባት መራቅ አራራቅ ርቀት ሽሽት ስደት
english: The act of arriving, departing, or seeking seclusion.

amharic: አገባ አስገባ አራቀ አስራቀ አስገለለ አሶገደ ለየ
english: To cause someone to enter or to cause them to go away/separate.

amharic: የሚያገባ አግቢ አራቂ አስገላይ አጋፋሪ ከልካይ
english: One who helps someone enter or one who keeps someone apart.

amharic: መግቢያ ማግቢያ ማግለያ ማስገለያ ቦታ ዐዘቅት ኵስሕ
english: An entrance, an exit, or a designated place for entry or removal.

amharic: መጋፍ መጥረግ ማፈሥ መውሰድ ማንሣት ማስገለል
english: The act of sweeping, scooping up, or removing something.
One who sweeps, scoops up, or is greedy.
To cause someone to sweep, remove, or lift up.
Something that has been swept, scooped up, or removed.

amharic: ቅርጫት መሶብ እንቅብ አገልግል ቅንብቻ ኰፈዳ ግትቻ
english: A basket, container, or bag used for carrying items.
A tool used for sweeping or scooping.
The hard shell of a sea turtle.

amharic: መጕበጥ መጐንበስ መጽነን እንደ ደጋን መኾን በደዌ እብርግና
english: To become hunched, bent over, or curved due to age or illness.
A person who is hunched or bent over.
The condition of being hunched or bent.

amharic: አጐበጠ አስጐበጠ ጐባጣ አደረገ ዐረቀ ቀለለ አስጐነበሰ
english: To cause someone to bend over or become hunched.

amharic: ፍሕም ፍም የእሳት ምርት የበለስ ዕንጨት ብስል በርበሬ የሚመስል
english: Glowing charcoal or embers from a fire.

amharic: በቁሙ ዐባጣ ሸካራ የምድር መሬት የበትር የንጨት ለእጅም ይኾናል፡፡
english: A bump, knot, or rugged terrain; can also refer to a knot on a wooden staff or a knuckle on a hand.

amharic: መጓጐጥ መጐጥጐጥ መሠቅሠቅ መቈፈር መሰርሰር መውጋት መትከል፡፡ ማጣበቅ መቈንጠር አጣብቆ መያዝ፡፡
english: To poke, pierce, dig, drill, plant, pinch, or hold something tightly.
Someone or something that pierces, sticks, or pinches.

amharic: መውጊያ መጓጐጫ መቈንጠጫ አሽሙር ችንካር አርቃሾ፡፡
english: A tool used for piercing, pinching, or fastening; a sharp object like a nail.

amharic: በቁሙ መቈንጠጫ አጥብቆ አጣብቆ መያዣ አንደ መቀስ ፪ ጣት ያለው፡፡
english: A pair of tongs or tweezers used for gripping or holding objects tightly.

amharic: ሕዝብ ያንድ አገርና ያንድ መንግሥት ሰው ቋንቋውና ሕጉ አንድ የኾነ፡፡
english: A group of people belonging to the same nation, sharing the same language and laws.
A pocket or a pouch.

amharic: መሳት መሳሳት ከመንገድ መውጣት በስሕተት መበደል ኅጢአት መሥራት፡፡
english: To make a mistake, wander from the path, commit an error, or do wrong.
One who errs, makes mistakes, or acts wrongly.
A person who has strayed, is ignorant, or is a wrongdoer/sinner.
A mistake, wrongdoing, sin, or evil act.
To cause someone to stray or commit a sin.

amharic: የባከነ ብኩን ብክንክን በካና እንቡዝ ቅብዝብዝ፡፡
english: Wasteful, aimless, or reckless behavior.

amharic: የባከነ ብኩን ብክንክን በካና እንቡዝ ቅብዝብዝ፡፡
english: Wasteful, aimless, or reckless behavior.
To hurry, run, escape, or become strong/energetic.

amharic: ቅጽል፡፡ ብርቱ ጮሌ ፈጣን ሯጭ ፈርጣጭ፡፡
english: Energetic, clever, fast, or quick to escape.
To cause to hurry, make run, or urge to speed up.

amharic: መሸሽ መኰብለል፡፡ መራቅ መሰደድ ካሉበት ከነበሩበት መጥፋት መታጣት ወደ ሌላ ሕዝብ መኼድ መጠጋት፡፡
english: To flee, escape, go into exile, or leave one's home to seek refuge elsewhere.
One who has fled or is a fugitive.

amharic: መሸሽ መኰብለል ሽሽት ኵብለላ ስደት ሩጫ ፍርጠጣ፡፡
english: The act of fleeing, escaping, or running away.
Flight, exile, or the act of escaping.
To chase away, cause to flee, or drive off.
Someone or something that drives away or causes others to flee.
A place of refuge, a shelter, or a place to escape to.

amharic: መጎም መዳመን ደመና መልበስ በጉም መታፈን መሸፈን መጮኽ ማስገምገም ማስተጋባት፡፡
english: To become foggy, be covered in clouds, or to rumble like thunder.

amharic: ጉም ብዙ ደመና ከምድር ወርዶ ተራራ ኰረብታ የሚሸፍን ወዠድ ለወዠድ የሚጐተት የቀን ጨለማ፡፡
english: Fog or a thick mist that covers the ground and mountains.

amharic: ታላቅ ጩኸት ጓህና ተመማ የብዙ ሰው ዜማ፤ በቁሙ የነፍስ ዋጋ ለሟች ወገን የሚሰጠው ካሳ፡፡
english: A loud collective cry, a song, or historically, compensation paid to the family of a deceased person.

amharic: ርኩም አፈ ረዥም ክንፈ ውዥምዥም ድምጡ እንደ ከበሮ የሚተም እንደ ነጋሪት የሚጐሰም እንደ ሰማይ የሚያስገመገም፡፡
english: A deep, resounding sound like a drum or distant thunder.

amharic: ስመ ፈለግ ካራቱ ዐበይት አፍላጋት ኹለተኛው ወንዝ ነጭ አባይ ከአፍሪቃ ደቡብ ተነሥቶ ወደ ሰሜን ወደ ሱዳን አገር የሚፈስ፡፡
english: Gihon; a great river, traditionally identified with the White Nile, known for its powerful flow.

amharic: መሰብሰብ መክተት መሰለፍ ለጦር ለመንገድ መዘጋጀት ከዚህ በኋላ መዝመት መገሥገሥ ማልዶ መኼድ፡፡
english: To gather, prepare for a journey or battle, or set off early in the morning.
Someone who travels early in the morning or sets off on a journey.
A traveler, stranger, or someone passing through.

amharic: አገሠገሠ አስገሠገሠ አማለደ አስማለደ ማለዳ ወሰደ፡፡
english: To cause to march, send off, or escort someone early in the morning.
Tomorrow morning or the following day.

amharic: መንቀፍ መስደብ መገደር መናቅ ማጥቃት ማስጨነቅ ማስቸገር፡፡
english: To criticize, insult, mock, attack, or trouble someone.

amharic: ተነቀፈ ተናቀ፡፡ ተነቃቀፈ ተናናቀ ተገዳደረ፡፡ ተጊያጊያጠ ተሸላለመ፡፡
english: To be mocked, to argue with one another, or to challenge or compete.
An ornament, decoration, garment, or equipment.

amharic: ሳተ ለቀቀ የሕፃን የድውይ፡፡ ሸሸ አመለጠ፡፡
english: To slip, make a mistake, or flee and escape.

amharic: በፍቅር በትምርት መሳብ ማቅረብ ማስጠጋት አሕዛብ ከጣዖት ማፍለስ በኦሪት ማሳመን መግዘር ይሁዲ ማድረግ፡፡
english: To draw someone in through teaching or love; to convert someone to a new belief or faith.
One who brings others near or converts them to a faith.

amharic: ወደ አይሁድ መጣ ተጠጋ ይሁዲ ኾነ በኦሪት አመነ፡፡
english: To become a convert to a faith (often Judaism in the context of Ge'ez texts).

amharic: መጤ መጣተኛ ስደተኛ ካገሩ ከሕጉ የፈለብ ፈላሻ የአይሁድ ጥገኛ በኦሪት ያመነ ግዙር፡፡
english: A stranger, an immigrant, a convert, or one who has joined a new faith.
The act of plastering, coating, or smoothing a surface.
The state of being an immigrant, exile, or convert.

amharic: ቍርዕ ቍር ቦርቦርቲ የራስ ጋሻ ከወፍራም ቈርበት የሚሠራ ላዩ ብረት ውስጡ ቈርበት በጦርነት ጊዜ የምለበስ፡፡
english: A helmet made of thick leather or metal worn in battle for protection.
A title for God or the Lord.
To move forward or travel.

amharic: ጦር ዘገር የሚወረወር ዐጭር መጠነኛ፡፡ ባለብሉዮች ግን ላማርኛ ስለ ቀረበ ጋሻ ይሉታል፡፡ አልዕል እዴከ በጋይሶ (ኢሳ ፰ ፲፰)፡፡ በዶንን እይ፡፡
english: A short spear used for throwing; some consider it a shield.
To become a master or a lord.
Wealth, riches, or lordship.

amharic: ስመ ሀገር የኢሎፍሊ ክፍል፡፡ ፈለሰት ታቦተ እግዚአብሔር ውስተ ጌት (፩ነገ ፭ ፰)፡፡ ሴት ጌትያዊ (፪ነገ ፲፰ ፪)፡፡
english: The name of a Philistine city.

amharic: ፋሮ ፋደት መጠማት ድመት ሾላ ሙጭ ሙጭላ ዶሮ ዶሮ የሚያድን የሚበላ መሬት የምፍር የሚቈፍር ታናሽ ክፋ አውሬ፡፡ ዐይነቱና ስሙ ብዙ ነው ባለብሉዮች ግን ፪ አፍ ያለው እባብ ይሉታል (ዘሌ፲፩ ፴)፡፡
english: A small, dangerous predatory animal or, according to some scholars, a two-mouthed snake.
Darkness.
A broken piece of pottery or a shard.

amharic: ማጥመድ መቃጥን መሰደድ መረብ መንዛት መሳብ መጐተት መግለብ መሥራት ያሣ ወጋሪ፡፡ እንዘ ንገልብ (ኪዳ)፡፡ መግለብ መግለጥ የኅፍረት የቂጥ፡፡ መሸሽ መሮጥ መጋለብ ማምለጥ መዘራት መበተን መቅለል መንጓለል ፍሬ ቢስ መኾን የገለባ፡፡
english: To cast a net, fish, or wander; also refers to fleeing or being empty/chaff-like.

amharic: መቃጥን መንጠቆ መግለቦ ዞረ መትር ያሣ ወጥመድ መያዣ መጋፈፊያ፡፡ ከመ በመግለብት ወበመዋቅሕተ ኅጺን ዓሣ ተሐውር (ዕር ኢሳ፫ ፮)፡፡ ጀልባ ታንኳ ፍልኳ ዓሣ  ወጋሮች የሚቀመጡበት፡፡ አንዳንድ መጽሐፍ በገለብ ፈንታ ጌልያ ብሎ መርከብ ይላል፡፡ ገለባ ንፋሽ እንጕላይ (ዐማርኛ)፡፡
english: A fishing net, trap, or a small boat used by fishermen.

amharic: ጋሻ ዐጋም በግራ የሚያዝ የሚነገብ አላባሽ አግሬ፡፡
english: A shield held in the left hand.

amharic: ዠማ ነጋዴ ቅፍለት ማኅበር ኹኖ አጋሰሱን ጭኖ እንደ ጐርፍ የሚኼድ የሚያረብድ፡፡
english: A caravan or a group of merchants traveling together with pack animals.

amharic: አሸሸ አባረረ፡፡ ገለባ አወጣ አጓለበ አንጓለለ፡፡ አስገለበ አስገለጠ፡፡
english: To chase away, drive off, or reveal.

amharic: የሚያሸሽ አባራሪ ዓሣ ወጋሪ፡፡ መግለቦ ሠሪ ገለባ አውጭ፡፡ መጸብሓዊ ወመገልብ (መቅ ወን)፡፡
english: One who chases, drives off, or a fisherman.

amharic: ሸፈነ ከደነ አለበሰ አከናነበ ጋረደ ለበጠ መረገ ለሰነ ቀባ፡፡ ገልበቡ ርእሶሙ፡፡ ይገልብብ አፉሁ፡፡ ይገለብብዎ ገጾ፡፡ ሥብሕ ዘይገለብብ ከርሦ፡፡ ዘይገለብብቦ ለሰማይ በደመና፡፡ ወገልበቡ ኵሎ ዘውስቴቱ እምዕፅ በነፍጥ ብዙኅ፡፡ ገልበበታ ለንፍቅ ፒስ (ኤር፲፬ ፬፡፡ ዘሌ፲፫ ፵፭፡፡ ሉቃ ፳፪ ፷፬፡፡ ዘፀ፳፱ ፳፱፡፡ መዝ ፻፵፮፡፡ ዮሴፍ፡፡ ኩፋ ፵፯)፡፡
english: To cover, wrap, veil, or spread something over.
One who covers, a veil, or a shroud.

amharic: የተሸፈነ የተከናነበ ሽፍን ሽፍንፍን፡፡ ግልቡብ ርእሱ፡፡ እንዘ ግልቡባን ገጾሙ፡፡ ብእሲ ዘግልቡብ ርእሱ፡፡ ግልቡባት (፪ነገ ፲፭ ፴፡፡ ሔኖ፲፫ ፱፡፡ ፩ቆሮ ፲፩ ፬፡፡ ዲድ ፫)፡፡
english: Covered, veiled, or wrapped up.

amharic: መሸፈኛ መጋረጃ ልብስ ክዳን ክንብንብ ሠርመዲ ሻል የሐር የሻሽ መንዲል ጥላ ቀጸላ፡፡ ክሥቲ ግልባበኪ፡፡ ንሥኡ ግልባብየ፡፡ ከሠተ ግልባበ ገጹ፡፡ ለብስት ግልባቤ፡፡ ቀራንብት ሥዪማት እማንቱ ህየንተ ምስዋር ወግልባቤ፡፡፡ እምሐሩረ መርቄ ወእምቍረ ኵሉ ምንዳቤ አክናፊክሙ ይኩናን ግልባቤ፡፡ ግልባቡ (ኢሳ፵፯ ፪፡፡ ማሕ፭ ፯፡፡ ስንክ ሠኔ፩፡፡ ኩፋ ፵፩፡፡ ደራሲ፡፡ ስንክ ኅዳ፲፫፡፡ መስ፳፩)፡፡
english: A covering, veil, curtain, or garment.

amharic: በቁሙ ጐለበተ ጕልበታም ኾነ ዐየለ በረታ (ዐማርኛ) ፡፡
english: To become strong, powerful, or muscular.

amharic: በቁሙ ብርክ ኅይል ብርታት ጥንካሬ፡፡ (ግጥም ፪ ደጃዝማቾች ሲዋጉ ትቢተኛው ድል ስለ ኾነ) አላዋቂ ሰፊ ሱሪ አሳጥሮበት የደጃች እገሌ ጕልበቱ ታየበት፡፡
english: Strength, power, or specifically, the knee.

amharic: ማጌጥ መሸለም መልበስ መፀረር መከናወን መበጃጀት ወደ ሸንጎ ወደ ገበያ ወደ ሰርግ ወደ ቤተ ክሲያን ለመኼድ ፡፡
english: To dress up, decorate, or prepare for a special occasion or gathering.

amharic: ሰብሰበ አከማቸ ጉባኤ አቆመ፡፡ ተሰበሰበ ተከማቸ ሸነጓ ከተመ ተጠራቀመ ዶለተ መከረ፡፡ አንገለግነ ዐቢየ እንግልጋ፡፡ አንገለጉ ኵሉ ሕዝብ ላዕለ ኤርሚያስ፡፡ ለምንት አንገለጉ አሕዛብ (ነሐ፭ ፯፡፡ ኤር፴ ፱፡፡ መዝ ፪፡፡ ዘኁ፲፮ ፲፩፡፡ ግብ፲፭ ፮፡፡ ፩ቆሮ ፭ ፬)፡፡
english: To assemble, gather, or hold a council.

amharic: ገለገለ ገላገለ ለየ ነጠለ አላቀቀ የሰው፡፡ ዘረገፈ ቀዳ ገለበጠ አጋባ ባዶ አደረገ የዕቃ ፡፡ ወገልገልዋ ለሙዳየ ምጽዋት (፪ዜና ፳፬ ፲፩)፡፡
english: To separate, empty out, or clean out.

amharic: ገልጋይ ገላጋይ ዘርጋፊ ዘራፊ ወራሪ በርባሪ፡፡
english: One who separates, cleans, or raids.

amharic: በቁሙ አግልግል ግልጋሎ ጕልጓል ማለት ከዚህ ወጥቷል፡፡
english: To serve; the root of words related to service.

amharic: ተማረከ ተከረፈ ተበረበረ፡፡ እስመ ገልገለ ተገልግሎ ትትገለገል (ዓሞ፭ ፭)፡፡ ተፄውዎ ትፄወው ፈሊስ ትፈልስ ጠፊአ ትጠፍእ ማለት ነው፡፡
english: To be captured or taken into exile.

amharic: ስመ ሀገር መንኰራኵር ማለት ነው፡፡ አሊሁም ባይሁዳ ክፍል ያሉ ፪ አህጉር ናቸው አንዲቱ የኢያሪሖ ቅርብ አጠገብ (ኢያ፭ ፱፡፡ ፩ነገ ፯ ፲፯)፡፡ ፪ኛዪቱ በኬብሮን ያለች (ዘዳ፲፩ ፴፡፡ ኢያ፲፪ ፳፫)፡፡
english: The name of a place (Gilgal), meaning wheel.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ መንኰራኵሮች የሠረገላ እግሮች ተሽከርካሮች ተንከባላዮች (ሕዝ፲ ፪ ፲፫)፡፡ ባለቅኔዎች ግን ሰማይ ይሉታል ደመና ሰማይ ብርህት እንተ ይብልዋ ጌልገላ (ደራሲ)፡፡
english: Wheels, rollers, or poetic reference to the sky.
Golgotha, a place name.

amharic: መደጕስ ቈርበት ማልበስ፡፡ ማንጠፍ መከፈፍ ዐልጋን መኝታን በዠንዲ በነት ወይም በሰርፍ በአሐፍ መሸነፍ ማስጌጥ፡፡ በቀጠንት ገለድኩ ምስካብየ ወዘርሴታተ ነጻፍኩ (ምሳ፯ ፲፮፡፡ ዲድ ፪)፡፡
english: To cover with leather, decorate, or spread a bed.

amharic: ቈዳ ቈርበት ዠንዲ ነት ዐጥፍ ዳቦ ሌጦ አንቀልባ የባሕር ዐረብ ብራና ቅርፍተ ዕፅ፡፡
english: Leather, hide, parchment, or bark.

amharic: ኪዳን ሰላም ዕርቅ ፍቅር ስምምነት ቅርበት ልጽቀት፡፡
english: Covenant, peace, reconciliation, or friendship.
To be covered in leather or bound.

amharic: ድጕሶ ድጕስት አደጓጎሰ፡፡ ተነጠፈ የተጌጠ የጓሳ ወፍራም፡፡
english: Covered, bound, or decorated with leather.

amharic: ድጕስ ድጕሰት አደጓጐሰ አጠራረዘ የድጕስ ሥራ፡፡
english: The act of binding or covering with leather.

amharic: መደጐስ መደጐሻ የድጕሰት ዕቃ መሣሪያ ፱ ዐይነት፡፡ ርእስ መደጐስ ፫፡፡ መሳቢያ የድጕሱ ኹሉ መከፈፊያ ፩፡፡ ዕይነ ርግብ ትልቅ ፪፡፡ ቀርነ በግዕ ፩፡፡ የውሃ እናት ፩፡፡ ፈለግ ፩፡፡ ድሙር ፱፡፡ በነዚህ ላይ ደግሞ ፩፡፡ ጨምረው ፲፭ የሚሉ አሉ መደበኖቹ ግን ዘጠኝ ናቸው የቀረው ትርፍ ነው፡፡
english: Tools or instruments for leatherworking.

amharic: ታላቅ ቢላዎ ካራ የበጎች ጠጕር መሸለቻ ቈርበት የሚቀፍ ቈዳ የሚቀድ የሰፎችና የፋቆች መሣሪያ፡፡
english: A large knife or tool for shearing or cutting leather.

amharic: መጐለብ መለጐም መሸፈን መጋረድ ማልበስ መለበጥ መጐለብ የስፌት መለጐም የባላፍ ያታሞ የከበሮ መሸፈን ማልበስ ለኹሉ መለበጥ ከንጨት ከደንጊያ ለተሠራ ለቤት ለሣጥን፡፡ ጎምር ዘገለውዎ በቈጽለ ወርቅ (፪ቆሮ  ፫ ፲፭፡፡ ድጓ፡፡ መጽ ምስ፡፡ ዘፀ፲፮ ፴፫፡፡ ፫ነገ ፮ ፲፭)፡፡
english: To cover, veil, or wrap (often an object or instrument).
A covering, a veil, or that which covers.

amharic: ተሸፈነ ተጋረደ፡፡ ዘበሠቀ ጽልመት ተገልወ (መጽ ምስ)፡፡
english: To be covered or veiled.
Covered or veiled.

amharic: መሸፈን (ጥሽ) መሸፈን አሸፋፈን ሽፈና ልበጣ፡፡ መሸፈኛ ሽፋን መጋረጃ ልባጥ ሰሌዳ፡፡ ግልወታ በወርቅ፡፡ አመ ፂዋዌ አወፈየ ኤርሚያስ ኵሎ ንዋየ ግበሪሃ ለደብተራ ለሥጠተ ኰኵሕ ወተመጢዋ ከመ ግልወተ ኅጺን (አዋል፡፡ መጽ ምስ)፡፡
english: A covering, veil, or layer.

amharic: ከመ ዕፅ ፍሬው ዘይት የሚኾን ቅባታም ሐኪሞች ለሆድ መፈወሻ ዐበዞች ለምጣድ ማሠሻ ፋቆች ለቈበት ማራሻ ለማለስለሻ የሚሹት ዕንጨቱ ግብዝ ውስጠ ክፍት፡፡ (ተረት) የጕሎ ዘንግ የባሪያ ደግ፡፡
english: A castor-oil plant or tree whose seeds provide oil for healing and softening.

amharic: ያሞራ ስም ጕጕት የቀን ዕውር የሌት ዐይን ብር፡፡ ባለብሉዮች ግን ጫት አሞራ ይሉታል (ዘሌ፲፩ ፲፬፡፡ ዘዳ፲፬ ፲፭)፡፡
english: A type of bird, often associated with an owl.

amharic: መጕላላት መግዘፍ መታየት መገለጥ እንደ ልጩ ራስ መኾን፡፡ የጥፈት የሥዕል የመልክእ ፊደል የነገር የምስጢር የድምፅ የቃል፡፡
english: To be prominent, visible, clear, or hairless (bald).

amharic: በቁሙ የጐላ የተገለጠ ግልጥ ፈጽሞ የሚታይ የሚሰማ፡፡
english: Prominent, clear, or visible.

amharic: ልጩ ንጩ ራሱን ጽሕሙን ኅፍረቱን የላጨ የነጨ መላጣ ቡሓ ጐዳ ራስ በዳ፡፡ (ተረት) የሴት ላጪ የወንድ ነጪ፡፡
english: Bald or hairless.

amharic: ተዳሪ ተቃበጠ ተዳለቀ ተዳሰቀ በግልጥ፡፡ ወይም በስውር ኅፍረት ለኅፍረት ተጋለጠ ተገላለጠ፡፡
english: To be exposed or uncovered, often referring to revealing something that should have remained private or hidden.

amharic: ድሪ ቅንጥ የአፍኣ፡፡ ወይም የውስጥ መገላለጥ፡፡
english: The state of being revealed, exposed, or the outer covering of something.
To make something clear, obvious, or larger so that it is easily understood.

amharic: መቍረጥ መቈጥቈር መለየት መግለጥ መግፈፍ ማሳየት ራቍቱን ግንዱን መለመላውን መተው የዛፍ የሰው፡፡
english: The act of cutting, separating, peeling, or stripping something bare like a tree or a person.

amharic: አስቈረጠ አስገለጠ አስለየ አስታወቀ እገሌ አሰኘ ራሱን ወይም ሌላውን፡፡
english: To cause something to be cut, exposed, or revealed; to designate someone.

amharic: የስም ለውጥና ምትክ ህየንተ ስም በስም ፈንታ የሚነፃር ቃል፡፡ እከሌ እንቶ(ተ)ኔ እንተን ያ ርሱ አንድ ሰው አንተ ሰውዬ ሰዌ፡፡
english: A placeholder word used for a person's name, like 'so-and-so' or 'what's-his-name' when the name is unknown or being withheld.

amharic: የእከሌ የእንቶ የርሱ የዚያ ያንድ ሰው፡፡
english: Pertaining to 'so-and-so'; belonging to a specific person whose name is not mentioned.
To be cut off, separated, or revealed.
Clear, revealed, or cut-off; something that is plain to see.

amharic: መግለጥ መገለጥ አገላለጥ ገለጣ ቈረጣ፡፡ የመጽሐፍ ገጽ ሉሕ ፊት ለፊት ተገልጦ የሚታየው የሚነበበው፡፡
english: The act of revealing, an opening, a cut, or the page of a book.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ ገጽ ግልየት ሢራክ ሰንጠረዥ፡፡
english: A page, a surface, or a table of contents.

amharic: መምረጥ ማንጓለል መለየት ማስገለል፡፡ ማንጋለል በዠርባ ማስተኛት፡፡
english: The act of choosing, setting aside, or laying someone on their back.
To be separated, set aside, or to lie on one's back.
Separated, set aside, or laying on one's back.

amharic: ስመ ሀገር የምድር እስራኤል ሰሜን በዮርዳኖስ በርብርያዶስ በዐቢይ ባሕር መካከል ያለ የይሳኮርና የዛብሎን ክፍል፡፡
english: Galilee; the name of a northern region in Israel.

amharic: በቁሙ ልዩነት ያለው ባለመለዮ ሕዝብ ጭፍራ፡፡
english: A distinct group of people or a warrior tribe.
Warriors, soldiers, or guards.

amharic: መጐለል በቤት ራስና በጕልቻ ላይ ማስቀመጥ ማኖር መጣድ ማስረር፡፡
english: The act of placing something on a hearth or stand for cooking.

amharic: አፍላል መንቀል የሸክላ ቅል ጕልላት የመንቀል ዐይነት፡፡
english: A type of pottery dome, hearth, or top cover.

amharic: መጐለም ጕልማ መስጠት፡፡ መጐልመስ ማደግ መጐላመም ጐልማማ ባለጕልማ መኾን፡፡
english: The process of growing up, maturing, or becoming a young adult.
A name or term relating to a specific ancient creature or character.

amharic: ዛዛኝ ሴሰኛ አውሬ የድመት የሙጭሙጭላ ዐይነት፡፡
english: A term describing a wandering, wild, or mischievous creature.
To sit down or to settle.

amharic: መንቃት መሠንጠቅ መሰበር መድቀቅ መንከት መነካት መጐዳት የሸክላ ያጥንት፡፡
english: The act of cracking, breaking, or damaging something brittle like pottery or bone.

amharic: ገል የሸክላ ስባሪ እንክትካች የሳት መጫሪያ፡፡
english: A broken piece of pottery or a shard.
Broken pieces or shards.

amharic: ስመ ሀገር ተራራ ከዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ያለ፡፡
english: Gilead; the name of a mountainous region.

amharic: መቅረጥ ማነጥ ማንጠጥ ጣዖት መሥራት በንጨት በደንጊያ በልብስ ላይ መሣል መመሰል መፈደል መጠረዝ መጥለፍ፡፡
english: The craft of carving, engraving, or sculpting designs into wood, stone, or fabric.
A carver, sculptor, or artist who makes engravings.
To cause something to be carved or engraved.
To be carved, engraved, or designed.
Something that is carved, engraved, or decorated with a design.
A carving, sculpture, or an engraved image.
To peel, skin, or trim leather or skin.

amharic: መግለጥ መግፈፍ ማሳየት መንገር መተርጐም ማሳረዳት፡፡
english: The act of explaining, translating, showing, or revealing something clearly.
To be revealed, to become clear, or to be seen and understood.
Revealed, clear, or obvious.

amharic: መለበድ ልብድ መስፋት ቈርበት ማልበስ መደጐስ እምደልደል ማመቻቸት መሽብለል መጠቅለል የኮርቻና የጭነት፡፡
english: The process of upholstering, covering, or padding something, like a saddle or load.

amharic: በቁሙ የኮርቻ ልብስ ምንጣፍ ምቹው መቀመጫው፡፡
english: A saddle cloth, a comfortable cover, or a pad.

amharic: መጐለት መትከል የጕልቻ፡፡ ማውረስ መስጠት የገንዘብ የርስት፡፡
english: The act of granting land, an inheritance, or setting up a hearth.
A donor, grantor, or someone who provides an inheritance.
To be granted land or to receive an inheritance.

amharic: ጕልቻ፡፡ በቁሙ ዐዲስ ርስት ሰው በፈቃዱ ለዘመድ ለባዕድ ወይም ለገዳም የሚያወርሰው ገንዘብ ጥሪት ቦታ መሬት፡፡
english: A land grant, inheritance, or a plot of property gifted to someone or an institution.
Things that are placed or positioned.
The name of the third letter of the alphabet (Ga).
A long, straight wooden stick or bow.

amharic: ስመ ዕፅ በግብጽ ወንዝ ዳር የሚበቅል ውስጠ ክፍት የሸንበቆ የቀርክሓ ዐይነት ታንኳ ፍልኳ የሚኾን፡፡
english: A type of hollow reed or papyrus plant that grows near riverbanks, often used to make small boats.
To become rotten, to feel disgusted, or to be repulsive.

amharic: የገማ ግም በሽቃጣ፡፡ (ተረት) ግም ለግም ቢተቃቀፍ አይነቃቀፍ፡፡
english: Rotten, smelly, or repulsive. (Proverb: When rotten things cling together, they do not separate.)
The act of rotting or the state of having a bad smell.
A pot or clay vessel.
The edge, bank, or border of something.

amharic: መጕመድ መጐማመድ መቍረጥ ማጨድ መጨርገድ መገዝገዝ ማረድ፡፡ መቍረጥ መገምደል፡፡ መግመድ መፍተል ማክረር፡፡
english: To cut, harvest, chop, saw, slaughter, spin, or tighten.
One who cuts, harvests, or chops.
To cause to cut, harvest, or chop.
To be cut, slaughtered, harvested, or chopped.
Something cut, a fragment, or a piece.

amharic: መቍረጥ መቈረጥ አቈራረጥ ቈረጣ ዐጨዳ ጐማድነት፡፡
english: The act of cutting, chopping, or harvesting.

amharic: ቍራጭ ጐመድ ጕማጅ ጕራጅ ዕራፊ ቅናሽ ሙዳ ጉማ፡፡
english: A piece, a fragment, a scrap, or a slice.
The state of being cut or chopped.

amharic: ስመ ነገድ ስመ ትውልድ ያፌታውያን የጎሜር ቍራጮች፡፡
english: A tribal or lineage name referring to the descendants of Gomer.

amharic: በቁሙ ግመል የቤት እንስሳ የጭነት የኮርቻ ከብት በረሓ ቈላ የሚደፍር ውሃ ጥም የሚችል ዐንገተ ረዥም ነዊኅ ቅልጥም ካህያ ካጋሰስ አብልጦ የሚይዝ የሚሸከም፡፡
english: A camel, a large animal used for carrying heavy loads in the desert and known for its endurance.
Camels.

amharic: ግመልማ የግመል ዐይነት ግመል ሳቢ ጠባቂ የግመል እረኛ ባለግመል፡፡
english: Relating to camels, or a camel herder.
The name of the third letter in the Ge'ez alphabet ('Ga').

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ ስመ ፊደል ገ፡፡ ፍችው ፍጹም ዐስብ ዕሴት ፍዳ፡፡
english: The name of the letter 'Ga'; it also signifies recompense or reward.

amharic: ያዘ ጨበጠ ላጨ ቈረጠ ከረከመ የለጓሚና የላጭታ፡፡
english: To hold, grasp, shave, or cut short (hair or trim).

amharic: ማግመን ማሳረር መጥበስ፡፡ ማሳደፍ ማኵለፍለፍ ማርከስ ማሰነወር መለወጥ መቀየር የቃል የነገር፡፡
english: To scorch, to roast, to defile, or to corrupt words or things.
Something that corrupts, stains, or defiles.

amharic: ዐረረ ገመነ ተከነ አደፈ ረከሰ ሴሰነ፡፡
english: To be scorched, to become defiled, dirty, or sinful.
Defiled, stained, or unclean.

amharic: እድፍ ርስሐት ትክቶ ዝሙት ኀጢአት ገመና ነውር የሚያሳፍር፡፡
english: Filth, corruption, shame, or sin.

amharic: ማረር መግመን ማሳረር ማግመን አገማመን ገመና ዐራራነት ጥቍረት ነውር ኅብስት፡፡
english: The state of impurity, corruption, or scorchedness.
To cut hair, to shave, or to shear.

amharic: የሚቈርጥ ሸላች ላጭታ ገያሪ ሸክላ ሠሪ፡፡
english: One who shears, shaves, or works with pottery.
To cause to be shaved or smoothed.
To be shaved, cut, or smoothed.
Shaved, shorn, or smooth.
The act of shaving or cutting.

amharic: ምንቸት ማሰሮ ዐይኑት ጭንቍላ ታናሽ ሸክላ ልጩ ራስ ጭንቅላት የምትመስል የዘይት ዕቃ፡፡
english: A small clay pot, vessel, or oil container.

amharic: በቁሙ ጕማ ሙዳ የሥጋ ቍራጭ ታናሽ ክፍል ለብቻው ጉም ያለ፡፡
english: A small piece or fragment, especially of meat.

amharic: መግመጥ መጋጥ መተንዘር መዘብተር ማማት መንቀፍ፡፡
english: To gnaw, to bite, or to criticize and slander.
To be gnawed or bent.

amharic: ማግመር መጨረስ መፈጸም መቻል ማያዝ መወሰን ማድፈር ጨርሶ መናገር፡፡
english: To finish, complete, determine, or speak decisively.
To cause to finish, complete, or determine.
To be finished, completed, or determined.
Finished, complete, determined, or limited.
Endurance, capability, or competence.

amharic: ጭራሽ አካቶ ፈጽሞ ካንዱ ዘንዱ መቼም መች፡፡
english: Completely, at all, or ever (used in negatives).

amharic: በቁሙ ታላቅ ዝንጀሮ ባሉበት ጅር ጐምቱ ሽማግሌ ያገር ቀንድ መምህር አቦ ማኅበር፡፡
english: A large monkey, or metaphorically, a respected elder or teacher.
A sea monster or creature.

amharic: ታናሽ ልክ የኽል መስፈሪያ እንደ ድርጎና እንደ ቍልቢጥ እንደ ቈለምሸሸ ያለች፡፡
english: A small measure for grain (Omer).
Ripe, fully mature, or finished.

amharic: ስመ ሀገር አካቶ ፈጽሞ እስተ መዐት ከዘነመባቸው ካምስቱ አህጉረ ሰዶም አንዲቱ፡፡
english: Gomorrah, the ancient city destroyed by fire.

amharic: የገሞራ ሥራ የሚሠራ ወንድ ኹኖ ወደ ወንድ የሚኼድ በሴት ፈንታ ወንድ የሚፈልግ፡፡
english: Relating to the wickedness of Gomorrah; acting against nature.

amharic: የቈላ ዕንጨት ዐረጋም አሾኻም የቀንጣፋ ወንድም ወንዴና ሴቴ ያለው፡፡
english: A type of thorny tree or bush.

amharic: መግመስ መገማመስ መቍረስ መቈራረስ መሽረፍ መሸራረፍ፡፡ መመንዘር አንድ የነበረውን ብዙ ማድረግ ለብዙ መለወጥ፡፡
english: To break bread, to divide, or to exchange money.

amharic: የሚገምስ ገማሽ ቈራሽ ስፍራ ሸራፊ መንዛሪ ዐራሽ
english: Someone or something that divides, breaks, or cuts things into smaller pieces.
To cause something to be broken, cut, or divided into smaller portions.
To be broken, divided, or split into parts.
Something that has been broken or divided; a fragment or a piece.
One half or an equal division of something.
Also meaning half or a portion.
Small change or currency used for daily transactions.

amharic: ጐሽ ቀንደ ሹል የበረሓ እንስሳ መልኩ የላም የበሬ ጠባዩ ያውሬ
english: A wild buffalo or a large animal resembling a cow with sharp horns and a fierce nature.
The act of estimating, guessing, or evaluating the value or size of something.
An estimate, a judgment, or a calculated assessment.

amharic: ታላቅ ጐምቱ እባብ ዐይጥ የሚውጥ የሚሰለቅጥ
english: A large snake that swallows animals like mice.
Christmas or the time of birth.

amharic: ገነባ ግንብ ሠራ ወይም አፈረሰ ቈፈረ ሰረሰረ
english: To build a structure, or conversely, to dig or break ground.
To be built or constructed.
A small container, jar, or pitcher made of clay.
The ninth month of the Ethiopian calendar.

amharic: ጉንባሕ ጉጉ እያለ የሚጮኽ ታላቅ አሞራ
english: A large bird of prey or vulture that makes a loud, distinct cry.

amharic: መጐነድ ጕንድ ጐናዴ መኾን መተከል ራስን መቻል መወፈር መደንደን
english: To become firm, sturdy, or thick, like the trunk of a tree or a strong character.
Sturdy, firm, thick, or hardened.

amharic: በቁሙ ግንድ በሥርውና በዐጽቅ መካከል ያለ ወፍራም ደንዳና ዕንጨት
english: The trunk of a tree or a thick, solid piece of wood.
Lineage, ancestral roots, or family tree.
A wooden block or shackle used to hold someone's feet.
A pillar or a structural support of a building.
A large traditional container used for measuring honey.
To grow old or wear out.

amharic: ቈየ ዘገየ ሰነበተ ሥር ያዘ ቀረ
english: To stay, wait, linger, or remain in one place for a long time.

amharic: የቈየ የዘገየ የሰነበተ የኖረ ዳተኛ ዝግተኛ
english: One who is slow, late, or has stayed a long time.
Having stayed, waited, or lingered for a while.
To cause someone to wait or to delay them.
Something that causes a delay or holds someone back.
An ant (a small, slow, biting insect).

amharic: ጕንደ ሀገር የፋሲል ከተማ መናገሻ ታላቅ መዲና
english: Gondar, the historical capital city and great royal seat.

amharic: ጕንደ እግር ማእሰረ እግር የግር ግንድ
english: A wooden leg-stock or shackle used to restrict movement.
The act of practicing witchcraft, serving idols, or being possessed.
Someone involved in witchcraft, idolatry, or demonic practices.
The name of a place or city.
To wrap a body in a burial shroud.
Someone who prepares a body for burial; an undertaker.
To have someone buried or wrapped in a shroud.
To be buried or wrapped in a shroud.
Wrapped, hidden, or buried; a secret or concealed thing.
The process or act of burial preparation.
A burial shroud or linen used for wrapping the dead.
A burial cloth or shroud.
Treasure, money, or buried wealth.
The act of shouting, rebuking, or expressing anger with a loud voice.
Someone who is angry, rebuking, or shouting.

amharic: ጩኽት እሪታ ታላቅ ድምፅ ቍጣ ተግሣጽ
english: A loud cry, shouting, rebuke, or a harsh command.
Cries, expressions of anger, rebukes, or powerful words.
A trumpet or horn that makes a loud, blasting sound.

amharic: ታላቅ አሞራ ጋን የሚያኽል ጯኺ ልዑለ ቃል
english: A very large, loud bird with a powerful voice.
To cause someone to cry out, to provoke anger, or to speak.
Something or someone that causes shouting, provokes anger, or initiates conversation.

amharic: ጋን ገናና ታላቅ የሸክላ ዕቃ የጠላ የጠጅ መጥመቂያ የልብስ ማጨቂያ።
english: A large clay vessel used for brewing drinks or washing clothes.

amharic: መገዛት ማጐንበስ መስገድ መዋረድ መታዘዝ ማገልገል መጸለይ ማመስገን ምስጋና ማቅረብ መለማመጥ ማቈላመጥ።
english: To submit, bow down, worship, humble oneself, obey, serve, or offer praise and thanks.
One who submits, is obedient, worships, or gives thanks.
One who is submissive, humble, or a faithful servant.

amharic: አገልግሎት አገዛዝ ምሳና ቍልምጫ ልመና የመዝሙር ስም
english: Service, submission, supplication, or a specific type of hymn or praise.
To cause someone to submit, to persuade, to force, or to lead someone to offer praise.
To submit oneself, to obey, or to plead humbly.
To connect, bring together, or reconcile.

amharic: መሰብሰብ መጐቸት መሰንደቅ መከመር መቈለል ቤት ማስመሰል ወይም እያሰሩ መሸከም መደብለል
english: To gather, stack, heap up, or bundle things like grass or crops together.
One who gathers, stacks, or carries bundles.
To be heaped up, stacked, or piled together.

amharic: ሽል ጭንጋፍ የተናቀ ወራዳ ታናሽ ርካሽ።
english: Something small, neglected, cheap, or considered of low status.

amharic: በቁሙ መንፈስ ርኩስ ዲያብሎስ የዲያብሎስ ጭፍራ ክፉ ጨካኝ ዕቡይ
english: An unclean spirit, a devil, or a cruel, proud, and wicked demonic being.
Possessed by a spirit, demonic, or suffering from madness.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ ዘጋኔን። እንስሳ ጋኔናዊ አው አብድ።
english: Demonic, related to spirits, or behaving in a wild, confused manner.

amharic: ገነነ ገናና ኾነ ታበየ ኰራ ተንጠራራ።
english: To become great, famous, proud, or to stand tall.
To exaggerate, make something appear greater, or to exalt.
To be planted, enclosed, or set within a boundary.

amharic: የተክል ቦታ ብዙ ዛፍና ዕንጨት ሽቱ ቅመም የሚበቅልበት ምንጭ ያለው ውሃ የሚገባው የታጠረ የተቀጠረ።
english: A garden, park, or paradise; an enclosed, watered place with trees and plants.
A large vessel or container (variant of Gan).

amharic: ጐነሣለ መሰለ ቀረጸ። ዐጠበ አጠራ ወይም ለማጠብ ባመድ በረመጥ ጐነፈ ቀቀለ
english: To wash, clean, mold, or boil in water or ashes.
A clothes washer or launderer.

amharic: በቁሙ ጕንፋን ገር በሽታ ከክርፋትና ከትንፋገን ከክፉ ሽታ የሚመጣ።
english: A cold, flu, or illness caused by bad air or unpleasant smells.
A traditional porridge dish.

amharic: አቦካ ለወሰ ጡብ ሠራ ተኰሰ። ወደ ላይ አለ ፈላ ፈሰሰ
english: To knead, bake, boil over, or overflow.
To collect, gather, or put into a container.

amharic: ጐረንጐሬ የፍላጻ ቤት ባለቀስት ፍላጾችን አክቦ ሰብስቦ የሚይዝበት እንደ ቍናማት እንደ ከረጢት ያለ።
english: A quiver or container for holding arrows.
One who changes, flips, or transforms something.
To be changed, flipped, or transformed.
Something changed, inverted, or transformed.
A reversal, turning backwards, or an upside-down state.
To hurry, rush, or move quickly.
To disturb, shake, or cause to tremble.
Turmoil, confusion, agitation, or shaking.
To touch, feel, or stroke.

amharic: መግሣት መግሣት መጮኽ አፍን መክፈት መትፋት መቀርሸት ቋቅ ማለት
english: To belch, roar, shout, or gasp; an expression of satiety or frustration.

amharic: ማግሣት መናገር አገሣሥ አነጋገር ግሣት ትፋት ቅርሻት ልብ ወልድ ፈጠራ ነገር።
english: A belch, a harsh utterance, an imaginary story, or an impulsive thought.
To cause to belch, roar, or speak.

amharic: መገሠጽ መቅጣት መቈጣት አጥብቆ መላልሶ መምከር ማስተማር እንደ ደንጊያ መውቀር በነገር ባለንጋ መግረፍ
english: To rebuke, discipline, correct, sternly advise, or instruct with firm words.

amharic: በቁሙ የሚገሥጽ ቀጭ ተቈጭ መካር መምር።
english: One who rebukes, corrects, or provides stern advice.
A corrector, a disciplinarian, or a rebuker.

amharic: በቁሙ ተመከረ ተሠራ ተቀጣ ምክር ሰማ ቅጣት ተቀበለ።
english: To be rebuked, disciplined, corrected, or to accept advice.

amharic: የተገሠጸ የተማረ የመከረ ምሁር የተሠራ የተቀጣ የተገራ
english: One who has been corrected, disciplined, learned, or humbled.

amharic: መገሠጽ (ጥገ) መገሠጽ አገሣሠጽ ግሠጻ ቍጣ፡፡ ነቢይ ምህሮ ወግሣጼ (ስንክ ጥቅ፳፩)፡፡
english: A rebuke, warning, or correction given as a lesson to help someone behave better.

amharic: በቁሙ ስብከት ትምህርት ብርቱ ምክር ምዕዳን ቍጣ ዘለፋ ኀይለ ቃል ከበትር የሚበልጥ የሚሻል የምስጢሩ ስሜት ልብ የሚሰብር የሚነካ፡፡ በእንተ ተግሣጸ ሕዝባውያን፡፡ ዕቀብ ተግሣጾሙ ለአእሩግ፡፡ አባ ሲኖዳ ደረሰ ድርሳናተ ብዙኃተ ወተግሣጻተ ወቃላተ በቍዔት (ምሳ፳፭-፳፱፡፡ ፈ መ ፴፪፡፡ ፴፬፡፡ ሢራ፰ ፱፡፡ ስንክ ሐም፮)፡፡
english: Serious instruction, wise advice, or a firm correction that touches the heart.

amharic: ጓሚያ ቃሪያ እንጭጭ ያልበሰለ ድብድብ የጥጥ ያበባ እንቡጥ፡፡
english: Something young, immature, or a flower bud that has not yet opened.

amharic: ግዕዘ ነቀፈ ቈረጠ አጋዘ ግኢዝ ገአዘ ግእዝ፡፡
english: To detach, cut off, or separate something.

amharic: መጓዝ ካሉበት መነሣት እግርን መንቀል ጉዞ መዠመር ማዝገም ቀስ እያሉ መኼድ መዝመት፡፡ ወግዕዙ ደቂቀ እስራኤል እምራምሴ ውስተ ሱኮት፡፡ ወይግዕዙ ግብጽ ድኅሬሆሙ፡፡ ወግዝክሙ ውስተ ገዳም (ዘፀ፲፪ ፴፯፡፡ ፲፬ ፲፡፡ ዘዳ፩ ፵)፡፡
english: The act of traveling, moving from one place to another, or starting a journey.

amharic: የተጓዘ ነፃ የወጣ፡፡ ግዑዝ ውስተ ምዉታን፡፡ እመኒ ግዕዝት ደብተራ፡፡ ይሬስዮሙ ግዑዛነ (መዝ፹፯፡፡ ዘኁ፩ ፶፩፡፡ ፩ነገ ፲፯ ፳፭፡፡ ፍ ነ ፴፩)፡፡
english: Something or someone that has moved or has been set free.

amharic: መጓዝ መጓጓዝ ጉዞ፡፡ ነጻ መውጣጥ ነጻነት ሐርነት፡፡ ግዕዘት እምትፅርርት ኅበ ሰላም (ፊልክ ፻፭
english: The state of traveling or the condition of being free; freedom.

amharic: ኹነታ አኳዃን ጽንዕ ልማድ ሐሳብ ኅሊና ፈቃድ ባሕርይ ጠባይ የባሕርይ ሥራ ዐመል መንገድ ጕዞ አካኼድ አረማመድ የክፉ  የበጎ፡፡ ሰብእ ዐይን አንትሙ ወመጻእክሙ ትርአዩ ግዕዘ ብሔር፡፡ ሰብእ ሠናያነ ግዕዝ፡፡ ስምዐ ግዕዝን፡፡ ወልድከ ዘኢየሐውር በግዕዝከ፡፡ እምከመ ዐረዩ ግዕዛቲሆሙ፡፡ ሰማይ ጥቀ ሠናይት ወብርህት ፈድፋደ በግዕዛ፡፡ በግዕዘ ጠባይዕ ወበባሕርይ፡፡ ወነያ ይእቲ በዓልተ ጥዒና ሐዳስ ምስለ አራዊት ዘተኅደር ነፍስ እንዘ እምነ ሰብእ ትትገሐሥ እስመ ግዕዘ አርዌ ዐቢይ ወግዕዝ ሰብእ ንኡስ፡፡ ዝንቱ ውእቱ ግዕዝኪ እምንእስኪ (ዘፍ፵፪ ፱፡፡ ዮሴፍ፡፡ ሢራ፴፭ ፳፪፡፡ ፊልክ  ፬፡፡ አፈ ተ፲፮፡፡ ድር፪፡፡ ቅኔ፡፡ ኤር፳፪ ፳፩)፡፡
english: The nature, character, way of behaving, or the characteristic way of doing something.
The state of being free or independence.

amharic: ጓዝ መንገደኛ ቤተ ሰብ፡፡ ተቃወመከ በፍኖት ወአምተረከ ጋዕዘከ እለ ጻመዉ በድኅሬከ፡፡ ተንሥኡ ምስለ ገዓዞሙ (ዘዳ፳፭ ፲፰፡፡ ዘኁ፲ ፲፪)፡፡
english: Travelers, luggage, or one's family and companions on a journey.

amharic: አጓዘ አስጓዘ አሸሸ፡፡ ነጻ አወጣ አስወጣ፡፡ ዐገዘ ረዳ አጸና አበረታ አዳነ፡፡ ወእምዝ አግዐዙ ተዓይኒሆሙ ወንዋዮሙኒ፡፡ አግዐዘ ዮሴፍ ሥጋሁ ለያዕቆብ ወአብጽሖ ኅበ መቃብረ አብርሃም አጓዘ (ዮዲ፯ ፲፰፡፡ ቀሌ፡፡ ዘኁ፴፪ ፴)፡፡ በእንተ አግዕዞ ገብር፡፡ ኢይደሉ ከመ ትትወሰብ ብእሲት ለገብር ዘአግዐዞ ምታ፡፡ ንጉሥ ዘኢይሠይምዎ እግዚእ ዘኢያግዕዝዎ፡፡ አግዐዘነ እምኅጢአት ወሞት (ፍ ነ ፴፩፡፡ ፈ መ ፭፡ ፲፭፡፡ ቅዳ ዮሐ፡፡ ሮሜ፰ ፪)とした
english: To help someone travel, move them, set them free, or provide support and help.

amharic: አጓዥ እግዚእ ጌታ ባለቤት ነጻ አውጪ አሰናባች ጥሩ የሰው ልጅ፡፡ ወኵሉ ገብር ወአግዓዚ፡፡ ዘዘ እልፍ አግዓዚ፡፡ ግብርናተ ዘካልኡ መድኅኔ ዓለም አግዓዚ ዲበ ግዕዛኑ ወሰከ፡፡ ለአከት ኅበ አጋዕዝቲሃ፡፡ እግዚአ አጋዕዝት፡፡ አኅው አጋዕዝተ ኪነት (ራእ፮ ፲፭፡፡ ፭ ፲፩፡፡ ቅኔ፡፡ ጦቢ፪ ፲፪፡፡ መዝ፻፴፭፡፡ ፊልክ ፻፹፱)፡፡ ግዑዝ በማለት ፈንታ አግዓዚ አግዓዛይ ይላል የተሳሳተ ነው፡፡ ትፌንዎ አግዓዜ፡፡ ትፌንዋ አግዓዚተ፡፡ ኢየሩሳሌም አግዓዚት፡፡ ወረሰይካ ለሔዋን አግዓዚተ እምዕረ ሞት፡፡ ወኩኑ ከመ አግዓዝያን፡፡ ጸጋ አግዓዝያን  ዘነሥኡ፡፡ አግዓዝያንኑ እሙንቱ፡፡ እፎ ከመ ይረሲ ርእሶ አግዓዛየ፡፡ አግዓዛይት (ኤር፵፩ ፲4፡፡ ዘዳ፳፩ ፲፬፡፡ ቀሌ፡፡ ውዳ ፪፡፡ ፩ጴጥ ፪ ፲፮፡፡ ስንክ ሚያ፲፰፡፡ ማቴ፲፰ ፳፮፡፡ ቈር ጰላ፡፡ ፩ቆሮ ፯ ፳፪፡፡ ፴፱)፡፡
english: A traveler, a master, a savior, or someone who sets others free.

amharic: ስመ ነገድ መላእክት፡፡ መላእክተ አጋዕዝት (ሔኖ፷፩ ፲፡፡ ኤፌ፩ ፳፩፡፡ ቆላ፩ ፲፮)፡፡
english: A high rank or group of angels.

amharic: መጓዣ መጓዣ መዝመቻ መሰደጃ፡፡ ምግዓዞሙ ለእስራኤል (አዋል)፡፡
english: The means, place, or time for traveling or migrating.
To travel together in a group or to follow one another in a line.

amharic: መጋር መጮኽ መጨነቅ ማጣር፡፡ ገዐርኩ ኅቤከ፡፡ ይግዕሩ እመዝራዕተ ብዙኃን፡፡ የዐወይዉ ወይግዕሩ፡፡ ገዐሩ እምግብሮሙ፡፡ ገዐረ በዐቢየ ቃል፡፡ ግዒሮ ሞተ (ኢዮ፴ ፲፱፡፡ ፴፭፡፡ ፱፡፡ ኤር፳፱  ፪፡፡  ዘፀ፪ ፳፫፡፡ ማር፲፭ ፴፬ ፴፯ ፴፱)፡፡
english: To cry out loudly, to groan in distress, or to call out in pain.

amharic: የጋረ የጣረ ጋረኛ ጣረኛ፡፡ ግዑራን (ቈር ጰላ)፡፡
