english: The third month of the Ethiopian calendar (Hidar), the harvest season.
To open, to be opened, or to become clear.

amharic: ነቅ ሥንጥቅ፡፡ በቁሙ ክፍት ባዶ ወለል የቤት የደጃፍ፡፡ አየር የሰማይና የምድር መካከል
english: An opening, a crack, empty space, or the air between heaven and earth.

amharic: ታናሽ ጠባብ መስኮት ፋካ ዐይን የሚያስክል እጅ የሚያሾልክ
english: A small window, a doorway, or a gate for light and air.

amharic: የባሕር ኰክ እሾኻም ፍሬው ጥቍር ዘይቶንና ዘቢብ የሚመስል ተምር የሚያካክል፡፡
english: A thorny berry tree with fruit resembling olives or dates.
The name of the letter 'Ho' in the alphabet.

amharic: መቀላቀል መደባለቅ አንዱን ካንዱ ጋራ መለወስ መቀመም
english: The act of mixing, blending, or stirring things together.
To be mixed or blended together.
Mixed, blended, or a mixture.
A state of mixture or combination.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ፡፡ ቅልቀላ ድብለቃ ቅልቅልነት የባሕርይ ፍልሰት፡፡
english: Mixing, combination, or blend.
To visit or check on someone.

amharic: ጠጠር አሸዋ ድቡሽት ታናናሽ ጥቃቅን የደንጊያ ቅንጣት
english: Sand, gravel, or tiny particles of stone.
Weak, sickly, or thin.
To choke, squeeze, or cause distress.
To carry something on one's back or shoulders.

amharic: ጣብ የጨዎታ ስም በጠጠር ወይም በተነጠጠ ዕንጨት የሚጫወቱት ጨዎት
english: A game played with small stones or sticks.
To be sad or to grieve.
To drive away or push forward.

amharic: ኅጢአት መሥራት መበደል ሕግ ያዘውን መተው ያላዘዘውን ማድረግ
english: To sin, to do wrong, or to break a rule.
A sinner or someone who does wrong.
A person who is wicked or breaks the law; a sinner.
Relating to sin or a sinful nature.
To be lost, to disappear, or to flee.
Poor, needy, or lacking something.
The state of being a sinner or sinful.

amharic: በቁሙ በደል ዐመጥ ግፍ ሕገ ወጥ ሥራ
english: Sin, wrong-doing, or an act against the law.
A place or situation that leads to sin.
Becoming very small, tiny, or thin.
A tiny particle, a grain of sand, or a small seed.
A small amount; a few; little.

amharic: ሰላጣ ሥንቆ የወፍ ዘረር ማናቸውም ቅጠላቅጠል በጨው የሚጣፍጥ፡፡
english: A salad or edible leaf seasoned with salt.

amharic: መሸንገል፡፡ መደለል ማባበል በምክር በነገር ማሳት ማታለል፡፡
english: To deceive, trick, or mislead someone using clever or persuasive words.
A person who is a deceiver or a trickster.
To have been deceived, tricked, or fooled by someone.
Something or someone that is deceived or is a result of deception.
The act of deceiving, trickery, or the state of being fooled.

amharic: ሽንገላ ድለላ ጕሕሉት ተንኰል ልዝብ ጥዑም ቃል ንባብ ድግ ምስጢረ ክፉ
english: Trickery, cunningness, or using smooth words to manipulate others.
A type of antelope or mountain goat.
A cluster of grapes.

amharic: መጮኽ ቡታ መሰደድ ድረሱልኝ ማለት ከምጥና ከጭንቅ የተነሣ፡፡
english: To cry out loudly for help or to summon people in distress.

amharic: ማየል መበርታት መጐልበት ኅይለኛ መኾን መድፈር ማሸነፍ፡፡
english: To become strong, powerful, brave, or to gain victory.

amharic: በቁሙ ኅይለኛ ዐርበኛ ጥኑ ብርቱ ጠንካራ ጕልበታም፡፡
english: Strong, powerful, mighty, or brave.
Something that is very strong, powerful, or intense.

amharic: አጠና አበረታ አጠነከረ ኅይለኛ አደረገ አበዛ፡፡
english: To make something stronger, to encourage, or to empower.

amharic: ተበረታበት ተደፈረ ተሸነፈ ተጠቃ በታች ኾነ፡፡
english: To be overpowered, defeated, or oppressed by someone stronger.

amharic: ተበራታ ተበረታታ ተጠናከረ ተጠነካከረ አይዞኽ አይዞኽ ተባባለ፡፡
english: To gain strength together, encourage one another, or to act bravely.
Someone who is aggressive, a bully, or a powerful oppressor.
The state of being strong, bravery, or strength.
To cause someone to become strong or to encourage them.
One who encourages, motivates, or cheers others on.

amharic: ድንኳን ማደሪያ ከፀምር ከክታን ከማእስ የሚሠራ የጓዝ የሰፈር ቤት የሚነቀል የሚተክል የሚታጠፍ የሚዘረጋ
english: A tent or portable shelter used for living, often made of fabric.
To be better, to improve, or to be superior.

amharic: መቸር መለገስ ፊት ለፊት እያዩ እያሳዩ መስጠት ማቅረብ ማደል ማሳለፍ፡፡
english: To give generously, show kindness, or share with others.

amharic: ቸር ለጋስ ደግ ቅን በጎ ደኅና መልካም ተንኰልና ክፋት ቢስነት የሌለው፡፡
english: Kind, generous, good, or someone with a pure and honest heart.
Kindness, generosity, or the act of giving.

amharic: ቸር ለገሰ ደግ ቅን መልካም ኾነ፡፡
english: To act kindly, to be generous, or to behave in a good manner.
Kindness, goodness, or a generous nature.
Generosity, kindness, or good-heartedness.

amharic: አቸረ አስቸረ ቸር ገር አደረገ አለዘበ፡፡
english: To make someone kind, to soften someone's heart, or to act generously.
To criticize, disapprove, or judge something as bad.
To be better than, to exceed, or to improve.
Superiority, the quality of being better, or improvement.
To make better, to improve, to perfect, or to decorate.
To improve mutually or to compare and be better in relation to others.
To seek improvement or to compete in being better.

amharic: አጎት (ኃልት) አክሥት ያባትና የናት ወንድም እኅት፡፡
english: An aunt or an uncle (a parent's sibling).

amharic: ብዙ ዘመን መኖር መቈየት ዕድሜ ማግኘት፡፡ መጨረስ መፍጀት
english: To live for a long time, to endure, or to complete a lifespan.
To be finished, completed, or to come to an end.

amharic: ፋሮ ታናሽ አውሬ ምድር የሚፍር የሚቈፍር፡፡
english: A small burrowing animal, such as a mole.
To keep watch, to be a guard, or to stay awake (especially at night).
A guard, a watchman, or a shepherd.
To guard, keep watch, or protect.

amharic: ማሰብ ከልብ ማቃት ነገርን ሥራን ከነቢብ ከገቢር በፊት በሐሳብ በልብ መፍጠር ማስገኘት ማሰናዳት፡፡
english: To think, to ponder, or to plan something in the heart before doing it.
One who thinks, a thinker, or someone who is thoughtful.
To cause someone to think, to remind, or to inspire.
To be thought of, to come to mind, or to become conscious/awake.
Something that is thought of, an idea, or a contemplated matter.

amharic: ኅሊና ሐሳብ ምኞት ከልብ የሚነቃ ነቅዐ ልብ ውሳጣዊ ሕዋስ፡፡
english: The mind, inner thoughts, or desires that come from the heart.
Conscience, mind, or deep thoughts.

amharic: የሐሳብ ሥራ ኅቡእ ረቂቅ ውሳጣዊ ድብቅ ከሳቢው በቀር ለሌላ የማይታወቅ፡፡
english: His/her inner mind, deep hidden thoughts, or secret reflections.

amharic: መብላት መንደል መፈልፈል፡፡ ውስጠ ክፍት ባዶ ማድረግ አንደ ከበሮ፡፡
english: The act of eating, hollowing out, or making something empty inside like a drum.

amharic: ውስጠ ክፍት ዘንግ ብርዕ አገዳ ቅልጥም ያለው የጐሽ መቃ ወይም ቀለም ሽንበቆ ቀርክሓ የመሰለው ኹሉ፡፡
english: A hollow tube, reed, or pipe, similar to a quill, stem, or bamboo stalk.
To pass by, move past, or go by.

amharic: ማለፍ ፈጥኖ መኼድ መሻገር መራመድ መራቅ መወገድ፡፡
english: The act of passing through, moving quickly, traveling, or stepping aside.

amharic: የሚያልፍ መንገደኛ ዐላፊ ጠፊ ሟች ተለዋጭ ወረተኛ፡፡
english: A passerby, a traveler, or something that is temporary and fading.
That which has already passed or gone by.
The act of passing, passage, or moving from one place to another.

amharic: በቁሙ የብራና ስሯጽ ቀንጃ ኹኖ ታጥፎ ተቀንፎ ባንድ ወገን ወይም ተቀናጅቶ ተላልፎ በ፪፡ ወገን በጥራዝ መካከል የሚገባ ፪፡ ገጽ ያለው አንዳንድ ሉሕ ወይም ቅጠል፡፡
english: A leaf or page of a book, specifically a folded sheet of parchment used in binding.

amharic: ማለፊያ ማሳለፊያ መግቢያ በውጫ በር መንገድ ቦታ፡፡
english: A passage, a doorway, or a pathway used for entering or exiting.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ፡፡ ጸሎተ ማኅለፍተ ነፍስ፡፡ መንገደ ሰማይ ማለት ነው፡፡
english: A passage or gateway, often referring to the spiritual journey or path of the soul.
To be passed over, skipped, or crossed.

amharic: ተላላፈ ተሸጋገረ ዕልፍ ዕልፍ እለ የእግር የነገር፡፡ ተመላለሰ ወዲያ ወዲህ አለ ተዛወረ፡፡
english: To walk back and forth, travel across, or cross over frequently.
The act of crossing, passing back and forth, or mutual passing.
To cause to cross, transfer, or interweave.
The throat, windpipe, or passage for breathing.
The state of coming to an end, finishing, aging, or disappearing.
Finished, completed, or final.

amharic: ማለቅ ተጨርሶ መጥፋት መክሳት ማነስ መጕደል፡፡ -ጫፍ መጨረሻ ፍጻሜ፡፡
english: The end, destruction, decline, or the final conclusion.
To finish, complete, consume, or destroy.
The end, limit, border, or final destination.
To be destroyed, finished off, separated, or scattered.
To cause to end, finish, separate, or alternate.
To count, calculate, add up, or enumerate.
Someone who counts, a counter, or someone knowledgeable in numbers.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ፡፡ መኈልቍ ከእኈለቈም ሊወጣ ይቻላል.
english: A calculation, counting, or the process of enumerating.

amharic: ቍጥር ሒሳብ በየስሙና መያኃዙ ልክና መልክ ውሳኔ ያለው.
english: A number, amount, or mathematical count.
To have something counted, to teach counting, or to cause to enumerate.
To be counted or included in a number.
Something that has been counted or included.
The practice or act of counting or enumeration.
Poison or venom.
To criticize, speak against, or blame.
To bind, tie up, or fetter.
One who binds or ties up others; a jailer.
To cause to be bound or to deliver someone to be tied up.
To be bound, tied up, or held in chains.
A prisoner or someone who is bound.
The act of binding, tying, or imprisonment.
A binding, a cord, or a shackle used for tying.
To gather, pick, or collect.
Wine or a deep red color.

amharic: ዐይነቱ ወይም ቅላቱ የጥቍር ወይን ጠጅ የሚመስል፡፡
english: Dark red or wine-colored.
To do five, to divide by five, or to do something five times.

amharic: ዐምስት ማድረግ ካምስት መክፈል እስካምስት ጊዜ መመላለስ፡፡
english: The process of making into five, dividing by five, or repeating five times.

amharic: ዐምስት የሚያደርግ ካምስት የሚከፍል ከፋይ ዐምስት ባይ፡፡
english: One who divides into five or someone related to the number five.
To become five or to be divided into five parts.

amharic: ዐምስት የኾነ የተባለ ካ፭ የተከፈለ ፭ነት ያለው፡፡
english: Fifth or something that is five-fold.
The state or quality of being five.
Five; a term used to describe quantity or time.

amharic: በወንድ አንቀጽ ዐምስቱ ዐምስተኛው ካምስት አንዱ ያሰኛል፡፡
english: The five; the fifth one; one of five.

amharic: በቁሙ ዐምሳ ፭ ጊዜ ዐሥር ወይም ፲ ጊዜ ዐምስት፡፡
english: Fifty; five times ten.
The fifth; one part of five.
Pertaining to the fifth or a fifth-order position.

amharic: የኬክሮስ ዐምስቲያ ክፍል በራብዒትና በሳድሲት ማኽል ያለች፡፡
english: A measurement unit between the fourth and sixth parts in astronomy.
The fifth part or a period of five.
Fivefold; five times the amount.

amharic: ዐምስት ወገን ዐምስት ክፍል ዐምስት እጅ፡፡
english: Divided into five parts or five groups.
A source or spring (associated with tears).
A fruit or blossom that has opened.
Someone who is lame, walks with difficulty, or crawls.
To become lame or walk with a limp.
A goiter; a swelling in the neck.

amharic: ዐላዊ ከሓዲ ሸንጋይ አታላይ ግብዝ አረመኔ፡፡
english: A rebel, someone who denies truth, a deceiver, or a pagan.
Belonging to a group seen as pagan or rebellious.
To scratch or scrape.
To cut or prune.
To wrap or cover up.

amharic: መጠርጠር ማውለብ በጥርስ፡፡ ማንጠርጠር ማበጠር ማንዘርዘር በስፌድ በወንፊት፡፡
english: The act of sifting, sorting, or cleaning with a sieve.
To be sifted or shaken out.

amharic: ጥርጣሪ እንጥርጣሪ ንፋሽ ገለባ ልቃሚ ብጣሪ፡፡
english: Chaff; the bits left over after sifting grain.

amharic: ማነቅ ማስጨነቅ ጕረሮን ዐንገትን አጥብቆ ሰቅስቆ ማያዝ ማሰር ለመግደል አፍን አፍንጫን ማፈን ማድፈን ትንፋሽን መከልከል፡፡
english: To choke; to strangle; to restrict breathing.
Something that causes choking; a strangler.
A snare or a tool used for choking/strangling.
To cause someone to be choked or strangled.
To be strangled or to die from choking.
Choked; suffocated.

amharic: ማነቅ መታነቅ አስተናነቅ ዕንቂያ ዕንቂት ድንገተኛ ሞት፡፡
english: Suffocation or the act of choking.

amharic: በቁሙ ዕንቅርት ኵልኵልት ያንገት የማንቍርት የቀጥላ ጕረሮ የሚያንቅ የሚያስጨንቅ፡፡
english: Goiter; or something that causes a lump in the throat.
To lie or deceive.
A unit of measure or container.
To become bad or wicked.

amharic: መወሥ መሟሰስ መጥረግ ማበስ ማደፍ መወልወል የምጣድ፡፡
english: To wipe, clean, or polish.
A seeker, explorer, or investigator.

amharic: ፍላጎት ፍለጋ ጥያቄ ጥየቃ ምርምር መርመራ ፈቃድ መፍቅድ ሐሳብ ምኞት፡፡
english: Desire, search, investigation, or intent.
A tool or method for searching/cleansing.

amharic: ሹካ መንካ ጭልፋ የሥጋ ማውጫ፡፡ ጕጠት የጥርስ መንቀያ፡፡
english: A fork, spoon, or small tool for picking or lifting.
To be sought after, searched for, or examined.
Sought after; examined; searched for.

amharic: በቁሙ ዕሥሥት የንሽላሊት ዐይነት መልኳ እንደ ሌታ ቀን የሚለዋወጥ ጠንቋዮች አጥብቀው የሚሿት፡፡
english: A type of creature or object often sought after by traditional medicine practitioners.

amharic: መሠሥ መታሠሥ፡፡ መሻት መፈለግ መመርመር አመራመር ምርመራ ምርማሪ መላ ግምት ጥንቈላ ሟርት፡፡
english: Searching, investigation, guessing, or divination.
To investigate, debate, or search mutually.
To cause a search or guide an investigation.
An investigator or seeker of truth.

amharic: ምርምር ምርመራ ፍላጎት ፍለጋ፡፡ በቁሙ ትሣሥ የወር ሥም የመስከረም አራተኛ፡፡ ወርኅ ተኃሥሦ ማለት ነው
english: The fourth month of the Ethiopian calendar; it also refers to the act of searching or investigating.

amharic: ስመ ዕፅ ክትክታ ቅጠሉ ቀንበጡ ለሐዲስ ምጣድ ማሟሻ ማሠሻ የሚኾን፡፡ ዕንጨቱም እንደ ፍየለ ፈጅ ተቀጥቅጦ መብራት ይኾናል
english: A plant name whose leaves are used for scrubbing new clay pans; its wood can also be used as a torch.

amharic: ማረፍ ዝም ጸጥ ጫ፡ ማለት አለመታወክ፡፡ መብረድ መቀዝቀዝ የቍጣ የጠብ
english: The state of being calm, quiet, or resting; cooling down from anger or conflict.
To cause someone or something to be calm, quiet, or peaceful; to soothe.

amharic: ማከክ ማቍሰል መላጥ መምለጥ መቅረፍ መግፈፍ መግለጥ
english: The act of scratching, wounding, peeling, or exposing the skin.
To become scratched, wounded, peeled, or touched/irritated.
Someone who is itchy, scratched, or has skin sores.

amharic: ዕከክ ብግር ኪንታሮት ቍስል የገላ ነውር
english: An itchy skin condition, blemish, or sore on the body.
To gather or collect things together.
To become impoverished, diminished, or to be in a state of hardship.

amharic: ግንብ አዳራሽ ቤተ መንግሥት ኑኅ ርሕብ ምጥቀት ርዝመት ያለው፡፡ ዕርድ ምሽግ አንባ
english: A tall tower, fortress, castle, or high building used for protection and observation.
To become moist, humid, or emit steam/heat.

amharic: መምታት መውቃት መደብደብ የበትር፡፡ መደሰቅ መሰጐድ መጠፍጠፍ የቡጢ የጥፊ
english: The act of hitting, beating, or striking someone or something with a rod, fist, or palm.
Someone or something that hits, beats, or strikes.
To be drawn, stamped, or carved with a seal.
The design, impression, or pattern left by a seal.
To suffocate, cover, or stifle.
To gather up in handfuls or scoop up.

amharic: ማፈር መፍራት ከነቍትነት የተነሣ እንደ አዳም፡፡ መደንገጥ መለወጥ ዐመድ መምሰል
english: The feeling of shame, embarrassment, or fear that causes one to hide.
Someone who is easily embarrassed, shy, or ashamed.
To cause someone to feel ashamed or embarrassed.
Something or someone that brings shame or disgrace.
To be feared, respected, or held in high honor.

amharic: የታፈረ የተፈራ ታፋሪ ተፈሪ፡፡ ያፈረ የፈራ ኅፍረት የያዘው
english: Someone who is respected/feared or, alternatively, someone who is ashamed.

amharic: ማፈር ድል መኾን መሸነፍ ዕፍረት ፍራት
english: The state of being ashamed, defeated, or filled with fear.
Shame, embarrassment, or modesty.

amharic: ተፋፈረ ተፋዘዘ፡፡ ወይም ኅፍረት ለኅፍረት ተጋለጠ ተገላለጠ ተደፋፈረ የሩካቤ
english: To be exposed, uncovered, or to act in a shameful way regarding intimate matters.

amharic: የታመነ ወዳጅ ባልንጀራ ዘመድ ጎረቤት ቤተ ሰብ ቄስ ሐኪም ገመናን ኅፍረትን ገልጦ የሚነግሩትና የሚያሳዩት
english: A trusted friend, relative, or advisor to whom one reveals secrets or personal burdens.
Something that causes shame; a source of embarrassment.

amharic: ኵፌት እንደ ዘውድ ያለ ቆብ የቀድሞ ነገሥታት ሊቅነ ካህናት ዛሬም ጳጳሳት ኤጺስቆጶሳት በራሳቸው ላይ የሚደፋት የሚቀዳጁት
english: A crown, cap, or head covering worn by kings, priests, and bishops.
To wash or cleanse.

amharic: ማጦዝ መጠምዘዝ ማረቅ ማጕበጥ መጠቅለል የሐረግ የንጨት የሽቦ የብረት
english: The act of twisting, bending, or curling items like vines, wood, wire, or metal.

amharic: ሜንጦ ቀለበት ዘለበት የድንኳን መግጠሚያ መያያዣ ማቈላለፊያ
english: A clasp, ring, or hook used for fastening items like tents together.
The act of cutting, castrating, or rendering someone incapable of reproduction.
One who castrates or cuts; a cutter.
To cause someone to be castrated or cut.
To be castrated or lose one's reproductive ability.
Someone who is castrated or a eunuch.

amharic: መስለብ መሰለብ ጃን ደረባ መኾን ማድረግ
english: The condition or act of castration.
Iron or a metallic ore found in the earth.
To raise or bring up.
To fence, enclose, or limit.
Shortness, scarcity, or being brief in time or height.
Short, small, or little.
Limited, short, small, or a few.
Shortness, shortage, or brevity.
To shorten or make smaller.
Washing, cleaning, or purifying.
Someone who washes or a cleaner.
To help wash or make someone wash.
To wash oneself or become clean.
Washed, clean, or pure.
Washing, cleaning, or baptism.
Wastewater or residue from washing.
A basin or tool used for washing.
A place for washing.
To harvest or cut down.
To raise or nurture.
To hug or embrace.
To spend the night.
To dig or carve.
Carving, engraving, or drilling.
One who carves or engraves.
To be carved, pierced, or drilled.
Carved, engraved, or pierced.
The act of carving or an incision.
A tool used for carving or piercing.
A small or narrow window or opening.
Pertaining to carving.
Choosing, selecting, or preferring.
One who chooses or selects.
To cause someone to choose.
To be chosen or selected.
Chosen, select, or elite.
The act of choosing or selection.
A choice or a selection.
To leave or refrain.
A small character, letter, or mark.
The name of a specific letter.
To plow or farm.
To harvest or collect fruit.
Harvesting or gathering fruit.
Spring or a specific season of the year.
Plowing, feeding, or taking care of.
A farmer, provider, or caregiver.
To be cultivated, fed, or cared for without toil.
The process of giving birth or being a new mother with a newborn.
To assist in childbirth or to act as a midwife.

amharic: ዐራስነት ወሊድ ወለዳ የወሊድ ወራት ከርስሐት እስኪነጹ ድረስ፡፡
english: The period of recovery and purification following childbirth.

amharic: በቁሙ ዐራስ ወላድ ትኵስ እመጫት የጨቅላ እናት የምታጠባ፡፡
english: A mother who has just given birth or is nursing a baby.

amharic: ተባት ወንድ ልጅ ያላደገ ወይም ያደገ፡፡
english: A male child, whether young or grown.
A bushel or a measure for grains.
A container or basket used for measuring grain.
Chaff, dust, or unwanted remnants.
To search, seek, or look for something.

amharic: መጕደል ማነስ መክሰር፡፡ መዋረድ መጐስቈል አይቶ ዐጣ አድጎ አነስ መኾን፡፡
english: To diminish, suffer loss, become humble, or experience decline.

amharic: በቁሙ ያነሰ የጐደለ ሕጹጽ፡፡ የተዋረደ ትሑት ወራዳ ጐስቋላ ምናምንቴ፡፡
english: Something small, lacking, humble, or of low status.

amharic: ሕጸጽ ክ(ኅ)ሳራ ውርደት መከራ ዕጦት ጕዳት ጕስቍልና፡፡
english: A loss, a disadvantage, shame, or hardship.
To humiliate, degrade, insult, or criticize.

amharic: የውርደት ስም ቀባ ቀባባ አነካካ አብዝቶ መላልሶ አካቶ ፈጽሞ ጥቂት ሳይተው፡፡
english: To completely disgrace or fully degrade someone.
A lie or falsehood.

amharic: መቃጠል መንገድ ቦግ ቱግ ብልጭ ቍልጭ ማለት መብራት ብርሃን መኾን፡፡
english: To shine brightly, burn, or illuminate like a light.
Lit, burning, or illuminated.
To ignite, kindle, or cause to shine.

amharic: ፋና መብራት የሠም የዘይት የሌላውም ኹሉ፡፡
english: A lamp, lantern, or a source of light (candle or oil).

amharic: ማብሪያ መቅረዝ ቀንዲል ፋኖስ የመሰለው ኹሉ፡፡
english: A candlestick, lamp stand, or lighthouse.
To seal, close, lock, or stamp.
One who seals or uses a stamp/seal.
To cause to be sealed, to witness, or to set a mark.
To be sealed, closed, finished, or anointed.

amharic: የታተመ ዕትም የተጻፈ ጽሑፍ የተዘጋ ዝግ ስውር፡፡
english: Sealed, closed, written, or hidden.

amharic: ማተም መታተም አስተታተም ዕተማ ዕትማት ቡራኬ፡፡
english: The act of sealing, a printing, or a blessing.

amharic: በቁሙ ማተሚያ መታተሚያ የበር የነገር መዝጊያ የጣት የጥፈት ምልክት፡፡
english: A seal, a signet ring, or a device used for locking and marking.
To examine, investigate, or research.

amharic: ዘጠንኛ ፊደል በግእዝ እልፍ ቤት በአገደ ስሙ ጠይት ቍጥሩ ዘጠኝ አኃዝ፡፡
english: The ninth letter of the Ge'ez alphabet, representing the number nine.
To cover, plug, or seal off.

amharic: መጥረግ መከወን እድፍን ጕድፍን ማሶገድ ማስገለል ቦታን ቤትን ንጹሕ ማድረግ፡፡
english: To sweep, clean, tidy up, or purify a space.
To cause to be swept or cleaned.
One who organizes, prepares, or beautifies.

amharic: የጣፈጠ የተጣፈ ጥፍጥ ጠፍ ያለ ያማረ የተከናወነ ውብ ስብቅል ንጹሕ፡፡
english: Tasty, beautiful, clean, well-done, or refined.
The quality of being pleasant, skillful, or beautiful.
Refinement, elegance, or proper behavior.
To fear, tremble, shake, or be agitated.
Something that pops, scatters, or jumps (like seeds).
To taste.
Breast or teat.
The nipple.
To like or desire.

amharic: መጠበብ መፈልሰፍ መራቀቅ ልባም ጠበበኛ መኾን፡፡
english: To be wise, creative, or skilled.

amharic: የሚጠበብ ጥበበኛ ልባም ብልኅ ዐዋቂ ተራቃቂ ፈላስፋ ሐኪም ጠንቋይ፡፡
english: A wise person, a scholar, a craftsman, or an expert.
Wisdom or the state of being wise.

amharic: ዕውቀት፣ ብልኅት፣ ፍልስፍና፣ ምክር፣ ወይም ተንኰል
english: Wisdom, knowledge, skill, or philosophy.
To make wise, to instruct, or to teach.
A wise teacher or one who imparts wisdom.
To argue, to scheme, or to act deceitfully.
Deceit, trickery, or malicious schemes.
To reconcile or to improve through skill and wisdom.
To whip, lash, or strike.
One who whips or carries a whip.
To be whipped or lashed.
One who has been whipped.
The act of whipping or a lashing.
To cause to drip or to drip.

amharic: ልብስ፣ ከተልባ እግር የሚሠራ ጽሩይ ጸዐዳ ጨርቅ
english: Fine white linen cloth.
To slaughter.
Sucking or nursing (from a breast).
A nursing infant.
To breastfeed or nurse an infant.
One who breastfeeds or a nurse.
Slaughtering, sacrificing, or skinning.
A butcher or one who slaughters.
To cause to be slaughtered.
To be slaughtered or skinned.
Slaughtered or butchered.
The act or process of slaughtering.
A slaughtered animal or sacrifice.
A slaughterhouse or place of sacrifice.
A knife, blade, or sword used for slaughter.
Sharp like a blade or related to a knife.
A personal name.
Nature or character.
Washing or the act of baptism.
Holy water or baptismal water.
To wrap, roll up, or bind.
To be wrapped or covered.
Wrapped, rolled up, or covered.
The act of wrapping or covering.
To be bold, courageous, or decisive.
Bold, brave, or strong-willed.
Courage, boldness, or determination.
Boldness or bravery.
To encourage, strengthen, or embolden.
Natural or inherent.
An order, command, or instruction.
To tighten, fasten, stick, or secure.
One who fastens or something that adheres.
A tool or substance used for sticking, gluing, or fastening things together.
To stick together, connect, or join with something else.

amharic: የጠበቀ የተጣበቀ የገጠመ የተያያዘ ልክክ ያለ፡፡
english: Firm, tightly connected, or well-fitted together.
To cause things to be stuck, joined, or fitted together.
To firmly join, fasten, or assemble parts together.

amharic: መጥበስ በእሳት ማብሰል ከእሳት ላይ መጣል የሥጋ የሸት፡፡
english: The act of roasting or cooking food, especially meat, over an open fire.
To be roasted or cooked thoroughly over fire.

amharic: የተጠበሰ ጥብስ አለውሃ በእሳት ብቻ የበሰለ፡፡
english: Roasted or grilled meat cooked directly over fire.
The method or process of roasting or grilling food.
Roasted meat or a portion of food cooked by roasting.

amharic: መጥበሻ መጥበሻ የብረት ሠቅሠቅ ምሧዐ ብርት፡፡
english: A metal pan or rack used for roasting or grilling.
A girl or a young maiden.
A name meaning a beautiful or graceful young girl.
A flat clay pan used for baking bread.

amharic: መጠጋት መደገፍ ጥግ ደገፉ መያዝ ልጥቅ ልጥፍ ማለት መጣበቅ አንድ መኾን፡፡
english: To lean against, get close to, or rely upon something for support.

amharic: የተጠጋ የሚጠጋ ተጠጊ ጥግ ፈላጊ ጥገኛ፡፡
english: One who leans against or seeks refuge and support from another.
Something that is placed close, supported, or resting against another object.
To bring something close, provide support, or make it firm.
To huddle together or be stacked against one another.
Things that are layered, crowded, or leaning together.

amharic: አጣጋ አጠጋጋ ሰገሰገ ጽፍቅ አደረገ አያያዘ አጣበቀ፡፡
english: To arrange things closely together or fasten them in a neat row or position.

amharic: መጠጊያ ማስጠጊያ ቦታ፡፡ መጨጊያ መከዳ ድጋፍ፡፡
english: A place of refuge, a support, or something used to lean on.
Metal or iron.
A type of evergreen tree (Juniper).

amharic: መንጻት መጥራት ከኅጢአት ንጹሕ ጥሩ መኾን በውሃ በንስሓ፡፡
english: The act of becoming pure, clean, or holy through washing or repentance.
Purity or the state of being clean.
Cleanliness, purity, or holiness.
To cleanse, purify, or baptize.

amharic: የሚያነጻ የሚያጠራ ዐጣቢ አጥማቂ ወይም ውሃ፡፡
english: A cleansing agent, a purifier, or something used for washing.
To be cleansed, washed, or purified.

amharic: የነጻ የተናጻ የጠራ የተጣራ ንጹሕ ጥሩ፡፡
english: Clean, pure, or sparkling clear.
To be clean or pure.

amharic: ጡብ ሠራ መሠረት አስጌጠ አሳመረ ሥራውን፡፡
english: To build with bricks, set a foundation, or decorate work beautifully.

amharic: የሰው ስም ሠናይ ልሑይ ጻድቅ ኄር፡፡
english: A proper name meaning good, righteous, or excellent.
The name of a month in the traditional calendar (January/Tir).
Cotton or cotton thread.

amharic: ማክረር መፍተል ማጥመም መቈልመም ማጠፍ ማጕበጥ መጠቅለል መጠምጠም፡፡
english: To twist, turn, spin, fold, or bend something.
Crooked, twisted, or morally wrong.
Crookedness, distortion, or wickedness.

amharic: ብስና ክፉ ግሣት እንደ ፈስ የሚሸት፡፡
english: Something foul or unpleasant smelling.
A twist, a knot, or a ring-like formation.
One who twists, bends, or turns things around.
To cause to twist, bend, turn, or bow down.
A tool or device used for twisting, bending, or turning.
To cover, roof, or shelter something.
To drape, spread, or hang something like a cloth or shelter.

amharic: ጣፈ ለገበ ሰፋ ጠቀመ ቀዳዳን ነገር በሚመስለው ቍራጭ፡፡
english: To sew, mend, or patch something with fabric.
To stretch out, screen, or cover something.
Covered or veiled.
The act of spreading or covering with a veil or screen.

amharic: መጋረጃ ግርዶሽ ጥላ ከለላ ልብስ ክዳን ልባጥ ሽፋን፡፡
english: A curtain, veil, or protective covering.

amharic: በቁሙ መጠብር ነጠላ ያንገት ልብስ፡፡ ገበርባሬ ባለጥቍር ጥለት አይሁድ በጸሎት ጊዜ የሚለብሱት፡፡
english: A shawl or garment worn over the shoulders, particularly during prayer.
The act of folding, wrapping, or rolling something up.
One who folds, wraps, or rolls.
To be folded, wrapped, or rolled up.
Folded or wrapped.
The process or state of folding.

amharic: መጽሐፍ ደብዳቤ ክታብ የመልእክትና የትእዛዝ የሰላምታ ቃል ያለበት ካገር ወዳገር በፖስታ የሚላክ፡፡
english: A letter, scroll, or written message sent to others.

amharic: መሠሠት መሣሣት መንፈግ መቈጠብ መቤስ መቀቀት፡፡
english: The act of being stingy, withholding, or sparing.

amharic: ማስጨነቅ ማስጠበብ አጥብቆ ማሳዘን ማሠቃየት መቅጣት መከራ ማምጣት፡፡
english: The act of causing distress, oppression, or suffering.
To be distressed, anxious, or confined.
Someone who is distressed or burdened.

amharic: መጨነቅ ማስጨነቅ ጭንቀት ጥበት ጭንቅነት መከራ፡፡
english: Distress, anxiety, or a state of being in a tight spot.
Suffering or distress.
To become anxious, overwhelmed, or pressed.
To cause someone else to feel distressed or pressured.

amharic: ካብ ናስ ግንብ ድንጊያው የተሰደረ ስድር ድርድር፡፡
english: A wall, structure, or layer of masonry.

amharic: ቍንጯም ወፍ ላባው ዝንጕርጕር ዐይናማ ነብርማ የኾነ ጥሩ ውብ መልከ መልካም፡፡
english: A peacock, known for its beautiful, colorful feathers.
A type of potent or medicinal honey.

amharic: መጣል ከውሃ ማግባት መበጥበጥ መዘለል መጥመቅ መጠጀት፡፡
english: The act of casting into water, mixing, or brewing.
One who casts, mixes, or brews.
To cause something to be cast, soaked, or mixed.
To be cast into, to fall into, or to be soaked/brewed.
Something that is cast aside or fallen.

amharic: አተላ አንብላ ዝቃጭ ተራዋጭ ገፈት ፍላቂ ሐሠር ጥማቂ፡፡
english: Dregs, sediment, or the remains after straining a drink.

amharic: የሶበ ሊጥ እንደ ፍትፍት በገር የሚዋጥ የሚሰለቀጥ፡፡
english: A soft, dough-like food that is easily swallowed.
The act of grinding or crushing grain into fine particles.
A miller or someone who grinds grain.
A mill, grinder, or jaw used for crushing.
Fine flour or ground grain.

amharic: መጮኽ ማግሣት ከረኅብ ከቍጣ የተነሣ የንስሳ ያንበሳ ያራዊት ኹሉ፡፡
english: The roaring or growling of animals due to hunger or anger.
A loud roar or powerful bellowing.
The sound of animal roars or bellows.
To cause to roar or bellow.
To incite or cause repeated roaring.

amharic: ያታክልት ወገን ፍሬው ቅባታም ጠጕሩ ፈትልና ልብስ የሚኾን፡፡
english: Cotton, a plant whose fibers are used to make thread and cloth.
A whip or lash.

amharic: ዶቅማ የዶቅማ ዐይነት ዛፍ መልካም ሽታ ያለው፡፡
english: A fragrant tree of the aromatic kind.

amharic: ኀያላን ነዊኃን የዓናቅ ልጆች መጠናቸው ከሰው የሚበልጥ፡፡
english: Giants or powerful, tall people of legendary strength.
To cook, roast, or bake on a griddle.
A cook, baker, or someone who repairs things.
To be cooked, baked, or repaired/restored.

amharic: የበሰለ የተጋገረ አንባሻ ዳቦ ቈሎ ዕንጐቻ፡፡
english: Cooked or baked bread, roasted grain, or food.

amharic: ስመ ፈለግ ካ፬ቱ ዐበይት አፍላጋት አንዱ፡፡
english: The Tigris river, one of the four great rivers.

amharic: ታላቅ ነብር በወንዝ ዳር በባሕር ጠረፍ የሚኖር ቍጡ ብስጩ ክፉ ጨካኝ፡፡
english: A fierce, swift tiger, often associated with powerful water.

amharic: መምረግ መለሰን በጭቃ መዝጋት መድፈን የዦሮ፡፡
english: The act of sealing, plastering, or covering up, such as ears.
To be sealed, plastered, or covered.
Blocked, sealed, closed, or deaf; someone or something that cannot hear or let things through.
Teff; the tiny, nutritious grain native to Ethiopia.

amharic: ፀሓየ ፊሳ ዕንቈ ባሕርይ ሰደፍ ከፀሓይ የምቶልደው፡፡
english: A sun-gem or precious stone believed to be born from sunlight.
To ask, examine, investigate, or research to gain knowledge or find the truth.
An inquirer, someone who asks questions, or an investigator.

amharic: አስጠየቀ አስመረመረ፡፡ አስረዳ አሳወቀ አስታወቀ ነገር አሰማ አስተማረ፡፡
english: To cause someone to ask, to explain, to inform, or to teach.

amharic: የሚያስጠይቅ አስጠያቂ አስመርማሪ፡፡ የሚያስረዳ አስረጅ መምር አስተማሪ፡፡
english: An educator, someone who makes things clear, or a study guide.

amharic: በቁሙ ተመረመረ ታወቀ ተረዳ ተረገጠ ታየ ተገለጠ፡፡
english: To be examined, known, understood, verified, or revealed.

amharic: የተጠየቀ የተመረመረ፡፡ የታወቀ የተረዳ የተረገጠ ዕለት ጥይቅት፡፡
english: Something verified, examined, known, or understood.

amharic: ርግጥ በርግጥ እውነት በውነት በግልጥ ፈጽሞ፡፡
english: Certainly, truly, clearly, or definitely.

amharic: በቁሙ መጠየቅ (ጥ ጠ) መጠየቅ አጠያየቅ ጥየቃ ምርመራ፡፡
english: A question, an inquiry, or an investigation.
Certainty, clear understanding, or confirmation.
To fly or soar like a bird.

amharic: ተነባ ጠነቈለ አሟረተ በወፍ ጩኽት በድምፀ አራዊት በሌላውም ፍጥረት፡፡
english: To practice divination or fortune-telling using the sounds of birds or animals.

amharic: የሚያሟርት ሟርተኛ ጠንቋይ ወፍ ጠያቂ እንዳገውና እንደማይጭሖ ሰው የወፍ ቋንቋ የሚያውቅ፡፡
english: A fortune-teller or someone who practices divination by watching birds.

amharic: አበረረ አስበረረ አከነፈ አክነፈነፈ፡፡ አስጠነቈለ ወፍ አስጠየቀ አስመለከ፡፡
english: To make something fly or to engage in the practice of divination.
An omen-reader or one who uses birds for divination.

amharic: ሰው ሠራሽ አሞራ ዘመን አመጣሽ ወፍ በአየር የሚበር የሚከንፍ አይሮፕላን፡፡
english: An airplane or an artificial bird capable of flying in the air.

amharic: ጥንቈላ ሟርት አምልኮ ባዕድ፡፡ ዐጥር ቅጥርንም ያሳያል፡፡
english: Divination, fortune-telling, or an enclosure/fence.

amharic: ጣራ ባጥ ጠፈር መዋቅር ድንኳን (ሕዝ፳፭ ፬)፡፡
english: A roof, canopy, ceiling, or structure/tent.

amharic: በቁሙ ስመ ወርኅ ኃምስ እመስከሪም ጠር፡፡
english: Tir; the fifth month of the Ethiopian calendar.

amharic: መጤስ መትነን መብነን መትጐልጐል ከሚነድ ከሚቃጠል ነገር ጭጋግና ጉም ጥቍር ደመና መስሎ መውጣት፡፡
english: To smoke or emit vapors like mist or dark clouds from a fire.

amharic: በቁሙ ጪስ ጭጋግ የሚመስል፡፡ ላበት እንፋሎት ስልባቦት ከሙቅ ከትኵስ ነገር የሚወጣ፡፡
english: Smoke, steam, or fog-like mist coming from a hot object.
To cause to smoke, to burn incense, or to fumigate.

amharic: ስመ ፊደል ታስዕ፡፡ ሠናይት ላሕዩት ጠባብ ኄርት ማለት ነው፡፡
english: Teth; the ninth letter of the Ge'ez alphabet, meaning goodness or beauty.
Tait; also referring to the ninth letter of the alphabet.

amharic: በቁሙ ጥይት ሠራ፡፡ መረጠ መራረጠ አበጀ አዘጋጀ የሸትን ዘላ ለመጥበስ ለማሸት፡፡
english: To prepare, select, organize, or craft (specifically preparing grain for roasting).
A person who prepares or makes something, such as grain for roasting.
To have someone prepare or craft something.
An instrument or person that facilitates preparation.
To be selected, prepared, or made ready.
Prepared, tied, or made ready.

amharic: በቁሙ ጥሩ እሸት ተመርጦ የታሰረ ለመጠበስ የተደከረ፡፡ ዐረረ ርሳስ የሚፈነዳ የሚተኰስ፡፡
english: Specifically prepared/tied grain for roasting, or a bullet (modern).
Dew or a dampening substance.
To drip, dew, or moisten.

amharic: መርጠብ መታደስ ልምላሜ ማገኝት ርጥብ ለጋ መኾን የዐጽቅ የልጅ፡፡
english: To become moist, fresh, young, or to sprout/bloom.

amharic: ግልገል እንቦሳ ውርንጭላ ለጋ ቀንበጥ ርጥብ ጨሌ ዐራስ ጨቅላ፡፡
english: A young animal, calf, foal, or a newborn.

amharic: ታናሽ ሴት ልጅ ለጋ ቈንዦ ድንግል ከዘጠኝና ካሥር ዓመት በላይ ያለች፡፡
english: A young girl or maiden (often used in the sense of a young maiden).

amharic: መጥለል መጥራት የጠላ የጠጅ፡፡ መውረድ መረጨት የጠል የካፍያ፡፡ መራስ መረስረስ መርጠብ መለምለም፡፡
english: To filter (liquid), to drip like dew, or to become moist and lush.

amharic: የጠለለ ጥሩ፡፡ የለመለመ የረጠበ ለምለም ርጥብ፡፡
english: Filtered, clear, moist, fresh, or lush.
Moisture, freshness, or natural beauty.

amharic: አጠለለ አወረደ የጠላ የጠል፡፡ አራሰ አረጠበ አለመለመ አረካ፡፡
english: To bring dew, to moisten, to refresh, or to make lush.
Refreshing, moistening, or something that brings relief.
A filter, strainer, or sieve.

amharic: በቁሙ አንጠለጠለ አነሣ ያዘ ለመውሰድ ለመጣል ወይም ለማኖር፡፡ ተያዘ ተንጠለጠለ ተወዛወዘ ለመውደቅ፡፡
english: To hang, suspend, swing, or hold something up.

amharic: ካደ ከዳ ሸፈጠ ተውል አፈረሰ ሰደበ ነቀፈ፡፡
english: To betray, deceive, deny, or insult.

amharic: ክቡር ደንጊያ ዕንቍ ልዩ ሕብር የሌለው የውሃ ዐይነት፡፡
english: A precious stone, a jewel of clear or water-like appearance.

amharic: ስመ ሰይጣን የሲኦል በረኛ አጋፋሪ ከሓዲ ግፈኛ ማለት ነው
english: A name for a devil, a gatekeeper of hell, a treacherous or cruel person.
To emerge, sprout, grow, or become taller.

amharic: መጥለቅ ጥልቅ ዕሙቅ መኾን ወይም ጥልቅ ብሎ መግባት መነከር መዘፈቅ ማደፍ መኵለፍለፍ መርከስ መጨማለቅ
english: The act of diving or going deep; being submerged, sunk, muddied, or stained.

amharic: ፈታ ለቀቀ ሰደደ አወጣ አሶጣ አሰናበተ የሚስት የገረድ
english: To release, set free, send away, dismiss, or discharge (like a wife or servant).
Something deep, profound, submerged, or stained and dirty.
Depth, profoundness, or the state of being stained or spiritually unclean.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ መጥለቅ አጠላለቅ ጥልቂያ ጥልቆሽ
english: The process or act of diving, submerging, or becoming stained.
To dress or put on clothing like a shirt or trousers.
The act of blackening, charring, or turning into ash by fire.

amharic: በቁሙ ጥቍር ዐመድ ጥላተ የሣር የገለባ የቅጠል ሕመት ቀለም የሚኾን
english: Black ash, soot, or a dark pigment made from burned grass or leaves.
To blacken, smear with soot, cast a shadow, or darken.

amharic: በቁሙ ጥቍር የሐዘን ልብስ ከል እማሎሚ የጠለስና የጥላ የጨለማ ዐይነት
english: A black garment worn for mourning; a dark, shadowed, or gloomy material.

amharic: በቁሙ ክታብ ጠንቋዮች በጥቍር ቀለም ጥፈው ጠልስመው የሚያሲዙት
english: A talisman, amulet, or charm written by a sorcerer using black ink.
A sacred or honorable vestment, often a priest's stole or neck garment.
To fold, bend, or twist.

amharic: የሰው ስም ጠንባሳ ዕዉር ዐይነ ስዉር
english: A person's name meaning blind or sightless.
To be very numerous or abundant.
Close, nearby, or adjacent.

amharic: መጥቀም መጠቃቀም መስፋት መደረት መጣፍ መለገብ ያሮጌ ልብስ ያሮጌ ጫማ
english: The act of patching, mending, or sewing together old clothes or shoes.

amharic: የሚጠቅም የሚለግብ ጣፊ ለጣፊ ድሪቶ ሰፊ አሮጌ ጠጋኝ የጨርቅ ወጌሻ
english: A patcher, tailor, or someone who mends old garments.

amharic: አስቀመጠ አስለገበ አስደረተ ልብሱን ጫማውን አስጠገነ
english: To cause to be mended, patched, or fixed (like clothing or shoes).

amharic: ተሰፋ ተጠቀመ ተጣፈ ተለገበ ታደለ ተጠገነ
english: To be mended, patched, or fixed.
Something mended, patched, or sewn together.

amharic: መጥቀም መስፋት መስፋት አሰፋፍ ስፌት ጥቅማት
english: The craft of sewing, mending, or patching.
To be mended thoroughly or expanded by patching.

amharic: አጣቀመ አጠቃቀመ የጨርቅና የጨርቅ ለነገርና ለሰውም ይኾናል
english: To arrange for something to be patched or joined together.
A tool used for sewing or patching.

amharic: መጥቀል በነገር መንካት መጐነጥ ጠቅ ማድረግ መሽሟጠጥ ፊት ለፊት ወይም በስተኋላ ማማት መንቀፍ መዋሸት መቅጠፍ መክሰስ ማሳጣት
english: The act of accusing, slandering, mocking, or lying about someone.

amharic: የሚነካ ጐናጭ አሽሟጣጭ ሰብቀኛ ከሳሽ አሳጭ ቀጣፊ የሰው ስም አጥፊ ሹላፍ እሾኻፍ
english: A mocker, accuser, slanderer, or someone who causes trouble.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ የሰው ስም ምትሀታሞ አስማታም ጠንቋይ መሠሪ ጋኔን ጠሪ ሙት አናጋሪ ማለት ነው
english: A sorcerer, fortune-teller, or one who claims to speak with spirits.

amharic: በቁሙ ጠቀለለ ጠቀላለለ ጠመጠመ የልብስ የገመድ
english: To wrap, roll up, or bundle clothing or rope.
To be wrapped, bundled, or rolled up.
Something wrapped, rolled, or bundled.
One who points out or is helpful/useful.

amharic: ተጠቀመ ተሠራ ታጠረ ተከበበ ጥቅም አገኘ
english: To benefit, use, or be enclosed/fenced in.
Something built, fenced, or constructed.

amharic: ግንብ ናስ የግንብ ቅጥር መካበቢያ የደንጊያ ድሪቶ ጥቅምቅም በኖራ ፍትልነት የተሰፋ የተጠቀመ የተሳካ የተጋጠመ ብርቱ ሥራ
english: A wall, fence, fortification, or a well-constructed piece of work.
Tikimt (the name of the second month in the Ethiopian calendar after Meskerem).

amharic: መደወል ማቃጨል መምታት ማንኳኳት የንጨት የብረት ማጨብጨብ እጅ መጽፋት መንፋት ማጋፈት
english: The act of ringing, beating, clapping, or blowing into a musical instrument like a horn or flute.
One who rings, blows, or plays an instrument.

amharic: በቁሙ መጥቅ ድወል ቃጭል መረጥ ነጋሪት ቱልቱላ ዋሽንት እንቢልታ መለከት
english: A bell, trumpet, drum, or any musical wind instrument.
To cause to sound, beat, or blow (an instrument).
To be beaten, blown, or sounded.
Someone who has been beaten, defeated, or is lowly.

amharic: መጠቃት መሸነፍ በታች መኾን በቁሙ ጥቃት ውርደት
english: Defeat, humiliation, or being struck down.

amharic: አጠገብ ጐን ላይ ቅርብ የቅርብ ቅርብ ሊይዙት ሊነኩት ወይም በጨበጣ ሊመቱት ሊወጉት የሚቻል
english: Near, beside, close by, or adjacent.

amharic: መጠቀን ማነስ ጥቃቅን ታናናሽ መኾን ተፈጭቶ ደቆ ተሰባብሮ ወይም ተቈርሶ ተፈርፍሮ
english: Being small, fine, crumbled, broken into tiny pieces, or meager.

amharic: መብዛት ብዙነት ማነስ ጥቂትነት የቍጥር የመጠን መንፈግ መቤስ ንፍገት ጩቅነት
english: The state of being small, few, or a scarcity.

amharic: እጅግ ብዙ ዐያሌ ጥቃቅንነቱ እንዳሸዋ እንደ ጤፍ ቅንጣት አንዳፈርና እንደ ዶቄት ያለ የብዛቱ መጠን
english: Tiny, very small, like dust or sand particles, and uncountable due to their minuteness.

amharic: መጥቀር መጥቈር ጠቀራ መኾን ጥቀርሻ መምሰል የጣራ የፊት የደመናት፡፡
english: The state of becoming black or dark, like a soot-covered ceiling, a dark face, or storm clouds.

amharic: በቁሙ ጠቀራ፡፡ ጥቀርሻ ጥቍር ጠቋራ ጥላት የጢስ ስልባቦት በማድ ቤት ጣራ በሣሩም በንጨቱም የሚገኝ፡፡
english: Soot, blackness, or dark residue found on kitchen ceilings, grass, or wood from smoke.

amharic: መጥቀስ ማመልከት ባይን በጅ በቃል የሰው የወጥ የነገር፡፡ መኰስተር መተርከስ የመብራት የቀንዲል፡፡
english: To gesture, signal with the eyes or hands, or to mention/quote something; also refers to lighting a lamp.

amharic: ጥቅሻ ምልክት፡፡ በቁሙ የመጽሐፍ ቃል ዐጭር ቍርጭኝ ንባብ ምሳሌ መሰል ማስረጃ ምስክር የሚኾን፡፡
english: A signal, gesture, or a short excerpt/quote from a book used as evidence or an example.

amharic: መጥራት መጮኸ አቤት አቤት ማለት ቡታ መስደድ፡፡
english: To call out loudly, shout, or summon someone.
One who calls, a shouter, or a summoner.
A call, a shout, or a loud cry.

amharic: የሹመት የማዕረግ ስም ደጅ አዝማች ራስ ቢቶደድ እንደ ማለት ያለ፡፡
english: A title of rank or office, similar to a governor or high-ranking leader.

amharic: የንጨት ስም ቡጥም መልካም ሽታና ብዙ ቅጠል ደም ወተት ያለው ቅጠሉና ፍሬው ታናናሽ ቍንዶ በርበሬ የሚመስል፡፡
english: A type of tree known for its pleasant scent and berries that look like small peppercorns.

amharic: ትርያ ጕብኣን ከዋክብት እንደነ ስድስቶ ያሉ ባንድነት ተጻፍቀው ተሰናክለው አበባ መስ類の የሚታዩ፡፡
english: A constellation or a cluster of stars that look like a flower arrangement.

amharic: መጠረዝ መጥለፍ መዘምዘም ፈትልን በመርፌማቈላለፍ በልብስ ላይ ዛፍና ሐረግ መሣል ልብስን በስፌት በሐር ማስጌጥ፡፡
english: To embroider, bind, or decorate fabric with intricate thread patterns, flowers, or vines.
An embroiderer, a binder, or one who does detailed needlework.

amharic: ግብረ መርፌ ጥልፍ ዝምዝማት በልብስ ላይ የሚጠልፉትና የሚታቱት፡፡ የመጽሐፍ ስፌት ብራናው ባንድነት የሚያዝ፡፡
english: Embroidery work; also refers to a bound volume or a collection of parchment pages sewn together as a book.

amharic: በቁሙ የልብስ ዳርቻ ዝሓው ዕጥፍ ድርብ ኹኖ ጥራዝና ጥልፍ የሚመስል፡፡
english: The edge, hem, or border of a garment.
To become bulging, distended, or round (often referring to a belly or face).
To have become bulging or distended.

amharic: ተንጠረዘዘ እንጥርዝ ፊተ ከባድ ርጕዝ ጋን ሆድ፡፡
english: Bulging, round, or distended (like a large pot or a heavy belly).
A priest or religious leader.

amharic: መጠረት ጥሪት ማጥራት ገንዘብ ግንኙነት መሰብሰብ መግዛት መውረስ ጥሩ ገንዘብ ማድረግ፡፡
english: To acquire, earn, collect wealth, or obtain assets.
A buyer, heir, or a wealthy person who possesses assets.
To cause to acquire, to help obtain wealth or goods.

amharic: ተገዛ ተዋጀ ተገኘ ተሰጠ ጥሩ ገንዘብ ኾነ፡፡
english: To be acquired, purchased, redeemed, or obtained.
Something acquired, purchased, or inherited.

amharic: በቁሙ ገንዘብ ብዕል ሀብት ብዙ ከብት ቁም መንጋ የሚንጋጋ፡፡
english: Wealth, money, assets, or livestock.

amharic: ጥሪት መጥሪያ ዕቃ መሣሪያ ወፍጮ መኪና ወይም የሚከራይ ገመል ፈረስ በቅሎ ባሪያ የመሰለው ኹሉ፡፡
english: Assets, tools, equipment, or resources like animals/servants used for work.

amharic: ጥሬ ገንዘብ ፍራጥ ሩብ እላድ ቤሳ መሐልቅ ጥሬ ወርቅ፡፡
english: Cash, hard currency, or precious metal/gold.
In a raw state, eaten without being cooked.

amharic: በቅሙ ያልበሰለ ቅንጣት ፍሬ ያልተፈታ ቋንቋ በዚያው በበቀለበት የሚነገር፡፡
english: Raw, uncooked, a seed/grain, or a plain, unrefined language.

amharic: መጠረቅ መጠርነቅ መጠርቈሽ መብላት መንደል አጣብቆ መውጋት መቸንከር መለበጥ ማስጌጥ፡፡ መጠርቀቅ ማስጨነቅ ማነቅ፡፡
english: To press, squeeze, bind tightly, or crush; also to decorate or make firm.
One who presses, squeezes, or tightens.
To cause to be crushed, pressed, or beaten.
One who causes crushing or firm pressure.
To be crushed, pressed, or firmly packed.

amharic: የተጠረቀ ጥርቅ የተሰነጋ ፍሬው የወጣ ኵልሽ ሰንጋ ቅጥቅጥ፡፡
english: Crushed, pressed, or firmly compacted material.

amharic: መጠርሰም መስበር መሠንጠቅ መፍለጥ መምታት መቀጥቀጥ ለማድቀቅ፡፡ ጥርስ ማውጣት ማብቀል የሕፃን፡፡
english: To break, crack, split, or smash; also the act of growing teeth.
A tooth or a jaw.

amharic: ሰደቃ ገበታ እራት እግር ያለው ማናቸውም፡፡ ምሧዕ መንበረ ታቦት፡፡
english: A table, altar, or stand used for dining or religious purposes.

amharic: የመጽሐፍ ስም የፍትሐ ነገሥት መዠመሪያ ክፍል ካራት አንዱ፡፡
english: The name of a book or section, specifically one of the four parts of the Fetha Negest (Law of Kings).

amharic: ማጥፋት መደምሰስ መፋቅ መሠረዝ የጥፈት፡፡ መጣስ መጠምሰስ ማስተኛት መለጠስ፡፡
english: To destroy, erase, wipe out, or abolish.
One who destroys, an eraser, or a destroyer.
To be destroyed, erased, or wiped away.
Destroyed, erased, or abolished.
Destruction, erasure, or the act of wiping away.

amharic: ጦስኝ የደጋ ቅጠል ክድልኽ ቅመም የሚገባ፡፡
english: Thyme, a highland herb used as a spice.

amharic: ፲ኛ ፊደል በግእዝ እልፍ ቤት በአበገደ ስሙ የማን ቍጥሩ ዐሥር አኃዝ ሲኾን፡፡
english: The 10th letter of the Ge'ez alphabet, representing the number 10.

amharic: የቅጽል ምእላድ ወይም የስም አርቲክል በሴት አንቀጽ ለሚነገር ቃል፡፡
english: A feminine article or suffix used with nouns or adjectives to indicate 'the'.

amharic: የሣልስ ሥረዮች ዪ የሣልስ ዬ የኃምስ፡፡
english: Refers to the phonetic sounds associated with the 3rd (Yi) and 5th (Ye) Geez character orders.

amharic: የጥሬና የስም ምእላድ ወገናዊ ቅጽል የ ኛ፡፡
english: A suffix indicating belonging, type, or possession, similar to 'of' or '-ish'.

amharic: የጥሬና የስም ምእላድ ፍችው ኛ፡ የ፡፡
english: A particle used to show origin, relationship, or possession, like '-an' or 'of'.

amharic: ቃለ ብካይ ወሰቈቃው በቁሙ ዮወዮ ወየው ይብላኝ፡፡
english: An expression of sorrow, mourning, or weeping; similar to 'woe' or 'alas'.

amharic: የቅጽል ምእላድ እንደ ዊ በጥሬና ብስም እየገባ ወገን የሚያሳይ፡፡
english: A suffix used with nouns to indicate classification or character.

amharic: ድርብ ዝርዝር የገቢር ዐጸፋ ባራት ሰራዊት በሩቅ በሩቆች የሚነገር፡፡
english: A suffix used as an object pronoun referring to something distant; means 'that' or 'him'.
Currently, at this very moment, or now.
She is, that one (feminine reference).

amharic: የቤለ ካልኣይ ትንቢት አንቀጽ፡፡ ፍችው ይል ይላል ይል ነበር፡፡
english: He said, says, or was saying.

amharic: እልል ማለት በደስታ ቃል መጮኽ ማመስገን የዘፈን የማሕሌት፡፡
english: To cheer, celebrate, sing, or make joyful sounds.

amharic: በቁሙ እልልታ ጩኸት ምስጋና መዝሙር በደስታ ቃል የሚነገር፡፡
english: A joyful sound, celebration, cheer, or song of praise.
To dry up, harden, or lose freshness.
Dried out, hardened, or dry.
Dryness, the state of being parched.

amharic: ድርቅ ደረቅ ምድር ባሕር የሌለው ውሃ ያልሸፈነው፡፡
english: Dry land, earth not covered by water.
To make dry, to parch.
Behold or now.
The name of the letter 'Yod'.

amharic: ክፍለ ወርኅ የወር እኩሌታ በዱሮ አከፋፈል፡፡
english: Mid-month; a specific period in the ancient calendar.

amharic: ማወቅ መረዳት ልኩን ርግጡን ማግኘት በጠባያዊ ዕውቀት፡፡
english: To know, understand, or discover the truth through wisdom or study.

amharic: አለ ነገረ አስተማረ አመለከተ አሳወቀ አስታወቀ አስረዳ፡፡
english: To teach, explain, inform, or make known.
To be known, understood, or revealed.
Known, understood, or revealed.
Knowledge, understanding, or a speech/discourse.
Knowledge, discernment, or wisdom.
A short, sacred name of God (Yah).

amharic: የሰው ስም ምስጋና እምነት ወይም አማኒ ምእመን ማለት ነው፡፡
english: A name meaning 'praise', or referring to the tribe/land of Judah.
The Jews; descendants of Judah.

amharic: በቁሙ የአይሁድ ወገን ይሁዲ እስራኤላዊ ወይም ፈላሻ ግዙር፡፡
english: Jewish; an Israelite.
Judaism; the faith or identity of being Jewish.
To become a Jew; to follow Jewish customs.

amharic: ይሁዲነት የአይሁድ እምነትና ሥርዐት ለሐዲስ ኪዳን አምሳል መርገፍ ኹኖ የተሰጠ፡፡
english: Judaism; the traditions and laws of the Jewish faith.

amharic: ስመ አምላክ ከፍጡራን ስም የተለየ ከፈጣሪ በቀር ለማንም ፍጡር የማይሰጥ፡፡
english: The sacred name of God (Jehovah).
A name meaning 'God knows'.

amharic: ማለዘብ ማለዛዘብ ማግራራት ማቈላላት ቅንነት ማስተማር ገር የዋህ ቅን ማድረግ፡፡
english: To soften, to show gentleness, to be kind, or to guide with patience.

amharic: የዋህ ኾነ ቀና ለዘበ ተገራ ለመደ፡፡
english: To become gentle, humble, or tame.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ የዋህ ኾነ ለዘበ ቀና በገዛ እጁ፡፡
english: To be gentle, humble, or kind.

amharic: በቁሙ የቀና ቅን ልዝብ ገር ገራም ጭምት ደግ ጥሩ እውነተኛ፡፡
english: Gentle, humble, kind, simple-hearted, or sincere.

amharic: በቁሙ የዋህ መኾን የዋህነት ገርነት ቅንነት፡፡
english: Gentleness, humility, or kindness.
Gentleness or tranquility.
The 10th letter; also represents the number ten.

amharic: የጊዜ መሰፈር መቍጠር መክፈል መተንተን ቅጽበትን በካልኢት፡፡
english: The act of measuring or calculating time.

amharic: ዛሬ አኹን ዘንድሮ የተወሰነ ክፍል መዓልትና ሌሊት ዕለት ወርኅ ዓመት ቀመር፡፡
english: Today, the present day, or a specific unit of time.

amharic: ሙያተኛ የዕለት ምንደኛ ከጧት እስከ ማታ የሚሠራ፡፡
english: Daily; someone who works day-to-day.
A dove (male or female).

amharic: ፬ኛው የያፌት ልጅ የግሪኮች አባት፡፡ የሀገርና የሕዝብ ስም
english: The fourth son of Japheth and the ancestor of the Greeks; also refers to a nation or group of people.
A descendant of Javan or a person from Greece.

amharic: ጽርእ የግሬክ ቋንቋ ከቅብጥ የሚስማማ የቅብጥ ጎረ ቤት ባለ ፳፬ ፊደል፡፡
english: The Greek language, which uses a 24-letter alphabet.

amharic: ክቡር ደንጊያ ዕንቍ የቀይ ጥ፰ር ደማም ቅላቱ የሮማን ፍሬ ደረቅ በርበሬ የሚመስል ደባባ
english: A precious gemstone with a dark red or brownish-red color, similar to a pomegranate seed or dried pepper.

amharic: በቁሙ የወር ስም ፮ኛ ወር ከመስከረም፡፡ የመከር ጫፍ መካተቻ የበልግ መባቻ ማለት ነው
english: The sixth month of the Ethiopian calendar, marking the end of harvest and the beginning of the spring season.

amharic: መላ ፈጸመ ቈረጠ ገደበ፡፡ ዘሩ ሜመየ ነው፡፡
english: To complete, finish, cut, or set a boundary.

amharic: ባሕር ኵሬ ዐዘቅት ምንጭ ጕድጓድ ታላቅ የውሃ ዕቃ፡፡ ምዕራብ የፀሓይ መግቢያ መጥለቂያ፡፡
english: Sea, pond, pool, fountain, pit, or a large water vessel; it also refers to the west, where the sun sets.

amharic: መቅናት ቅን ቀኝ መኾን መጽናት መበርደድ መብዛት መፈድፈድ መክበር መወደድ በቀኝ መቀጥቀጥ ወደ ቀኝ መኼድ፡፡
english: To be right, straight, firm, or abundant; to be favored, honored, or to move towards the right side.
Strong, firm, sturdy, or resilient.

amharic: እጅግ በጅግ ብዙ በብዙ አካቶ ፈጽሞ ጭራሽ፡፡
english: Very much, greatly, entirely, or completely.

amharic: ቀኝ የቀኝ እጅ የቀኝ ጐን ማእዝን ደቡብ የግራ ትይዩ የሰሜን አንጻር፡፡
english: Right side, right hand, southern direction, or the side opposite to the left.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ ቀኝ የቀኝ ክፍል ወገን በስተቀኝ ያለ ቦታ ማእዝን እጅ ሕዋስ፡፡
english: Right side, right part, or a direction towards the right.

amharic: አቀና ቀኝ አደረገ ወደ ቀኝ መራ አስተማረ፡፡
english: To direct towards the right, to guide, or to teach.

amharic: ስመ ሀገር የምድረ እስራኤል ደቡብ ምድረ ዐረብ፡፡
english: A name of a country or region situated south of Israel in the Arabian lands.

amharic: ስመ ወርኅ ጥር የኤሮፓዎች መዠመሪያ ወር፡፡
english: The month of January, the first month for Europeans.
Weak, feeble, or sickly.
A pillar or something that stands upright.
To gain, profit, or earn.

amharic: የሰው ስም ፮ኛው ትውልድ የሔኖክ አባት፡፡
english: A personal name; the 6th generation from Adam and the father of Enoch.

amharic: ስመ ፈለግ የከነዓን ወንዝ ታላቅ ዠማ
english: The Jordan River, a major river in Canaan.
Jesus, the Savior.

amharic: ስም የሙሴ ዐማት፡፡ ተረፍ ትራፊ ቅሬታ ወይም ከቍጥር ያልገባ ጭማሪ ማለት ነው
english: The name of Moses' father-in-law; it means remainder or surplus.

amharic: ፲፩ኛ ፊደል በግእዝ እልፍ ቤት በአበገደ ስሙ ካፍ
english: The 11th letter of the Ge'ez alphabet, called 'Kaf'.
A particle used for emphasis, exclamation, or to make a statement more vivid.
Second.
To pour out.
A large clay water jar.
Dung or animal manure.

amharic: መክበብ ማጠር መሾም ማክበር መጥራት ማደም መሰብሰብ
english: To surround, enclose, appoint, honor, call, or gather.
One who surrounds or gathers.
To cause to surround or to convene a meeting.

amharic: የሚከብ የሚያስከብብ ከባቢ አስከባቢ ሹም አለቃ ሰብሳቢ
english: One who surrounds, a leader, a chief, or a person who gathers others.
To be surrounded, gathered, or assembled.
Surrounded, round, or circular.
Roundness, circle, or surroundings.
To bounce, roll, or move in a jumping motion.

amharic: ሰርግ የመርዓዊና የመርዓት ጉባኤ የዘፈን የደስታ በዓል
english: A wedding feast, a celebration, or a joyous gathering.
To roll something along or to move by rolling.

amharic: መክበድ መመንዘል መብለጥ መብዛት በሚዛን በቍጥር፡፡
english: To be heavy, to weigh down, or to be abundant in number or value.

amharic: በቁሙ የክበደ ከባድ ጥኑ ብርቱ ክቡር ታላቅ ዐያሌ እጅግ ብዙ፡፡
english: Heavy, firm, strong, honorable, great, or very many.
Lazy, slow, or sluggish.
Strong-armed or muscular.
Those with large horns or big-horned ones.
Porters burdened with heavy loads.
Heaviness, weight, or the quality of being heavy.
To make heavy, to burden, to increase, or to strengthen.
To make difficult or to burden someone.

amharic: ጕበት ክንዋያተ ውስጥ አንዱ የሐሞት ምንጭ
english: The liver, an organ of the body.

amharic: ጠፋ ጠለለ ፈዘዘ ዕልም ድርግም አለ የእሳት የመብራት የዐይን፡፡
english: To fade, become dim, or go out, like a light, fire, or fading eyesight.
To bind, tie, or chain someone with metal.

amharic: ማሰሪያ የግር ብረትና የሰንሰለት ፍንጅ የሣጥን ዦሮ ቀለበት ዙሪያው ክብ የኾነ ምአዘኑ አይዶለ፡፡
english: A metal ring, shackle, or circular loop used for holding things together, such as the handles of a box.

amharic: መክበር መክበር መወደድ ማደግ መብለጥ መግነን ታላቅ መኾን የሀብት የዋጋ የማዕርግ የድሜ የወርድ የቁመት፡፡
english: To become great, honorable, expensive, or high in value, age, or stature.
Honorable, precious, respected, or dearly loved.

amharic: በቁሙ መክበር አከባበር ከበሬታ፡፡ ውድነት ክቡርነት፡፡
english: Honor, dignity, or the quality of being precious and respected.

amharic: በቁሙ ልዕልና ላቂያ ብልጫ ሹመት ሽልማት ታላቅነት ኅይል ብዕል ብዙ ገንዘብ፡፡
english: Glory, honor, high rank, or great wealth.

amharic: ክቡርነት፡፡ በቁሙ የሴት ልጅ ክብር ማኅተመ ድንግልና፡፡
english: Purity or the precious dignity of a young woman.

amharic: የመጽሐፍ ስም ያኵስሞች መጣፍ ንብረ እድ ይሥሐቅ በላስቶች ዘመን የደረሰው ወይም ከዐረብ የመለሰው የጽላተ ሙሴን አመጣጥ የአኳሱምን ልዕልና የነገሥታቷን ክብር ከሰሎሞን መወለዳቸውን አምልቶ አስፍቶ የሚናገር፡፡
english: The 'Glory of Kings', a famous ancient book describing the history of the Ethiopian kings and their royal lineage.
To honor, respect, exalt, or make someone distinguished.
Someone who shows honor or respects others.
To strike, hit, or beat, such as tapping a drum.

amharic: በቁሙ ንዋየ ማሕሌት አታሞ ነጋሪት ከማዕድን ከንጨት ከቈርበት የሚሠራ ስለ ክብረ በዓል የሚመታ፡፡
english: A drum made of wood and leather, used during celebrations and religious ceremonies.

amharic: በቁሙ ዲን የእሳት ዐፈር እሳታዊ ጭቃ ዐይነቱ ብጫ ክርፋታም፡፡
english: Sulfur or brimstone, a yellow, smelly substance that easily catches fire.
Related to or containing sulfur.

amharic: ስመ ሀገር በምድር እስራኤል ያለች አንዲት ገጠር፡፡
english: The name of a small village in the land of Israel.

amharic: መክበስ ማክበስበስ ጠጕርን ሰብስቦ ጠምዞ በማኽል ራስ ላይ መጠቅለል ማሰር በወለባና በሚዶ መያዝ መቸንከር፡፡
english: To style, twist, or bundle hair neatly upon the head and decorate it.

amharic: ተከበሰ ተከበሰበሰ በራሱ ላይ ጌጥ ተሸከመ ተሸለመ፡፡
english: To be well-groomed or adorned with hair ornaments.
Someone who is beautifully adorned or loves decorative hair styles.

amharic: ክብስ ጠጕር ክብሳት፡፡ የስራ የጠጕር ክባስ በስተ ላይ የሚኾን ጌጥ ሽልማት ቀጸላ ሠርመዲ ዐይነት ርግብ፡፡
english: A decorative hair ornament, crown, or headpiece.

amharic: ኰብሻ የደዌ ስም ገላ የሚነፋ የሚያሳብጥ የሚያፈርስ የሚቄምጥ ቍምጥና ቢስ ገላ፡፡
english: A name for a skin disease that causes swelling and decay.

amharic: መከበት መሸሸግ መሰውር መደበቅ እንዳይገኝ ማድረግ፡፡
english: To hide, cover, conceal, or tuck something away so it cannot be found.
One who hides or conceals something.
To cause something to be hidden or kept safe.

amharic: ተሸሸገ ተደበቀ ታባ ተሰወረ ከቦታው ታጣ፡፡
english: To be hidden, concealed, or to go missing from sight.
Hidden, secret, or concealed.
Inner, deep, secret, or spiritual.
The state of being hidden or a secret hiding place.
Secrecy or the state of being hidden.
To step on, tread, or walk over.

amharic: ዕንቍ የዕንቍ ስም ሕብሩ የሮማን ዐይነት እንደ ቦረቦጭ ያለ የሚፈልቅ የሚብለጨለጭ፡፡
english: A precious gemstone that sparkles like a pomegranate.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ ከደዋና ካድኮድ አንድ ስም ነው፡፡
english: The same as Kedewa, a type of precious stone.

amharic: መክደን መግጠም ማልበስ መሸፈን መሰወር መጋረድ እንዳይታይ ማድረግ፡፡
english: To cover, veil, hide, or protect something from view.

amharic: የሚከድን የሚያለብስ ከዳኝ ሰዋሪ ጠባቂ ወባት ጠበቃ፡፡
english: One who covers, protects, or serves as a guardian.
A cover, lid, or garment that protects.
To cause something to be covered or dressed.
To be covered, dressed, or hidden.
Covered, dressed, hidden, or veiled.

amharic: መክደን መክደን አከዳደን አለባበስ ክዱንነት፡፡ የሴት ልብስ ጭን ኅፍረት፡፡
english: The act of covering, clothing, or the state of being veiled.

amharic: በቁሙ መክደኛ መግጠሚያ ልብስ ቀሚስ መጐናጠፊያ ለሓፍ ምንጣፍ መጋረጃ ድንኳን ዳስ ጥላ ከለላ ቤት ጐዦ የሚሰውርና የሚሸፍን ኹሉ፡፡
english: A covering, garment, curtain, tent, or shelter that provides protection.
A lid, a cover, or a garment.
The same as Mekden; a cover or lid.
Another word for a lid or cover.
A covenant, agreement, or a formal promise.

amharic: መድከም ማነስ መጨለም መፍዘዝ መደንዘዝ የኅይል የጕልበት የዐይን የብርሃን፡፡
english: To weaken, become dim, dull, or lose strength and light.

amharic: ጊደርና ጥገት፡፡ ካሂ ጊደር እንስት ጥጃ፡፡ አካሂ ጥገት እመጫት ላም፡፡
english: Terms referring to a young female calf (Kahi) and a nursing cow (Akahi).

amharic: ወዲያ ወደዚያ ከዚያ በዚያ የቦታን ፈቀቅታ ጥቂት ርሕቀት ያሳያል ፍችው እንደ ህየ ስልቱ እንደ ለፌ ነው፡፡
english: Over there, beyond, or a distance away from here.

amharic: መቻል መብቃት ማግባት መወሰን በሚሠሩበት ሥራ ማየል መበርታት መብት ማግኘት፡፡
english: To be able, capable, or empowered to do something.

amharic: የሚችል ቻይ ኅይለኛ ብርቱ ሥሉጥ ዕጉሥ፡፡
english: One who is capable, powerful, strong, or patient.

amharic: አስቻለ አበረታ አቦቃ መብት ሰጠ አሰናበተ፡፡
english: To enable, encourage, permit, or authorize someone.
That which enables or makes something possible.
To be possible, feasible, or convenient.

amharic: ተቻቻለ ተስማማ ተዋደደ ተዋዋለ ተቋረጠ የዋጋ፡፡
english: To agree, reconcile, be in harmony, or settle a deal.
Something that is possible, agreeable, or harmonious.
To cause reconciliation or to make things compatible.
A mediator or one who brings people together in agreement.

amharic: የጠፍር ኳስ ዕሩር ጥንግ የተኵስ ዐላማ ጊጤ ከሆድ የሚወጣ ሐሠር ጕድፍ፡፡
english: A target, a ball, or a small object used for play or aiming.

amharic: ካህን መኾን ክህነት ተሹሞ በግዜር ፊት ቁሞ ማገልገል የአምልኮ ሥራ መሥራት፡፡
english: The act of being a priest and performing sacred duties or serving in a place of worship.

amharic: በቁሙ ቄስ ጳጳስ የግዜር አገልጋይ የሕዝብ መሪ አስተማሪ መንፈሳዊ አባት፡፡
english: A priest, spiritual leader, or teacher who serves God and the people.

amharic: አሳካነ ክህነት ሰጠ ሾመ ካህን አደረገ፡፡
english: To ordain someone or appoint them as a priest.

amharic: ተካነ ክህነት ተሾመ ተቀበለ ካህን ኾነ ካህን ተባለ ለማገልገል፡፡
english: To be ordained as a priest and enter into service.
One who is ordained and serving as a priest.

amharic: መካን ማስካን ካህንነት ተክኖ ማገልገል፡፡ አገልግሎት መንፈሳዊት ሹመት፡፡
english: The priesthood or the holy office of spiritual service.
Pertaining to the priesthood or priestly in nature.

amharic: መቅለል መፍጠን መቀልጠፍ ያካኼድ ያነጋገር፡፡ መዋሸት መቅጠፍ መለፍለፍ፡፡
english: Swiftness, quick movement, or light and fast speech.
Quick, fast, or nimble.
Lightness, speed, or sometimes deception in speech.
To wander, roam, or move in circles.
To spin, rotate, or make something turn around.
A wheel, a spindle, or a revolving metal part.

amharic: በቁሙ የብርሃን ጸዳል ሰሌዳ ብርሃን የተሣለበት የሰማይ ጌጥ የጠፈር ፈርጥ፡፡
english: A star, a shining jewel of the night sky.
Fixed stars that do not move or shift.
Saint Anthony, known as the 'Star of the Desert'.
A comet (a star with a tail), traditionally seen as a bad omen.
The evening star (Venus).
The Martyrs of Nagran (often referred to as stars).
The morning star that appears at dawn.
Wandering stars (or false teachers who lead others astray).

amharic: በቁሙ ኮክ የተክል ዕንጨት ስም ፍሬው የሚጥም ዐጥንታም፡፡
english: A peach or a stone fruit tree.
To move around, wander, or revolve.

amharic: መከወል ወደ ኋላ ማድረግ የኋሊት ማስኼድ ማስፈግፈድ፡፡
english: To make something go backwards, to retreat, or to follow behind.

amharic: ወደ ኋላ አለ አፈገፈገ፡፡ ደጀን ኾነ በኋላ ተከተለ፡፡
english: To step back, retreat, or follow someone as a guard.
One who is behind, a follower, or a guardian.
Behind, the back, or in the rear.

amharic: የተክል ዕንጨት ስም ትፋሕ ፍሬው ክብ እንክብል ሥጋማ፡፡
english: A type of tree or fruit (often associated with apple or similar sweet fruits).

amharic: የወርቅ ትፋሕ በትፋሕ አምሳል የተሣለ የተቀረጸ
english: A gold ornament or carving shaped like a fruit.

amharic: ያርሞን ፍሬዎች እንደ ትፋሕ ደስ የሚያሰኙ
english: Fruits of the pomegranate or similar ornamental garden fruits.

amharic: ዕንጐት የሽቱ ቅጠል በርሻ ባዝመራ ውስጥ የሚበቅል
english: A fragrant field plant or flower, often used in gardens.

amharic: ተንኳለለ ኮለል ኮለል ዱብ ዱብ አለ
english: To roll, drop, or flow down in small amounts.
To spin, make dizzy, or cause intoxication.
Dizziness, vertigo, or intoxication.

amharic: ስመ ዕፅ ፍሬው የሚበላ የኮል ሱታፍ
english: A type of tree with edible fruit.
The name of an ancient idol.

amharic: መኾን መባል ሳይለወጡ በሱታፌና በምሳሌ በግብር ሌላ ስም መቀበል፡፡
english: Becoming; the state of changing or taking on a new nature, role, or identity.
Being, existence, birth, or creation.
To be, to exist, or to happen.
Something that exists, becomes, or changes into something else.

amharic: መኾን አኳኾን ኹነታ አናዎር፡፡ እግዚእ የአምር ኅሊና ሰብእ እምቅድመ ኩነታ፡፡ ኩነተ ብሔር (አፈ ድ፫፡፡ ገድ ኪሮ)፡፡
english: A state of being, a condition, or the way something exists.

amharic: የደንጊያ ዐምድ ሐውልት ትክል ደንጊያ ቁሞ ተገትሮ የሚኖር፡፡
english: A tall stone pillar, monument, or statue that stands upright.
To be sufficient; to say 'it is enough' or 'it has become mine'.

amharic: ቦታ ሰፈር ስፍራ፡፡ መቆሚያ መቀመጫ ቤት መሥሪያ ማደሪያ መኖሪያ መሰብሰቢያና መከማቻ ዐጸድ ወዠድ አገር መንደር ከተማ ገጠር፡፡
english: A place, space, site, home, or location where things are gathered or people live.

amharic: መከወን ማከናወን መፈጸም ማበጀት ማዘጋጀት ማሳመር ማስጌጥ ማቅናት ማሳካት፡፡
english: To perform, complete, organize, decorate, or achieve a task.
To be finished, completed, or fully carried out.
An action, a performance, or the process of doing something.
To be organized, arranged, or to have successfully occurred.
An ancient type of currency or unit of money.

amharic: በቁሙ ኮቻ ግላስ ማክዳ ትራስ ቀንበር፡፡
english: A saddle, seat, or supportive frame.

amharic: በቁሙ አጠመደ ጋፈፈ ያዘ የዓሣ፡፡ ቀዘፈ ተረከዘ መርከብን ነዳ በሥራት አስኬድ በባሕር በመርከብ ሥሉት ኾነ፡፡
english: To row a boat, steer a vessel, or catch fish using a net.

amharic: ኵሬ ምዕቃል የውሃ መቋሚያ መጠራቀሚያ፡፡ የውሃ ዕቃ ታናሹም ታላቁም ጽዋ ጣሳ ምንዛህ ኵስኵስት፡፡
english: A water container, basin, cup, or storage vessel.

amharic: ሙራደ ማይ የሰን የኵስኵስ ጡት፡፡ የላሕመ ብርት አፍ እንደ ቧንቧ አፍ ኹኖ ጡት ያለው የሚከፈትና የሚዘጋ፡፡
english: A spout, nozzle, or pipe-like opening that controls the flow of water.

amharic: የኤጲስቆጶስ ዐርክ ምክትል እንደራሴ ወኪል ወራሴ መንበር፡፡
english: A deputy or representative of a bishop.

amharic: ማካወስ መበጥበጥ ማወክ መድረጥ መነቅነቅ ማናወጥ የባሕር የኮሶ የፈሳሽ ነገር፡፡
english: To stir, disturb, shake, or agitate a liquid or sea.
To cause something to be stirred, shaken, or agitated.
To be shaken, stirred, or disturbed.
Something that has been stirred, shaken, or agitated.

amharic: ጽዋ ዋንጫ የመጠጥ መሣሪያ መቅጃ መጠጫ ማደያ መስጫ፡፡
english: A cup, goblet, or drinking vessel.

amharic: ብዛት የጥፈት አበዛዝ ብዥ ቅጅ አንድ የነበረው ብዙ መኾን፡፡
english: A copy or a reproduction of something.
To go away or depart.

amharic: መካድ ማክዳት እምነትን ውልን መሐላን ማፍረስ መሸፈጥ ቃልን መለወጥ መዋሸት ዐሎ ማለት ማበል መወንጀል፡፡
english: To deny, break a promise or oath, or betray a trust.
A person who denies, a traitor, or one who breaks faith.

amharic: አስካደ አስከዳ ዐሎ አሰኘ አሳበለ ከሓዲ አደረገ፡፡
english: To cause someone to deny, betray, or turn away from faith.
One who causes others to deny or turn away.

amharic: ተካደ ተጣለ ተተወ ተከዳ ዐሎ ተባለ፡፡
english: To be denied, rejected, or betrayed.
To argue, dispute, or debate with one another.
Someone or something that has been denied or disputed.

amharic: መካድ መካካድ አካካድ፡፡ በቁሙ ክዳት አሉታ ሸፍጥ ዐመጥ በደል ወንጀል፡፡
english: Denial, betrayal, apostasy, or the act of breaking a vow.

amharic: ጥርጥር አሉታ ኑፋቄ ክሕደት ክርክር ሙግት የነገርና የትምርት ዕንቅፋት መሰናክል፡፡
english: A contradiction, denial, heresy, or a stumbling block to truth.
To cause a dispute or to bring two sides into an argument.

amharic: የሚያሟግት የሚያከራክር ዳኛ፡፡ ተሟጋች ተከራካሪ መናፍቅ ከሐዲ፡፡
english: Someone who provokes an argument, a debater, or a dissenter.

amharic: ቀላቀለ ደባለቀ አንድ አደረገ ቀምሞ፡፡ ከካ ፈነከተ ፈነካከተ ፈጨ ደቈሰ ጨፈለቀ የወፍጮ የናዳ የመርግ፡፡
english: To mix, blend, grind, or crush into small pieces.

amharic: ጥኑ ደንጊያ ንፍጥ ዐፈር ለበስ ቋጥኝ ገዎቻ ተራራ ኰረብታ ጭንጫ ደረቅ ጥብቅ ጠጠራም መሬት፡፡
english: A strong rock, boulder, mountain, or hard, stony ground.
To crumble or break into very fine pieces.
Crumbs or tiny broken pieces.
To be able to or to have the capacity to do something.

amharic: መኳል ማስነካት ዐይንን በኵል ዶቄት በመድኅኒት መቅባት ለጌጥና ለፈውስ፡፡
english: The act of applying kohl (cosmetic powder) to the eyes for beauty or medicine.
Someone who applies kohl to the eyes.
To have kohl applied to one's eyes.
Someone whose eyes have been decorated with kohl.

amharic: በቁሙ ኵል ጥቍር ሰማያዊ የቀለም ደንጊያ ተደቍሶ ላይን የሚቀባ የሚኳል ጌጥነት ከመድኅኒትነት ስላለው በኹለት ወገን የሚፈለግ፡፡
english: Kohl, a dark cosmetic mineral powder used for eyes.

amharic: ኵሕላዊ ኵልማ የኵል ዐይነት ጥቍረቱ ኵል የሚመስል፡፡
english: Similar to kohl, dark-colored.

amharic: መክሳት መቅጠን ማነስ መኰሰስ ካሻዋ መኾን የገላ፡፡ ማቅበር መለገም ሳይሽር የሻረ መምሰል ወይም መስፋት መግነን የቍስል፡፡
english: To become thin, shrink, wither, or to describe the appearance of a healing or worsening wound.
Thinness, leanness, or the state of a healing wound.

amharic: ቤቶች ድንኳኖች ወይም የድንኳን ቈር ቤቶች በስተላይ ጠፈር መዋቅር የሚኾኑ፡፡
english: Houses, tents, or structures resembling tent-coverings.
Salad or gathered herbs/vegetables.

amharic: የብረት ጋኖች ታላላቅ ድስቶች ለማብሰያ ለመቀቀያ ወይም ውሃ ለመምሊያ ለመታጠቢያ የተሠሩ ለታታናሾችም ይነገራል
english: Large metal pots or containers used for cooking, boiling, holding water, or washing.

amharic: የገቢር ዐጸፋና ቅጽል ይህም እንደዚያ ነው አለዝርዝር ብቻውን አይገባም
english: A grammatical particle or pronoun used to refer to someone or something specific.
Myself; me.

amharic: መኼድ መርገጥ መዳጥ መደፍጠጥ መጠቅጠቅ ማጥቃት በእግር በጫማ በርግጫ መምታት
english: To walk, step, trample, crush, or strike with one's feet or shoes.
One who steps, tramples, or attacks.
To cause to tread, trample, or thresh.
To be trampled, crushed, oppressed, or treated with contempt.
Trampled, crushed, or oppressed.

amharic: የተረገጠ መረገጥ አረጋገጥ ርግጫ ጫማ ስኰና
english: A footprint, the act of treading, or a shoe.
To trample one another or tread repeatedly.

amharic: መርገጫ መኼጃ ጫማ ውስጥ እግር ዝርጉ ጠፍጣፋው
english: A place to tread, a path, or the sole of a foot/shoe.

amharic: ዐውድማ ተረግጦ የጠበቀ መሬት የዝመራ መውቂያ ማበራያ ፍሬን ከገለባ መለያ መምረቻ ማግረጃ
english: A threshing floor, a place where grain is crushed or winnowed.

amharic: አዋለ አሰረ ውል አደረገ ነገርን ቈረጠ አጠበቀ አጠና በቃል በጥፈት የሥራ የንግድ
english: To make a pact, establish a treaty, or seal an agreement in word or writing.
To arrange an agreement or facilitate a covenant between others.

amharic: ከመጽሐፈ ኪዳን የወጣ የነግህ ጸሎት ቀሳውስት ጧት ጧት የሚያደርሱት
english: The Morning Covenant prayer used by clergy.

amharic: የማርያም ስም ወይም የኪዳኗ በዓል በየካቲትና በናሴ ባ፲፮ ቀን የሚውል ትእምርተ ኪዳን ማለት ነው
english: The Covenant of Mercy, a feast day associated with the Virgin Mary.
The name of a specific month, equivalent to December.
Because they are small or lessen.

amharic: የ፯ቱ ከዋክብት ተራ ጾታቸውና ምግብናቸው አካኼዳቸው
english: A name for a group of stars (the Pleiades).

amharic: መሾል መሰላት ሹል ስል መኾን ለመውጋት ለመቍረጥ መዘጋጀት የብረት
english: To sharpen, become pointed, or prepare metal for cutting or piercing.

amharic: ብልኅ ጠቢብ ብልኅተኛ ጥበበኛ ሥራ ዐዋቂ አንጥረኛ ባለመኪና ፈጣሪ ሐኪም ወጌሻ መሐንድዝ
english: A skilled person, artisan, craftsman, or wise expert.
Same as the previous entry (skilled person or expert).

amharic: መጠበብ መራቀቅ ጥበበኛነት የእጅ ጥበብ ተግባረ እድ
english: Craftsmanship, artistry, or skillful work.
Wisdom, skill, artifice, or cleverness.
To be skilled or to act as an artisan.

amharic: በቁሙ መዘውር የጥበብና የብልኅት መሣሪያ ሥራን ኹሉ በፍጥነት የሚያስኬድ
english: A machine; a tool of art or skill that performs work quickly.

amharic: ጦር ዘገር መውጊያ መዘርከቻ በብልኅት በጥበብ የተሠራ የስላ የሾላ
english: A spear or sharp pointed weapon crafted with skill.
A rock or stone (often used as a name, Cephas/Peter).

amharic: ዐጠፈ ጠቀለለ ሰበሰበ የልብስ የገመድ የሽቦ
english: To fold, wrap, or gather cloth, rope, or wire.
A snake or dragon.

amharic: በቁሙ ታናሽ ከረጢት ቍናማት የገንዘብ መያዣ ማሰሪያና መቈለፊያ ያለው
english: A small bag, purse, or pouch for holding money.

amharic: ጥሩ ቀይ ቀለም ወይም በቀይ የታለለ ልብስ ፈትል
english: A fine red color or red-dyed thread.
A specific type of bird (crow/raven) or a white-headed sheep.

amharic: ካከመ የእግር ኰመኰመ የምግብ የጨዎት ዐፈሰ ዛቀ የምርት
english: To collect, harvest, or scoop up.
A shovel or scoop for ashes or hot coals.
A unit of time measurement (a division of a day).
All; everything.
To forbid, prevent, stop, or withhold.

amharic: የሚከለክል ከልካይ በረኛ ዘበኛ አጋፋሪ ጠላት ምቀኛ
english: One who forbids, a guard, a doorkeeper, or an opponent.
Same as the previous entry (guard or blocker).

amharic: መከልከያ ኬላ በር ዐጥር ቅጥር አጕራ
english: A barrier, fence, gate, or prohibition.
To be forbidden, stopped, or prevented.
Forbidden, prohibited, or restricted.
Prohibition, restriction, or the act of forbidding.

amharic: ክልክል የግዞት ቤት ዘበኛ ከልካይ የሚቆምበት፡፡ የቋጥር ስም የጊዜ ቅጽል ባንድና በሦስት መካከል ያለ ቍጥር ኹለት፡፡
english: A guardian or barrier, and the number two, positioned between one and three.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ ኹለት ጥንድ ጣምራ የተቈራኙ የተመሳሰሉ እንደ መቀስና እንደ ጕጠት እደ ሚዛንና እንደ ጡት ያሉ ቅጽልነቱ ሴትና ወንድ ያስተባብራል፡፡
english: A pair or two items that are connected or matching, like parts of a pair of scissors.
Two, specifically referring to males.
Two, specifically referring to females.

amharic: ሌላ ልዩ ኹለተኛ ተከታይ መሰል እኩያ መንቲያ ጓደኛ ወዳጅ ባልንጀራ ባለሟል፡፡
english: Another, a second one, or a companion and friend.
Secondary or second.

amharic: ፪ኛም ክፍል የቍጥር ቤት የኬክሮስ ፰ኛ፡፡
english: A second part or category.
To remove or take off.

amharic: መክለብ መክለብለብ መቅለል መቸኰል መክለፍለፍ ቀላል ችኵል ክልፍልፍ መኾን፡፡
english: To be quick, hasty, or light-minded.

amharic: ውሻ የቤት አውሬ የዥብ ወገን የክፉ ሰዎች ምሳሌ፡፡
english: A dog, a wild animal, or a symbol for a mean person.

amharic: ውሻ ፊት ጠባየ ውሻ ዘማዊ ውሻዊ ልክስክስ
english: Dog-like, behaving like a dog, or untrustworthy.
A personal name, Caleb.
A fragrant resin or incense.

amharic: መክለል መጮኽ በታላቅ መስበክ መንገር ማዜም ማጕረምረም፡፡
english: To shout, proclaim loudly, sing, or grumble.
Someone who shouts, a loud or short-tempered person.
A loud noise, shout, or commotion.
To shout back and forth or create a commotion together.
To cause to shout or coordinate a loud sound.

amharic: መስፈር መመዘን መለካት ከልክ ማግባት የሥራ የምግብ የገንዘብ፡፡
english: To measure, weigh, or allocate resources.
One who measures or a person who weighs.

amharic: የቤት ዕቃ መሣሪያ ቈሳቍስ ንዋየ ሐልቅ ልክና መልክ
english: Household tools, instruments, or general equipment.

amharic: የሚዛን ስም ፍጹም ልክ ባለሺሕ ክፍል፡፡
english: A unit of weight or measurement.

amharic: የሚዛን ዐዋቂ ደንጊያ ወይም ብረት ርሳስ መጠኑ ፫ ሺሕ ስቀል የሚያነሣ፡፡
english: A standard weight or talent used for balancing and measuring.
Kidney, an organ in the body.

amharic: ከለከለ ከላ ከላ አለ አገረ አስተጓጐለ፡፡
english: To forbid, block, or stop someone from doing something.
To be forbidden or prevented.

amharic: መከለል መጋረድ ማጠር መክበብ ማጀብ ማክበር ጩኾ ማስመገን፡፡
english: To surround, shield, protect, or crown.
One who shields, crowns, or covers.

amharic: አስከለለ ተክሊል አስደረገ አክሊል አሠራ አስደፋ፡፡
english: To cause to be crowned or to place a crown on someone.

amharic: በቁሙ ዘውድ የራስ ጌጥ ሽልማት የክብር ጕልላት፡፡
english: A crown, a head ornament, or a prize of honor.

amharic: ክቡር ልብስ ፍጹም ጌጥ ፍጹም ሽልማት
english: Precious clothing or a magnificent ornament.
A shield, fence, or screen.
To be shielded, crowned, or covered.
Crowned, adorned, or honorable.
Crowning, an act of honoring, or completion.
Marriage, a holy bond or wedding ceremony.

amharic: ኹል ጊዜ ኹል ቀን ኹሉ ነገር ጠቅላላ
english: All, everything, or the whole collection.
Everywhere or always.
Universal or belonging to all.
Entirety, the whole being, or everything.

amharic: የውስጥ የአፍኣ የነፍስ የሥጋ ፍጹም ሰብእና
english: Complete, pertaining to the whole being.
Paint, color, or a substance used for decoration.
A short robe or cloak of honor.
To take off clothing or strip off.
Chalcedony, a precious stone.
To harvest, gather, or collect crops.
A harvester or someone who gathers.
To be harvested or gathered together.
Something that has been gathered, harvested, or collected.
