amharic: ዐጭር ድንክ ኵርንባጥ ታናሽ ዝራጭ እጅግ የተናቀ፡፡
english: Small, short, or tiny; often used to describe something of little importance.

amharic: ታላቅ አሞራ እግረ ሽመላ የሽመላ ወገን ባዋሽ ወንዝ የሚገኝ፡፡
english: A large bird, similar to a stork or heron, found near rivers.

amharic: ማስገደድ በግድ መያዝ ማሠራት አለውድና አለፈቃድ ማኖር፡፡
english: To force, compel, or make someone do something against their will.
Something done under pressure or necessity, without true desire or willingness.

amharic: ዐወጀ ጩኾ ሰበከ አስተማረ፡፡ ሾመ ቀደሰ ባረከ የክህነትና ያዲስ ቤተ ክሲያን፡፡
english: To proclaim, preach, or announce something publicly, often in a religious context.
A proclamation, religious preaching, or a formal appointment and blessing.

amharic: የከተማ ስም በጌንሳሬጥ ባሕር አጠገብ የነበረች ከተማ፡፡
english: The name of an ancient city located near the Sea of Galilee.

amharic: መቈፈር መማስ መሰርሰር መፈልፈል መብሳት መንደል፡፡
english: To dig, excavate, or make a hole in the ground.
One who digs or someone who does the work of excavation.
A tool or instrument used for digging or excavating.

amharic: ከረይት መክርያት፡፡ የቅጥር ማፍረሻ ቀንዳም ብረት ባለመዘውር ባለመንኰራኵር፡፡
english: An ancient siege machine or heavy tool used to break through walls.
To cause someone to dig or to have something excavated.
To be dug or to have been excavated.
Something that has been dug or excavated.
The act or process of digging or excavation.
A formal title of respect for a lady or mistress.

amharic: እግዚኦ ተሣሀል፡፡ ኪሪዬ አቤቱ ጌታ ሆይ፡፡ ኤሌይሶን ይቅር በል፡፡
english: A prayer meaning 'Lord, have mercy'.
The name of a specific month in the ancient calendar.

amharic: ቍርዬ ታላቅ አሞራ እንደ ራዛ ያለ ሲጮኽ ኵር ኵር የሚል በዝቶ ተንጋግቶ የሚኼድ፡፡
english: A large, noisy bird that travels in flocks.
A precious dark gemstone, like coal or onyx.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ ከርከዴን የሚባል ዕንቍ ወይም ሌላ ከርክዴናዊ፡፡
english: A type of precious stone similar to the dark gemstone.

amharic: በቁሙ ላንድ ቀንድ አውሬ ቀንዱ እንደ ቤት ቍንጮ በማኽል ራሱ የበቀለ መልኩ የፈረስ ቀንዱ ያውራሪሥ፡፡
english: A rhinoceros, a large animal known for the horn on its head.

amharic: የተክል ዕንጨት ስም ለውዝ ፍሬው እንደ ኮክ ያለ ዐጥንታም አፍኣውና ውስጡ የሚጥም፡፡
english: An almond tree or its delicious, nut-like fruit.

amharic: ፈጨ አዞረ መጁን፡፡ በቁሙ ከረከረ ገዘገዘ፡፡
english: To grind, rotate, or rasp something against another surface.
A millstone or grinding tool used for milling grain.

amharic: ዘለለ ፈነጨ ዞረ ዐወደ በዙሪያ ኼደ ዙሪያውን ዞረ፡፡
english: To jump, spin, or move around in circles.
To turn over, overturn, or tumble something.
The action of tumbling, overturning, or being chaotic.
A wheel, especially one belonging to a chariot or carriage.

amharic: ወይን መትክል የተተከለውን ማገልገል፡፡ መዝነም መፍሰስ ክረምት መኾን የወራት የጊዜ፡፡ መክረም ክረምትን ማለፍ ማሳለፍ፡፡
english: To pass the time, live through a season, or to wait for the rainy season.

amharic: በቁሙ የሚከርም የከረመ የኖረ ያምና ያኻች ዓምና የወዲያኛው የብዙ ዓመት፡፡
english: Something lasting, enduring, or referring to things from past years.

amharic: የወይን ቦታ ዐጸደ ወይን ሐረገ ወይን፡፡
english: A vineyard or a garden where grapes grow.

amharic: በቁሙ ዝናም የዝናም ወራት በጸደይና በመፀው መካከል ያለ ክፍል ዓመት፡፡
english: The rainy season or winter months.
To cause rain, or to spend the rainy season somewhere.

amharic: መክረሚያ ማክረሚያ የክረምት ቦታ ሙቀት ያለው ቈላ የምድር ቤት፡፡
english: A winter shelter or a warm place to stay during the rainy season.
The first month of the Ethiopian calendar, marking the start of the new year.
A fertile field, garden, or place where plants grow.
The elbow joint of the arm.
To store, place, or keep something in a specific location.
The stomach or the area inside the body where food is held.
To bow down, kneel, or bend the knee in respect.
The knee, the part of the leg that allows for bending.
The elbow or the bending part of the arm.
To strike, punch, or hit something.
To be struck or beaten.
Someone who is arrogant, or someone who has been beaten.
Pride, arrogance, or the act of acting superior.
A small bag, purse, or pouch for holding items or money.
To dry up, be brittle, or pass away suddenly.
To cause something to dry out or to cause a sudden death.
A flowing stream or a dry riverbed.
The stomach or interior of the body.
Gold or a golden ornament/jewelry.
Pottery, earthenware, or broken pieces of clay.
A type of precious stone or gemstone.
A beautiful, shiny gemstone.
The Anointed One, a sacred title referring to the Savior.
Related to Christ; a follower or disciple of Christ.
A baptized person; a follower of the Christian faith.
A church; a place where believers gather to pray.
Christian-like; belonging to or characteristic of Christians.
A baptized person or a true Christian.
The Christian faith or the state of being a Christian.
A specific type of green precious gemstone.
To cut, chop, or slice into pieces.
A piece of paper, parchment, or a scroll for writing.
To write, draw, or sketch upon parchment or paper.
A writing pen or instrument with a tip for marking.
To gain, earn a profit, or benefit from work.
To cut, trim, or shave, such as hair or nails.
To cause someone to be cut or circumcised.
To be circumcised or trimmed.
Someone who is circumcised.
Circumcision or the act of trimming.
The clippings, scraps, or remnants from cutting.
The neck.
To feel sick, suffer from indigestion, or purge.
Waste, dung, or bodily refuse.
A place for waste or a sewer/drainage pit.
To cause someone to vomit or purge.
A cover, veil, or curtain.
Covered, closed, or shut off.
To speak quickly, wittily, or poetically.
To be separated, ruined, or damaged.

amharic: መለየት መክፈል መክፈል፡፡ ወኵስየት ዘቅዱሳት መጻሕፍት (ቄር ጰላ)፡፡
english: To distinguish, separate, or categorize things.

amharic: ሞክሼ የስም ተባባሪ ስም ዐበር፡፡ ሶፍያ አንጌቤናይት እስመ አነ መኵሲሃ፡፡ ዳንኤል ብፁዕ መኵሴ ዳንኤል ነቢይ ወካልእስ በመኵሴ ወልድ ተሰምየ ወልደ (ስንክ መስ፭፡፡ ታኅ፯፡፡ ቄር)፡፡
english: A namesake; someone who shares the same name as another.

amharic: ሞክሸ ተሞካሸ ሞክሼ ኾነ በስም ተባበረ፡፡ ተመኵሰዩ መልከ ጼዴቅ ወኢያሱ ምስለ ክርስቶስ በጸዊረ ስም ወአኮ በአማን፡፡ ሰላም ለሱስንዮስ በምግባር ወተሰምዮ ለዕጓለ ጴጥሮስ ሱሲ ዘተመኵስዮ (መጽ ምስ፡፡ ስንክ ሐም፳፩)፡፡
english: To become a namesake or share the same name as someone else.
To name someone after another; to make them a namesake.
To become speckled, spotted, or textured with varied colors.

amharic: ዝንጕርጕር ጠቃጠቆ፡፡ ዘኰስኰስ ሕብሩ ወዘኢኮነ ኰሰኰሰ፡፡ ወበግዕት ላባ ድንግል ዘኢተአምር ተውሳከ ወለደት ኰሳኵስ ሰብአ ወአምላከ፡፡ አምሳለ ወርቅ ይግበሩ ለኪ ኰሳኵሰ ዘብሩር፡፡ አፍራስ ኰኵሳን (ዘፍ፴ ፴፪ ፴፫፡፡ ቅኔ፡፡ ማሕ፩ ፲፩፡፡ ዘካ፩ ፰)፡፡
english: Speckled, spotted, or multi-colored patterns.

amharic: በቁሙ ጡታም መንቀል ገንቦ እንስራ ማድጋ ዝንጕርጓርነት ያለው፡፡ ሲያዩት ደስ የሚያሰኝ ቀለም እየቀቡ ሳይደርቅም በርጥቡ ሐረግ እየጣሉ ያስጌጡታልና ኵስኵስት ያሰኘው ሕብሩ ነው፡፡
english: A decorated or patterned pottery vessel; something with a textured or spotted appearance.

amharic: ኰሸኰሽ ያፍንጫ ዐጥንት ሹሉ እንደ ጡት ያለው፡፡
english: The protruding cartilage or bone of the nose; shaped like a small bud or bump.
To scatter, distribute, or separate into parts.
Kislev, the ninth month of the Hebrew calendar (corresponding to December).

amharic: ጉብኣን ከዋክብት አንድነት ያላቸው፡፡ ኬሴላ ኬሴላ ይላል የተዛወረ ነው ሰከለን እይ (ዓሞ፭ ፰)፡፡
english: A constellation or a group of stars.
To become beautiful, successful, clean, or pure.

amharic: ኰሰተረ ጠረገ ጥሩ አደረገ ሰበሰበ ለማፈሥ ቈረጠ ቈጠቈጠ፡፡
english: To sweep, clean, gather together, or tidy up.

amharic: የሚጠርግ የሚያጠራ ጠራጊ፡፡ ኰስታሪተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን (አዋል)፡፡
english: A sweeper or one who cleans.

amharic: መጥረጊያ መጠራረጊያ የጕድፍ መሣሪያ፡፡ ወይልሕሱ ምኵስታረ ቤት (አዋል)፡፡
english: A broom, brush, or tool used for cleaning.
To be swept, cleaned, or tidied up.
Clean, swept, or tidy.
Sweepings, dust, or discarded debris.

amharic: በቁሙጣፈ ጻፈ፡፡ አጋባ አራከበ ተባቱን ከንስት ደዌውን ከጥዑይ የተክል የፈንጣጣ፡፡
english: To write, or to join/connect things together.
A writer or scribe.

amharic: መጽሐፍ መልእክት ደብዳቤ ጦማር፡፡ ተብህለ በክታበ ዐረቢ፡፡
english: A book, a written message, letter, or document.

amharic: የቤተ ክሲያን ስም ኵሳዊ ዘኵሉ እንተ ላዕለ ኵሉ፡፡
english: Catholic; meaning universal or pertaining to the whole.

amharic: ካቶሊካዊ የካቶሊክ፡፡ ሃይማኖት ኮቶሊካ እንተ ይእቲ ሐዋርያዊት፡፡
english: Catholic (pertaining to the universal apostolic faith).
The queen or the king's wife.
To be cut, chopped, or sliced into pieces.

amharic: መጨረስ መፍጀት መፈጸም መክተት የግብር የነገር፡፡
english: To finish, spend, complete, or fulfill a task.

amharic: መትጋት መቸኰል ማዘውተር የዠመሩት እስኪፈጸም ድረስ አለማቋረጥ
english: To be diligent, prompt, or to persist in finishing a task.

amharic: ማውካት ወካዎ ወኮ ወኮ ማለት ማቅራራት መደንፋት መጮኽ መድረቅረቅ መፈከር መንደቅደቅ፡፡
english: To shout, clamor, roar, or make a loud noise.
To shine, glow, or light up brightly.

amharic: መውከክ ወከክ ማለት መደንገጥ መፍራት ማፈግፈግ መራቅ ወይም ወደ ኋላ ማለት፡፡ መሳት መሳሳት የማያውቁትን ደፍሮ መናገር መቀባጠር፡፡
english: To be startled, fearful, to retreat, or to speak foolishly.

amharic: መወከል ወኪል ጠበቃ ማድረግ አምኖ መሾም እንደራሴ ማለት፡፡
english: To appoint an agent, representative, or advocate.

amharic: በቁሙ መታመን እምነት ትምክሕት ጽኑ ተስፋ አለኝታ የሚይታበል የማይጠረጠር የሃይማኖት ፍሬ፡፡
english: Trust, faith, confidence, or strong hope.
To be tired or weary from hard work.

amharic: ማውከፍ እጅ በጅ መስጠት ማቀበል ማሲያዝ ማስጨበጥ ማቅረብ ማስረከብ፡፡
english: To hand over, deliver, or present something.

amharic: አሰጠ አስቀበለ ተሰጨውን መደብ አድርጎ ተቀባዩንም ያሳያል
english: To receive, accept, or cause something to be received.

amharic: አስተማመመ አመቀኛኘ፡፡ ነገር ሰርቶ መድኅኒት ሰጥቶ፡፡
english: To treat, heal, or provide medicine for someone.

amharic: ክፉ መድኅኒት የሚያም የሚገድል ሥራይ የሚኾን፡፡ ወይም ሰዉዮው ባለ መድኅኒቱ፡፡
english: A healer, someone who provides medicine, or one who deals in harmful potions.
One who belittles, despises, or criticizes others.

amharic: መክበብ ማጠር መሾም ማክበር መጥራት ማደም መሰብሰብ ማክብ በዓል ሰርግ ጉባኤ ማድረግ፡፡
english: To surround, enclose, honor, or gather for a celebration or assembly.

amharic: መክበድ መመንዘል መብለጥ መብዛት በሚዛን በቍጥር፡፡
english: To be heavy, burdensome, or to be superior/abundant.

amharic: ጠፍ ባይ ባድማ የዱሮ ከተማ የተፈታ አገር ዱር ጣሻ በረሓ የኾነ፡፡
english: A desolate place, wilderness, or an abandoned, ruined city.

amharic: ዐቢይና ደቂቅ አገባብ፡፡ ከ-ተ-ዘንድ የ ቅጽል፡፡
english: A term indicating proximity, origin, or the state of being from or at a certain place.

amharic: መወሠር መገዝገዝ መከርከር መቍረጥ መሠንጠቅ መተርተር በመጋዝ፡፡
english: To saw, cut, or slice through something using a blade or tool.

amharic: በቁሙ ቀን ፀሓይ ወጥቶ እስኪገባ ያለ የሥራ ጊዜ ፲፪ ሰዓት
english: Daytime, the twelve-hour period between sunrise and sunset.

amharic: ዘከሃ የቅርብ ሩቅ ዐጸፋ እጅ የማይደርበት ዐይን የሚያርፍበት፡፡ ያ ያው ያኛው ርሱ፡፡
english: That one (demonstrative pronoun for someone or something at a distance).

amharic: የፊደል ስም ፰ኛ ፊደል ሐ ሕይወት ማለት ነው
english: The name of the 8th letter of the alphabet, representing life.
A carrying sling or a device used to support or carry something.

amharic: አሳበደ እብድ አደረገ አስመሰለ፡፡ ናቀ ነቀፈ አቃለለ
english: To make foolish, to treat as an idiot, or to belittle and despise.

amharic: የወደደ የጨከነ ጨካኝ ደፋር ቈራጥ ጥኑ ጠንካራ ጠባየ ብርቱ፡፡
english: Brave, strong-willed, firm, or courageous.

amharic: የሚከለክል ከልካይ በረኛ ዘበኛ አጋፋሪ ጠላት ምቀኛ፡፡
english: One who prevents, a guard, an opponent, or a prohibitor.
The same as the previous definition (one who prevents or guards).

amharic: መክረር አድረቅ መራራ ደረቅ መኾን በድንገት መሞት፡፡
english: To become dry, bitter, hard, or to die suddenly.

amharic: ሞክሸ ተሞካሸ ሞክሼ ኾነ በስም ተባበረ፡፡
english: To share the same name as another (namesake).

amharic: ዘጋ አሸገ ዐተመ እንዳይከፈት፡፡ አመለከተ ምልክት ጣፈ አደረገ፡፡ በቁሙ ከተማ ሠራ መዲና አደረገ፡፡
english: To seal, lock, mark for identification, or establish a city.
To be sealed, marked, tattooed, or branded.
A sign, mark, or symbol of identification.
An edge, end, tip, or boundary.
Urban; relating to a city.

amharic: መሸጋገሪያ ድልድይ በታላቅ ወንዝ ላይ የሚጋደም ጫፍና ጫፉ ከማዶ እስከ ማዶ የሚገጥም ዕንጨትና ብረት ግንብ ን ስሯጽ ነው፡፡
english: A bridge, walkway, or crossing structure built over a river.
Linen; cloth made from flax fibers.

amharic: ማሰር ማጣመር ማስተላለፍ ማቈላለፍ የእጅና የጣት እስራት ወይም ያለማሰርት በጸሎት ጊዜ ለግር ተወርችም ይኾናል፡፡ በቁሙ መክተፍ መከሸን የሥጋ የሽንኵርት፡፡
english: To bind, tie together, knot, or chop (as in food preparation).
To be tied, bound, or joined together.
Bound, tied, or imprisoned.
The act of binding or tying; a bond.
A shoulder or a place/tool for chopping.
To close, stop, hinder, or forbid.
One who surrounds; a bandit or raider.
A pillar capital, crown, or top decoration of a column.

amharic: መከትከት ማድቀቅ መውቃት ማምረት መሰብሰብ መክተት ያዝመራ፡፡
english: To crush, grind, harvest, or gather grain.

amharic: ፲፪ኛ ፊደል በግእዝ እልፍ ቤት በአበገደ ስሙ ለውይ ላዊ፡፡ ቍጥሩ ሠላሳ አኃዝ ሲኾን (ለ-፴) ሠላሳ ይባላል፡፡
english: The 12th letter of the Ge'ez alphabet, representing the number 30.
To send or to dispatch.
A sender.
To be sent or to serve.
One who is sent; a servant or messenger.
An envoy, messenger, or servant who has been sent.
A messenger, servant, or attendant.
A maidservant.
A message, letter, or written correspondence.

amharic: በቁሙ የግዜር መልክተኛ ሰማያዊ ረቂቅ የእሑድ ፍጥረት፡፡
english: An angel; a heavenly messenger created by God.
To become a leader, chief, or to be appointed.

amharic: አለቃ ሾመ አለቃ አደረገ መልአክ አሰኘ፡፡
english: To appoint someone as a leader or to designate as a messenger.
Leadership, rank, or the state of being a messenger.

amharic: መላፍ መማግ የሙቅ ያጥሚት፡፡ መዋጥ መሰልቀጥ የጥሕሎ የፍትፍት፡፡
english: To mix, mash, or crush food (like porridge or bread pieces).

amharic: ለስላሳ ምግብ የመላ የጣመ ዋጡኝ ዋጡኝ የሚል፡፡
english: Soft, tasty, or easily swallowed food.

amharic: የማእዘን ስም ንኡስ ማእዝን ደቡብ ከዚያውም የደቡብ ምሥራቅ በደቡብና በምሥራቅ መካከል ያለ የባሕር ትይዩና አንጻር፡፡
english: A directional term meaning the South or South-East.

amharic: መለበብ ልባብ ማግባ መገረም መጨመት ልበ ቅን መኾን እንደ ተረራ ከብት፡፡
english: To become wise, gentle, humble, or prudent.

amharic: ልበ ቅን ገር ልዝብ ገራም ጭምት፡፡
english: Wise, gentle, humble, or kind-hearted.
Inward, spiritual, or pertaining to the heart/mind.
Wisdom, gentleness, or humility.
A term referring to something internal, hidden, or deep in thought.

amharic: በቁሙ የታወቀ ሕዋስ፣ የደም መሰብሰቢያ፣ የሐሳብ፣ የፈቃድ፣ የውቀት ምንጭ
english: The heart, which acts as the center for blood circulation, thoughts, feelings, and understanding.
Hard-hearted; stubborn, cruel, or cold and unfeeling.
Faint-hearted; someone who is timid, fearful, or easily discouraged.

amharic: ቍጡ፣ ብስጩ፣ የደም ነፍስ ዕውቀት ያለው
english: Beast-hearted; someone who is short-tempered, angry, or wild in nature.
Flesh-hearted; soft, gentle, kind, and compassionate.

amharic: ለጋ፣ ቀንበጥ፣ ሙሽራ፣ ከውስጡ ከልቡ የሚወጣ
english: Pure-hearted; someone fresh, innocent, or newly emerging like a budding plant.
Human-hearted; wise, observant, and possessing deep understanding.

amharic: በልብ ወልብ፣ ፪ ልብ፣ ፪ ሐሳብ
english: Double-minded; someone who is conflicted or has two different thoughts or opinions.
Heartfelt; something that is deep, internal, hidden, or spiritual.

amharic: ለበመ፣ ልባም ኾነ፣ ልብ አደረገ፣ አስተዋለ፣ ዐወቀ፣ ተረዳ
english: To become wise, understand, perceive, or realize something.

amharic: ልባም፣ ልብ አድራጊ፣ ተመካች፣ አስተዋይ፣ ብልኅ፣ ዐዋቂ
english: Wise; someone who is intelligent, understanding, and sensible.
Wise or knowledgeable; someone who is mindful and understands things well.
Wisdom or insight; the quality of being intelligent and understanding.

amharic: ልብ ማድረግ፣ ማስተዋል፣ ዕውቀት፣ የልብ አስተያየት
english: Mindfulness; the act of being aware, wise, or having deep spiritual insight.
Intelligence; the ability to think, reason, and understand things deeply.

amharic: አለበመ፣ ልብ አስደረገ፣ አሳሰበ፣ አስታወቀ፣ አስተማረ
english: To teach, instruct, or make someone understand or aware of something.
One who informs or helps others understand; a teacher or guide.
To be understood, or to be prepared and ready.
To mix, blend, or knead materials like clay or mud.
A mixture or blend, like mud or clay.
Pottery; items made from kneaded clay.

amharic: የሸክላ ወገን፣ የሸክላ ዐይነት ዕቃ፣ ሸክለኛ፣ ሸክላ ሠሪ
english: A potter or something made of clay/pottery.
To coat, cover, decorate, or plate with materials like gold or cloth.
One who covers, coats, or decorates surfaces.
To have something covered or plated with a material.
To be covered or plated with something.
Covered, plated, or decorated (e.g., something plated in gold).
The act of covering, plating, or decorating.
A short-sleeved garment or a tunic, often worn by monks.

amharic: ልበ ቢስ ኾነ፣ ዘነጋ፣ ተሳሳተ፣ ተደናገረ
english: To become foolish, make a mistake, or become confused and wander in thought.

amharic: ልበ ቢስ፣ ደፋር፣ አፉ እንዳመጣ የሚናገር
english: Foolish or rash; someone who speaks without thinking.

amharic: ልቡና የሌለው፣ ዝንጉዕ፣ ስሑት፣ ግብዝ፣ ክፉ
english: Foolish, heartless, or misguided; someone who is deceptive or acts poorly.
To deceive, ruin, destroy, or lead someone astray.
To whiten, bleach, clean, or purify.
A white tree or wood that is pale in color.
Frankincense; a white aromatic resin used as incense.
Lebanon; a famous name for the high, white, snow-covered mountains.
The lower lip.
Laban; a name meaning 'white' or 'bright'.
Lubar; the name of a great, tall mountain.
Libertines; people who have been set free or possess their own freedom.
To wear clothes, to cover oneself, or to put on garments.
One who wears clothes; a wearer.
To dress someone, cover, or clothe another person.
To be dressed or clothed.
Clothed or covered; someone wearing garments.
The act of dressing or the state of being clothed.
Clothing or garment; anything used to cover the body.
A garment or piece of clothing.

amharic: በቁሙ ተለባበሰ ርስ በርሱ፡፡ ባማርኛ ግን አደግድግ ሲል ተላበስ ይላል መላበስ የካህናት መታጠቅ መሸንፈጥ የሕዝብ የሰራዊት፡፡
english: To dress oneself, or specifically for priests, to put on sacred robes or gear.

amharic: ጽህርት የብረት ድስት በገ፡ ፈርጅ ወይም ላመ ፈጅ (፪ዜና ፴፭ ፲፫)፡፡
english: A metal cooking pot or cauldron.

amharic: ሰራዊት ጭፍራ፡፡ የጦር አበጋዝ የጭፍራ አለቃ፡፡ ስድስቱ ሺሕ ጭፍራ ከናለቃው አንድ ሌጌዎን ይባላል (ማቴ፳፮ ፶፫፡፡ ማር፭ ፮፡፡ ሉቃ፰ ፴)፡፡
english: A large group of soldiers; a legion.

amharic: ሴዴርያ የደረት ልብስ ከአልባስ ክህነት አንዱ፡፡ ልብሰ ሎግዮን፡፡ ከመ ልብሰ ክህነት ሎግዮ (ዘፀ፴፮ ፲፭ ፲፮ ፳፪፡፡ ደራሲ)፡፡ ባማርኛ መልካማ ነገር ሲታይ ወሼን ወሼን ውሽን ማለት ሖሼን ከማለት የወጣ ነው፡፡
english: A ceremonial chest piece or breastplate worn by priests.

amharic: መለጐም ማጕረሥ በአፍ መወተፍ አፍን መዝጋት ዝም ማሰኘት መከልከል መግታት፡፡
english: To muzzle, bridle, or keep something quiet by stopping its mouth.

amharic: ጕርሻ ባፍ የሚመላ አንዳፍ አንድ ቢጆ፡፡ በቁሙ ቀለበታም ብረት በእንስሳት አፍ የሚጐረሥ፡፡
english: A bridle or bit used to control animals by their mouth.

amharic: አለጐመ አስጐረሠ ዝም አሰኘ አፍ አሲያዘ፡፡ ባማርኛ ግን ዐጕል አንቀጽ ነው ዝምም አለ ያሰኛል፡፡ አልጕም ክፉ ዝምተኛ፡፡
english: To cause someone to be silent or to put a muzzle on someone.

amharic: ተለጐመ ተዘጋ ዝም አለ ተገታ፡፡ ናሁ ተለጕመ ዜማ መሰንቆ ጥዑም፡፡ ተለጕሞ ልሳን፡፡ ይትለጐም ጸላኢ (ግንዘ፡፡ አፈ ተ፳፬፡፡ አምር ይሥ፮ ፪)፡፡
english: To be muzzled, silenced, or kept in check.
To knead dough and bake bread.

amharic: ዕንጐቻ እንደ ጣቢታ ያለ ሥሥ ረቂቅ፡፡ ባለብሉዮች ግን አንባሻ ይሉታል (ዘሌ፪ ፬)፡፡
english: A thin, flat loaf of bread.
A soft food like porridge or gruel.

amharic: ለገን ዋዲያት ማድጋ ምንቸት መንቀል ኵስኵስት፡፡ ገንዐ ወልጕነ (ገድ ተክ)፡፡
english: A cooking pot or vessel.

amharic: የዕንቍ ስም ሕብሩ ጥፍር ደባባ ደማም ወይም ደመ ርጽማ (ዘፀ፳፰ ፲፱፡፡ ፴፮ ፲፱)፡፡ ያክንትን እይ፡፡
english: A precious stone, likely a dark or reddish-colored gem.

amharic: ሰፋ ጥልቅ ኾነ ጐታ ማለት ከዚህ ወጥቷል፡፡ ለገተ ደቀነ እቀረበ ወይም ተለገተ ለመክተት ለመቀበል፡፡
english: To become deep or wide; a container for storing things.

amharic: ቀላይ ጥልቅ ዕመቅ የባሕር የወንዝ የጕድጓድ የዐዘቅት፡፡
english: An abyss, a deep body of water, or a deep pit.
Lamentation or crying.

amharic: መንገድ መቃጠል መንበልበል መሞቅ መተኰስ መላብ መውዛት ለብ ማለት፡፡

english: To smooth out, soften, or make level.
To be smoothed, changed, or to act flatteringly.

amharic: ለምጻም በራ፡፡ የለዘበ ልዝብ ለስላሳ ልሙጥ ቀጥ ያለ የተካከለ ዐባጣ ጐባጣ ሸካራ የሌለው፡፡
english: Smooth, polished, or level without any bumps.

amharic: በቁሙ ለምጥ የቈርበት ደዌ የቍምጥና ወገን የተላጠ የተመለጠ ዕንጨት የሚያስመስል፡፡
english: Leprosy or a skin condition.
A person affected by leprosy.

amharic: ለኛ የኛ እኛን ለ፡ ነ፡ ለከ፡፡
english: To us or for us.
A work apron or a waist cloth.

amharic: ሠረገላ ወይም ሰፈር የሰፈር ቦታ ሰራዊት ንጉሡን ከቦ የሚሰፍርበት፡፡
english: A military camp or a place where soldiers surround a leader.

amharic: የእሳት ላንቃ ነበልባል ምላሱ ወልብልቢቱ ወይም ችቦ ፋና ቀንዲል፡፡
english: A flame, a torch, or a bright light.
To send or dispatch someone.

amharic: ላይ ላይ ማለት ከፍ ከፍ አፈፍ አፈፍ ማለት መነሣት ማረግ ወደ ላይ መውጣት መርዘም መብለጥ መክበር ልዕልና ማግኘት በላይ መኾን፡፡
english: High, upward, elevated, or to be exalted.

amharic: ላይ ላይ የሚል ከፍ ከፍ ባይ ወደ ላይ ይሚያርግ የሚወጣ ወጣት፡፡
english: Something or someone that is high, going up, or climbing.

amharic: በቁሙ ከፍ ያለ የበለጠ በላይ ያለ ታላቅ ረዥም ምጡቅ፡፡
english: Exalted, high, superior, or noble.
Exaltation, height, or greatness.

amharic: ልዕልና ያለው ላይኛ ከፍተኛ የላይ የሰማይ፡፡
english: Sovereign, high, celestial, or belonging to the top.

amharic: በቁሙ ልዑልነት ታላቅነት ከፍታ ምጥቀት ርዝመት፡፡
english: Excellence, greatness, or high status.
Up, top, or the highest point.
Above, over, or upwards.
The one above, or that which is on top.
Upper, higher, or superior.

amharic: አነሣ አስነሣ ከፍ ከፍ አደረገ ወደ ላይ አወጣ አሳረገ አላቀ አስበለጠ አከበረ አገነነ አስመሰገነ፡፡
english: To raise, elevate, honor, or exalt.

amharic: የሚያነሣ ከፍ ከፍ የሚያደርግ የሚያሳድግ አሳራጊ፡፡
english: Something or someone that lifts up, raises, or exalts.
A staircase, ladder, or elevated place.
To be raised, exalted, or to compete for superiority.
To cause to lift up, to assist in raising.
Forever or eternal.
To stutter, stammer, or speak indistinctly.

amharic: ድዳ ለፍዳዳ ለንባዳ ኰልታፋ ክቡድ ልሳን፡፡
english: A person who stutters or has difficulty speaking clearly.

amharic: መላት ላት ማውጣት፡፡ መትክል ማግባት ማዋደድ መሰካት ማስማማት ዕንጨትን ከብረት ብረትን ከንጨት፡፡
english: To join, graft, or attach materials together.

amharic: በቁሙ ላይ የበግ ዥራት፡፡ ቅጠል የበግ ላት የሚባል፡፡ ውላጋ እጀታ የሰይፍ የካራ የነፍጥ፡፡
english: The tail of a sheep, or the handle/hilt of a tool or sword.
To separate, divide, or split in two.

amharic: ወዲህ ወደዚህ ወዲያ ወደዚያ የጊዜ የቦታ፡፡
english: Here and there, this way and that way (referring to time or place).

amharic: መለፈፍ መሸፈን መጠቅለል፡፡ መልፈፍ መለፍለፍ መስበክ ዐዋጅ መንገር፡፡
english: To wrap, cover, preach, or announce.
A preacher, speaker, or announcer.
A wrapping, covering, or scroll.

amharic: መንፈሳዊ ክታብ የደረት መጣፍ ማንበቡና መሸክሙ ብቻ የሚያጸድር፡፡
english: A spiritual amulet or scroll worn on the chest for protection.

amharic: የተሸፈነ የተጠቀለለ ሽፍን ጐመን ኵርንባ ጭብጦና ኵብ ራስ የሚመስል ቶሎ የሚበስል፡፡
english: Wrapped, bundled, or a type of quick-cooking vegetable bundle.
To babble, chat excessively, or talk too much.

amharic: ለፈጠ ለወሰ ዐሸ አበቀ አበሰበሰ የዶቄት የበሶ፡፡ ከፈለጸና ከኰስ ከኹለቱ ሥር የወጣ ነው፡፡
english: To knead or mix flour and water together to make dough or paste.

amharic: ተለፈጠ ታሸ ታቀበ ተለወሰ፡፡ ሊጥ ማለት ከዚህ ዘር ነው፡፡
english: To be kneaded or mixed together, like making dough.

amharic: የተለፈጠ ልፍጥ የታሽ የታበቀ ልዉስ ፍጹም ሊጥ ቀጭን ብጥብጥ ያይዶለ እንፍርፍር፡፡ ልፉጽ በቅብዕ (ዘፀ፳፱ ፵)፡፡
english: Dough, paste, or a thick, soft mixture.
The state of being doughy or like a thick paste.

amharic: ነበዘ አጥብቆ ያዘ ቀለመ ቢያጥቡ አይጠራ ኾነ የደም የቀለም የርስሐት፡፡ በተነስሖቱኒ ኢተሰርየ ሎቱ ኅጢአቱ እስመ ደመ መለኮት ዘለፈቆ (መጽ ምስ)፡፡
english: To stain, smudge, or hold a mark that is difficult to wash away.

amharic: መላጨት መለጫጨት ጠጕርን ከሥጋ መለየት ካሥሩ መቍረጥ መጋወጥ ቈርበቱ እስኪታይ እሲገለጥ፡፡ ላጸየ ሥዕርተ ርእሱ፡፡ ላጸዮሙ መንፈቀ ጽሕሞሙ፡፡ ርእሶ ኢይላጺ (ኢዮ፩ ፳፡፡ ፩ዜና ፲፱ ፬፡፡ ዘሌ፳፩ ፲)፡፡
english: The act of shaving hair from the skin.
To cause someone to be shaved.

amharic: ተላጨ ተለጫጨ (ዘሌ፲፫ ፴፫፡፡ ፲፬ ፰ ፱፡፡ ሚክ፩ ፲፯)፡፡ ተላጸየ ርእሶ፡፡ ለትትላጸይ ወእመ አኮ ለትትቀረፅ (ግብ፲፰ ፰፡፡ ፩ቆሮ ፲፩ ፮)፡፡
english: To have been shaved or to be in the process of shaving.

amharic: የተላጨ ልጩ፡፡ ልጹያን አጽሓሚሆሙ፡፡ እስመ ከመ ሉጹት ይእቲ (ኤር፵፰ ፭፡፡ ፩ቆሮ ፲፩ ፭)፡፡
english: Shaved or clean-shaven.

amharic: መላጫ መቍረጫ ምላጭ ሰንጢ ሰይፍ ካራ ስለታም ብረት (ኢሳ፯ ፳፡፡ መዝ ፶፩፡፡ ዘኁ፮ ፭)፡፡ መላጺ ኢለከፈኒ ርእስየ እስመ ናዝራዊ አነ፡፡ ከመ ጠቢብ ዐቃቤ ሥራይ ዘይጠብሕ በመላዲ፡፡ ከመ መላጺ በሊኅ ዘክልኤ አፉሁ (መሳ፲፮ ፲፯፡፡ ዲድ ፲፡፡ ሢራ፳፩ ፫)፡፡
english: A razor, blade, or sharp cutting tool.

amharic: ተናወጠ ተውለበለበ ወዲያ ወዲህ ላይ ታች ደፋ ቀና አለ ተቅመደመደ የሚዛን የልሳኑና የስሓኑ ለከይሲም ይኾናል፡፡ ባለቅኔዎች ግን መዘነ በለዉ ይፈቱታል፡፡ ለጠለጠ ልጥልጥ አደረገ በልክ በሚዛን (ዐማርኛ)፡፡ ዘሩ ለጺጽ ነው፡፡
english: To sway, fluctuate, or balance back and forth like a scale.

amharic: የሚዛን ምላስ ውልብልቢት ላንሴታ ማእክል ኹኖ ግራና ቀኙን የሚያስተካክል፡፡ ከመ ለጽሊጸ መዳልዉ ፍትሐ እግዚ (ምሳ፲፮፡ ፲፩፡፡ ጥበ፲፩፡ ፳፫)፡፡ አንዳንዱ መጽሐፍ በለጽሊጽ ፈንታ ለጽላጺ እንደ ማለት ልጽላጺ ይላል የጣፊ ስሕተት ነው፡፡
english: The balance beam or tongue of a scale that shows equilibrium.

amharic: መለጠጥ (ጥለ) መለጠጥ ለጣጭ ተለጣጭ ተለጣጭ ልጥጥ መኾን፡፡
english: Stretching, elongation, or being stretchy.

amharic: መለጠቅ መጣበቅ መጠጋት ልክክ ልስቅ ማለት መስማማት፡፡ እንዘ ይለጽቅ፡፡ እስከ ለጸቀ ማእሰ ሥጋሁ ዲበ ዕፅሙ፡፡ እስከ ለጸቀ ማእሰ ሥጋሁ ዲበ ዐፅሙ፡፡ ጠግዐ ወለጸቀ ምስለ መንበሩ (ዘፀ፳፮ ፳፰፡፡ ስንክ፡ መስ፲፬፡፡ ግን፮)፡፡
english: To stick, adhere, attach, or be very close to something.

amharic: አለጠቀ አስለጠቀ፡፡ አስጠጋ አቀረበ፡፡ ታለጽቆሙ ለርሑቃን (ቅዳ ዮሐ)፡፡ ዳግመኛም አብጽሐ አቅረበ በማለት ፈንታ አልጸቀ አስተልጸቀ እንደ ማለት ነው፡፡ በተቃርቦ አስተላጸቀ ለርእሱ ካልአ ብእሴ፡፡ ተዓርኮ ከመ ዝ፡ ውእቱ ዘየአምኖ ለፍቁር ወያስተላጽቆ በፍሥሓ ወኢይትዔበይ ላዕሌሁ፡፡ እለ ያስተላጽቁ ሰንበታተ ሐሰት፡፡ እመ አስተላጸቅሙ ወአዝለፍክሙ ኅልዮ (ቄር ጰላ፡፡ ፈላስ ገ፲፭፡፡ ዓሞ፮፡፡ ፫፡፡ አፈ ድ፴፫)፡፡
english: To cause to stick, to bring close, or to join together.

amharic: ተላጠቀ ተለጣጠፈ ተጣጋ ተያያዘ ተጣመረ ተቃረበ፡፡ እለ ይትላጸቃ በበይኖን፡፡ ነፍስ እንተ ትትላጸቅ ምስለ እግዚ፡፡ እመ ቦ ብእሲ ዘተላጸቀ ወሰከበ ምስለ ብእሲቱ በእሎን መዋዕል፡፡ ተላጽቆተ ስኢል (ዘፀ፳፰ ፯፡፡ አፈ ተ፳፰፡፡ ፈ መ ፲ ፫፡፡ አፈ ተ፳፯)፡፡ በቀርበና በለጸቀም ፈንታ ተላጸቀ ይላል፡፡ ሶበ ይትላጸቆ ብእሲ ወየሐውር በገቦሁ ይረግዞ፡፡ ይትላጸቅ ረድእ ለመምህሩ፡፡ ጎሩ ዘይትላጸቅ (ዮሴፍ፡፡ ቄር ጰላ፡፡ ፍ ነ ፴፯)፡፡
english: To be joined, connected, or closely associated with others.

amharic: የለጠቀ የቀረበ የተጠጋ የገጠመ የተያያዘ ፅሙር፡፡ አዘዘ ጦጦን ያንኅሱ መካን ልጹቀ ቍደስ፡፡ አግዋር እለ ልጹቃን፡፡ እመ ኮነት ነፍስ ልጽቅተ ምስለ እግዚአብሔር (ዮሴፍ፡፡ ፍ ነ ፴፯፡፡ አፈ ተ፳፯)፡፡
english: Joined, attached, connected, or close.

amharic: መጠበቅ መጣበቅ ልጥቅ ማለት እንደ ድጕስ፡፡ ቅርበት አው ልጽቀት (ቄር ጰላ)፡፡
english: The state of being stuck, closeness, or union.
Glue, adhesive, or anything that binds things together.

amharic: ሳንቃ መዝጊያ ወይም የቤት ታዛይ ጕርጃ ጓዳ፡፡ ኆኃት ውሳጥያት እለ ያበውኣ ውስተ ልጽቀ ቤት (፪ዜና ፬ ፳፪)፡፡
english: A plank, door, partition, or interior wall/chamber of a house.

amharic: ሸለሊት እንሽላሊት የገቡሎ ዐይነት፡፡ ወይም ሣሬት ሸረሪት፡፡ ላጽቂት ዘበእዴሁ የሐውር (ምሳ፴ ፳፰)፡፡
english: A lizard or a spider.

amharic: አላጠቀ አጣጋ አቃረበ፡፡ ዛቲ መጽሐፍ አስተላጻቂተ ርሑቃን፡፡ በአስተላጽቆ (ፈላስ፡፡ ስንክ ሠኔ፲፪)፡፡
english: To unite, bring together, or cause closeness.

amharic: ስመ ሀገር በቱርክ አገር ውስጥ ከዚያውም በፍርግያ ክፍል ያለች ታላቅ መዲና (ግብ፲፬ ፲፩)፡፡
english: Iconium, an ancient major city located in modern-day Turkey.

amharic: መያዝ እጅ ማድረግ ፈልጎ ማግኘት ይዞ ማሳየት፡፡ ዘይሌቅድ ብዕለ እንበለ ንዋይ ወግርማ እንበለ ሢመት ወኅይለ እንበለ ዕደው (ፈላስ ገ፳፮)፡፡
english: To seize, obtain, or catch hold of something.

amharic: ለቈደ አሰረ የምላስ፡፡ ለገደ ዘጋ የጕረሮ፡፡
english: To tie, bind, or block (like a tongue-tie or a blocked throat).
A variety of grain or cereal seed.
To lend, borrow, or the act of lending.

amharic: ለቀቀ አላቀቀ አዛጋ አፋሸገ ከፈተ ፈታ የአፍ የ፪ልፍ፡፡ መኑ ክልአክሙአርምሞ መኑ ለቀዎ ለአፉክሙ ከመ ትንብቡ ዘንተ መኑ አገብረክሙ ለተናግሮ (መጽ ምስ)፡፡ ወና የ፡ ተወራራሾች ስለ ኾኑ በዘወረ ፈንታ ዘረየ እንዲል በለቀወም ፈንታ ለቀየ ይላል ሥሩና ምንጩ በቀወ ፈንታ ለቀየ ይላል ሥሩና ምንጩ በቀወ ነው፡፡ ጐደጐደ ወሶበ አልቦ ዘያወሥእ ለቀየ ወቦአ ውስተ ጽርሕ (ዮዲ፲፬ ፲፭)፡፡
english: To open, unlock, release, or yawn.

amharic: አቀለጠ ቅጥይ አወጣ የሣር የቅጠል የማሽላ፡፡
english: To cause a sprout or shoot to emerge from a plant or grain.

amharic: በቁሙ ደኃራዊ ሣር ዳግማይ ቡቃያ ቅጥይ ከቈረጣና ካጨዳ በኋላ በገፍና በብላጊ ዝናም የሚበቅል (ዐማርኛ)፡፡
english: Regrowth; grass or plants that sprout again after harvesting.

amharic: አቅማዳ ስልቻ አፉም፡፡ አፈ ሰፊ ማለት ነው፡፡ አቅማዳፍ ስልቻፍ እንዲሉ፡፡
english: A wide-mouthed leather bag or pouch.

amharic: ማለቃት ማበደር መስጠት ማስተማር ትርፍ ለማግኘት ኋላ ለመቀበል፡፡ በደረንና ተበድረን እይ፡፡ እመ ለቃሕከ ብሩረ ለነዳይ፡፡ ኢትለቅሖ ለዘይብዕለከ፡፡ ብዙኃን እለ ኢይሌቅጡ፡፡ ወዘኢለቅሐ ወርቆ በርዴ (ዘፀ፳፪፡ ፳፬፡፡ ሢራ፰፡ ፳፪፡፡ ፳፱፡ ፯፡፡ መዝ፡ ፲፬)፡፡
english: Lending, borrowing, or giving with the expectation of return.

amharic: የሚያለቃ አለቂ አበዳሪ፡፡ ወለእመ ኅለፈ ይደልዎ ለለቃሒ ከመ ይምልክ ዘአኅዘ፡፡ በ፪ዔተ ለቃሒ (ፍ ነ ፳፯)፡፡
english: A lender or creditor.
To cause to lend or to facilitate borrowing.

amharic: ተለቃ ተበደረ ወሰደ ተቀበለ የገንዘብ የትምርት፡፡ እፈዲ እሎንተ ዘተልቃሕኩ ትምርት (አርጋ መል፴፭)፡፡ ዘይትሌቃሕ ከመ ዘይሌቅሕ፡፡ ኤትትለቃሕ እንዘ ነዳይ አንተ፡፡ ዘይትሌቃሕ ሥርናየ ውስተ ክምሩ (ኢሳ፳፬ ፪፡፡ ሢራ፲፰ ፴፫፡፡ ምሳ፳ ፬)፡፡ ዐለፈ ተሰጠ ተሰጭ ኾነ ገንዘቡ ካበዳሪ ወደ ተበዳሪ፡፡
english: To borrow, receive, or acquire knowledge or money.

amharic: ልቆኛ ተማሪ ተበዳሪ፡፡ ለቃሒ ወተለቃሒ (ምሳ፳፱ ፲፫)፡፡
english: A borrower or a student (someone who receives).
Borrowed or received items/knowledge.

amharic: ልቆ ብድር ዕዳ፡፡ ዘየሐንጽ ቤቶ በንዋየ ልቃሕ፡፡ ምስዋትሰ ወልቃሕሰ ይደሉ ከመ ይኩን በአኅዝ አው በትሕቢተ (ሢራ፳፩ ፰፡፡ ፍ ነ ፲፮፡፡ ፳፯)፡፡
english: A loan or debt.

amharic: ማበደር መበደር አበዳደር ብደራ ልቆ የብድር ሥራ፡፡ እስመ አፍቅሮቱ በላዕሌከ ልቃሔ፡፡ ፍትሐ ልቃሕያት (ማር ይሥ፴፫ ፫፡፡ ፍ ነ ፴፬)፡፡
english: The business of lending or borrowing; financial obligation.
To release, open, or let go.

amharic: ለቀለቀ ቀባ መረገ ዘጋ ደፈነ ደፈነ የቤት የዐዘቅ ያውድማ የንቅ የሥንጥቅ፡፡ ኢገብእ ውስቴቶሙ ማይ ወለቅለቅዎሙ በዐረር (አዋል ትርጓሜ፡፡ ኤር፪ ፲፫)፡፡ ዐጠበ አጠራ የልብስ፡፡
english: To plaster, caulk, seal cracks, or wash clothes clean.

amharic: መለቅለቅ አለቃለቅ ለቅለቃ ልቅልቃት መጨረሻ ዕጥበት፡፡
english: The act of plastering, sealing, or a final washing.
To gather, collect, or store.
To mourn, weep, or cry.
Releasing, opening, letting go, or freeing.

amharic: መታ ጸፋ ገረፈ፡፡ አዘዘ ይልቅቅዎ ወይኅምይዎ ውስተ ዘነበ ፈረስ ወያዑድዎ ውስተ ሀገር (ስንክ ሠኔ፲፱)፡፡ ፪ኛም አስረው ይተዉት ዘንድ ያሰኛል፡፡
english: To hit, lash, or whip (also used to mean to release or let go).

amharic: ዐዘነ ተጨነቀ አለቀሰ እንብ አፈሰሰ፡፡ ዕብራይስጡ ግን ላቄሽ ብሎ ለቀመ ቃረመ ሰበሰበ ይላልና በዚህ ዘይቤ ሲፈቱት ልቅሶኛ መጥራትን አልቅሱኝ ማለትን ያሳያል በክየን እይ፡፡
english: To mourn, weep, or call for mourners.

amharic: አስለቀሰ አሳዘነ፡፡ ባማርኛ ግን አድራጊ ነው፡፡
english: To cause someone to mourn or weep.
To mourn or to be mourned for someone who has passed away.
To mourn together or to comfort one another.
To cause someone to mourn or to lead others in expressing sympathy.

amharic: የወፍ ስም ድምፁና መልኩ ደስ የሚያሰኝ ደረቱ ብጫቱ ወርቅማ፡፡
english: A beautiful bird with a bright, golden-yellow chest and a pleasant song.

amharic: ለማራስ ለማረሰረስ ለማበቅ ለማበስበስ ለማርጠብ ለመለወስ ለማፈርፈር ለመለፈጥ፡፡
english: To moisten, soak, soften, or mix something (like dough or soil) to make it ready.
To knead or mix dough.

amharic: ጠባ መጠጠ ጨመቀ አፈረጠ የጡት የፍሬ፡፡ ረጋ ጸና የወተት የማር የፈሳሽ፡፡
english: To suck, squeeze, or extract liquid, or for a liquid (like milk) to thicken or set.

amharic: ጭማቂ ውጤት (ደም ወተት) ዕትብት እንግዴ ልጅ፡፡
english: Extract or liquid product, such as milk or juice.

amharic: ለፈጨቀ አፉን ምላሱ አጮኸ አንጯ አለ፡፡
english: To smack one's lips, make a slurping noise, or speak with an unclear sound.
Tasteless, bland, or lacking flavor.

amharic: መላሸት መላጥ ዐልጫ መኾን ዐልጫነት አለመጣፈጥ፡፡
english: The state of being bland, tasteless, or lacking flavor.

amharic: አላሸ ዐልጫ አደረገ አደክመ አሰነፈ አስናቀ አስነቀፈ፡፡
english: To make something bland, to weaken, or to cause someone to feel discouraged.

amharic: መለሰን መምረግ ምርግን ማስተካከል ምላስ የላሰው ማስመሰል የጭቃ፡፡
english: The act of plastering, smoothing over, or shaping something.

amharic: ለፈለፈ ቀባጠረ አፈቸለ ተናገረ ፊት ለፊት፡፡ ነገር ሠራ አሳበቀ ባንደበት ወይም በወረቀት፡፡
english: To chatter, gossip, or speak openly, sometimes in a way that reveals secrets.
A talkative person, a gossip, or someone who tells secrets.
To be plastered or covered with mud or plaster.

amharic: በቁሙ ምላስ አንደበት የአፍ ውስጥ ሕዋስ የመብል የነገር መሣሪያ፡፡
english: The tongue, used for tasting, eating, and speaking; also refers to language.
A gold ornament made in the shape of a tongue.
A tongue of fire; a flame.

amharic: የባሕር ጫፍ ሾለቅ አሞጥሙጦ ወደ የብስ ማኽል የሚገባ፡፡
english: An inlet, bay, or a place where a river flows into the sea.

amharic: ነዊኅ ልሳን ምላሰኛ ለፍላፊ አሳባቂ ወይም ቋንቋ ዐዋቂ፡፡
english: Someone who is talkative, a gossip, or skilled in languages.

amharic: ጽሩየ ቃል ነባቤ ቃል ጽሩይ አንደበተ ጥሩ፡፡
english: Eloquent, one who speaks with beautiful or pure words.
The tongue or pointer of a balance scale.

amharic: ምዑዘ ቃል ነገሩ እንደ ሽቱ ደስ የሚያሰኝ፡፡
english: Pleasant or soothing speech, like a sweet perfume.

amharic: የድርሰት ስም መልክእ ልሳን የልሳንን ጠባይ የሚናገር፡፡
english: A composition or literary work about the nature of human speech.
For me, mine, or to me.

amharic: ጐረሰ አላመጠ ተጐነጨ ተጕመጠመጠ ጕንጩን ነፋ አሳበጠ፡፡ ከተተ አገባ ልብስን በሣጥን ወይም ሰውነትን በልብስ በቀሚስ፡፡
english: To swallow, drink, rinse the mouth, or put clothes/body into something.
Someone who swallows or drinks.
To feed someone, help them drink, or put something inside.
The jaw or the cheek.
To touch or hold one's cheek or face with the hand.

amharic: ፊት አስመለስ አሳፈረ ወይም በጥፊ አስመታ፡፡
english: To cause shame or to slap someone on the cheek.

amharic: ጕንጮቹን ያዘ ፊቶቹን ጸፋ በ፪ እጁ የሐዘን የአንክሮ፡፡
english: To hold one's own cheeks or slap one's own face, often in sorrow or surprise.

amharic: በቁሙ መታ ገጨ ወገጠ ፈተገ ኅፅቦ ጕርዶ አወጣ ዐሸ አበቀ፡፡
english: To beat, grind, rub, or crush grain to make flour.
To be crushed, ground, or rubbed together.
Ground, crushed, or rubbed; specifically fine flour.
A place name meaning paved or a flat, paved area.

amharic: መለተት መኰልተፍ መኰላተፍ ለታታ፡፡ መኾን ያንደበት፡፡
english: To lisp, stammer, or have difficulty speaking clearly.

amharic: በቁሙ ለታታ ኰልታፋ ክቡድ ልሳን አፈ ድዳ አጥርቶ የማይናገር፡፡
english: A person who stammers or has difficulty speaking clearly.

amharic: የለተተ ድኩመ ልሳን ድዳ ለንባዳ ወይም በጭራሽ መናገር የማይችል፡፡
english: Someone who is unable to speak or has a speech impediment; mute or stammerer.
The condition of being unable to speak or having a weak, unclear voice.

amharic: በቁሙ የቅጠል ስም የደጋን መሟዥ ደካማ ለስላሳ የወጥ ቅጠል፡፡
english: A type of soft, edible leaf used as a vegetable or in medicine for healing.

amharic: ፲፫ኛ ፊደል በግእዝ እልፍ ቤት በአበገደ ስሙ ማይ ቍጥሩ አርባ አኃዝ ሲኾን አርብዓ ይባላል፡፡
english: The 13th letter of the Ge'ez alphabet, representing the number 40.

amharic: የወንዶች አብዢ ምእላድ በሩቆችና በቅርቦች ዝርዝር የሚገባ፡፡
english: A plural suffix used for masculine pronouns and nouns.
An interrogative particle used to ask 'what' or 'who'.
To win, conquer, or be victorious.
To gather or collect together.

amharic: በቁሙ ማድ ገበታ ሰደቃ አውራጅ የምግብ ማቅረቢያ መብሊያ መጠጫ ወይም መሼጫ መለወጫ ሰፊ ዝርግ ሞላላ ወርዳም ቁመታም ወይም ክብ እንዳውድማ ያለ እግራም፡፡
english: A table, tray, or dining surface used for serving food or conducting trade.

amharic: የጊዜና የጥያቄ አገባብ መቼ ምን ጊዜ በምን ሰዓት፡፡
english: A question word used to ask about time, such as 'when' or 'at what time'.
To feel sorrow, grief, or sadness.

amharic: ተቄጣ ዛተ ገላመጠ ቃጣ ሰነዘረ አስፈራራ
english: To threaten, scold, or intimidate someone with words or gestures.
Describing someone who is angry, harsh, or threatening in their expression.
The act of scolding, threatening, or intimidating.

amharic: ቍጣ ዛቻ ፍጥጫ ግልምጫ ጕራ ፍከራ በትር ስንዘራ፡፡
english: Anger, a threat, or a defiant look.
Food or provisions.
The middle or center point between things.

amharic: ዘረጋ አሰፋ ሰፊ አደረገ የቦታ የሕንጻ፡፡
english: To stretch, widen, or expand a space or building.
The width or span of something.
Mud, swamp, or marshy ground.

amharic: ጥቂት ውሆች ጫማ የሚያለብሱ እስከ ቍርጭምጭሚት የሚደርሱ
english: Shallow water that only reaches the ankles.
One time or once.

amharic: ገፈፈ አስራቄተ ቈርበት አወጣ፡፡ ማሰ ቈፈረ አጐደጐደ፡፡
english: To peel, skin, dig, or hollow out.

amharic: በቁሙ ማስ ቈርበት ጠፍር ቈዳ አነዳ፡፡
english: Leather, hide, or skin used as a belt or strap.

amharic: በዛ ፈደፈደ ዐሥር ዕጥፍ ወይም መቶ ኾነ ተባለ፡፡
english: To multiply or increase tenfold or one hundredfold.

amharic: አበዛ ዐሥሩን መቶ ወይም መቶውን ሺሕ አደረገ፡፡
english: To increase significantly in quantity, such as turning tens into hundreds.

amharic: የቍጥር ስም መቶ ዐሥር ጊዜ ዐሥር ወይም መቶ ጊዜ አንድ፡፡
english: The number one hundred.

amharic: መቆዎች ዐሥር መቶ ወይም መቶ ጊዜ ዐሥር አንድ ሺሕ፡፡
english: One thousand.

amharic: መቶ ጊዜ መቶ ዐሥር ሺሕ ወይም አንድ እልፍ፡፡
english: Ten thousand.

amharic: የቅኔ ስም በ፫ኛው መዝሙር የሚገባ ፫ ቤት ያለው፡፡
english: A specific type of Qene poem composed of three parts.
To rule, dominate, or act with authority.
To appoint someone as a ruler or authorize them.
Those who are upright, standing, or correct.

amharic: የመጽሐፍ ስም ፬ኛው ክፍል ፍትሐ ነገሥት፡፡
english: The fourth book/part of the Fetha Nagast (Ethiopic Law Code).

amharic: መመገብ መቀለብ ማብላት ማጠጣት መክበብ ለመጠበቅ፡፡
english: To nourish, feed, provide for, or protect.

amharic: በቁሙ የሚመግብ የሚጠብቅ ጠባቂ ሹም አዛዥ ቤታባት ምስለኔ እንደራሴ ወኪል ሞግዚት መሪ አስተማሪ፡፡
english: A provider, guardian, manager, steward, or teacher.

amharic: በቁሙ ቀለብ መብል መጠጥ እንጀራና ወጥ፡፡
english: Food, meals, or daily nourishment.

amharic: አስመገበ አስጠበቀ ዐደራ ሰጠ ሾመ አሠለጠነ መጋቢ አደረገ፡፡
english: To cause someone to be fed, to appoint as a manager, or to entrust with care.

amharic: በቁሙ በላ ጠጣ ተቀለበ ተጠበቀ ተሾመ፡፡
english: To be fed, sustained, or appointed to a position of care.
Someone who is well-fed, protected, or appointed to a role.
The state of being a steward, management, or guardianship.
The seventh month of the Ethiopian calendar.
To become infected, swollen, or to burst (like a sore).
To cause a sore to open or drain.

amharic: በቁሙ ካበጠ ክቈለለ ገላ የሚፈስ ነጭ እድፍ፡፡
english: Pus or infection from a wound.

amharic: ጋሻ አግሬ፡፡ በዳዊት ጋሻ አምሳል የተሠራ የአይሁድ ንሻን ማኅተመ ሰሎሞን፡፡
english: A shield, specifically a symbol often associated with the Seal of Solomon.
To scold, reprimand, or criticize.
To cause someone to be scolded or shamed.

amharic: ፫ኛ ክፍል ፍትሐ ነገሥት፡፡ በቁሙ የወፍጮ ግልገል (ዐማርኛ)፡፡
english: The third book/part of the Fetha Nagast, or a small millstone.
A pile, collection, or heap of things.
A clay water jar or pitcher.
To stretch out, level, or prepare ground (like a threshing floor).

amharic: የላይ ልብስ የክብር ልብስ ነገሥታት መኳንንት ልጆቻቸውም የሚለብሱት፡፡
english: A royal or ceremonial outer garment worn by kings and noblemen.
Name of a tribe (Midian).

amharic: ሰፋ ረዘመ ወፈረ፡፡ ስፋት የወርድ ርዝማን የቁመት ወፍር የወል የመካከል፡፡
english: To expand, grow long, or become thick.

amharic: በቁሙ ወጋ ቸከለ ምድር ያዘ ተመረኰዘ ከምድር ወረደ ተጠጋ የብስ ረገጠ
english: To land, step on dry ground, or dock a boat.

amharic: በቁሙ ሰፊ ዝርግ ረዥም ወርዳም ቁመታም ደንዳና ወፍራም ከነባሕሩና ከነየብሱ፡፡
english: Earth, ground, or land (including the sea and everything on it).

amharic: በቁሙ የምድር ከምድር የተገኘ በምድር የሚኖር፡፡
english: Earthly; belonging to or living on the earth.

amharic: ከምድር አገባ ከተተ ቀበረ ፈጸመ ጨረሰ አከናወነ ያዝመራ የሥራ፡፡
english: To bury, finish, complete, or finalize a task.
To cause to be placed into the ground or buried.

amharic: ሟሟ ቀለጠ ውሃ ኾነ ዛለ ደከመ ወዛ፡፡
english: To melt, dissolve, become liquid, or grow weak and tired.

amharic: የብርሌ የብርጭቆ የቅዛዝ የመስታዮት ጭቃ ዐፈሩ ደንጊያው እንደ ኖረ ፈልቶና ቀልጦ የሚሠራ ወይም የተሠራው፡፡
english: Glass or molten material used to make vessels like bottles and vases.
To show compassion, have mercy, or forgive.

amharic: የሚራራ መሓሪ ዐዛኝ ይቅር ባይ ዳዳኝ ፈዋሽ፡፡
english: Someone who is compassionate, merciful, or a healer.
To receive mercy or be forgiven.
Someone who has received mercy or forgiveness.

amharic: መራራት ይቅር ማለት፡፡ ይቅር መባል ይቅርታ ማግኘት፡፡ ይቅርታ ስርየት ርኅራኄ፡፡
english: The act of showing compassion, mercy, or forgiveness.
To frighten or startle someone.
To be afraid, startled, or shocked.
A prayer, petition, or a vow of supplication.
A walkway, path, or corridor.
To retreat or step back.
A gift or tribute presented as a token of respect.
A direction or reference, meaning 'from there' or 'of that place'.

amharic: መማር መምህር መኾን መምራት ማሳየት መምከር ማስተማር ማልመድ ማስለመድ፡፡
english: To learn, teach, guide, or instruct.
A teacher, guide, or mentor.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ በቁሙ መምር የትምርት አባት፡፡
english: A master teacher or an instructor.
Instruction, teaching, or a body of knowledge.

amharic: አስተማረ አስተማረ ለመምህር ሰጠ ከተማሪ ቤት አገባ፡፡
english: To teach or to enroll someone in a school.
To learn, study, or become accustomed to something.
A student or a disciple.

amharic: በቁሙ የተማረ ትምህርት የጠገበ ዐዋቂ ሊቅ ልባም አስተዋይ፡፡
english: A learned person, a scholar, or a wise expert.
Education, a lesson, or a habit.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ በቁሙ ትምርት ዕውቀት ድርሳን ምዕዳት፡፡
english: Knowledge, learning, or a formal teaching.

amharic: ማረከ ዘርፎ ወሰ ነዳ ወደ ርሱ ሳበ አቀረበ በትምርት በታምራት ወይም በጦርነት፡፡
english: To capture, take as a prize, or draw someone toward oneself through teaching or war.
To cause to be captured or seized.
To be captured or taken as a prisoner.
A captive, prisoner, or the spoils of war.
Captivity or the state of being a prisoner.
To lead into captivity or manage the capture of others.
To win, overcome, or achieve victory.
A winner, a victor, or someone who conquers.
To empower, strengthen, or cause to be victorious.
To be defeated or conquered.
Defeated or someone who has been conquered.
Victory or the act of winning.
Victory or triumphant state.
The means of victory or a winning strategy.

amharic: በቁሙ የታወቀ ተክል የንስትና የኮባ የጕናጕና ወገን ፍሬው ጥፍጥ፡፡
english: A banana, a tropical fruit-bearing plant.
To stretch, expand, or extend.

amharic: ትይዩ አንጻር ፊት ለፊት አኳያ አምሳያ፡፡
english: A counterpart, equal, or one who stands face-to-face.

amharic: መሟጨት መፋቅ የጥርስ፡፡ መፈግፈግ መወልወል መጥረግ ማጥራት የድፍ የጕድፍ፡፡ መካስ ካሳ መስጠት ቂምን በቀልን በካሳ ማጥፋት፡፡
english: To clean, polish, or provide compensation/restitution to settle a grievance.
One who provides restitution or cleans and purifies.
To cause restitution to be made.
To be compensated or to settle a dispute.
Compensated or settled through restitution.
To settle accounts with one another or resolve a conflict.
To make peace or settle a disagreement.

amharic: ካሳ በደል አስተራረቅ፡፡ መሟጫ መፋቂያ ርጥብ ዕንጨት ወይም ጭራ
english: Restitution for an offense, or a tool used for scrubbing or smoothing.

amharic: ትቢያ እቅብ ቂንድ እድፍ ጕድፍ ደቃቅ ነገር
english: Dust, dirt, or tiny particles.

amharic: ሙጭ ቈላፍ በትር የጤፍና የማሽላ መውቂያ
english: A wooden stick or tool used for threshing grain like teff and sorghum.
An exit or an opening for getting out.

amharic: መሞቅ መተኰስ ሙቀት መንሣት ማግኘት ከፀሓይ ከእሳት ከልብስ ከደዌ
english: The process of warming up or gaining heat from the sun, fire, clothes, or health.
Warm or hot.
Warmth or the state of being hot.
Heat or warmth.
To warm something up or make it hot.
To warm oneself up.
To cause something to become warm.

amharic: መሞት መለየት በነፍስ ከሥጋ በሥጋ ከነፍስ መራቅ እየብቻ መኾን
english: Death; the separation of the soul from the body or the act of ceasing to live.

amharic: በቁሙ የሞተ የሚሞት ሟች ሥጋዊ ሰው
english: A mortal; someone who is living and will eventually die.

amharic: በቁሙ የሞተ የተለየ ሬሳ በድን አስክሬን
english: Dead; a corpse or someone who has passed away.
The act or state of dying.
Death; the end of physical life.

amharic: ሙት በክት ሳያርዱት ታሞ ወይም ገደል የሞተ የከብት ሬሳ
english: The carcass of an animal that died naturally or from an accident instead of being slaughtered.
The state of being dead, weak, or lifeless.
To kill, destroy, or separate.
To make someone jealous or to boast.
To pull out, uproot, or snatch away.
Something bad or a negative outcome.
The doorposts on the left and right sides.
To play, act silly, or flirt.

amharic: ድል ድል ቅምጥል ቀለጤ ቀበጥ ቅብጥብጥ
english: Someone who is playful, flirtatious, or mischievous.

amharic: ጽፉቅ ጽፍቀት ማለት ነው የሰውን ብዛት የቦታን ጥበት መላፋትንና መፋተግንም ያሳያል
english: Crowdedness; a state of being packed closely together.
A long pole or rod.
To rub, scrub, or polish.
To be rubbed, scrubbed, or polished.
Something that has been rubbed, polished, or cleaned.

amharic: መመዘን መለካት ነገርን መሞከር በሚዛን ዕውቀት ማነጻጸር
english: The act of weighing, measuring, or comparing things.
To be weighed or measured.
Something that has been weighed or measured.
A scale or a measuring tool.
To brew, stir, or mix liquids.
A brewer or someone who makes traditional drinks.

amharic: ዝልል ጥሩ ጠላ ከእኽል የሚሠራ ዐረቂ ጠጅ የሚያሰክር መጠጥ
english: A brewed, alcoholic drink made from grain.
Constellations or signs of the zodiac.

amharic: የልዕልና የከበሬታ ስም ልዑል ዐቢይ ክቡር
english: A title of honor, greatness, or majesty.
To melt or dissolve.
To destroy, erase, or wipe away.
A destroyer or something that uproots.
To be destroyed, erased, or uprooted.
To mature, grow up, or become a young adult.
A young man or youth.
Youth, adolescence, or the prime of life.
To behave youthfully, play, or flirt.
To have mercy or feel compassion.

amharic: ማለ ተረገመ ተፈጠመ ነገርን ለማጽደቅ ለማጽናት፡፡
english: To swear or take a solemn vow to confirm the truth of a statement.
A person who swears or takes an oath.

amharic: በቁሙ ማላ ፍጥም የውል ነገር ማጽደቂያ በፈጣሪ ወይም በፍጡር ስም በሚወዱትና በሚያከብሩት ነገር የሚደረግ፡፡
english: A solemn promise or oath made in the name of someone or something respected.
To cause someone to take an oath or to make someone swear.
To have an oath taken upon oneself.
To make a mutual agreement or covenant with others.

amharic: ተማማለ ለመነ ማለደ አቤት አቤት አለ መሓላና ኪዳን በማሳሰብ፡፡
english: To plead, beseech, or earnestly ask for mercy by reminding someone of a promise.

amharic: በቁሙ ልመና ምልጃ የማኅበር የሕዝብ ጸሎት እግዚኦታ፡፡
english: A communal prayer or public petition asking for God's help.

amharic: መፈግፈግ ማሸት ማልፋት ማለስለስ የቈርበት ለልብስና ለፈትልም ይኾናል፡፡
english: The process of softening, rubbing, or preparing leather or fabric.

amharic: ማሻ ማልፊያ ወይም አልፊ ዐሽታ ዐራቢ፡፡
english: A tool or substance used for rubbing or smoothing.

amharic: በቁሙ መን የሻማ መሥሪያ ርስ በርሱ የሚፋተግ የሚፈጋፈግ፡፡
english: Material used for grinding or rubbing together.
The shadow or reflection of the divine from above.
A gift offered as a token of friendship or respect.
A fortress, tower, or defensive wall.
A friend or companion.

amharic: መታ ፈለጠ ቈረጠ ሰበረ አደቀቀ ገደለ አጠፋ፡፡
english: To strike, cut, break, or destroy.

amharic: የሚመታ ተማች ፈላጭ ቈራጭ ገዳይ አጥፊ፡፡
english: One who strikes, cuts, or destroys.

amharic: ማጤ ምሣር መቍረጫ መፍለጫ መምቻ መከትከቻ፡፡
english: An ax, tool for cutting, or striking instrument.
To be struck, cut, killed, or destroyed.
One who has been struck, cut, or destroyed.

amharic: መምታት መቍረጥ መመታት መቈረጥ ሞት ጥፋት፡፡
english: The act of striking, cutting, or destruction.
To be in great distress or labor pains.
The womb or a place of gestation.
To teach or instruct.

amharic: መማር ይቅር ማለት ዕዳን በደልን መተው፡፡
english: To show mercy, forgive, or release someone from a debt or fault.

amharic: በቁሙ የሚምር ማሪ ይቅር ባይ ዐዛኝ ርሩ ሰጭ መጿች ለጋስ ሰው ወዳጅ፡፡
english: A merciful, forgiving, and kind person.
To cause to show mercy or to inspire forgiveness.
One who has been forgiven.

amharic: በቁሙ ይቅር ማለት መባል፡፡ ይቅርታ ቸርነት ርኅራኄ ፍቅር ምጿት፡፡
english: Mercy, forgiveness, kindness, or compassion.

amharic: ለመነ ማለደ አማለደ አስማረ ማረኝ ማርልኝ አለ፡፡
english: To plead for mercy or ask someone to intercede on one's behalf.
To reconcile or act as a mediator to bring peace.
A mediator, intercessor, or one who brings comfort.
To take captive or capture.
A lamb.
A fortress or tower.

amharic: ማማጥ መጨነቅ በምጥ መያዝ ለመውለድ የሆድን ለማውጣት፡፡
english: To be in labor or experiencing the intense struggle of childbirth.
Labor pains or great distress.
To cause distress or labor pains.
A bog, marsh, or deep place that causes struggle.
A bed, throne, or resting place.
A pan or instrument for roasting/frying.

amharic: መመጥወት ምጧት መስጠት ማደል ማጕረሥ ማቀበል ማሳለፍ ማቅረብ ማሲያዝ ማስጨበጥ ማስረክብ፡፡
english: To give, offer, hand over, or present as a gift or offering.
One who gives, offers, or hands over.
To receive something that has been given.
A receiver or one who is being given something.
Something given or handed over; an offering.
The act of giving or the offering itself.
An ax or hatchet.
Desire, greed, or a deep craving.

amharic: መመጠን መለካት መስፈር መክዳት ልክ ማወቅ መገመት ይኽን ያኽል ማለት መወሰን ማስተካከል፡፡
english: To measure, quantify, calculate, determine a limit, or adjust.
One who measures, a calculator, or someone who knows the limit.

amharic: በቁሙ ልክ ስፍር ቍጥር ሚዛን ገመድ ዐቅም ማዕርግ፡፡
english: A measure, quantity, scale, limit, capacity, or rank.

amharic: ዐቢይ አገባ የ እንደ ያኽል ጊዜ ዘመን ሳ ይኾናል ጊዜና ሳ ፩ ወገን ነው፡፡
english: A particle meaning 'as', 'like', 'as much as', 'when', or 'while'.
To be measured, weighed, or brought within a limit.

amharic: የተመጠነ አመጣጠን አለካክ ምጠና ግምገማ ልክ መጠን ስፍር ቍጥር የወርድ የቁመት የስፋት፡፡
english: Measured, balanced, or calculated; a dimension or precise amount.

amharic: መጠነኛ ታናሽ ልክ መተንተኛ ወይም ጢንጦ የክፍል ክፍል ሢሶ ርቢት ዐምሾ ትሙን ይህን የመሰለ፡፡
english: A small portion, a fraction, or a modest measure.

amharic: በቁሙ ምድር ለቀቀ ከምድር ራቀ ረዘመ፡፡
english: To rise, to leave the ground, to soar, or to become tall/high.
One who snatches or pulls; a taker.

amharic: አመጠቀ አረዘመ አስመጠቀ አስረዘመ ምጡቅ ረዥም አደረገ ወይም አስደረገ፡፡
english: To make something higher, longer, or taller.

amharic: ተነጠቀ ተመነጠቀ ወደ ላይ ተሳበ ከፍ ከፍ አለ፡፡
english: To be snatched up, to be taken high, or to be raised above.

amharic: በቁሙ የመጠቀ ከምድር የራቀ ከፍተኛ ረዥም ሩቅ ረቂቅ፡፡
english: High, tall, distant, lofty, or elevated.
Height, length, or elevation.

amharic: ርቀት አራራቅ ልዕልና ከፍታ ልገል ስልቻ ወይም ከነት ከቈርበት የሚሠራ የረኞች ወንጭፍና ደንጊያ ሌላም ነገር የሚከቱበት፡፡
english: Distance, height; also a pouch or sling for stones.

amharic: ማንጠሪያ ማነጣጠሪያ የቀስተኛና የነፍጠኛ ዐላማ ወይም ይላማ ፍላጻው ዐረሩ ሲነደፍ ሲተኰስ የሚያርፍበት እንደ ጌጤ ያለ በሩቅ በአንጻር ፊት ለፊት የቆመ የተተከለ፡፡
english: A target or mark for arrows or shooters.

amharic: ዝናብ የውሃ ሕንባብ ነጠብጣብ ከላይ የአየር ከቀስት ደመና የሚነደፍ የሚወነጨፍ፡፡
english: Raindrops or something hurled/shot from the air.

amharic: የተቀደስ አክሊል ዘውድ ሥራውና ጌጡ ከነገሥታት ዘውድ የተለየ ቀድሞ በብሉይ ሊቃነ ካህናት ዛሬም በሐዲስ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት የሚለብሱት፡፡
english: A sacred crown or miter worn by high priests.
A bishop or one who wears a miter.

amharic: እመ አህጉር ታላቅ መዲና ከተማ መናገሻ፡፡
english: A capital city or metropolis.
The act of returning or turning back.

amharic: በቁሙ ውሃ የታወቀ ፈሳሽ ከምድር ሆድ የሚፈልቅ የሚወጣ በባሕር በየብስ በጕድጓድ በዐዘቅት በኣፍላግ በአንቅዕት በኹሉ የሚገኝ ለባሕርዩና ለባሕርያቱ የተለየ ሕብር ጣዕምና መዐዛ የሌለው ጽሩይ ንጹሕ ቈሪር ካራቱ ባሕርያት አንዱ.
english: Water; a clear, cooling, life-giving liquid.
Watery or aquatic; relating to water.

amharic: በቁሙ ዐማርኛ፡፡ ዐርክ መርዓዊ ገልገል ሙሽራ የመርዓዊ አሳሳች እኩያው አምሳያው ከማሳሳቱም የተነሳ የመርዓት ወገኖች መኑ ዝንቱ ብለው የሚያደንቁት የሚጠይቁት፡፡
english: A best man, groomsman, or a close companion of the groom.

amharic: በቁሙ ሴት ሙሽራ የመርዓዊ ጣምራ ሚዝ(ስ)ቱ፡፡
english: A bridesmaid or the female companion of the bride.

amharic: በቁሙ ማዚያ ስመ ወርኅ ሳምን እመስክረም የሚዛዝትና የሙሽሮች ወር፡፡
english: Miazia (an Ethiopian month), often associated with weddings.
To return, turn around, or reverse.
One who returns, changes, or reverses something.
To cause to return or cause to change.
To return, turn back, or be reversed.

amharic: የተመይጠ ድርብ፣ የተመላለሰ ተዛወረ ተገላበጠ ተለዋወጠ፡፡
english: To move back and forth, to exchange, or to rotate.
To return or alternate back and forth.
One who moves back and forth or is changeable.
Returned, reversed, or changed.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ መመለስ ምሰላ፡፡ መለወጥ መለዋወጥ መዛወር፡፡
english: Returning, changing, or oscillating.
Change, transformation, or mutability.

amharic: ዝን ዓዲ ከማሁ ምልልስ ተለዋዋጭ ተገላባጭ መኾን እንደ ኅሥሥት፡፡
english: Variable, shifting, or constantly returning.

amharic: ተመያዉ የተመለሰ የሚመለስ ምልስ ነር የዋህ ኅዳጌ በቀል፡፡
english: One who repents or returns; merciful or forgiving.

amharic: ተማያዉ አስተማያዉ የተማለሰ የሚያማልስ ተማላሽ አማላሽ፡፡
english: A mediator, one who goes back and forth to make peace.

amharic: የመንገድ ስፍር በቁመት ሺሕ ርምጃ ሺሕ መትር ወይም ፪ ሺሕ ክንድ ማለት ነው ፩ ምዕራፍ እንደ ማለት፡፡
english: A mile; a unit of measurement for distance.

amharic: ስመ ፊደል መ ማይ ማያት ማለት ነው፡፡
english: Mem (the name of a letter), meaning water.

amharic: ውሃ ኾነ ሟሟ ቀለጠ ውሃ መሰለ ውሃ ውሃ አለ፡፡
english: To become liquid, melt, or flow like water.

amharic: መተንኰል መጠብበ ማወቅ መራቀቅ ለግብር ለነገር መልክ ማውጣት ምሳሌ መስጠት፡፡ ማክዳት መዋሸት ማበል ማታለል መሸንገል፡፡
english: To plot, scheme, trick, deceive, or act cunningly.
To teach deceit or to incite trickery.
To be deceived, tricked, or plotted against.
One who is deceitful or tricky.

amharic: የተታለለ የተሸነገለ ተላላ ሽንግል ሌሎች ያታለሉት የተተነኰሉት፡፡
english: Deceived, tricked, or fooled.
Craftiness, trickery, or deceitful behavior.

amharic: ክዳት ክፋት ተንኰል ክፉ ምክር ሽንገላ
english: Bad advice, dishonesty, or evil intent.
A repetition of the previous meaning of deceit or craftiness.
Deception, lies, or hypocrisy.
To melt, become liquid, refine, or taste sweet.
A pleasant scent or something that is refined, melted, or sweet.

amharic: መመሸት መለወስ ማሸት መበጥበጥ ማማሰል መጠጀት መዘለል
english: The act of mixing, stirring, pouring, or brewing liquids like wine or honey.

amharic: መሻጭ መሸተኛ የሚጠጅ የሚጠምቅ የሚዘልል በጥባጭ ዐረቂ አውጭ
english: Someone who prepares, stirs, or serves drinks or beverages.
To cause a drink to be prepared, served, or to turn something back.
To be mixed, poured, or tilted like liquid.
Something that has been stirred, poured, or tilted.

amharic: መሸታ ጠጅ አረቄ የወይን የማር የሌላውም ኹሉ የሚያሰርክ መጠጥ
english: A beverage such as honey-wine, mead, or other types of drinks.

amharic: ዋነተኛ ተበገናኝ ማየ ሐማሲ እግረኛ የማይደፍረው ዋነተኛ የሚሻገረው ዕሙቅ ጥልቅ
english: Deep or vast waters that can only be crossed by swimming.

amharic: ሜዳ ለጥ ቀጥ ያለ የተካከለ እንዳውድማ ያለ ርቱዕ
english: Flat, level, or straight ground like a threshing floor.

amharic: የመጽሐፍ ስም ፪ኛው ክፍል ፍትሐ ነገሥት
english: The name of the second part of the Fetha Nagast law book.
The name of the Archangel; literally meaning 'Who is like God?'.
To boast, be proud, or feel honored.
A proud, boastful, or honorable person.
To cause someone to boast or to honor someone.
A source of pride or someone who makes another boast.

amharic: የተመካበት ተከበረበት መመኪያ መክበሪያ ኾነ ለሌላው
english: To have been a source of pride or honor.
Someone who is proud or something that serves as a boast.

amharic: መመኪያ ትምክሕት ክብር ምስጋና ሞገስ ልዕልና ጌጥ ሽልማት
english: Pride, honor, glory, or an ornament that one is proud of.
Arrogance, pride, or a source of glory.
To guard, protect, or act as a watchman.
An expert in weighing or measurement.
Barrenness, the inability to produce fruit or have children.
The state of being barren or unproductive.
To make someone or something barren or unproductive.
Something or someone that causes barrenness.
The name of a month, either Tahsas or Ginbot.

amharic: ድጋፎች ተሸካሞች መሠረቶች ወይም ስክተቶች ጕልቶች
english: Supports, foundations, or pillars.

amharic: ማምከር ማሰብ ማውጣት ማውረድ ሐሳብ ማሻሻል መወሰን
english: To advise, think, plan, or make a decision.

amharic: የሚመክር መካር አስተዋይ ምክር ዐዋቂ አማካሪ
english: An advisor, counselor, or wise person.
The act of counseling or the council of advisors.
To seek advice or to consult.
To receive advice or listen to counsel.

amharic: የተመከረ ዕድሜና መጣፍ መከረአ ወይም ባልንጀራ የመከረው
english: Someone who has been advised or guided.

amharic: ቍርጥ ሐሳብ ፈቃድ ትምርት ዕውቀት ምስጢር ኅቡእ ነገር
english: Advice, secret knowledge, or a well-thought-out plan.
To deliberate or consult together.
To facilitate a discussion or to consult with one another.
To test, try, or examine something to understand its nature.
To cause something to be tested or tried.
To be tested, tried, or examined.
Hardship, tribulation, or a difficult test.
The harvest season or the fruit of the land.
The name of a month, Yekatit.
Namesake; someone who shares the same name.
A covering, veil, or protective layer.
To start, hold, or fill.

amharic: ዐጕልና ገቢር “ላዕለና ውስተ በ፡ ግእዝ ይስማሙታል”፡፡ መምላት መንተርፈፍ ጢም ማለት ማደር መክተት የኅዳሪ
english: The act of filling, overflowing, or storing.
One who fills or a state of being full.

amharic: ተመላ ጠገበ ውስጡ ኹሉ ያዘ ተመላበት በዝቶ ዐደረበት ኅዳሪው፡፡
english: To become full, satisfied, or occupied.
Full, complete, or perfect.
Fullness, completion, or the state of being finished.

amharic: ምላት ምሉ ፍጹም ክፍል ልከኛ ሕጸጽና ተውሳክ የሌለው፡፡
english: Entire, perfect, or lacking nothing.
A name of a great star.

amharic: ማለገ ምልግልግ አለ ማላጋ ኾነ የፈሳሽ የሰውም ይኾናል፡፡ ታገሠ ቻለ፡፡
english: To flow, slide, or be patient/enduring.

amharic: ማላጋ ምልግልግ፡፡ ዕጉሥ ታጋሽ ትዕግሥተኛ ቻይ ልበ ሰፊ
english: Patient, enduring, or broad-minded.

amharic: ለምለም ለስላሳ ዝልፍልፍ የሚል የሚተጣጠፍ የለፋ ወይም የራስ ርጥብ ትኵስ
english: Soft, supple, flexible, or moist.

amharic: ማጨውየት ጨው ማውጣት ውሃውን ጨው ማድረግ ወይም ጨው መጨመር በጨው ማጣፈጥ ማጀል
english: The process of salting or seasoning with salt.
To be salted or seasoned with salt.

amharic: ጨዋም ጨው ጨው የሚል የጨው ውሃ፡፡
english: Salty or salt water.
Salt or saltiness.
A name for an idol (Moloch).

amharic: መንቀል መምዘዝ ማፍለስ ማውጣት ማጥፋት ማራቅ ቦታ ማስለቀቅ
english: The act of pulling out, removing, or extracting.
One who pulls out or extracts.
To cause to pull out or extract.
To be pulled out or extracted.
Extracted, pulled out, or drawn (like a sword).
The act of pulling out or extraction.
To draw a weapon like a sword.
To cause to draw a weapon.

amharic: በቁሙ ላጠ ቀረፈ ገጠበ ነጨ ላጨ የቈርበት የጠጕር፡፡
english: To peel, shave, or strip skin or hair.

amharic: አስመለጠ አመለጠ አዳነ ራሱን ወይም ሌላውን
english: To escape, save, or rescue.

amharic: ተመለጠ ተመላለጠ ምልጥልጥ አለ ተላጠ ተገጠበ፡፡
english: To peel off, become hairless, or slip away.

amharic: የተመለጠ ምልጥ መላጣ በራ ቡሓ ገባጣ ንክ የዳነ ያመለጠ ሙላጭ ሟላጣ፡፡
english: Bald, stripped, or escaped.

amharic: ጨምጫማ በልጣጣ ማዝ የያዘው ዐይን ቅንድቡ የተመለጠ የተገለበጠ
english: One who has lost eyebrows or has bare, exposed eyes.

amharic: ዐጥፍ ሌጦ ዘብድው ጠጕር የሌለው የላይ ልብስ፡፡
english: A skin, hide, or sleeveless outer garment.
A name of a Cherub (a heavenly being).

amharic: መላ መታ በመላ ዐወቀ መለኛ ኾነ፡፡
english: To devise, plan, or solve with wisdom.

amharic: መለኛ መላ ዐዋቂ፡፡ የሚያፈስ የሚለያይ አቅላጭ አፍሳሽ፡፡
english: One who devises, solves, or guides.
The act of worshiping, ruling, or conquering.

amharic: የመለከ የሚመልክ ገዢ ሠራዒ መጋቢ ነጋሢ ወራሲ ባለቤት ጌታ ባለሙሉ ሥልጣን
english: A ruler, king, master, or one who governs.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ የመለከ መላኪ ንጉሥ ባለዘውድ፡፡
english: A king or a crowned ruler.

amharic: ንጉሣዊ የንጉሥ ወገን ንጉሥ የዞመው ራስ ደጃዝማች
english: Royal or relating to a king.

amharic: አስመለከ አስገዛ አስደራጊ፡፡ አነገሠ አጌተየ አሠለጠነ
english: To cause to worship or to make someone rule.

amharic: በቁሙ ሃይማኖት ማምለክ ማስመለክ አምላክ ማድረግ፡፡
english: Worship, religion, or the act of honoring a deity.
A worshiper or one who serves.
Divinity or the state of being God.

amharic: ያምላክ ወገን ገንዘብ አምላክማ አምላካም ባላምላክ፡፡
english: Divine or god-like.
To be worshiped or to be subject to someone.

amharic: የተመለከ ምልክ የተገዛ ግዝ እጅ ዐደር፡፡
english: Subjected, ruled, or a servant.

amharic: መምለክ መግዛት መመለክ መገዛት አገዛዝ አምላክ መኾን፡፡
english: The act of ruling, serving, or statehood.

amharic: መልከኝነት ገዥነት ጌትነት ሹመት አገዛዝ ግዛት ጥበቃ፡፡
english: Governance, authority, or lordship.
Subjugation, oppression, or being under rule.

amharic: ስመ ኮከብ ዐቢይ መጋቤ መፀው ካራቱ መራሕያን አንዱ (ሔኖ ፷፬)፡፡
english: The name of a major star and one of the four angelic leaders responsible for the harvest seasons.
Authority, a kingdom, or ruling power.

amharic: በቁሙ ባሕርያዊ አምላክነት ያለው የአምላክ የመለኮት፡፡
english: Divine; relating to or possessing the nature of God.

amharic: በቁሙ የመንግሥትና የሹመት ምልክት ነገሥታት መኳንንት የሚያስነፉት፡፡
english: A trumpet or horn used by kings and leaders as a sign of authority.

amharic: አመለከተ አሳየ ምልክት ጣፈ አደረገ፡፡ መለከት ነፋ አስጮኽ፡፡
english: To indicate, show, sign, or blow a trumpet.

amharic: ተመለከተ ባለምልክት ኾነ ለራሱ፡፡ ጠበቀ አስተዋለ ሌላውን፡፡
english: To look at, watch, observe, or pay attention to something.

amharic: በቁሙ የዜማ የንባብ የትርጓሜ የስም የቍጥር በፊደል በነቍጣ የሚደረግ፡፡
english: A symbol, mark, or sign used in writing, music, or numbers.

amharic: የደቂቀ ዓሞን ጣዖት እስራኤል ያመልኩት የነበረ ፊቱ የጥጃ እጁና ግንዱ የሰው እጆቹ ሕፃን ለመቀበል የተዘረጉ፡፡
english: An ancient idol worshiped by the children of Ammon, often depicted with a calf's face and human-like arms.

amharic: መሉክዬ ጥሩ ሐምል የወጥ ቅጠል ለግላጋ ጠውላጋ ለንጉሥ የሚገባ የንጉሥ ወጥ ማለት ነው፡፡
english: A specific type of high-quality green leafy vegetable or herb suitable for preparing royal dishes.

amharic: ገቢርና ዐጕል መለመለ ላጠ ላገ መለሎ አደረገ ዐረቀ አስተካከለ፡፡
english: To straighten, align, make smooth, or lengthen.

amharic: የሰው ስም ፭ኛው ትውልድ ከአዳም ቀዳማዊ በኵረ አምላክ ስብሐተ አምላክ ዘይሴብሕ አምላከ፡፡
english: The name of the fifth generation from Adam; means one who praises God.
A type of black spice, similar to nigella or black cumin seeds.
A term describing a flat surface or structure.
To fill, be full, or become complete.

amharic: መንገድ መዠመር መምራት ፈጥኖ መነሣት እግርን መንቀል በችኰላ መኼድ መራመድ፡፡
english: To start a journey, move quickly, walk, or lead the way.
To cause to move, to hasten, or to inspire someone to set off.
To be carried along, led away, or to take something with one.
To cause to be carried away or to make something travel along.

amharic: ጣፈጠ እጅ አስመጠጠ ላመ ጣመ ደስ አሰኘ የምግብ ያንደበት የቃል፡፡
english: To taste delicious, be pleasant to the tongue or mouth.

amharic: የንብ እንጀራ ሰፈፉ፡፡ ጠቃጠቆው ወይም ቀፎው ማጓው የንቡ መዝገብ፡፡
english: A honeycomb; the place where bees store their honey.

amharic: ቈረጠ ቀጨ ነጨ የራስን ያንገት የጠጕር፡፡
english: To cut, pluck, or shear hair or vegetation.

amharic: ቅርጫት ታናሽ አስፈሬድ ወይም እንቅብ ጕርዝኝ፡፡
english: A small basket or container.

amharic: መመለስ መለወጥ የቃል የነገር ለውሃና ለእግርም ይኾናል፡፡
english: To return, change, or answer; can refer to movement or speech.
To cause to vomit or to make something return (physically).
To return, turn back, or be smoothed out.

amharic: የተመለሰ ምልስ ቅልስ፡፡ የተሳለ የተሰነገለ ብሩህ ጽዱል መፍርህ ዘያበለብል፡፡
english: Returned, polished, bright, or shining.

amharic: ዜማ ተሰጦ የዜማ ምስጋና ግራና ቀኝ የሚመላለስ፡፡ እሳታዊ ዕንቍ የሚበርቅ የሚያንጸበርቅ፡፡
english: A musical melody, or something brilliant and shining like a gem.

amharic: በቁሙ ስጣዌ ቃል ምላሽ የጥያቄ ፍሬ፡፡
english: An answer, response, or reply to a question.

amharic: በቁሙ ምላሽ ትፋት ቅርሻት ባፍ ገብቶ ባፍ የሚወጣ፡፡
english: Something regurgitated or a response coming back out from the mouth.

amharic: በቁሙ ዞረ ወዲያ ወዲህ አለ የእግር፡፡
english: To walk back and forth or to move around.
To interact, correspond, or converse back and forth.
To cause to interact, facilitate movement, or mediate back and forth.

amharic: ጥሩ ፀምር ጥሩ ሐር የክት ልብስ ግምጃ ከፀምር ከሐር ከክታን ከጥጥ የሚሠራ፡፡
english: Fine wool, silk, or high-quality decorative fabric used for special clothing.

amharic: አፍጸፍ ብላጥ በቤት ዙሪያ የሚሠራ ጌት ዐምድና እንደ ዝናር ያለ ሥረ ወጥ ወይም የኋላ ቅጥል ልብጣት ልባጥ፡፡
english: An architectural ornament or decorative structure around a house, like a pillar or belt-like border.

amharic: ዱባ የባር ቅል ታላቅ ክብ ወይም ሞላላ ሳይቀልል የማይበላ ዐይነቱ ብጫ፡፡
english: A pumpkin or gourd; a large, round or oval vegetable, often yellow.

amharic: በጢሕ ብርጭቆ የዱባ ዐይነት ጥሬው የሚበላ የማይቀቀል፡፡
english: A melon or cucumber-like fruit that is eaten raw.

amharic: ንኡስ አገባብ የማሻሻልና የማማረጥ የጥያቄ ቃል፡፡ ወይስ፡፡
english: An interrogative word meaning 'or' or used to ask a choice between options.

amharic: የመረ ጥሬ የሰው ስም የአብርሃም ወዳጅ ባለቃል ኪዳን ሽፍታ እንቢተኛ አሳዛኝ ማለት ነው፡፡
english: A proper name (Mamre); often associated with the friend of Abraham.

amharic: ገንዘብ ጥሪት ብዕል፡፡ ጣዖት አሻንጉሊት ከወርቅና ከብር የተሠራ፡፡
english: Wealth, money, or an idol made of gold and silver.

amharic: ፈራ ደነገጠ ከልብ ካንዠት ታወከ ተሸበረ ሸሸ ደነበረ፡፡
english: To fear, be startled, troubled, or to flee in panic.
Frightened, troubled, or a cowardly/panicked person.
Panic, fear, or great disturbance.
To cause fear or to worry someone.
Something that causes fear or a person who frightens others.
A person who does something wrong; a criminal.

amharic: ጐደሰ አነሰ ሕጹጽ ኅሱር ነውረኛ ኾነ
english: To be incomplete, insufficient, or lacking in quality.

amharic: ሕጸጽ ሕጹጽነት ነውረ ሥጋ የሕዋሳት መጕደል
english: A physical flaw, disability, or being incomplete.
Who; a question used to ask about a person's identity.
Who; asking about someone specifically.
What; a word used to ask about things or actions.
Nothing; something that is empty or does not exist.
Manna; the special food provided from heaven.
To measure, count, or finish a task.
Towards decoration or adornment.
A machine, mechanism, or a gear-like tool.
To operate a machine or set a trap.
To be caught in a trap or deceived.
An ancient catapult or a machine for throwing heavy stones.
Government or kingdom.
Distress, trouble, or hardship.
A fancy or honorable garment.
A cloth, scarf, or napkin.
A water canal or irrigation channel.
Menz; the name of a region.
Someone who is suffering or tormented.
Drawn out or moved.
An adulterer or unfaithful person.
A place of rest.
A type of bird.
Spirit (often referring to the Holy Spirit).
A filter or straining tool.
To set apart, define, or surround with a fence.
A monastery or a special sacred place.
The act of wishing, desiring, or wanting something.
To make someone wish for or desire something.
To wish, desire, or want something.
A wish, desire, or request.
An opening or a niche.
The thumb.
A biting tool or place for biting.
A monk; someone who lives a simple life of devotion.
Monastic; relating to the life of a monk.
A nun; a woman devoted to a religious life.
To become a monk or join a monastic order.
To ordain or dress someone as a monk.
Monasticism; the life and state of being a monk.
Relating to monastic duties.
The state of being small, thin, or diminished.
The act of rejecting, despising, or disliking something.
A person who renounces or abandons worldly things; someone who lives a hermit's life.
To cause someone to abandon something; to make something seem worthless or be rejected.
To be rejected, despised, or considered worthless.
Something that is rejected, despised, or of no value.

amharic: በቁሙ (ላ፡ ጥ) መመነን መናቅ ምነና ንቀት አናናቅ፡፡
english: The act of renouncing the world or living a life of humble asceticism.

amharic: በቁሙ የሚዛንና የገንዘብ ስም አንዱ ምናን ፶ ስቅል ነው
english: A unit of ancient weight or currency; one 'maneh' is equal to 50 shekels.

amharic: የሴት ልጅ ስም ቀጭን ፈታይ ባለሟያ ወይም መልከ መልካም ትክክል ፍጽምት ሕጽጽ የሌለባት ማለት ነው
english: A name for a girl meaning someone who is beautiful, perfect, or refined.
Breath, spirit, or soul.
A rug, carpet, or floor covering.
A dwelling place or the state of living.
A test, trial, or challenge.

amharic: ምን ኾነ ምን ተባለ ምን አ(ተ)ደረገ፡፡
english: To ask what happened or what was done.
To become double, to be a pair, or to give birth to twins.
Something that is doubled or a twin.
Duality, being a twin, or having two parts.
The state of being double or having twins.

amharic: በቁሙ ኹለት ጥንድ ዘውግ የትካከለ የተመሳሰለ፡፡
english: Twins; a pair that is matched or identical.
To make something double or cause a birth of twins.
A rabbit or a creature of the rabbit family.
A trap-setter or hunter.
The Anointed One; the Messiah.

amharic: መንጠቅ መቀማት በኅይል መውሰድ መዝረፍ መግፈፍ፡፡
english: The act of grabbing, taking by force, or stealing.
A snatcher, a grabber, or someone who steals.

amharic: አስነጠቀ አስቀማ አሶሰደ የያዘውን ወይም ራሱን፡፡
english: To cause someone to be snatched or to have something taken away.

amharic: ተመሠጠ ተነጠቀ ተቀማ ተማረከ ተዘረፈ ጠፋ ታጣ፡፡
english: To be snatched away, taken, captured, or to disappear.
Something that has been snatched or taken.

amharic: መንጠቅ መነጠቅ አነጣጠቅ ንጥቂያ ቅሚያ ሽሽት ሩጫ፡፡
english: The act of snatching, grabbing, or a sudden departure.
To snatch from one another or to scramble for something.
A hook, fastener, or clasp used for pulling or attaching.
A place for seizing or taking things by force.

amharic: በቁሙ ነጭ የቈላ ተባይ የጕንዳን ዐይነት ውስጥ ውስጡን የሚኼድ መሣጢ
english: A termite; a type of white ant that eats through wood from the inside.
A secret or a hidden mystery.
To measure or calculate.
A winnowing fan or a tool for cleaning grain.
A foundation or base of a structure.
A pleasant scent or good-smelling perfume.
A wave or a surge of water.

amharic: የሠረገላ መንገድ የሰራዊት ሰፈር ክቢከባቢ መካበቢያ፡፡
english: A chariot path, a camp, or a surrounding barrier.
A dining table or a feast.

amharic: መምከር ማስተማር አብዝቶ ማላልሶ ምክር መስጠት
english: The act of counseling, teaching, or giving good advice.
A counselor, teacher, or advisor.
To be taught, counseled, or to listen to advice.
Someone who is well-taught or has received good advice.
The process of giving or receiving counsel/advice.
To consult one another or take counsel together.

amharic: ምክር ተግሣጽ ስብከት ትምርት መንፈሳዊነት ጨዎት፡፡
english: Spiritual teaching, admonition, or sound advice.

amharic: በቁሙ የብረት ወገን የሚጠበስና የሚቀልጥ የሚቀጥቀጥ
english: Metal or mineral resources that can be melted and shaped.
Metals or minerals (plural).

amharic: ረጠበ ራሰ ለዘበ ለሰለሰ ላመ ጣመ፡፡
english: To become moist, soft, smooth, or delicious.

amharic: አረጠበ አራሰ አለሰለሰ፡፡ አገባ ከተተ ስፍራ አሲያዘ፡፡
english: To moisten, soften, or to put and place something in a specific spot.

amharic: አንዠት ሆድ የሆድ ዕቃ የመብል መሣሪያ ካንዠት ጋራ ዐብሮ ተያይዞና ተገንዞ ያለው ንዋየ ውስጥ፡፡
english: The internal organs, stomach, or digestive tract.

amharic: ቤት ቦታ የበት ማእዝን ግራና ቀኝ ጐን ጥግ አጠገብ ስብሳብ፡፡
english: A dwelling place, corner, side, or a meeting space.
The north direction, or the side to the left when facing south.

amharic: መሽተት መልካም ሽታ መስጠት ላፍንቻ መጣፍጥ ጥሩ ሽቱ መኾን፡፡
english: To smell good, to have a pleasant fragrance or aroma.

amharic: የሚሸት ሽታች ምዑዝ ባሕርይ ዕዙዝ መዐዛ፡፡
english: Fragrant, having a pleasant scent or aromatic nature.

amharic: አማዘ አሸተተ ሽቱ ቀባ ረጨ ረበረበ ቀመመ አጣፈጠ፡፡
english: To perfume, to spray fragrance, or to season food to make it smell and taste good.

amharic: ተሸተተ ተጣፈጠ ተቀመመ ተነጠረ ሽቱው፡፡ ሽቱ ተቀባ ዘገበ ተረጨ ተረበረበ ስውዮው ወይም ልብሱ፡፡
english: To be perfumed, to be filled with a pleasant scent, or to be anointed with fragrance.

amharic: የሸተተ የተሸተተ የጣፈጠ የተጣፈጠ፡፡ ሽቱ የተቀባ ቅቡዕ፡፡
english: Fragrant, aromatic, or someone who has been perfumed.

amharic: በቁሙ ሽታ ሽቱ ሽቶ፡፡ ጥዕመ መዐዛየ ከመ ቀናንሞ፡፡
english: Scent, smell, or fragrance.
A ray of light.
To become angry, stern, or cruel.
A cooking pot or vessel.
The middle, center, or in between.
To rebel, to betray, or to be disloyal.
A rebel, a traitor, or one who is disloyal.
To incite rebellion or to cause someone to be a traitor.
Daytime or the duration of a day.
Deep, a pit, or an abyss.
Mud, sludge, or clay.
A type of wide cooking dish or bowl.
A snare, noose, or something used to trap or bind.
A fortune teller or a soothsayer.

amharic: መቈጣት መበሳጨት ማዘን መናደድ ከልብ ካንዠት፡፡
english: Anger, frustration, or deep sorrow and irritation from the heart.
Angry, irritable, short-tempered, or combative.

amharic: ብቁሙ መቈጣት መበሳጨት፡፡ ማት ቍጣ ተግሣጽ ብስጭት ንደት ጩኸት፡፡
english: Wrath, anger, frustration, or sharp rebuke.

amharic: አስቈጣ አበሳጨ አሳዘነ አናደደ አስጮኽ አስወገሸ፡፡
english: To provoke, to make someone angry, or to irritate.
To fight, to argue, or to be mutually angry.
Anger, irritability, or the state of being quick-tempered.
To cause a fight, to set against one another, or to provoke conflict.

amharic: ፈጥኖ ማለፍ መር ቸር ማለት ፩ ጊዜ ብቻ ለማለፍና ለመሻገር፡፡
english: Once, passing through, or happening at one specific time.

amharic: ፩ ጊዜ ፊት መዠመሪያ ጥቂት ጊዜ ደቂቃ ቅጽበት ቶሎ አኹን ድንገት ወዲያው፡፡
english: Once, at first, a moment, suddenly, or immediately.

amharic: በቁሙ ማር የሚጣፍጥ እጅ የሚያስመጥጥ የንህብ ሥራ
english: Honey, the sweet substance made by bees.

amharic: የ(ቅባ)ማጓ ማር በዱር በገደል በዛፍ ላይ የሚገኝ
english: Wild honey found in forests or caves.

amharic: የንጀራ መዓር አንጀራነት ያለው ወይም ግራ መዓር የማር እንጀራ፡፡
english: Honeycomb, the structure containing honey.

amharic: ሙጫ የዶሮ ማር ወይም አዶሮማል ከንጨት የሚገኝ፡፡
english: Tree resin or sap often compared to honey.
Ground honey or honey produced by bees in the earth.

amharic: መዓራዊ የሚጣፍጥ ጣፋጭ ጥፍጥ ማር ማር የሚል የማር ወገን፡፡
english: Honey-like, sweet, or tasting of honey.

amharic: ማርነት ጥፍጥነት ማር ማር ማለት መጣፈጥ፡፡
english: Sweetness or the quality of being like honey.

amharic: አጣፈጠ አጠፋፈጠ ማር አደረገ ማር አላሰ በማር ለወሰ፡፡
english: To sweeten, to mix with honey, or to flavor.
A leather pouch or skin container.
Alone, solitary, or a loner.
Wrath or anger.
A sign, seal, or mark.

amharic: ሊሉያን ፍለጣን፡፡ በባህል በትምርት ከፈሪሳውያን ተለይተው ለብቻቸው ማኅበር ያቆሙ ከስምንቱ ክፍል ቤተ አይሁድ አንዱ፡፡
english: The Zealots, a specific sect in ancient Jewish society.
Angry, wicked, or short-tempered.
One who has come, an arrival, or someone present.
Arrival, coming, or advent.
Relating to arrival, or (colloquially) a glutton.
To bring, cause to come, or obtain.
One who brings, produces, or provides.
A place of arrival or origin.
To be stretched, pulled, or dragged along.
To cause to stretch, pull, or to act as an intermediary.
A sound or a shout.
Charity or a gift given to those in need.
A mirror or a reflection.
To wither or fade.
To suck, sip, or draw in with the lips.
To chew, gnaw, or bite food.
To carry or bear a burden.
A beautiful flower.
A person who is stooped or bent (hunchbacked).
To bloom or produce flowers.
Intestines, stomach, or internal organs.
A rebel, traitor, or unfaithful person.
A wooden plow beam or yoke.

amharic: ሜእም ፌቲ ሞኝ የዋህ ሕጹጸ አእምሮ ስሑት ፊታዊ፡፡
english: Simple-minded, foolish, or naive.
Arrival, coming, or becoming.
Future, or something that is coming.

amharic: የክፍለ ዓመት ስም ያመት ርቦ ወይም ሩብ ጸአ፺፩ ቀን
english: Autumn or the harvest season (a specific three-month period).

amharic: መጠጠ ሖመጠጠ መጣጣ ኾነ ያበባው ፍሬ ቃሪያው፡፡
english: To become sour, tart, or tangy, like certain fruits or peppers.

amharic: መጣጣ ሖምጣጣ ቃሪያ እንጭጭ ጨርቋ ወይም የቦካ የበሰለ ብስል፡፡
english: Sour, acidic, or tart, like unripe or fermented food.
Sarcasm, wit, or a sharp, biting style of speech.

amharic: ያውሬ ስም አንድ ዐይነት አውሬ እንደ ተኵላና እንደ ነበር ያለ ነጣቂ ጠጕረ ልም ቈርበተ መልካም፡፡
english: A wild animal, possibly like a wolf, known for its fine fur and skin.
To warm up or become hot.
A metal tool or specific iron instrument.
To joke, mock, or play in a silly way.
To melt or render fat.

amharic: የሚያቅፉ የሚክቡ ዙሪያዎች፡፡ ዘሩ ሐቀፈ ነው (፫ነገ ፯ ፳፬)፡፡
english: Things that surround or enclose something; perimeters.

amharic: ማቀቀ ማቅ ለበሰ ባለመከራ ኾነ ቀለጠ ሟሟ አነሰ ኰሰሰ አረጀ ተበላሸ፡፡ ጣጣ  አንጣጣ የጕረሮ፡፡ ወመቀቆ ጕርዔሁ (ታም ማር የካ፲፮)፡፡
english: To melt, wear down, wither, grow old, or suffer; specifically, a throat rasp or irritation.

amharic: ዐጀለ ነከረ ዘፈዘፈ አጣፈጠ በጨው በመጣጣ የዓሣ የዘይት የቃሪያ የልፍት የመሰለው ኹሉ፡፡
english: To season, soak, or flavor food with salt, oil, or spices.
To be seasoned, soaked, or flavored.

amharic: የታጀለ የተነከረ የተዘፈዘፈ፡፡ ምቁር ኤልያስ (ምቁር ኤልያስ) የተጣፈ ዘይቶን የወይራ ፍሬ (ሥር ጳኵ)፡፡
english: Something that has been soaked, seasoned, or pickled.

amharic: መቍረጥ መለየት ማጥፋት፡፡ መቀስ ማለት ከዚህ ወጥቷል፡፡ (ተረት) ቀስ በመቀስ፡፡ ይሜቍሶ እግዚ እምሀብሩ እንተ አሰፈወ ለኄራን ሥዩማን ቤተ ክር (ቀሌ፡፡ መቃ ገ፭)፡፡
english: The act of cutting, separating, or destroying.

amharic: የሚቈርጥ የሚለይ አጥፊ ዐባይ ዋሾ ቀጣፊ፡፡
english: Something or someone that cuts, separates, destroys, or deceives.

amharic: ተቀጠረ ተለየ ተከለከለ ዐጣ ተቸገረ፡፡ ኵሎ ዘሰአላ አዕይንትየ ኢተመቈስኩ፡፡ ስእለተ ዚኣነ አብአ ኅበ አቡሁ ምእመን ወኢይትሜቈስ (መክ፪ ፲፡፡ ተረ ቈር፲፰)፡፡
english: To be cut off, separated, forbidden, or to suffer lack.

amharic: እግዚእ ጌታ፡፡ ለግዜርም ለሰውም ይነገራል ስምነቱ ግን ያምላክ ነው፡፡ ማር ኤፍሬም ሶርያዊ ማር ያዕቆብ ዘስሩግ ቢል የኔታ (የነ ጌታ) እገሌ ጌታዬእ እገሌ እንደ ማለት ነው (ሃይ አበ)፡፡ ማርታም ማለት እንደዚሁ እግዝእት እመቤት ማለት ነው፡፡
english: Lord, master, or a title of respect for holy or honorable people.

amharic: እግዚአነ ጌታችን፡፡ በምራን ዘይቤእ ሲፈቱት ግን የሚማርን ማራኝ የሚያስር የሚቈራኝ ኹሉን የሚዳኝ ሰው አይፈሬ መልአክ አያፍሬ የፍርድ ገበሬ ያሰኛል፡፡ (ማቴ፲፫ ፬ ፴፪-፵፪)፡፡
english: Our Lord.

amharic: የሐዲስ መላሽ (፩ቆሮ ፲፯ ፳፪)፡፡ እስከ ምጽአቱ ለእግዚነ ያለውን የቄርሎስ መላሽ እንደ ጽርኡና እንዳረቡ ሐዲስ ማራን አታ በማለት ፈንታ ፩ ቃል አድርጎ መራናታ ይላል፡፡ ባለሐዲሶች ግን ባለሊቃውንትም ሳይቀሩ የቄርሎስ ቃል መስሏቸው ለርሱ ሰጥተው ይፈታል ፍችውንም መቅረዟ መብራቷ ይሉታል፡፡ ባለቅኔዎችም መረነ አበራ ብለው ይገሱታል የኹሉም ስሕተት ነው ያማርኛውን ሐዲስና መናረትን እይ ነዊር ኖረ (ዕብ፱ ፪)፡፡
english: A phrase meaning 'Our Lord has come' or 'Our Lord is coming'.
A desert, a net, or a trap.

amharic: መምረግ መለጠፍ መለሰን መዝጋት መድፈን መቅባት መለቅለቅ የጭቃ የበት የኖራ የሺሜንት፡፡ ይመርግዎ ለውእቱ ቤት ወእምድኅረ መረግዎ፡፡ ጽቡር በዘይመርጉ ቦቱ፡፡ ወትመርጎ መሬተ ጸዐዳ (ዘሌ፲፬ ፳፪ ፳፫፡፡ ኩፋ ፲፡፡ ዘዳ፳፫ ፪ ፬)፡፡
english: The act of plastering, coating, or sealing with mud, lime, or cement.
To cause to be plastered or coated.
To be plastered or coated.

amharic: የተመረገ ምርግ ልስን ልቅልቅ፡፡ ቤት ምሩግ፡፡ ይረክቦ ምሩገ (ምሳ፳፩ ፱፡፡ ማቴ፲፪ ፵፬)፡፡
english: Plastered or coated work.

amharic: ምርግ ምርጊት ልስናት ልቅልቃት፡፡ ከመ ምረገ አረፍት፡፡ አይቴመ ምረግ ዘመረግሙ፡፡ ምረገ ኆጻ ውስተ አረፍት (ኢዮ፴፫ ፳፬፡፡ ሕዝ፲፫ ፲፪፡፡ ሢራ፳፪ ፲፯፡፡ ዳን፭ ፭)፡፡
english: Plaster, mortar, or a coating.

amharic: መረገገ ጐመዘዘ መርጋጋ ኾነ አፍ ያዘ እንደ ጭቃ (ዐማርኛ)፡፡
english: To become thick, sticky, or muddy like clay.
A type of gemstone.

amharic: ዕንቍ የዕንቍ ስም ሕብሩ ሐመልሚል ወይም የባሕር ውሃ የሚመስል የሚበርቅ የሚያብረቀርቅ በዐረቡ ዘበርጀድና ዙሙሩድ ልዩዎች ናቸው ዘበርጀድ ተርሴስና ክርስቲሎቤ ክርሴምቶን ካለው ይስማማል፡፡ እብን ዘሕብረ መረግድ፡፡ ይመስል ሕብሩ ከመ መረግድ፡፡ ወንሣእ ክልኤ እብነ መረግድ (አስቴ፩ ፮፡፡ ራእ፬ ፫፡፡ ዘፀ፳፰ ፱ ፲፯)፡፡ ወገብሩ ኵሎ እብነ ዘመረግድ፡፡ ወራውሬ ወዘመረድ፡፡ ወራብዕት በዘመድረግ (ዘፀ፴፮ ፲፫ ፲፯፡፡ ራእ፳፩ ፲፱)፡፡
english: An emerald or a sparkling sea-green gemstone.
A walking stick or staff.
The act of steadying or settling.

amharic: መሞረድ፡፡ መሸፈት ማመጥ መውረር መዝረፍ ማሸበር፡፡ መረደ ሀገሮሙ ለሳምራውያን ወአንኅለ መቅደሶሙ (ዮሴፍ)፡፡
english: Rebellion, attacking, raiding, or terrorizing.

amharic: የመረደ መራጅ ሽፍታ ወራሪ ጠብጣቢ ገሥጋሽ ሰራዊት ጭፍራ የጦር ሕዝብ ዘማች፡፡ ፈኖከ መራደ ትንንያ ይቅድሙ ተዓይኒከ፡፡ በእንቲኣክሙ እፌኑ ባቢሎን መራደ፡፡ ወሰአሎ ለፍምፍምዮስ ከመ ይፈኑ ሎቱ መራደ መርድአ ላዕለ እኁሁ (ጥበ፲፪ ፰፡፡ ኢሳ፵፫ ፲፬፡፡ ዮሴፍ)፡፡ ሀጕል ቀትል መዐት ስደት በማለት ፈንታ መራድ ይላል የመላሽ ስሕተት ነው፡፡ መራደ ረሲዓን፡፡ እለ ይትቃተሉ ውስተ መራድ፡፡ ወዐቀበ መራደ፡፡ አንሥኡ መራደ (ምሳ፫ ፳፭፡፡ ዮኤ፪ ፭፡፡ ዓሞ፩ ፲፩፡፡ ግብ፲፫ ፶)፡፡
english: A raider, rebel, warrior, or member of an attacking army.

amharic: የሚሞርድ ሞራጅ ሰው ወይም ሞረድ መራጃ ታላቅ መዶሻ፡፡ የዕቡይ ሞረድ እንዲሉ፡፡ በረደንና በርደደን እየይ፡፡ መና በ ይዋረሳሉ ዝናም ብ፡፡
english: A tool used for sharpening, or a large hammer.
To be attacked or raided.
Someone or something that has been attacked or raided.

amharic: የከበሬታ ስም ከራሶች በላይ ከንጉሦች በታች መካከለኛ የሺዋ ባላልጋ ወይም ዐልጋ ወራሽ የነጋሢ ዘር የሚጠራበት፡፡ መርድ አምኃየስ መርድ ኅይሌ እንዲሉ፡፡
english: A noble title for a prince or heir to the throne.
To be brave, bold, harsh, or quick to act.

amharic: ደፋር ጨካኝ ትጉ ፈጣን ሥራዉን መንገዱን የማያቆም የማያቋርጥ (ሄርማ ገ፯ና ፲)፡፡
english: Brave, harsh, diligent, or persistent.

amharic: መምራት ፊት ለፊት መኼድ መሳብ መውሰድ የመንገድ የትምርት የዜማ የጸሎት፡፡ መረየን እይ የዚህ መንቲያ ነው፡፡ መሪሐ ይመርሖሙ፡፡ መልአክ ዘይመርሐኒ፡፡ እለ ይመርሑ ወእለ ይተልዉ፡፡ ዘመርሐኒ ውስተ ብሔረ በድው (፬ነገ ፱ ፳፡፡ ዕር ኢሳ፯ ፲፮፡፡ ማር፲፩ ፱፡፡ ኤር፪ ፮)፡፡
english: The act of leading, guiding, or showing the way.

amharic: የሚመራ መሪ መምር አብነት፡፡ አንተ መርሖሙ ለዕውራን፡፡ ኤጲስቆጶስ ውእቱ መርሖሙ ለሕዝብ፡፡ አንትሙሂ መርሐ ኰንዎሙ፡፡ እስመ ውእቱ መርሕ ውስተ ጥበብ (ሮሜ፪ ፲፱፡፡ ዲድ ፬፡፡ ኪዳ፡፡ ጥበ፯ ፲፭)፡፡
english: A leader, guide, or example.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ መሪ አስተማሪ፡፡ መራሔ ሕይወት፡፡ መራሔ ኵሎ እኩይ፡፡ ዛቲ መጽሐፍ መራሒተ፡፡ ልቡና ይእቲ መራሕያነ ዕዉራን (ቅዳ ሕር፡፡ ማቴ፲፭ ፲፬፡፡ ፳፫ ፲፮ ፳፬)፡፡
english: A guide, teacher, or leader.

amharic: የርባታ መደቦች ዐሥሩ ሰራዊት አነ እንተ ቲ ውእቱ ይእቲ አንትሙ ን ውእቶሙ ን፡፡ ቀተልኩ ከ ኪ ለ ለት ቀተልነ ክሙ ን ሉ ላ፡፡ አውእቱንና የሁን አፈታት እይ፡፡
english: Plural form referring to guides or leaders.
To lead, guide, or provide a guide.

amharic: ተመራ ተከተለ፡፡ ተመራሕነ ውስተ ዛቲ ጸጋሁ፡፡ ተመሪሐነኬ ውስተ ጽድቅ፡፡ ከመ ንትመራሕ በትእዛዙ፡፡ ይደልወነ ንትመራሕ በምግባራቲሆሙ ወንትመስል ቦሙ (ሮሜ፭ ፪፡፡ ቄር፡፡ ፊልክ፡፡ ዮሴፍ)፡፡
english: To be led, to follow, or to be guided.
A student, a follower, or someone who is led.

amharic: መምራት መመራት መሪነት ተመሪነት የፀሓይ ምራት መሪት፡፡ ዘወሀቦ ጥበበ ምርሐት (ፊልክ ፻፱)፡፡
english: Guidance, leadership, or the state of being a guide.

amharic: ኮከብ የኮከብ ስም የፀሓይ ብርሃን ከሚነሡ ከስምንቱ ፀበይት ከዋክብት አንዱ፡፡
english: A star, or the name of a specific star.

amharic: ላሰ ሰነገለ ነጨ ነቀለ፡፡ በቁሙ ለየ ሾመ አከበረ፡፡ (ተረት) ከንጨት መርጦ ለታቦት ከሰው መርጦ ለሹመት፡፡ ሙርጥ ማለት ከዚህ ወጥቷል፡፡
english: To choose, select, appoint, or honor.

amharic: ኦሪት ሕግ ጽላት ስምዕ፡፡ ታቦት ዘመርጡር ል (ዘፀ፳፭ ፳፪፡፡ ፳፪፡፡ ፳፮ ፴፫)፡፡ መካነ መርጡል፡፡ በቅድመ መርጡል (፪ዜና ፳፬ ፯፡፡ ዘፀ፲፮ ፴፬)፡፡
english: Law, the Commandments, or a covenant.
To witness or to become a martyr.

amharic: ዕድሜ የበዓልና የቀጠሮ ቀን የጉባኤል ቦታ ዐውደ ስምዕ ሕዝብ ለጸሎትና ለመሧዕት ወይም ለክርክርና ለሙግት ለዘገን ለጨዎታ ለምስክርነት የሚሰበሰብበት፡፡ ደብተራ ዘመርጡል (ዘፀ፳፱ ፬ ፲፡፡ ፴ ፲፰፡፡ ፳፮ ፴፮)፡፡ በዕብራይስጡ ዔዱትና ሞዔድ ልዩ ሲኾን ጽርኡ አንድ አድርጎታል፡፡ ባለቅኔዎችም መርጡልን ተራዳ ያለውን ዘዘመን ዘብዑድ ዘስምዕ ይሉታል፡፡ አዳራሽ ከተባለ ክንድ መቅደስ ቤተ ክር በማለት ፈንታ መርጡል ይላል (ስንክ ጥቅ፮ና፳፭)፡፡ እምኔታት በውስተ አሐቲ መርጡል (ስንክ፡፡ ጥር፩ና፲፪፡፡ ገድ ተክ)፡፡ መርጡለ ማርያም ሥዕርተ ርእሰ በመልዕልተ ድማኅ ዘበቈለት (ቅኔ)፡፡
english: A place of gathering, a meeting place, or an appointed time for assembly.
Relating to the law or a covenant.

amharic: ለወጠ ቀየረ አስተላለፈ አሠረገ የብተት የቀን የጊዜ የዘመን፡፡ መጽሐፍ ግን በመረየ ፈንታ አሜረየ አምረየ ይላል አሳያሰኝም፡፡ ዛቲ ዕለት አሜረየት እንዘ ታመሪ (መጽ ምስ ገ፪፻፰፭)፡፡ ሥሩና ምንጩ መሪሕ ነው፡፡
english: To change, transfer, or move between times or seasons.

amharic: ሠግር የሱባዔ ቍጥር ዐውደ ዕለት ፯ ቀን ብቻ ስለ ኾነ የአውራኅንና ያመታትን ብተትና በዓል ከቀን ወደ ቀን የሚያሻግር የሚያዘዋውር፡፡ ዕለት ምርያ ዘያጠውዮን ለመዋዕለ ዓመታት ወያዐውዶን እምዘ ውስተ ዝ (መጽ ምስ)፡፡ ከፅንስ እስከ ልደት ያለውም የጌታችን መዋዕለ ፅንስ ፱ ወር ካ፭ ቀን ዮምወለድኩከ የተባለበት ለብሉዩና ለሐዲሱ ዘመን ሠግር ስለ ኾነ እንደዚሁ ምርያ ይባላል ዕለት ኅሪት ዕለተ መድኅኒት ማለት ነው (ኢሣ፵፱ ፩ ፭ ፮ ፰)፡፡
english: A marker of time or a bridge between seasons and holy days.

amharic: ሟረተ አሟረተ ጠነቈለ ወር አጓደለ በፊደል ቍጥር በግድፈት፡፡ መጽሐፍ ግን በማረየ ፈንታ ተምርየ ተማረየ ተማረተ ይላል ኹሉም ስሕተት ነው አያሰኝም፡፡ ለተምርዮ ወለተሰግል ወዘይትሜረይ፡፡ ዘይትማረይ፡፡ ዘይትማረይ ወዘያበውኦሙ ውስተ  ቤቱ ለማርያም፡፡ ኵሉ ተማርዮ እምኅይለ አጋንንት ብእሲት ተነብዮ እምኅይለ መንፈስ ቅዱስ፡፡ ብእሲት  ዘትትማረት አው ለካልእታ ትብል ትትማረት በእንተ ፍቅረ ምታ አው በእንተ ፍቅረ ካልእ (ኩፋ ፲፩፡፡ ቀሌ፡፡ ፍ ነ ፲፩፡፡ መጽ ምስ፡፡ ሲኖዶ)፡፡
english: To practice fortune-telling, divination, or magic.

amharic: የሚያሟርት የሚጠነቍል ማርተኛ ጠንቋይ ነቢየ ሐሰት ካህነ ጣዖት፡፡ ጲጥፋራ ማሪ ዘሀገረ ሔልዩ፡፡ ዮቶር ማሬ ምድያም፡፡ ወአምጽኡ ማሬ ዘድዮስ (ዘፍ፵፩ ፵፭፡፡ ዘፀ፪ ፲፮፡፡ ግብ፲፬ ፲፫)፡፡ እመ ቦ፡ ዘሐተተ ማሪተ፡፡ ማርያም ወሰብአ ሰገል፡፡ ውእቱ ይገብር ግብረ ሥራይ ወዘማርያት (ቀሌ፡፡ ዳን፮ ፭፡፡ ፪ዜና ፴፫ ፮)፡፡ በማረይት ፈንታ ማሪታት ይላል አያሰኝም ማረይት ቅጽልነቱ መድበል ስለ ኾነ ብዙዎቹን ወንዶችና ሴቶች ያስተባብራል ማሪታት ግብ ለሴቶች ብቻ ነው፡፡ ሐሳውያን ማሪታት (ቈር ገ፩)፡፡
english: A fortune-teller, a false prophet, or a practitioner of divination.

amharic: አስጠነቈለ አስሟረተ ማርተኛ ጠየቀ፣ አናገረ አሰለፈለፈ ሟርተኛ አደረገ
english: To practice fortune-telling, to gossip or speak endlessly, and to act as a sorcerer.
To be the subject of fortune-telling or sorcery.
Bitter, referring to a time of suffering or sorrow.
A small basket, pouch, or container used for storage.
White marble or polished stone.

amharic: የከርቤ ሽቱ ወይም ሌላ ያልተቀደሰ ምንም የሚቀባው ሥሩና ምንጩ መሪር መረ ነው
english: Holy oil or fragrant ointment used for anointing.
The Lord is coming or our Lord has arrived.
The act of ending, lasting, or remaining.
To touch, feel, or stroke gently.
Strong desire, passion, or improper behavior.
A person who is reckless, lustful, or immoral.

amharic: መጐምዠት መዳራት መቃበጥ መቈናጠጥ በውስጥ በአፍኣ መታወክ መቅበጥበጥ
english: The state of being restless, rebellious, or immoral.

amharic: ሴሰን ድራት እንስሳዊ ጭዎት ልፊያ ቍልመማ የዝሙት ዋዜማ
english: Immoral conduct or reckless, wild behavior.
A wedding or a bridegroom.
Spit or saliva.

amharic: ሥሥ ረቂቅ ዝርግ ጠፍጣፋ ልብስን ዕንጨትን ለማስጌጥና ለመለበጥ እንደ ቅጠል ኹኖ የተሠራ
english: A thin, flat metal foil or decorative leaf used for plating.

amharic: መምረር መጐፍነን ከጣፍጣና ከሖምጣጣ ልዩ ክፉ መኾን የጣዕም የጠባይ
english: To become bitter in taste or harsh in character.

amharic: በቁሙ መራራ ክፉ ቍጡ ብስጩ ዐመፀኛ
english: Bitter, angry, or rebellious.
Someone who is sad, hurt, or bitter.

amharic: በቁሙ መምረር ማዘን አመረር መራርነት ክፋት
english: Bitterness, sadness, or sorrow.

amharic: በቁሙ ምረት መራርነት ሐዘን መከራ ቍጣ
english: Grief, suffering, or deep anger.
To make something bitter or to cause sorrow.
A place name meaning a location with bitter water.

amharic: መራራ የደጋ ዕንጨት ወይም ቀላዎ ውስጠ ክፍት
english: A bitter high-altitude tree with a hollow trunk.
A harbor or a landing place.

amharic: መንከር መዘፍዘፍ ማጀል በጨው በውሃ በቅጠል ለማራስ ለማበስበስ
english: To soak, dampen, or soften in water.
To be soaked, soggy, or spoiled by dampness.
To grope, feel around, or touch carefully.
The act of touching or feeling around.
A fragrant myrtle plant.
A fortune-teller.

amharic: መምረት ከገለባና ከአበቅ መለየት እንዳፈር መቈለል
english: The process of winnowing or piling up grain.
To produce a harvest or to cause to yield.

amharic: በቁሙ የመረተ የተመረተ ባውድማ መካከል የተሾመ የተሸለመ ቍልል ጥሩ እኽል
english: Harvest, produce, or a pile of clean grain.

amharic: በቁሙ ዐፈር ትቢያ ዐመድ እንደ ምርት የሚዛቅ የሚታፈሥ የብስ
english: Earth, soil, or dust.

amharic: በቁሙ ምድራዊ ግዙ ካፈር ከመሬት የተገኘ ሟች ፈራሽ በስባሽ
english: Earthly, made of clay, or mortal.
A woven basket or food container.
A crossing, a path, or a bridge.
The middle or central part.

amharic: ማቅለጥ ማፍሰስ ውሃ ማድረግ ማጥፋት ማፍረስ የረጋውን
english: To melt, dissolve, or break down.
Something that melts or destroys.

amharic: ቀለጠ ሟሟ ዘለ ደከመ ጠፋ ፈሰሰ
english: To melt, dissolve, or become weak.
Melted, dissolved, or exhausted.
Weakness, exhaustion, or laziness.

amharic: መቅባት ቅባት መጨመር በቅባት ማሸት ማጣፈጥ
english: To anoint, oil, or apply ointment.
One who anoints.
