amharic: በቁሙ የሠለጠነ ሥልጡን ሠልጣና ሥልጣኔ ያለው ሥልጣን የተሰጠው፡፡
english: A person who is authorized, powerful, or possesses authority.
To appoint someone, grant authority, or bestow power.
A trainer, instructor, or mentor.
To provide training or instruction extensively.

amharic: በቁሙ መሠልጠን ማሠልጠን አሠለጣጠን ሥልጥንና ሥልጡነት ጠፍተኛነት በሥራ በነገር፡፡
english: Civilization, mastery of skills, or the process of training and expertise.
Power, authority, legal right, or a position of leadership.

amharic: ንጉሣዊ የንጉሥ የጳጳስ ወገን ሥልጣን ያለው ባለሙሉ ሥልጣን፡፡ የሹመት ሥራ ዳኝነት፡፡
english: Official, regal, or pertaining to someone with formal authority and power.
To finish, complete, or finalize a task.
A fragrant substance or perfume.
To glide, slip, or move smoothly.
To greet or offer peace to someone.
To triple something or make it three.
To march, line up, or form a procession.
The act of crushing or grinding something into a fine paste.

amharic: ዘበተ አፌዘ አላገጠ በነገር መታ ሠለቀ ተሣለቀ፡፡
english: To mock, tease, or make fun of someone.
To cause someone to be mocked or to strip something bare.
To be mocked, teased, or ridiculed.

amharic: በቁሙ ተሠላለቀ ተዘባበተ ተጫወተ ርስ በርሱ፡፡
english: To engage in mutual mocking, joking, or teasing.
To provoke teasing or encourage mocking behavior.
A joker, mocker, or someone who teases others.

amharic: በቁሙ ሣቅ ጨዎታ ለግጥ ቧልት ዋዛ ፈዛዛ ዘበት ዘበታ ወዘበሬታ፡፡
english: Laughter, joking, mockery, or trivial conversation.

amharic: ስመ ሀገር በግዳድ የምትባል የባቢሎን ክፍል፡፡
english: The name of a place, a region in Babylon.

amharic: መሠለስ ሦስት ማድረግ ከሦስት መክፈል ሦስት ማለት፡፡
english: Tripling, dividing into three, or the act of making something three-fold.
One who triples something or makes it three.

amharic: በቁሙ አሠገረ ሦስት አስደረገ ሦስት አገኘ፡፡
english: To cause something to become three or to organize in threes.
Something or someone that performs a tripling action.

amharic: ተሦስተ ሦስት ኾነ ፫ ተባለ ፫ኛ ኾነ፡፡
english: To become three, be tripled, or take the third position.

amharic: በቁሙ የተሠለስ ሦስት የኾነ ሦስቲዮ ሥሉሴ፡፡
english: Triple, threefold, or pertaining to the number three.
Trinity, threeness, or the state of being three.

amharic: ሦስትነት ሦስቲዮ ጕንጕን ሽርብ ሦስት እጅ፡፡
english: A trinity, a three-fold cord, or something tripled.

amharic: የደርብ ደርብ ፫ኛ ክፍል ሰገነት መልዕልተ መልዕልት፡፡
english: A third level, a loft, or an upper floor.

amharic: የቍጥር ስም ሦስት በኹለትና ባራት መካከል ያለ ቍጥር ፫ ጊዜ አንድ፡፡
english: The number thirty.
Three; the third one.

amharic: የዜማ ቃል ትምርት ሦስተኛ ክፍል ከውዳሴ ማርያም፡፡
english: A musical term for the third section of a hymn.

amharic: የዕለት ስምና ቅጽል ማግሰኞ ማግስተ ሰኞ የሰኞ ማግስት የእሑድ ሣልስት በሰኞና በረቡ መካከል ያለው ዕለት፡፡
english: Tuesday, the third day of the week.
Third.
Thirdly; one-third.

amharic: የቍጥር መደብ የኬክሮስ ፫ኛ አንዱ ሣልሲት ፷ ራብዒት ይኾናል፡፡
english: A unit of measure, specifically a third-degree division.

amharic: ሦስት ጊዜ ሦስት እጅ ሦስት ክፍል ሦስት ብቻ፡፡
english: Three times; threefold; a triple portion.
A term referring to groups of three, such as three parts, three hands, or three specific times.

amharic: መሠለሻ ሦስት ማድረጊያ ከሦስት መክፈያ ወይም ሦስቱን እጅ አንድ የሚያደርግ ሚዛን መስፈርት የሥልስ ወጭት።
english: A tool or standard unit used for measuring or dividing something into three equal parts.

amharic: ሦስት ወገን ሦስት ክፍል ታላቅ ሠረገላ ሦስት ፈረሶች የሚስቡት።
english: A large chariot pulled by three horses or an object divided into three distinct sections or sides.

amharic: ሣልሳት ሣልሳውያት ሦስተኞች ሦስተኛ ክፍሎች ደርቦች ተሥላሶች።
english: Relating to things that are third in order, or items divided into three layers or parts.

amharic: በቁሙ የአኃዝና የቍጥር ስም (ለ-፴) ፫ ጊዜ ዐሥር ወይም ፲ ጊዜ ሦስት።
english: The number thirty, which is three times ten.

amharic: ኅያላን ያርብሓን አለቆች የጦር ሰዎች ሦስተኛ ማዕርግ ያላቸው ወይም ኅይላቸው ሦስቲዮ የኾነ የተጐነጐነ።
english: High-ranking military leaders or warriors who hold the third position in rank.
The number sixty, which is two times thirty or three times twenty.
The act of mocking or teasing.
To lean against or move closer to someone or something.
To make something into eight parts or to count up to eight.
To hear or to provide testimony as a witness.

amharic: ሠም ጧፍ የማር ሰፈፍ ንጥሩ ግግሩ ልጥልጡ ነጋሪቱ ፋናው መብራቱ።
english: Wax, a candle, or the honeycomb that provides light and fuel for lamps.
To be pleasing, to agree, or to bear good results.

amharic: መሥመር መውደቅ ቍርጥ ፈቃድ ማድረግ እሺ በጎ ይኹን ሠመርኩ ማለት ልመናን ነገርን ወደ መቀበል፡፡
english: The state of being agreeable, a firm decision, or a willing acceptance of a request.
A friendly person who agrees or is well-liked by others.

amharic: ሠመርኩ አሰኘ አሶደደ አስፈቀደ፡፡ አገለገለ ደስ አሰኘ።
english: To make someone pleased, to gain approval, or to provide good service.
A servant or helper who provides joy and brings pleasure to others.
To be prepared, to be well-liked, or to be approved of.
Something or someone that is beautiful, well-liked, or accepted.

amharic: መውደድ መወደድ አወዳደድ ውድነት እሺታ ውዴታ ወድ ቍርጥ ፈቃድ።
english: Kindness, mutual affection, or a firm decision based on goodwill.

amharic: ተዋደደ ተስማማ ተባበረ አንድ ፈቃድ ኾነ።
english: To be in agreement, to cooperate, or to unite in shared purpose.

amharic: በቁሙ ማሥመሪያ ቀጥ ያለ ዘንግ አራት ገጽ ያለው ወይም የተጋደመ ባለኹለት ገጽ።
english: A straight ruler, a guide line, or a straight path used for measuring or drawing.

amharic: መውደድ ያለው ንስር ቀይና ጥቍር ያንበጣ ፀር።
english: A specific type of bird, often seen as a guardian that protects against locusts.
To fit together, to agree, or to reconcile.

amharic: ማማር መዋብ ሐዲስ መልክ ማውጣት ጥሩ ውብ ደመ ግቡ መኾን በመልክና በጌጥ ደስ መሰኘት።
english: The act of becoming beautiful, adorned, or looking very pleasant.
To be decorated, dressed up, or prepared to look one's best.
Something that is very beautiful, well-crafted, or elegant.

amharic: መልካም ውብ ደግ በጎ ቅን ደስ የሚያሰኝ የመልክ የጠባይ።
english: Good, beautiful, kind, or pleasant in both appearance and behavior.

amharic: ማማሪያ መዋቢያ መልካም ቦታ ምቹ ስፍራ።
english: A beautiful, comfortable, or pleasant place to be.

amharic: የወር ስም ዐሥረኛ ወር በግብጽና በኢትዮጵያ ሠናየ ዘርዕ ወርኅ ዘርዕ ሠናይ ማለት ነው።
english: Sene, the tenth month of the Ethiopian calendar, associated with planting.

amharic: መልክ ውበት ደም ግባት ጌጥ ሽልማት ጥራት ጥዳት ጠፍታ።
english: Beauty, grace, decoration, or the natural quality of being lovely.

amharic: አሳመረ አሰማመረ አስጌጠ አበጀ አዘጋጀ መልካም አደረገ።
english: To make something beautiful, to decorate, or to improve the quality of something.
One who beautifies, improves, or decorates things.
The number two, or relating to the second.
To sharpen, like a blade or a point.

amharic: መሠነቅ ሥንቅ መያዝ መውሰድ ለመንገድ የሚኾንን ነገር ማከት ማሰናዳት።
english: To prepare, gather, or pack necessary supplies for a journey.

amharic: በቁሙ የመንገድ መሣሪያ ልብስ ምግብ ገንዘብ።
english: Provisions, such as food, money, or clothes, needed for a trip.
To provide someone with necessary travel supplies.
A person or thing that provides provisions for a journey.

amharic: ሥንቅ መያዣ መቋጠሪያ መክተቻ አቅማዳ ኪስ ከረጢት።
english: A bag, pocket, or pouch used for carrying travel supplies.
Multiple bags or containers used for carrying provisions.

amharic: ማሣሣት መራራቅ ዘር ዘር ማለት የቡቃያ የዘር ያታክልት የጠጕር።
english: The process of thinning out, spacing out, or scattering seeds or hair.
Someone who is greedy, gluttonous, or constantly wanting more.

amharic: መሣሣት መሠሠት ሥሥ ሥሡ መኾን ሥሥት ሥሡነት።
english: The state of being greedy or having an excessive desire for something.
Greed, selfishness, or gluttony.
To make someone greedy or to act in a gluttonous way.

amharic: ማዝራት መበተን መመሸን የምርት፡፡ ማጥፋት ማባከን የገንዘብ።
english: To scatter, to sow, or to waste resources and money.
A winnowing fan.
To ask, request, or pray.

amharic: መሣል ማስመሰል መንደፍ መበገር፡፡ መፍጠር ማስገኘት መቅረጽ፡፡
english: The act of drawing, painting, sculpting, or creating an artistic image.
An artist, painter, or creator.
To cause something to be drawn or created; to commission artwork.
An artist or one who provides a visual representation.
To be drawn, sculpted, or created.
Something drawn, carved, or created.

amharic: በቁሙ መልክ የመልክ ጥላ አምሳል ንድፍ...
english: An image, picture, drawing, or painting; a visual representation.
To be quick or to move swiftly.

amharic: መግፈፍ መቅረፍ ማብነን መበተን ለማጥራት ለመግለጥ የዐይን የብሌን፡፡
english: The act of clearing, uncovering, or revealing.
To be cleared, unveiled, or scattered.
Scraps, peeling, or fragments.
To revoke, cancel, or annul.
The act of growing, sprouting, or blooming.

amharic: የሻረ የዳነ፡፡ የበቀለ የለመለመ ለምለም ሣርማ ምቹ ቦታ፡፡
english: Something healed, revoked, or lushly green and grassy.
Hair, fur, or fine thin plant-like growth.
A comb or a tool for grooming hair.
Combs or grooming tools.

amharic: ሣር ቡቃያ የብር ያገዳ እኽል የሚታጨድ ኹሉ...
english: Grass, hay, or harvestable crops.
Grasses, plants, or green vegetation.
A plant with grass-like leaves.

amharic: ገብስ የገብስ ዐይነት ኹሉ ጠመዥ ሌላውም፡፡
english: Barley or various types of grains.
Wheat or similar cereal grains like oats.
To measure or encamp.

amharic: ሣጥን የልብስ የገንዘብ የረሳ መክተሻ ማኖሪያ...
english: A chest, box, or container for storage.
The act of splitting, dividing, or cleaving lengthwise.
To be split, cracked, or divided.
Split, divided, or cleaved.
A splinter, a chip, or a split piece.
Sackcloth, often worn as a sign of repentance.
To support, prop up, or lean against.
To give drink or to cause suffering.
The act of causing suffering, distress, or hardship to others.
Someone or something that causes suffering, pain, or distress.

amharic: መሣቀያ መውጊያ መጠቈሚያ ሹል ዕንጨት ምስማር
english: A sharp object, like a thorn, spike, or nail, used to poke or cause pain.

amharic: በቁሙ ሥቃይ ተቀበለ ተጨነቀ ባለመከራ ኾነ
english: To endure pain, suffering, or deep distress.
A person who is suffering, distressed, or experiencing deep pain.

amharic: በቁሙ ጭንቅ መከራ መቅሠፍት ግፍ ቅጣት
english: Great pain, suffering, hardship, or severe punishment.
A specific corner, region, or section of the earth.
The act of covering, clothing, or wrapping something up.

amharic: ሸክሸከ ሠራ ታታ በሳሳ የማቅ የመግለቦ የወንፊት
english: To weave, knit, or craft a mesh-like or sieve-like pattern.
To be woven into a mesh, become perforated, or have a hole-filled pattern.
Something that is perforated, riddled with holes, or has a mesh structure.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ የተበሳሳ መግለብ ዐይነ ርግብ
english: A mesh work, sieve, or perforated fabric pattern.
To stand upright or to be placed in an upright position.
An ox or a bull.
To flow, stream, or trickle like a liquid.
The act of drinking, sipping, or absorbing liquid.
A prepared drink or beverage.
A prepared drink or beverage.
A tool used for drinking or drawing liquid, such as a straw or a pipe.
A container for drinking, like a glass, cup, or goblet.
A prickly, stinging plant, shrub, or bramble.
Decoration, ornament, or adornment.

amharic: መስኖ የመስኖ ውሃ ቦዩ መትረቡ ታናሽ ወንዝ ኵሬ
english: An irrigation channel, water ditch, or small stream.
To enter or sink into something.

amharic: መሥመር ማሥመሪያ አራት ገጽ ያለው ቀጥ ያለ የተካከለ ዐጭር ዘንግ
english: A ruler or straight-edged tool used for drawing lines.

amharic: አጋደመ መሥመር ጣሰ አሠመረ በርሳስ በቀለም
english: To draw lines, rule a page, or mark a surface with a straight edge.

amharic: ጋድም የቤት የቤተ ክሲያን ዖፍ ወይም ምሶሰው ዋልታ
english: A structural beam or wooden frame used for support in building.
A charioteer or someone riding in a chariot.

amharic: መንቀል ከሥር ማፍሰስ ጨርሶ ማጥፋት መደምሰሰ
english: To pull out by the root, destroy completely, or erase.
Someone or something that pulls up, uproots, or destroys.

amharic: ጕንድ ከሥር የሚወታ ዐምድ ምሰሶ ወጋግራ
english: A support pillar, column, or main post of a building.
A root or a tendon/vein in the body.
Roots, veins, or tendons.
The beginning, origin, or source of something.
The hip tendon or sinew.
To be uprooted, removed, or destroyed.
To be planted, established, or to have taken root.

amharic: መንቀል መነቀል አነቃቀል ነቀላ ጥፋት ጕዳት መቅሠፍት፡፡
english: The act of uprooting, destruction, or a sudden calamity.

amharic: ስመ ሀገር የባሕር ወንዝ ዳር ሜዳ ረባዳ፡፡
english: A proper name for a geographical region or a plain area near the sea or river.
A wedge, typically used for splitting or securing wood.

amharic: መሠረዝ ማጠር የተጣፈበት ቃል ሥሕተት ስለ ኾነ ቀለም ማልበስ ወይም በላዩ እንደ መሥመር ማሳለፍ ማጋደም፡፡
english: The act of crossing out, deleting, or striking through a mistake in writing.

amharic: ዐጥር የስሕተት ምልክት ከማንበብና ከመነበብ የሚከለክል፡፡
english: A mark used to cross out or indicate an error in text.

amharic: ማበጀት ማሳመር ማቅናት ማስላት ማሳካት ማከናወን ማሰናበት፡፡
english: The act of preparing, perfecting, accomplishing, or completing a task.

amharic: ተበጀ ተዘጋጀ ተከናወነ ሰላ ተሳላ ተሳካ ተሰናበተ፡፡
english: To be prepared, successfully completed, or finished.
Something that is well-prepared, beautiful, orderly, or successful.
Work, labor, or the effort put into a task.

amharic: መብራት መጽደቅል መሸብረቅ መፍለቅ ማንጸባረቅ መንደድ መቃጠል ቦግ ማለት፡፡
english: The act of shining, glowing, or bursting into a bright light.
Shining, bright, or radiant.
A light, radiance, glory, or an ornament.
Radiance or brilliance, similar to fire.

amharic: መሠረይ ሥራይ ማድረግ አስማት መድገም መጠንቈል ማሟረት ምትሀት ማሳየት የክፉ፡፡
english: The act of performing witchcraft, sorcery, or using magic spells.
A sorcerer, magician, or someone who casts spells.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ መሠሪ ጠንቋይ ሟርተኛ ምትሀታም፡፡
english: A wizard, fortune-teller, or practitioner of magic.
A book of remedies, medicine, or magical charms for healers.
A medicine or charm that is ingested or applied to the body.
To spin, thread, or operate a spindle.
A spider, symbolizing a spinner or weaver.

amharic: አዋሰው ጐነጐነ አሰረ ዐዘበ የቶታን የጫማ የወጥመድ፡፡
english: To weave, braid, or bind together, such as cords or footwear.
A design, pattern, or guide used for drawing lines or weaving.
Evening or nightfall; the end of the day.

amharic: ወዘመ ዋዜማ ቆመ የሠርክ ጸሎት አቀረበ፡፡
english: To arrive at evening time or to perform evening prayers.

amharic: ማረግረግ መቅለጥ መሳብ መዋጥ ማስጠም ማስመጥ የመሬት የውሃ፡፡
english: The act of sinking, drowning, or being absorbed into mire or water.

amharic: ረግረግ ማጥ የሚያጠልቅ የሚያስምጥ ያዛባ የጭቃ ጕድጓድ ዐዘቅት፡፡
english: A swamp, quagmire, or a deep pit of mud that causes one to sink.
Swamps, marshes, or deep places.
To be swallowed, to sink, or to fall into a swamp.

amharic: መሥራት ማድረግ ማበጀት ማዘጋጀት መምረጥ ማቅረብ መዘርጋት መሰደር መደርደር፡፡
english: The act of organizing, arranging, preparing, or setting in order.
An organizer, one who sets rules, or an arranger.

amharic: ተሠራ ተበጀ ተዘጋጀ ተሰናዳ ተጣፈ ተወሰነ ታገገ ተደነገገ፡፡
english: To be organized, established, or decreed by law.

amharic: የተሠራ የተበጀ የቀረበ የተጣፈ የተወሰነ የቆመ የተተከለ፡፡
english: Something organized, arranged, established, or orderly.

amharic: መሥራት መሠራት አሠራር ሥራት ደንብ አገባብ ሕግ ትእዛዝ ዐዋጅ ፍርድ፡፡
english: System, law, order, custom, or established procedure.
A ship's sail, a curtain, or a covering.

amharic: መፍላት መውጣት መብቀል ሥር መስደድ መለምለም ማፈጥፈጥ የተሐዋስያን የአዝርዕት የአትክልት፡፡
english: To sprout, grow, emerge, or spring up like plants or seeds.
The act of emerging, originating, or proceeding from a source.
Something that emerges, proceeds, or comes out.

amharic: የሠረጸ የወጣ የበቀለ የለመለመ ለምለም ጨፌ መስክ፡፡
english: Something that has sprouted, grown, or is lush and green.
The process of sprouting, emergence, or growth.

amharic: ቡቃያ ዐዲስ ወጣት ለጋ ቀንበጥ ሙሽራ ጫፍ ውልብልቢት፡፡
english: A sprout, a new shoot, a young bud, or the tip of a plant.
To cause something to grow, sprout, or come forth.

amharic: መነሣት መውጣት ብቅ ማለት መብቀል መወለድ መብራት መታየት መገለጥ
english: The act of rising, appearing, or shining, like the sun or moon.
The rising or appearance of light or stars.
The east, or the place where the sun rises.
Relating to the lunar month.

amharic: በቁሙ የፀሓይ መውጫ መገለጫ ማእዝን ሀገር የምዕራብ ትይዩና አንጻር
english: The east; the direction where the sun rises, opposite of the west.
Eastern; belonging to the east.

amharic: አወጣ አበቀለ አበራ ገለጠ ብልጭ አደረገ
english: To cause something to rise, shine, or appear.
To tie, cut, weave, or braid.
A noose, cord, or trap.

amharic: ጥሩ ወይን ዘር መልካም አስካሉ ሕንባቡ ታላላቅ ጣዕሙ ምቱቅ የኾነ
english: A type of excellent, sweet grape or vine.
The act of stealing or theft.
To fly or soar.

amharic: መመሥረት አጥልቆ ቈፍሮ መሠረት መጣል ማቆም መትክል ከዚያ በኋላ መንደቅ መሥራት
english: The act of laying a foundation, building, or constructing.
A founder, builder, or creator.
To be founded, built, or constructed.
Founded, built, or created.
Work, design, or structure.
To found, establish, or build.
To lay a foundation or start a construction.

amharic: ተመሠረተ መሠረት ኾነ ታነጸ ተሠራ ጸና
english: To be established, built, or made firm.
To spread out or weave.

amharic: መሠንጠተር መቅደድ መሠንጠቅ መክፈል መቍረጥ መበጠስ መቈንጸል መግረፍ መግጠብ ማቍሰል
english: The act of tearing, cutting, splitting, or whipping.
To be torn, whipped, or split.
Torn, whipped, or split.

amharic: መቅደድ መቀዳድ አቀዳደድ ግርፋት ቍስል ሰንበር
english: A tear, wound, or scar from whipping.

amharic: መሠንተሪያ መቅደጃ መግረፊያ ጫፉ የሚቈርጥ የሚከፍት
english: A tool for cutting, splitting, or whipping.

amharic: ማሥመሪያ ተጋዳሚው ዕንጨት ወይም ብረት ሚዶ ማበጠሪያ
english: A ruler, straight edge, or comb.

amharic: መሥመር ወስፌ ርሳስ ቀለም ያለፈበት ሰንበሩ ንድፉ ቢጋሩ
english: A line, drawing, or design.

amharic: ዐሥራ ስድስተኛ ፊደል በግእዝ እልፍ ቤት በአበገደ ስሙ ዐይን
english: The sixteenth letter of the Ge'ez alphabet, named 'Ain'.
A letter name for the Ge'ez character 'Ain'.
The name of a large, final Ge'ez letter.
To be foolish or lazy.
A servant, slave, or captive.

amharic: ማሰናከር ማስተጓጐል ከመንገድ ማውጣት በግድ መያዝ መሳብ መጐተት መግፋት ማዳፋት
english: To force, pull, push, or obstruct someone.
To refuse or say no.

amharic: መወፈር መግዘፍ መደንደን ማደግ መብለጥ ታላቅ መኾን መክበር መግነን ከፍ ከፍ ማለት ማየል መጽናት መበርታት መብዛት መፈድፈድ መመንዘል መክበድ
english: To grow large, great, strong, or proud.
Great, mighty, strong, or numerous.
Great ones, leaders, or elders.

amharic: ልዕልና ከፍታ ብልጫ ክብር ታላቅነት ገናንነት ብዛት ጽናት
english: Greatness, height, honor, or glory.

amharic: አሳደገ ከፍ አደረገ አላቀ አበለጠ አከበረ አገነነ አኰራ አጓደደ አስታበየ አበዛ አጸና
english: To magnify, honor, increase, or exalt.

amharic: ታበየ ትቢተኛ ኾነ ኰራ ተጓደደ ተነፋ ዐበጠ ልቡ ሐሳቡ
english: To be proud, arrogant, or boastful.

amharic: በቁሙ ትቢተኛ ኵሩ ልቡ ያበጠ የተነፋ
english: Proud, arrogant, or conceited.

amharic: በቁሙ ትቢት ትቢተኛነት ኵራት የልብ እድገት ከፍታ
english: Pride, arrogance, or conceit.

amharic: ተበላለጠ ተላላቀ ተወራረደ እኔ እበልጥ እኔ እበልጥ ተባባለ፡፡
english: To compete or boast about being superior to others.
To compare, weigh, or determine who is greater.

amharic: መሥራት መሣሪያ ማውጣት ፊት ጕጠቱ መዶሻውን ቀጥሎ ሌላውን የብረት፡፡ የተሠራውን ማደስ ማሾል መወልወል መሰንገል፡፡
english: The act of crafting, repairing, sharpening, or polishing metal tools.
A collection of metal tools or sharp weapons.

amharic: ፈሰሰ ወረደ ጋለበ ኼደ ታወከ ተናጠ ተደረጠ የጐርፍ የባሕር፡
english: To flow, rush, or surge like a stormy sea or a flood.

amharic: ማዕበል አስነሣ አወከ ደረጠ አናወጠ አጐረፈ የነፋስ፡፡
english: To cause a storm, agitate the sea, or stir up a whirlwind.
An itchy skin condition or rash.

amharic: ማለፍ መኼድ መሻገር የቦታ የዘመን፡፡ ማርጀት መድረቅ መምከን ርጥበት ልምላሜ ማጣት ድርቅ በጋ ቦና መኾን፡፡
english: To pass or cross over; to wither, dry up, or age.
Something that is dry, withered, or aged.

amharic: ድርቀት ድርቅ በጋ ቦና ችጋር ቀጠና ከዝናም ዕጦት የተነሣ፡፡
english: A drought, dry season, or period of famine caused by lack of rain.
To cause to pass or cross over; to make something dry or barren.

amharic: ባልቴቱ ዕድሜዋ ካምሳ ዓመት ያለፈ ፈጽማ ያረጠች የመውለድ ተስፋ የቈረጠች ሙቀት ልምላሜ የተለያት፡፡
english: An elderly woman, particularly one past child-bearing age.

amharic: ሽማግሌ የባልቴት ባል ሚስቱ እኩያው የኾነች ወይም የምትበልጠው፡፡
english: An elderly man, typically the husband of an elderly woman.
An elderly woman (an old lady).
A proper name, specifically the great-great-grandson of Shem.

amharic: የዔቦር ዘር ወገን ከልጅ ልጆቹ አንዱ፡፡
english: A Hebrew; a descendant of Eber.

amharic: ወንዲላ ደረቅ ብርቱ ልባም ወንዲት ዐጅሪት የምትባል፡፡
english: A strong, wise, or capable woman.

amharic: የዔቦር ቋንቋ እስራኤል የሚናገሩበት ኦሪት ነቢያት መዠመሪያ የተጣፉበት የብሉይ ኪዳን ምንጭ የሱርት የዐረብ የግእዝ ወንድም፡፡
english: The Hebrew language, the ancient tongue of Israel.
A turn, shift, or rotation of tasks.

amharic: በቁሙ ዐጓጕል ክብ እንክብል ድንብልብል ቅርጽ ገጽ ማእዘን የሌለው የኰብ የኳስ ዐይነት፡፡
english: Round, spherical, or having no sharp edges (like a ball).

amharic: አስካል ዘለላ ሕንባቡ ፍሬው ክብ እንክብል የኾነ፡፡
english: Round fruits, clusters, or berries.
Flax or linen fibers.
So-and-so (a placeholder name for a person).

amharic: ማደስ መሥራት መሰደር መደርደር መቈለል መከመር የደንጊያ የንጨት፡፡
english: To build, stack, arrange, or pile up stones or wood.

amharic: የደንጊያ ክምር ቍልል ስድር ድርድር፡፡ ያታክልት ረድፍ የዛፉ ተራ ቃዳው ተለላው መደቡ፡፡
english: A pile, stack, row, or layer of stones or plants.

amharic: ልጅ ጥጃ እንቦሳ ግልገል ጫጩት ውርንጭላ ያትክልት ፍል ግልግል ችግኝ፡፡ ምስጢሩ ለጋ ወጣት ርጥብ ጨቅላ ቡቃያ ማለት ነው፡፡
english: A young creature (calf, chick, sprout), meaning something young or tender.
Young animals or children.
A young female animal, like a heifer.

amharic: ልጅ ወይፈን ደቦል ጠቦት ጡት የተወ ያደገ ራሱን የቻለ፡፡
english: A young animal or child that has grown and become independent.
An orphan (a fatherless child).
Humanity; a child of man.
Human, earthly, or mortal.

amharic: መፍጠን መቀልጠፍ መቀማት መመንተፍ መበደል መግፋት መታገል ማጥቃት፡፡
english: To seize, rob, oppress, or attack violently.
A robber, oppressor, or someone who steals.
To cause someone to be robbed or oppressed.
A robber or someone who causes others to be oppressed.
To be robbed, seized, or treated unjustly.
Something that has been stolen or taken away.

amharic: በቁሙ ትግል፡፡ ቅሚያ ስርቆት ግፍ በደል፡፡
english: Robbery, injustice, or oppressive struggle.
To wrestle, struggle, or fight with someone.
To cause or incite others to fight or struggle.

amharic: የሚያቀማማ የቀማኛ ዐጋዥ ረዳት ዐብሮ የሚሰርቅ የሚቀማ፡፡
english: An accomplice or someone who assists in robbing or oppression.

amharic: ማስታገሥ ማቆም መግታት ማቈየት ማሰንበት ማስቀረት፡፡
english: To calm, stop, restrain, or grant patience.
One who calms, soothes, or provides patience.

amharic: ታገሠ ተገታ ቈየ ጠበቀ ደጅ ጠና ቻለ ተሸከመ፡፡
english: To be patient, endure, or wait for someone or something.

amharic: የሚታገሥ ታጋሽ ቻይ ልበ ሰፊ ነገር ዐላፊ፡፡
english: A patient, tolerant, or long-suffering person.
A patient person (one who has practiced endurance).
A patient or enduring person (similar to the above).
Patience; the ability to wait or stay calm.
To be patient or tolerate one another.
To help others be patient or to calm someone down.
A peacekeeper; one who encourages patience.
A medicinal plant, specifically aloe.

amharic: ማገት ዋስን መያዝ ማሰር መክበብ ማጠር መወሰን ዙሪያውን መዝጋት
english: To restrain, surround, block, or set boundaries.
To trap, surround, or confine.
A trap, a siege, or a blockade.
To be trapped, restrained, or surrounded.
Trapped, restrained, or captured.

amharic: ቃጫ ፊት ለፊት ወገን መራራ ክፉ ቅጠል ሽቱና መድኅኒት የሚኾን
english: A bitter medicinal plant or herb used for healing.
A state of being surrounded or a siege.

amharic: ዘልፈ ለዓለም ፍጻሜ የሌለው ጊዜ ዘመን
english: Eternity; an everlasting duration of time.
To owe a debt.
Hand; related to reaching out.
To distance, remove, or cast aside.
Distress, humiliation, or great sadness.
To cross over, pass, or walk across.
One who crosses or passes through; a traveler.
To help someone cross over.
The other side; the opposite bank of a river.
Those who cross or places on the other side.
To be crossed or skipped over.
Crossed over or passed by.
An enemy or a rival.
The act of crossing or passing through.
A crossroads or junction.
To cross each other; to pass through reciprocally.
To assist or cause someone to cross over.
A crossing point or a bridge.
To pay, repay, or provide a return.
One who pays; a payer.
A debtor or creditor; someone involved in a debt.
A type of yellow flower or a medicinal plant.

amharic: ሕግ ሥርዐት የአበው ትውፊት ልማድ ሀገር
english: Tradition, customs, or societal laws.
To give, distribute, or pass along.
A tunic or garment; soft clothing.
Garments, robes, or tunics.
To be red or look beautiful; to decorate.

amharic: ማደም መቅጠር ጊዜ መወሰን ቀን መስጠት
english: To invite, schedule, or set a date/time for an event.
To be invited or have an appointment set.
A guest or someone invited.
An appointment, a lifespan, or a set time.
To agree, join together, or form an alliance with others.
To want, search for, or seek something.

amharic: ምቹ ቦታ ወፍራም ሥብ መሬት አሻል ፋልማ
english: A delightful, lush, and fertile garden or paradise.
An exclamation of sorrow, surprise, or realization.

amharic: ጭን የጭን ራስ መብቀያው ከሆድ ጋራ የተያያዘው ማጠፊያው ማውዱ
english: The hip, or the joint where the thigh connects to the body.

amharic: መጥመም መጕበጥ መወላገድ ጠማማ ቈልማማ ዐንካሳ ጠንካራ ጠንባሳ ሸውራራ መኾን አለመስተካከል የሕዋስ
english: Crooked, twisted, lame, or physically deformed.

amharic: አላገጠ አለመጠ አሣለቀ አፋነ ከንፈሩን በማጣመም ዐይኑን በማጨንቈር በማሳወር
english: To mock, make fun of, or grimace by twisting one's face or eyes.

amharic: ጋገረ ዐነጐተ ክብ አደረገ የሊጡን ቅርጥ
english: To bake or shape dough into a round form.
To be baked or formed into a round shape.
A thin, round loaf of bread or cake.
To rotate, turn around, circle, or wander.
One who wanders or a herald who travels to announce news.

amharic: ዐዋጅ ለሕዝብ የሚነገር የንጉሥ ሕግና ደንብ ውሳኔ
english: A royal decree or public announcement issued to the people.
To cause to turn around or to proclaim an announcement.
To be circled or to have an announcement made.

amharic: የታወደ የተከበበ ክብ የታሰረ የተጠመጠመ ጥምጥም
english: Rounded, surrounded, wrapped, or tied in a bundle.
A rotation, cycle, or the act of going around.
A circle, surrounding area, or a boundary.

amharic: ፲፱ ዓመት በዚህ ጨረቃና ፀሓይ መንገዳቸውን እየፈጸሙ ተራክቦ ያደርጉታል
english: A 19-year cycle where the sun and moon align their paths.
A lunar month of thirty days.
A 76-year calendrical cycle.
A week of seven days, from Sunday to Saturday.
A solar year of 365 blessed days.

amharic: ፳፰፡ ዓመት በዚህ ዕለት ወንጌላዊ ይገናኙታል
english: A 28-year solar cycle.

amharic: ፭፻፴፪፡ ዓመት በዚህ ዕለት ወንጌላዊ አበቅቴ ይገናኙበታል
english: A 532-year Great Cycle in the Ethiopic calendar.
Plural circles, public squares, or gathering places.
A surrounding area, perimeter, or a place of gathering.

amharic: የሬት ዕንጨት ሽታው የሚያውድ ከሩቅ የሚሸት
english: A fragrant wood, like aloe, that smells good from a distance.
An excuse, reason, or argument used to clear one's name.

amharic: ጮኽ ቡታ ሰደደ ዋይ ዋይ አለ
english: To cry out, wail, or scream in distress.
To make someone cry out or weep.
A cry, wail, or loud lamentation.
Victory, triumph, or a loud shouting of success.
To trouble, harass, or cause worry.

amharic: በቁሙ ጥቅል ነፋስ ጠሮ ኵርፊት የትቢያ ማዕበል
english: A storm, whirlwind, or violent wind that kicks up dust.

amharic: ዕጓል ታናሽ ልጅ ሕፃን ግልገል ውርንጫ
english: A young child, baby, or young animal.
To cover, cloak, or darken like a cloud or shadows.

amharic: ለምለም ሣር ቅጠል ግጫ ሸንበቆ የመሰለው ኹሉ
english: Lush greenery, grass, reeds, or leafy plants.
Green forests or trees.
Tall trees or forest growth.

amharic: መብረር መስረር እንደ ደመና በአየር መኼድ መክነፍ
english: To fly or soar through the air like a cloud.

amharic: በቁሙ ወፍ ባለክንፍ የሚበር የሚስር ታናሹም ታላቁም
english: A bird, referring to any winged creature that flies.

amharic: ማወቅ ማስተዋል ምስጢሩ ጥበቃ ጥንቀቃ ነው
english: To know, understand, be watchful, or be careful.
To inform, reveal, or explain clearly to others.
To be known, understood, or revealed.
Known, famous, understood, or clear.

amharic: ማወቅ መታወቅ አስተዋወቅ ዕውቅነት ዕውቀት ዕውቂያ
english: Knowledge, the act of knowing, or being aware.

amharic: ዐውቂያ የሚያውቁት ምስጢር የሚነግሩት ወዳጅ ባልንጀራ
english: An acquaintance, a close friend, or someone with whom secrets are shared.
To become acquainted, to socialize, or to form a friendship.
To introduce someone to another or to help people become familiar with each other.

amharic: መታወር ዕዉር መኾን ከማየት መከልከል መደናበር ዐይን ፈሶ ፈርጦ ገበጣ መስሎ ተደፍኖ ተጨፍኖ ወይም ፈጦ ጐርጦ ፈዞ በልዞ
english: Blindness, the state of being unable to see, or the loss of vision.

amharic: ዕውር ጠንባሳ ዐይኑ የጠፋ የፈሰሰ የዐዊር ምስጢር ከብርሃኑ ይልቅ ዐይኑ ብሌኑ ከወጣ በኋላ ባዶውን ያለ ጕድጓድና ቈርበት ያሳያል
english: A blind person or someone with severely damaged eyes.
Blind people (plural).
Blind, someone who cannot see.
Blindness or the condition of being unable to see.
Blindness, often used to describe a lack of spiritual or mental sight.

amharic: ዐወረ አሳወረ ዐይን አወጣ አሶጣ ዕውር አደረገ አስደረገ
english: To make blind or to cause someone to lose their sight.

amharic: ዐይኑን ጨፈነ ቸል አለ ናቀ ዕውር መሰለ እያየ እንዳላየ ኾነ ደፈረ
english: To ignore, to turn a blind eye, or to pretend not to see.
Someone who is careless, indifferent, or ignores important things.
Negligence, indifference, or a lack of concern.
A type of bird, specifically a vulture or large raptor.
Awit, a proper name for a place or region.
To flow or spill.

amharic: በቁሙ የቦካ እበት ፍግ ፋንድያ ወደርሻ የሚጣል
english: Manure or dung used for fertilizing land.
To command, order, or give instructions.

amharic: መጽናናት መበርታት መጠንከር መሠልጠን ማጽናት ማበርታት ልብን ሰውነትን
english: The act of strengthening, encouraging, or becoming firm in body or heart.
Strong, firm, sturdy, or wise.
Strong, unbreakable, powerful, or firm.

amharic: ጥናት ብርታት ጥንካሬ ኅይል ሥልጣን ክብር ልዕልና
english: Strength, power, authority, or greatness.
To numb, make dull, or cause to feel sluggish.
Something that numbs or dulls; also a name for a type of fish that creates a numbing effect.

amharic: መፍዘዝ መስለል ድንዛዜ የዥማት ደዌ የበሽታ ጠንክ ቍጣ ሐዘን ኅፍረት ስቅጥጥታ
english: Numbness, dizziness, or a state of shock or great sadness.
Strong or mighty.
Ezil, a specific style of traditional Ethiopian musical chant.
Persian, or referring to the people of Persia.
Ear.

amharic: መፋር መቈፈር መብሳት መሰርሰር ማጐድጐድ ማጥለቅ ማዝቅ ዝቅ ማድረግ የኵሬ የጕድጓድ
english: The act of digging, piercing, or creating a deep hole like a pond or well.
A pit, a deep hole, or a pond.
Pits or wells (plural).
To scatter, spread, sprinkle, or distribute.

amharic: ተበተነ ተዘራ ተረጨ ተሠራጨ ተናኘ ተወራኘ
english: To be scattered, spread out, or distributed.

amharic: ብርሃን የጮራ እግር ቀርኑ ጦሩ የሚዋጋው
english: A ray of light, often described as a beam or a projection.
Rays of light or beams of brightness (plural).
To shine, radiate, or sparkle with light.

amharic: የምሥዋዕ ዕርከን የሕንጻው ዝናር ዙሪያው የሚክብ መደብ
english: A ledge or border surrounding an altar or building.

amharic: ማጠን ማጤስ ማብነን በጢስ ማፈን መሥዋዕት መሠዋት ማንደድ ማቃጠል
english: The act of burning incense, offering smoke, or conducting a sacrifice.
One who burns incense or offers smoke.
Those who burn incense (plural).
A place for burning incense.
A censer or an incense burner.
To be fumigated or to have incense burned before or upon.
The process or custom of burning incense.

amharic: በቁሙ ሽቱ የሽቱ ቅመም ለቤተ መቅደስ የተበጀ የተዘጋጀ መሥዋዕት ቍርባን የሚኾን የሚጤስ የሚታጠን፡፡
english: Fragrant incense prepared as an offering for the temple.

amharic: ቅኔ የቅኔ ከዕጣንና ከቍርባን በኋላ የሚቀኙት፡፡
english: A type of religious poetry or hymn recited after incense and offering rituals.

amharic: መሥራት ማጠፍ መጠቅለል ማልበስ መሸፈን ማጐናጠፍ መጠቅለያው የሸማኔ፡፡
english: The act of weaving, folding, wrapping, or covering.
To be made, folded, or wrapped up.
Something that is woven, folded, or wrapped.
A finished piece of clothing or garment.

amharic: መታጠቅ መቀነት ወገብን ማሰር ማጥበቅ ማሸረጥ ማሸንፈጥ ማገልደም፡፡
english: The act of girding, wearing a belt, or tightening around the waist.
One who wears a belt or armor.
To put on a belt or gear; to be equipped.

amharic: በቁሙ ያገዳና የቅልጥም ወሰን መገናኛው እንደ ትጥቅ ያለው፡፡
english: A joint or connection, such as a place where limbs meet, likened to a belt.
To help someone put on their armor or belt; to equip.

amharic: ኮከብ የኮከብ ስም ወይም ሥዕሉ ሰብአ ልስጥራን የሚያመልኩት፡፡
english: A specific star or planet, often associated with ancient beliefs.

amharic: ማንጠስ ድንገት ባፍና ባፍንጫ መጮኽ መተንፈስ ከጕንፋን ወይም ክክፉ ሽታ የተነሣ፡፡
english: The act of sneezing.
A sneeze or the act of having an open mouth during sneezing.
What? or which one?

amharic: ኵሬ የውሃ መቋሚያ መጠራቀሚያ ጐድጓዳ ቦታ ዐውደ ማይ ጉባኤ ማይ ታናሽ ባሕር፡፡
english: A pond, a small lake, or a reservoir of water.
Ponds or bodies of water.
A cup, bowl, or ceramic vessel for holding liquid.

amharic: ኵባዮች ፍንጃሎች የሸክላ ጥዎች እጀታ ዦሮ ያላቸው፡፡
english: Cups or bowls with handles.
A bat, or a mouse-like creature.
To wander or go astray.

amharic: መሳት መሳሳት ከመንገድ መውጣት መዞር መባከን ፈልጎ ማጣት፡፡
english: The act of wandering, going astray, or getting lost.
One who is wandering, confused, or aimless.

amharic: ላይ ላዩን መዞር መባከን መብረር ማውተት መንከርተት ያሞራ የወፍ፡፡
english: To wander aimlessly, roam, or fly about like a bird.
A wanderer or someone who roams around.
The state of wandering or roaming.
To cause to wander or to lead astray.

amharic: ብርቱ ጠንካራ ዐያሌ ብዙ የሕዝብ የመንጋ፡፡
english: Strong, powerful, or a large crowd/multitude.
To feed, ingest, or take in food.
To feed or eat.
To care for or watch over closely.
An eye, the organ used for seeing.
Eyes, the lights of the body.
A scout, spy, or messenger.

amharic: የማኅተም ዐይነት በማኅተም ላይ የተሣለ የተቀረጸ መልክ ወይም የታተመ የማኅተም ቅድ፡፡
english: The design or symbol carved into a seal.

amharic: የወፍ በሽታ ዐይንና ጥፍርን ሽንትን ሰውነትን ብጫ የሚያደርግ ወርቅ የሚያስመስል፡፡
english: A sickness (jaundice) that turns the eyes and skin yellow; also refers to an evil eye.

amharic: ጕድጓድ ዐዘቅት ኵስሕ የጕድጓድ ምንጭ ውሃው ከውስጥ ከመሬት የሚፈልቅ እንዳዲስ አበባ ያለ፡፡
english: An underground spring or deep water pit.

amharic: ከተመ ምንጭ ይዞ ሰፈረ ጐዦ ሠራ ድንኳን ተከለ ሕዝቡ፡፡
english: To camp, pitch tents, or settle in a location.

amharic: የተጐበኘ የተመረመረ የተገመገመ የተመረጠ የተለቀመ ምርጥ፡፡
english: Something selected, examined, or chosen carefully.

amharic: ሰፈር ከተማ መንደር ብዙ ድንኳን ጐዦ ቤት ዳስ በረት፡፡
english: A camp, village, or settlement.

amharic: ተሳፈረ ተሰፋፈረ ጐን ለጐን ወይም ፊት ለፊት፡፡
english: To camp alongside or face-to-face with others.

amharic: ማየር መቀላቀል የማዕድናት፡፡ መስደብ ማዋረድ መገደር ማላገድ መናቅ ማቅለል አሳልፎ መስጠት ራስን ወይም ሌላውን፡፡
english: To mix, to disgrace, to belittle, or to insult.

amharic: ተሳፈረ ተሰፋፈረ ጐን ለጐን ወይም ፊት ለፊት፡፡
english: To travel or stand side-by-side or facing one another.

amharic: ማየር መቀላቀል የማዕድናት፡፡ መስደብ ማዋረድ መገደር ማላገድ መናቅ ማቅለል አሳልፎ መስጠት ራስን ወይም ሌላውን፡፡
english: A person who is mocked, insulted, or betrayed.

amharic: ስድብ ውርደት ለግድ ተግዳሮት ጡር መስቃ፡፡
english: An insult, shame, or a challenging act of disrespect.
Something that is mixed or blended together.
A guardian angel or protector.
A trap used for catching small animals.
To prevent, forbid, or block someone from entering.

amharic: የንጉሥ ቤት ቤተ መንግሥት አዳራሽ ታላቅ ከፍተኛ ከፍ ባለ ቦታ የተሠራ ግቢ ሰፈር
english: A royal palace or a grand, elevated hall.

amharic: ከልካይ አጋፋሪ የበር መቅሠፍት፡፡ ተባይ ተናካሽ ፍጥረት
english: A small, biting insect or a pest that causes discomfort.
It is not, a word used for denial or negation.
To negate, deny, or say 'it is not'.

amharic: መጥገብ መጠገብ መሰልቸት ዕክክ ማለት፡፡ ብዙ ውሃ መያዝ
english: To be full to the brim or overflow with liquid.
Large pots, jars, or basins.
To be satisfied or full after eating.

amharic: ማሸነፍ መጣል ድል መንሣት በላይ መኾን የትግል የውጊያ፡፡
english: To win, defeat, or overcome in a struggle or fight.

amharic: ማሸነፍ መጣል መግደል መስለብ መግፈፍ፡፡ የድል ምልክት
english: A victory, triumph, or a sign of success in battle.
A bed, a place of rest, or a symbol of honor.
A tall wooden pole used for hoisting or as a crossbeam.
To collect or store items together.

amharic: መቀበል መስተጋባት የሰሙትን ዜማ መልሶ መቀበል መጮኽ መናገር፡፡
english: To call out, echo, or respond with a voice or melody.

amharic: መፈጸም መምላት መተው የሥራ የሹመት፡፡ መቅዳት መገልበጥ መተርጐም
english: To translate, copy, complete, or transfer from one form to another.

amharic: ወንጀለኛ እንቢተኛ ሽፍታ ለዋጭ ገልባጭ መላሽ፡፡
english: A rebel, someone who resists, or one who changes sides.

amharic: አስወነጀለ አስከዳ አስካደ ዐሎ አሰኘ አስለወጠ፡፡
english: To cause someone to rebel, betray, or change their ways.
Someone who causes rebellion or who performs translation/copying.
To be betrayed or to fall out with someone.

amharic: የወነጀለ ዐመፀኛ ክፉ ጠማማ ልዉጥ ከሓዲ፡፡
english: A rebellious, wicked, or treacherous person.

amharic: መወንጀል መለወጥ ወንጀል ዐመጽ ክዳት እንቢታ አደጋ ጥፋት፡፡
english: Rebellion, betrayal, or an act of wrongdoing.

amharic: ሽቱ የሽቱ ስም ዋግራ ፊት፡፡ ከርቤ ወዐልው፡፡
english: A type of fragrant perfume or incense (aloes).

amharic: ወነጀለ ሸፈተ ዐሌ አለ አንቢ አለ ጠመመ ሰገመ፡፡
english: To rebel, revolt, or act in a crooked or wicked way.
A wicked or rebellious person.
To rebel, revolt, or act collectively in rebellion.

amharic: ወንጀለኛ ሽፍታ ወያኔ አረመኔ ክፉ ጨካኝ፡፡
english: A villain, criminal, or a very cruel person.
To dye, color, or paint something.
To be separated, chosen, or set apart.
Separate, special, or set apart as unique.

amharic: ዐላላ ማለያ ቀለም ብዙ ዐይነት ያለው፡፡
english: A variety of colors or a patterned, dyed material.

amharic: ጕልት ገንዘብ ምሎ ተፈጥሞ ሕርም ይኹንብኝ ብሎ የሰጡት፡፡
english: A dedicated gift, offering, or property set apart by a vow.

amharic: ማለም ማመልከት ስምን መጣፍ ማተም መፈረም፡፡
english: To sign, mark, or record something in writing.
A teacher, instructor, or scholar.

amharic: ተመለከተ ባለምልክት ኾነ፡፡ ተጣፈ ተነገረ ትምርቱ፡፡
english: To learn, become educated, or be marked by knowledge.
A sign, a marker, or a flag.

amharic: ዕልም አለ ታባ ተሰወረ ከመታየትና ከመታወቅ፡፡
english: To disappear, be hidden, or become invisible.

amharic: ዕልም ያለ ኅቡእ ረቂቅ ስዉር ድብቅ፡፡
english: Hidden, mysterious, secret, or subtle.

amharic: በቁሙ ዓለመ ስብእ ሰው የሚኖርበት ምድር መሬት
english: The world, the earth, or the place where people live.
Worldly, secular, or earthly.

amharic: ቦታ ዘመን ዓለመ ሥጋ ሰው እሰከ ሞተና እስከ ምጽአት የሚኖርበት፡፡
english: This world, the present time of human life until the end.

amharic: ከሞት በኋላ የሚመጣው ዘመን ወይም ሕይወት።
english: The world to come; the afterlife or the time following death.
For ever and ever; an eternity that has no end.
Everlasting; something that lives or lasts forever without end.
Eternal; something that is permanent and unchanging.

amharic: ወደፊት የሚመጣን ጊዜ የሚያሳይ፣ እስከ ዘላለም።
english: Until forever; pointing toward an unending future.
A musical instrument; a type of harp with six strings.

amharic: ትል፣ ደም የሚመጥ፣ የሚጣበቅ የውኃ ፍጡር።
english: A leech; a water creature that sticks to and drinks blood.

amharic: የስንዴ ወገን የሆነ፣ ማሽላ የሚመስል እህል።
english: A type of grain, similar to wheat or millet.

amharic: ዓመት፣ ፫፻፷፭ ቀናት ያለው የጊዜ መለኪያ።
english: Year; a period of 365 days.
Year; a unit of time.
The age of the world, starting from creation.

amharic: ክርስቶስ ሰው ሆኖ ከተወለደበት ጊዜ ጀምሮ ያለው ዘመን።
english: The age of incarnation, starting from the birth of Christ.
The era of mercy, also known as the era of incarnation.
Perfume or incense.
To support, steady, or make something stand firmly.
A supporter or something that holds things up firmly.
A pillar or column used to support a structure.
Pillars or columns.
A pillar-dweller or someone living on top of a column.
A base or foundation for a pillar.
To be ill or sick.
To grow dark, cloudy, or murky.
A people, nation, or group of individuals.
Amharic language.
A swamp, marsh, or muddy place.
Emmanuel; God is with us.
To rebel, mistreat, or act unjustly.
A rebel or an unjust person.
Injustice, rebellion, or wickedness.
To suffer injustice or be mistreated.
Someone who has been wronged or mistreated.
To struggle, conflict, or fight against one another.
To cause a rebellion or force someone to act unjustly.
To go deep or hide from sight.
Deep, distant, or mysterious.
Depth.
An abyss, a deep pit, or a chasm.
To deepen or make something go deep.
To struggle or grapple with someone.
To browse or read casually.

amharic: ታላቅ ዓሣ፣ ዘንዶ የሚመስል የባሕር ፍጡር።
english: A whale; a large, legendary sea creature.
Whales or great sea monsters.
Amber; a substance that produces a sweet fragrance when burned.
A lion.

amharic: ጕትቾች ቀለበቶች ንፎዎች መንደልቶች (ዘፍ፳፬ ፳፪፡፡ ኢሳ፫ ፳፡፡ ሕዝ፲፮ ፲፪)፡፡
english: Earrings, rings, and various nose or ear ornaments.

amharic: በቁሙ ክሣድ ማንገቻ የጌጥ የሽልማት ማሰሪያ፡፡
english: The neck, or a decorative ornament worn around the neck.

amharic: ዐንገታም ዐንገተ ወፍራም፡፡ የባሕር አውሬ አርጃኖ (ዘሌ፲፩ ፴)፡፡
english: Something thick-necked, or a specific type of sea creature.

amharic: የባሕር አራዊት አርጃኖች፡፡ ዐንጐጓት ወብሔ (መጽ ምስ)፡፡
english: Sea monsters or large aquatic animals.

amharic: ዕንጐችት የሽቱ ቅጠል ሽቱነት ያለው፡፡ ዕንጐችት ፪ ዐይነት ነው ታላቅና ታናሽ፡፡
english: A fragrant leaf or plant used for its pleasant scent; it comes in two varieties.
A musical instrument used for singing.
To make a sound or to play an instrument.

amharic: አባለ ዘርዕ ደካማ ኰሳሳ የታሸ የተኰላሸ ፍሬው የወጣ ወይም ያበጠ የተነፋ ደዌ ያደረበት፡፡
english: Something weak, frail, damaged, or swollen due to an illness.
An offering, sacrifice, or a prayer of thanksgiving.
To dry out or become withered.
A mouse or rodent.

amharic: መክበድ ማጠር ዐንገትን በጌጥ ማሰር ማንገት ባንገት መሸከም ማንጠልጠል፡፡
english: The act of wearing jewelry around the neck or carrying something heavy around the neck.
To cause someone to carry something, or to tie something around the neck.

amharic: ክቡር ደንጊያ ብዙ ዐይነት ያለው ያንገት ጌጥ ሽልማት ተሰክቶ ባንገት የሚታሰር የሚሰደር የሚደረደር፡፡
english: A precious stone or a beautiful necklace used as jewelry.

amharic: ዕንቆች የከበሩ ድንጎች፡፡ ሰሐባ ለጥበብ እምአዕናቍ (ኢዮ፳፰ ፲፰)፡፡
english: Precious stones or jewels.

amharic: ዋኖሶች ቡላሎች፡፡ ያመጽእ ክልኤተ መዓንቀ (ዘሌ፭ ፯)፡፡
english: Doves or pigeons.

amharic: ረዐይታዊ ኅያል ሐርበኛ እጅግ ብርቱ መስሎ ረዥም ወርዳም ቁመታም መጠኑ ከሰው ልክ ያለፈ፡፡
english: A giant or a person of extraordinary height and strength.
A honeycomb.
To guess, predict, or speculate.

amharic: የሕዝብ ስብሰባ ጉባኤ ዐቢይ በዓል በዓለ ሠዊት በዓለ ኅምሳ ጰራቅሊጦስ፡፡
english: A public gathering, assembly, or a grand holiday like Pentecost.
The nature or character of a creature.
The fundamental elements of creation or natural properties.
The crown of the head.
The name of a place.

amharic: በቁሙ የባሕር እንስሳ መልኩና ነገዱ የተለየ፡፡
english: A sea animal or fish.
To pay a price or give value for something.
To work or build.
A trail, track, or trace left behind.

amharic: ዐሥር ማድረግ ዐሥራት ማውጣት ካሥር አንድ መስጠት ወይም መቀበል መውሰድ፡፡
english: The act of tithing or giving one-tenth of something.

amharic: ዐሥር አስደረገ ዐሥራት አሶጣ ግብር ቀረጥ አስከፈለ፡፡
english: To collect taxes or tithes from others.
To be invited or gathered for an event.
Someone who is selected or invited.

amharic: ቀጠሮ ዐሥር ተባለ ካሥር ተከፈለ ዐሥራት ወጣለት ታሸረ፡፡
english: An appointment, a portion, or a division of ten.

amharic: ዐሥር (የ፡ ፲) የቍጥር ስም መዠመሪያ ቀመር ያንድ ቤት ፍጻሜ የዘጠኝ ተከታይ በዘጠኝና በካያ መካከል ያለ ቍጥር ካንድ እስከ ዘጠኝ ያሉትን አኃዞች በመጫፈርና በመናበብ እስከ ኻያ ድረስ የሚዘምት፡፡
english: The number ten.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ ዐሥር ዐሥሩ ዐሥረኛው ቱ አርቲክል ነው፡፡
english: The number ten (specifically for masculine usage).
Ten (used for time).

amharic: ኻያ (ከ ፳) ኹለት ጊዜ ዐሥር ወይም ዐሥር ጊዜ ኹለት ካዕበት ዮድ ምክዕቢተ የውጣ፡፡
english: The number twenty.
Tenth.
Tenth.

amharic: በቁሙ ዐሥረኛ እጅ ክፍል ካሥር አን ቀረጥ ግብር፡፡
english: A tithe, which is one-tenth part.

amharic: ዐሥርነት ዐሥር ዕጥፍ ዐሥረኛ ክፍል ያሥር ቤት ባሥር ባሥር የሚበዛ ቍጥር ካሥር እስከ ዘጠና ያለው፡፡
english: A group of tens or decimal classification.

amharic: ዳነ ተፈወሰ ጤና አገኘ ባለጤና ኾነ፡፡
english: To be healed or to recover health.
To cover, coat, or apply something over a surface.

amharic: ሽቱ የሽቱ መረቅ ቅባት የነጠረ የተጣፈጠ፡፡
english: A perfume, fragrant oil, or ointment.

amharic: የራስ ልብስ መሸፈኛ ቆብ ኵፌት መጠምጠሚያ
english: A head covering, cap, or turban used to wrap the head.
Soil, earth, or dust.
A lot or fate.

amharic: ዐጸባ መኾን መጭነቅ መክበድ መባስ መክፋት
english: The state of being distressed, burdened, or experiencing difficult times.

amharic: የጨነቀ ጭንቅ አስቸጋሪ ጽኑ ክቡድ ቃለ አንክሮ ድንቅ
english: Amazing, wondrous, or a very difficult and heavy situation.
Distress, hardship, suffering, or a trap.
The condition of being anxious or distressed.

amharic: ጭንቅ መከራ ችጋር ቀጠና ዕጦት ድኽነት
english: Misfortune, poverty, or a time of great need and suffering.
Extreme, double-layered distress or a very complicated, difficult situation.
To cause distress, burden, or to make something intense and difficult.
To make things harder, worsen a situation, or express great wonder.

amharic: ማጭድ መቍረጥ መቈጥቈጥ ያዝመራ የሣር የቅጠል
english: Harvesting, cutting, or the act of gathering crops or grass.
A harvester, someone who cuts, or one who settles matters.
Harvesters or reapers.

Sickles.

Harvested crops or a sheaf of grain.
Courtyards, plots, or rural areas.

amharic: መዝጋት መግጠም መቈለፍ ማተም ማገድ መከልከል
english: To close, lock, seal, or prevent something from entering or leaving.
A door-keeper or one who closes something.
Gate-keepers or closers.
A door, shutter, or wooden board used for closing.
Doors or boards used for locking/closing.
To be closed or shut.
Closed, hidden, or locked.
The act of closing or the state of being closed.
A bone.
To fold, layer, or double up clothing.
One who folds or wraps around oneself.
To be folded, layered, or to wear/wrap oneself in a garment.
Folded, doubled, or dual-layered.
Folding, a way of folding, or the act of wrapping.
A cloak, shawl, or outer garment.
Cloaks or outer garments.
Cloaks or layers (similar to ዐጽፍ).
To grow, bud, or increase in height.
A branch, twig, or tip.
Branches, tips, or fruits.
To press, squeeze, or wring out.
A presser or someone who squeezes out juice.
To be pressed or squeezed.
Pressed juice or the product of pressing.
To harvest or reap.
To be strong, firm, or hardened.
A tree, strong wood, or a plant.
A Persian plant or leaf.
Trees or wooden objects.
The act of casting lots, a share, or a determined fate.

amharic: ዕንጨት፣ ቍጥቋጦ፣ ትንሽ ተክል ወይም ቅጠላ ቅጠል።
english: Wood, a shrub, small plants, or leafy vegetation.
Various types of trees, plants, or shrubs.
To cast lots with others or to share portions.
The method or process of casting lots.
To cause or command that lots be cast.
To become infested with worms or to produce worms.
A worm, maggot, or insect that eats or damages plants.
To become strong, hard, or bone-like.

amharic: ዐጥንት፣ የሰው ወይም የእንስሳ አካል ክፍል፣ ደረቅና ጠንካራ መዋቅር።
english: A bone; the hard, strong structural part of an animal or person.
The plural form of bones or parts of the body.
The state of becoming untied or full of trees/forests.

amharic: ዱር፣ በረሃ፣ ባድማ፣ አራዊት የሚኖሩበት ቦታ።
english: A wilderness, desert, or untamed land where wild animals live.
To guard, protect, watch over, or keep safe.
A guard, caretaker, or someone who keeps watch.
A doctor, healer, or pharmacist who prepares medicines.
A guard or a place where one keeps watch.
Guards or watchmen.
To have something guarded, to entrust, or to set a watchman.
Someone who causes things to be guarded or who holds a trust.
To place something in the care of another or to entrust for safekeeping.
The act of keeping a trust, protection, or stewardship.
To be guarded, to be careful, or to stay away from something bad.
Someone who is careful, watchful, or cautious.
Something kept safe, guarded, or prepared for later use.
A concubine or a woman in a secondary domestic position.
The act of guarding or maintaining protection.
Care, watchfulness, or safety.
To wait for one another or to keep watch together.
To cause others to be cautious or to warn them to keep watch.
A steep slope, an uphill climb, or a mountain path.
A thorn, weed, or troublesome prickly plant.
Thorns or prickly plants.
To tie, plan, or bend something like a bow.
To be planned, tied together, or bent/curved.
Planned, bound, or secured.
The act of binding or a framework of construction.
The design, structure, or way something is built.
A structure, roof support, or an arched frame.
To gather, store up, or enclose with a barrier.
A pond, water reservoir, or swimming place.
Wisdom, intelligence, or deep understanding.
To hold, bind, or keep in place.
One who decides, a judge, or a determiner.
A limit, measure, boundary, or extent.
To be limited, bounded, or held back.
Something decided, selected, or set apart.
A final decision, a rule, or an established order.

amharic: ማርጋት መግፋት መናጥ ቅቤ ማውጣት ማቡካት ማምጠጥ የወተት ያይብ፡፡
english: The process of churning, kneading, or extracting butter and milk products.

amharic: ለጋ ቅቤ እንቋሊት ርጎ (ዘፍ፲፰ ፰፡፡ ምሳ፭ ፳፭)፡፡
english: Fresh butter, curds, or soft dairy products.
The act of causing someone to trip, stumble, or creating an obstacle.
Someone or something that acts as an obstacle or causes others to stumble.
To place an obstacle or cause someone to stumble or fall.
An obstacle, a hurdle, or a stumbling block.
To stumble, trip over, or encounter an obstacle.
Someone who has stumbled or is considered fallen/humbled.
A trap, a stumbling block, or a serious difficulty.

amharic: መሰንከል መሸንከፍ እግርን መያዝ ማሰር መጥለፍ መዘርጠጥ ማንቀፍ፡፡
english: To trip someone, tie their feet, or restrain them physically.
To cause someone to be tripped, bound, or restrained.
To be tripped, bound, or shackled.
The act of tripping or binding someone; a snare.
Spices, herbs, or aromatic ingredients.

amharic: ማቈር መቋጠር ማኖር መክተት መሸጐጥ መታቀፍ፡፡
english: To bundle, tie up, store, or enclose something.
To be bundled, conceived, or set within limits.
Something bundled, tied, or stored away.

amharic: ቋጠሮ ቍጥራት የዐጽቅ ያበባ ችቦ ማቈሪያ መቋጠሪያ ጨርቅ ከረጢት ማድጋ፡፡
english: A bundle, a knot, a storage pouch, or a container.

amharic: ቅመም ጥርቅም የሽቱ የመድኅኒት የሌላውም ኹሉ፡፡
english: Spices, aromatic herbs, or medicinal mixtures.
Scorpions or similar creatures.
Scorpions or thorns (often used metaphorically).

amharic: ኮከብ የኮከብ ስም መልኩ ጊንጥ የሚመስል፡፡
english: The constellation Scorpio.

amharic: መምሸት ሠርክ መኾን መውረድ መዘቅዘቅ መግባት መጥለቅ የፀሓይ፡፡
english: Sunset, evening, or the act of the sun setting.
Evening or sunset.

amharic: ምዕራብ ዐቢይ ማእዝን የምሥራቅ ትይዩና አንጻር የፀሓይ መግቢያ መጥለቂያ መዘቅዘቂያ፡፡
english: The West, the direction of the setting sun.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ በቁሙ፡፡ ፀሓይኒ አእመረ ምዕራቢሁ፡፡ ምዕራበ ፀሓይ፡፡ ኮከበ ምዕራብ
english: The West; where the sun sets.

amharic: ስመ ዕለት ስድስተኛ ቀን በኅሙስና በቀዳም መካከል ያለ፡፡
english: Friday, the sixth day of the week.

amharic: ዐረቢኛ የዐረብ ቋንቋ የግእዝና የዕብራይስጥ የሱርት ወንድም፡፡
english: Arabic, the language related to Ge'ez and Hebrew.

amharic: በቁሙ መያዣ ፈለማ መዠመሪያ የስጦታ ድራር የጸጋ ዋዜማ ከብዙውና ከፍጹሙ ከታላቁ ዋጋ በፊት የሚሰጡት የሚቀበሉት፡፡
english: A deposit, earnest money, or an initial installment.

amharic: በቁሙ መያዣ ፈለማ መዠመሪያ የስጦታ ድራር የጸጋ ዋዜማ ከብዙውና ከፍጹሙ ከታላቁ ዋጋ በፊት የሚሰጡት የሚቀበሉት፡፡
english: A pledge, a down payment, or a promise of future fulfillment.

amharic: መናገጃ ገባያ መደብር፡፡ የንግድ ዕቃ ሸቀጥ፡፡
english: A marketplace or trading goods/merchandise.
A desert or plain.

amharic: ኵሓ ችባሓ ወንዝ አድምቅ የመሰለው ኹሉ፡፡
english: Cosmetics, paint, or embellishments.

amharic: ማረግ ከፍ ከፍ ማለት ከታች ወደ ላይ ወደ ሰማይ መውጣት፡፡
english: To ascend, go up, or climb to a higher place.
One who ascends or climbs upward.
Ascended, exalted, or accepted (often used for prayers).
Ascension or the act of going up.

amharic: ማዕጠንትን በመሥዋዕቱ ላይ ሦስት ጊዜ ማዞር ኹለተኛም ጢሱን ታፍኖ መሥዋቱን በእጅ ማጠን፡፡
english: The ritual of offering incense, typically during worship.
The ritual presentation or offering of the Eucharist.

amharic: አሳረገ ወደ ላይ አወጣ ከፍ ከፍ አደረገ፡፡
english: To lift up, elevate, or cause to ascend.

amharic: ማረጊያ መውጫ መረጋገጫ መሰላል ዕርከን ደረጃ እንደ ጣት መቀዳደምና መከታተል መበላለጥ ያለው ውስጠ ብዙ ሥራው የመሥመር ዐይነት ርስ በርሱ የተያያዘ ደረገን ተመልከት፡፡
english: A staircase, steps, or a rank/level in a sequence.

amharic: ዳገት ዐቀበት የተራራ መንገድ ሽቅብ የሚወስድ፡፡
english: An incline, a mountain path, or an upward slope.
Cedar tree.

amharic: ማልበስ ልብስ መስጠት፡፡ ወመዋጥሕየ፡፡ አውፅአ ሎሙ ዘይዔርዞሙ፡፡ አልባስ ወክዳናት ዘዐረዘቶን ዶርቃስ (ቀሌ፡፡ ሆሴ፪ ፯፡፡ ፬ነገ ፲ ፳፪፡፡ ግብ፱ ፴፱)፡፡
english: The act of clothing someone or providing garments.

amharic: ለበሰ ልብስ አገኘ ተቀበለ ልብሰ ዚኣነ ንትዔረዝ፡፡ ሀበኒ ዘእበይት ወእትዔረዝ፡፡ ተዐሪዞ ሃይማኖተ ክርስቶስ (ኢሳ፬ ፩፡፡ ቀሌ፡፡ አርጋ ፩፡፡ ስንክ ሠኔ፲፩)፡፡
english: To wear clothes or to receive/put on garments.

amharic: የለበሰ ልቡስ፡፡ ኵሎኡ እሊኣሃ ዕሩዛን እሙንቱ (ምሳ፳፱ ፴፱፡፡ ዲድ ፫)፡፡
english: One who is clothed or dressed.

amharic: ልብስ የውስጥ ቀሚስ ገላ ነክ፡፡ ሲሳየነ ወዐራዘነ፡፡ ተካፈሉ አልባስየ ወተዓፀዉ ዲበ ዐራዝየ፡፡ አባ ሙሴ ረስየ ቈጽለ ሆሳዕና ዐራዞ፡፡ አልባስ ወዐራዛት (፩ጢሞ ፮ ፰፡፡ መዝ ፳፩፡፡ ስንክ መስ፫፡፡ ፍ ነ ፲ ፮)፡፡
english: Clothing, undergarments, or attire that touches the body.

amharic: ጥብቆ ቀሚስ የሚጠለቅ የሚቈለፍ፡፡ እስመ ኮነት ትዕዝርቱ ኅልቅተ፡፡ ኮነ ትዕርዝቶሙ እምአምእስተ አባግዕ (ፊልክ ፶፮ና ፹፱)፡፡
english: A tight-fitting or buttoned garment.

amharic: በቁሙ ከሳ ቀጠነ መነመነ ሰለሰለ አነሰ ኰሰሰ ሣሣ፡፡ እንጀራ ዐርዟል ወጥ ዐርዟል ጨምሩ እንዲሉ፡፡ ግስነቱ ያማርኛ እንጂ የግእዝ አይዶለም፡፡
english: To become thin, frail, or weak; to diminish in size or substance.

amharic: ታረዘ ዕርዝተኛ ኾነ ተራቈተ ልብስ ምግብ ዐጣ ተቸገረ፡፡
english: To become needy, destitute, or lack clothing and food.

amharic: ክሳት ቅጥነት ቀጠና ዕርዝታ ችጋር ዕጦት ድኽነት፡፡ (ተረት) በርግዝና ላይ ዕርግዝና፡፡
english: Thinness, frailty, poverty, or lack of necessities.
To gather or collect.

amharic: ገቢርና ዐጕል፡፡ መደልደል ማስተካከል ቀጥ ለጥ ማድረግ፡፡ ጺሑ ፍኖቶ ወዐርዩ መጽያሕቶ፡፡ ከመ ተዐርዪ ልበ፡፡ ዐርዪ ግዕዝ፡፡ እስመ ኮנה ዐርዮ በማእከሎሙ (ኢሳ፵ ፫፡፡ ፩ጴጥ ፫ ፰፡፡ ሄርማ፡፡ ኩፋ ፴፮)፡፡
english: To straighten, align, or level; the act of making something straight.

amharic: የተካከለ የተመሳሰለ ትክክል አንድ ዐይነት፡፡ አእመረ ከመ ውእቱ ዕሩይ ምስለ ኵሎሙ አርድእት፡፡ ዘዕሩይ ምስለ አብ በመለኮቱ፡፡ መፍትው ለነ ንመጽውት ላዕለ ኵሉ በዕሩይ እንዘ ኢንሌሊ ጽኑሳን፡፡ ዕሩየ ተጸልኡ በኅበ እግዚ ረሲዕኒ ወርስዓኑ (ፈ መ ፫ ፮፡፡ ቅዳ፡፡ አፈ ተ፲፡፡ ጥበ፲፬ ፱)፡፡
english: Equal, equivalent, uniform, or balanced.

amharic: መተካከል እኩያ አምሳያ መኾን፡፡ ኢይከውን ድልዉ ዕርየት ምስለ ባሕታውያን (ፊልክ ፫)፡፡
english: Equality, similarity, or the state of being balanced.

amharic: እኩያ መሰል አምሳያ፡፡ ወከመ ዕራይሁ ለቀዳማይ ነገር ንሌብዎ ለዝንቱኒ (ቄር)፡፡
english: A counterpart, equal, or likeness.

amharic: መተካከል አንድነት ትክክልነት አለመበላለጥ፡፡ ዘኢየአምን በአካላተ ሥሉስ አው ዘኢየአምን ዕሪናሆሙ በባሕርይ ወባምላክና፡፡ አዘዘ አክብሮቶሙ በዕሪና፡፡ እፎ ትከውን ክብር በዕሪና፡፡ ለይረሱ በዕሪና (ፈ መ ፳፯ ፯፡፡ ዮሴፍ፡፡ አፈ ድ፴፫፡፡ ፍ ነ ፵፪ ፬)፡፡
english: Equality, unity, or fairness.
A state of balance or regularity (specifically regarding time).

amharic: ጌጥ ሽልማት የወርቅ የብር መሣሪያ ሥራው ከምሳሌው የተካከለ፡፡ ኪራስን እይ፡፡
english: An ornament, jewelry, or finely crafted metalwork.

amharic: አሳከለ አስመስለ ወይም አስተካከለ አመሳሰለ ኹሉም አድራጊ ነው፡፡ አዔረየ እንደ አምረየ በጸያፍ ገብቷል አያሰኝም፡፡ ያዔሪ ርእሶ ምስለ እግዚ፡፡ ጳውሎስ አዔረየ ርእሶ ምስለ ሕዋርያት፡፡ አዔረዮ ምስለ አቡሁ (ዮሐ፭ ፲፰፡፡ አፈ ድ፩፡፡ ፪)፡፡
english: To make equal, to liken, or to balance something.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ፡፡ አስተዐረይኮሙ ምስሌነ፡፡ ያስተዔርዮ ለአብ በወልዱ (ማቴ፳ ፲፪፡፡ አፈ ድ፬)፡፡
english: To reconcile, compare, or harmonize.

amharic: ተካከለ ተመሳሰለ፡፡ በይእቲ ዕለት ይትዔረይ መዓልት ምስለ ሌሊት፡፡ አልቦ ዘይትዔረዮ ለቅንአት፡፡ ወኢይትዔረዮ ዕፀ ቈጽርስስ (ሔኖ፸፪ ፳፡፡ ምሳ፳፯ ፬፡፡ ሕዝ፴፩ ፰)፡፡ ኹለተኛም ታከለ ተመስለ ሌላው እኩያው አከለው መሰለው ያሰኛል መተካከል የጋራ ነውና፡፡
english: To be equal, to resemble, or to match.

amharic: ትክክል እኩያ አምሳያ፡፡ በኅሊናስ ኮኑ መዐርያነ፡፡ ዘይሜህር ዘእንበለ ይስአሎ መዐርይ ውእቱ ምስለ ዘይዘልፎ፡፡ አንተ መሲሑ ወመዐርዩ ለእግዚ (ፊልክ ፩፡፡ ፪፻፳፱፡፡ ስንክ ታኅ፳፱)፡፡
english: An equal, a peer, or a match.

amharic: አስተካከለ አበጃጀ አዘጋጀ፡፡ እወ እግዚኦ ፍታሕ ወአግዕዝ ቀድስ ወአምዕዝ አንጽሕ ወአጽሪ አሠኒ ወአማዕሪ እሎንተ አግብርቲከ ወአእማቲከ (ግንዘ)፡፡
english: To arrange, prepare, or put in order.
Beautiful or goodly.

amharic: መሰደር መደርደር ማነጣጠር በያምሳያው በያኳያው ማኖር ፊት ለፊት ጐን ለጐን ወይም ላይና ታች፡፡
english: To arrange, line up, or organize in a specific order or position.

amharic: ተወዳጀ ተዛመደ ተቀናጀ ተጣመረ ተባበረ ተመሳሰለ በመልክ በግብር፡፡ እመ ትትዓረክ ዐርክ ተዓርክ በመዋዕለ ተጽናስከ፡፡ ዚተዓረኮ ለዕቡይ ይከውን ከማሁ፡፡ በአይቴ ይትዓረክ መቅፁት ምስለ ጽህርት ተኵላ ምስለ በግዕ (ሢራ፮ ፯፡፡ ፲፫ ፩-፪ ፲፯)፡፡
english: To befriend, bond with, or join in fellowship.

amharic: ወዳ ባለሟል ባልንጀራ ዐብሮ አደግ እኩያ አምሳያ ጓደኛ ቤተ ሰብ ሎሌ ገረድ መንፈሳዊ ዘመድ የጡት ያደራ የክርስትና ልጅ አበ ልጅ፡፡ አብርሃም ዐርከ እግዚ፡፡ ዐርክ ምእምን፡፡ እመ ቦ፡ ዘወድቀ ዐርክ ምስለ ዐርክቱ፡፡ ዐርካነ እግዚእ፡፡ ዐርካት ዘጥምቀተ ክርስትና (ኩፋ ፲፱፡፡ ሢራ፮ ፬፡፡ ቄድር፡፡ ቅዳ ግሩ፡፡ ፍ ነ ፵፰)፡፡
english: A friend, companion, or confidant.

amharic: ወዳጆች ባልንጀሮች፡፡ ብዙኃን ይኩኑከ አዕርክት፡፡ ጸላእትኒ አዕርክተ ይከውኑ፡፡ ህየንተ አዕርክቲሁ (ሢራ፮ ፮፡፡ ምሳ፲፭ ፳፰፡፡ ዮሐ፲፭ ፲፫)፡፡
english: Friends or companions.

amharic: አወዳጀ አዛመደ አመሳሰለ አስተካከለ፡፡ መኑ ያስተዓርኮ ለነዳይ ምስለ ባዕል (ሢራ፲፫ ፲፫)፡፡
english: To bring together, reconcile, or make friends.

amharic: የስንክሳር መርገፍ ምስጢሩ ያነኑ እናቱን የሚመስል፡፡
english: Someone who resembles their mother.

amharic: የተክል ዕንጨት ስም ኤላጤን እይ ከዚህ ጋራ ፩ ነው፡፡ አክዋል ዘዐርሞን (መቃ ገ፫፡፡ ድጓ)፡፡
english: A type of plant or tree (also known as Elaten).

amharic: የወይን ዳስ የዳስ ዐይነት ድንኳን፡፡ ወገብረ ላቲ ዐሪሠ ውስተ ናሕስ ቤት (ዮዲ፰ ፭)፡፡ ባለብሉዮች ግን ጐዦ ምግላል ቦታ የጾም በኣት ይሉታል፡፡
english: A canopy, tent, or arbor (often used for vines or spiritual retreat).

amharic: ማረፍ መተንፈስ ጸጥ ማለት አለመታወክ ቦታ ይዞ መቆም መቀመጥ መደገፍ መተኛት መሞት ማንቀላፋት ሀድአንና ንህየን ተመልከት፡፡ መጽሐፍ ግን በዐረፈ ፈንታ አሳረፈ ይላል አያሰኝም፡፡ አዕረፈ እምኵሉ ግብሩ፡፡ ከመ ያዕርፍ እምጻማሆሙ፡፡ እምብብ ከመ ኣዕርፍ፡፡ አዕረፈት ምድር እምነ ቀትል፡፡ አዕረፈት ታቦት ዲበ ርእሰ ሉባር፡፡ ኑሙ ወአዕርፋ፡፡ ወአዕረፈ ምስለ አበዊሁ አኅዊክሙ እለ አዕረፋ በሃይማኖተ ክርስቶስ (ዘፍ፪፡ ፪፡፡ ራእ፲፬፡፲፫፡፡ ኢዮ፴፪፡ ፳፡፡ ኢያ፲፩፡ ፳፫፡፡ ኩፋ፡ ፭፡፡ ማቴ፳፮፡ ፵፭፡፡ ሢራ፵፯፡ ፳፫፡፡ ዲድ፡ ፴፬)፡፡
english: To rest, relax, cease activity, or be calm.

amharic: ያረፈ ጸጥ ያለ የረጋ፡፡ ዕሩፈ ይነብር፡፡ ከመ ይኩን ልብየ ዕሩፈ በላዕሌክሙ (ኢሳ፴ ፱፡፡ ፩ዜና ፲፪ ፲፯፡፡ መዝ ፺፩)፡፡
english: Restful, calm, or peaceful.

amharic: በቁሙ ማረፍ ዕርፊት ሞት፡፡ መካነ ዕረፍት፡፡ ንባእ ውስተ ዕረፍቱ፡፡ ሠለስቱ ዕረፍታት፡፡ ሶበ በጽሐ ጊዜ ዕረፍቱ ለአዳም (ሱቱ ዕዝ፮ ፩፡፡ ዕብ፬ ፩ ፫፡፡ አፈ ድ፮)፡፡
english: Rest, a place of rest, or passing away.

amharic: አሳረፈ ዕረፍት ሰጠ ቦታ አዘጋጀ፡፡ ያረውጾን ወኢያዐርፎን፡፡ አዕርፋ ለነፍስየ፡፡ ያዐርፉ ለእሙ፡፡ ወአዕረፈ ሊተ ፈጣሪየ መንበርየ (ሄርማ፡፡ ፊልሞ ፳፡፡ ሢራ፫ ፮፡፡ ፳፬ ፰)፡፡
english: To provide rest, give peace, or prepare a place.

amharic: ማረፊያ መሳረፊያ መኖሪያ መቀመጫ ቦታ ሰፈር፡፡ ይከውን ክቡረ ምዕራፊሁ፡፡ ይእኅዝ ጽድቅ ምዕራፈ፡፡ ዛቲ ይእቲ ምዕራፍየ፡፡ ከመ ይኩን ምዕራፈ ስሙ ለሥሉስ (ኢሳ፲፩ ፲፡፡ ፴፪ ፲፯፡፡ መዝ ፻፴፩፡፡ ቀሌ፡፡ ዘኍ፲ ፴፫)፡፡
english: A resting place, dwelling, or residence.

amharic: ሐሜለት በናኖት በርኖስ የላይ የልብስ፡፡ ኤልሳዕ ሶበ ወረወ ላዕሌሁ ምዕራፊቶ ኤልያስ ኅደገ ዓለመ ወተለዎ (ፊልክ ፭፡፡ ፫ነገ ፲፱ ፲፫)፡፡ ዕራፊ ማለት ከዚህ ወጥቷል፡፡
english: A cloak, outer garment, or mantle.
To end the day or settle down (as in the sun setting).

amharic: መቅጃ መጨለፊያ ማንካ ጭልፍ፡፡ የዕጣን የቍርባን መሣሪያ ጌታ የተወጋበት የጦር ምሳሌ ትእምርተ መስቀል ያለበት፡፡ ግበር እዴከ ላዕለ ዛቲ ዕርፈ መስቀል ለሠሪዐ ሥጋሁ ወደሙ፡፡ ዲያቆን ኢያጥምቅ ወኢያቅርብ በእዴሁ ዘእንበለ እምጽዋዕ በዕርፈ መስቀል፡፡ ዕርፍ ማንካው መስቀል መያዣው (ሥር ቅዳ፡፡ ፈ መ ፴፩ ፪)፡፡
english: A ladle, scoop, or liturgical spoon used in church.
Plural of plow handles or scoops.

geez: ዐረፍት ግድግዳ አረፍ አረፍት፡፡ ዐሪቆ ቆት
amharic: መራቈት መገፈፍ መገለጥ ባዶ መኾን ብቻ መቅረት፡፡ ዐረቁ ወአልበስክሙኒ፡፡ ዝቅተ ወይንነ ዐርቀ ወበልየ፡፡ ዐርቀ፡፡ ኵሉ አህጉር፡፡ ዐርቀት እንተ ሰብዐተ ወለደት (ማቴ፳፭ ፴፮፡፡ ኢሳ፱ ፲፩፡፡ ኤር፬ ፳፱፡፡ ፲፭ ፱)፡፡ በዐርቀ ፈንታ ተዐርቀ ይላል አያሰኝም፡፡ ትሰክሪ ወትትዐረቂ፡፡ ቀሲስ ለእመ ሰክረ ወተዐርቀ አባሉ በቅድመ ሰብእ፡፡ ተዐርቁ እምሠናያት ዘተውህቦሙ፡፡ ተዐርቀት ሀገር እምነ ዕደዉ፡፡ ከዋክብት እምዕበየ ብርሀኖሙ ተዐርቁ (ስቈ፬ ፳፩፡፡ ፈ መ ፴፪ ፭፡፡ አፈ ድ፳፪፡፡ ዮሴፍ፡፡ ቅዳ ጎር)፡፡ መሳብ መውዛት ዐረቂ ማውጣት፡፡
english: To be stripped naked, exposed, or left bare.

amharic: ወዝ ላበት የደም ዐረቂ፡፡ የሚያስክር መጠጥ ከበለስ ከወይን ከሌላም አትክልት የሚወጣ ወዳጁን ገዳይ ጠላቱ ፈሪ ሽያጩን አክባሪ፡፡
english: Sweat, blood, or distilled alcoholic spirits.

amharic: የተራቈተ የተገለጠ የታረዘ የተገረፈ ግንዱን መለመላውን የኾነ፡፡ ዕሩቅ ወዕዉር፡፡ ኢይኩን ዕሩቀ አባል ቅድመ መኑሂ፡፡ ወልብስየኒ ለዕሩቃን፡፡ ኮኑ ዕሩቃነ እምጸጋ ዘላዕሌሆሙ (ራእ፫ ፲፯፡፡ ፈ መ ፴፪ ፫፡፡ ጦቢ፩ ፲፯፡፡ ቀሌ)፡፡
english: Naked, exposed, or stripped bare.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ ዕራቍት ግንድ መለመላ ባዶ ብቻ ልብስ ጭማሪ አልባ፡፡ ዕራቅየ ወፃእኩ እምከርሠ እምየ ወዕራቀከ ዘእንበለ አሣእን፡፡ ወአሦጡ ቀሣውስቲሆሙ ዕራቆ፡፡ ዘዕራቁ ለእለ ዕራቆሙ፡፡ ኢትስተይ ማየ ዕራቁ፡፡ ተጠምቀ በማይ ዕራቁ ጳውሎስ ሳሚሳጢ ይቤ እስመ ክርስቶስ ሰብእ ዕራቁ ብቻ (ኢዮ፩ ፳፩፡፡ ኢሳ፳ ፪፡፡ ኤር፲፬ ፫፡፡ ሱቱ ዕዝ፭ ፳፭፡፡ ፩ጢሞ ፭ ፳፫፡፡ መጽ ምስ፡፡ ፍ ነ መቅ)፡፡ ኢምንት በማለት ፈንታ ዕራቅ ይላል ምስጢሩ አንድ ነው፡፡ ስቀላ ለምድር ዲበ ዕራቃ (ኢዮ፳፮ ፯)፡፡
english: Bareness, nudity, or lacking covering.

amharic: በቁሙ ዕራቍት ዕራቍትነት፡፡ ባዶነት ንጽሕና፡፡ (ግጥም) እኔ ድኻ መስሎኝ ዕርቃኑን ባየው ርሱስ ጌታ ኑሯል የተሰቀለው፡፡ ሀበኒ እክድን ዕርቃኖ በልብስ ለዘከደነ ዕርቃንየ ዮርዳኖስ (ድጓ)፡፡ ከመ ይኩን ሎቱ ዕርቃን ለገቢረ ኵሉ ትእዛዛት፡፡ ዕርቃኖሙ ለሕፃናት እምኅሊናት ሕሥሥት (ፊልክ ፵፬፡፡ ፪፻፴፭)፡፡
english: Nakedness or emptiness.

amharic: ዕራቁትነት ዕርዝታ፡፡ በረኅብ ወጽምእ ወበዕርቅና (ዘዳ፳፰ ፵፰)፡፡
english: State of nakedness or extreme poverty.
To strip, empty, or remove clothes from someone.
To bend, straighten, or align something that was crooked.
A peacemaker; one who helps others settle their arguments.
The act of making peace or reconciliation.
To become bent, straightened, or settled.

amharic: ታረቀ ተራረቀ ተስማማ አንድ ልብ ኾነ፡፡
english: To reconcile, agree, or become friends again.
Peace, harmony, or a formal agreement between people.
To cause others to make peace or agree.

amharic: ርሳስ የማዕድናት ወገን ጥቍር ከባድ ልሕሉሕነት ያለው፡፡
english: Lead; a heavy, soft, dark metal.
A trellis or arbor for grapevines.

amharic: ዐልጋ መተኛ መጋደሚያ ቈጥ የሬሳ ማንሻ አራት እግር ያለው፡፡
english: A bed or a four-legged frame for sleeping.

amharic: ዐስብ ክራይ መስጠት የጕልበት ዋጋ መክፈል፡፡
english: To hire, rent, or pay wages for work.

amharic: አከራየ ለክራይ ሰጠ ቤቱን ክብቱን ወይም ጕልበቱን፡፡
english: One who rents out something or employs others.
To be hired or rented out.
A hired worker, laborer, or employee.
Relating to hired labor or a skilled professional.

amharic: የጕልበት ዋጋ ደመ ወዝ ምንዳ ክራይ፡፡
english: Wages, payment for work, or rent.
A fortune-teller or soothsayer.
Single or unmarried people.
A group of single, unmarried, or monastic people.
To live alone or remain single.
The state of being single or living alone.

amharic: ዋጋ መስጠት ማደል መክፈል ብድር መመለስ አብዝቶ አትርፎ፡፡
english: To reward, pay back, or give generously.

amharic: የሚሠጥ ሰጭ ቸር ለጋስ እጀ ሰፊ ዐዳይ አሳላፊ፡፡
english: A generous giver or a benefactor.
To receive a reward or payment.
A gift or a reward given to someone.

amharic: መሥራት መመታት መጥለፍ ማቈላለፍ ልብስን በወርቅ ማስጌጥ፡፡
english: To craft, weave, or decorate fabric with gold or embroidery.

amharic: ልብስ የሚሠራ ጥበብ ድርብ ሠሪ ሸማኔ ጠላፊ፡፡
english: A skilled weaver or embroiderer.
To be woven or decorated intricately.

amharic: የታሰቀ ክክታን ከሐር ዕጥፍ ድርብ ኹኖ የተሠራ፡፡
english: Something intricately woven or embroidered with silk or gold.

amharic: ጥሩ ግንጃ ክቡር ልብስ ዝንጕ ርጕር ባላራት ሕብር ወርቀ ዘቦ የተጌጠ፡፡
english: A precious, decorative, or brightly colored garment.
A bishop.
To bind, tie, or imprison.
To seal, mark, or complete.
To be sealed, marked, or blessed.
Sealed or clearly defined.
A thing that is sealed.

amharic: ማተብ መታተብ ማማተብ በአንብሮተ እድ መባረክ፡፡
english: A blessing, a seal, or the act of marking with a sign of a cross.
A blessing or benediction.
A decorative cross marking or embroidery on a garment.
To make the sign of the cross.
To be marked with a sign or receive a blessing.

amharic: መቄጣት መናደድ እንደሚጤስ እሳት ቱግ ማለት፡፡
english: To be enraged, furious, or smoking with anger.

amharic: በቁሙ እኽል ፍሬው ክብ እንክብል ድብልብል፡፡
english: A small, round, ball-shaped edible bean or pea.

amharic: ዐሥራ ሰባተኛ ፊደል በግእዝ እልፍ ቤት በአበገደ ስሙ ፈፍ ቍጥሩ ሰማንያ አኃዝ ሲኾን ፈ ፹ ይባላል፡፡
english: The 17th letter of the Ge'ez alphabet, representing the number 80.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ ስመ ፊደል ፲፯ኛ ፈ ፍችው አፍ ማለት ነው፡፡
english: The 17th letter of the alphabet, which specifically represents the word 'mouth'.

amharic: ማጕረሥ ባፍ መወተፍ መክተት መዶል ማግባት ማብላት ማዋጥ ቈርሶ መስጠት መዘከር፡፡
english: The act of feeding, placing food into the mouth, or sharing a meal.
Someone who feeds others; a person who provides food.
To cause to eat; to feed someone else.
To be fed; to have food put into the mouth.
To feed one another.
The collar or neck opening of a garment.
Feeding or providing food, usually for the hungry.
Offerings or gifts of food.
To beg for food or ask to be fed.
To assist or cause others to share food with one another.

amharic: መተንፈግ መከርፋት መቀርናት መግማት መሻገት መፋግ ፍግ መኾን፡፡
english: The state of being smelly, rotten, or musty.
Having a very foul or unpleasant smell.

amharic: ትንፋግ ክርፋት ቅርናት ግማት ክፉ ሽታ፡፡
english: A foul or bad smell.

amharic: ፈጀ ጨረሰ በላ አቃጠለ ለበለበ አንገበገበ፡፡
english: To burn, consume, or destroy with fire.

amharic: በቁሙ ዐዛባ ኵስሕ ከሕያዋን ሆድ የሚወጣ ፍጉገ ጺና፡፡
english: Animal waste or dung.

amharic: ፍጹም ተድላ ማድረግ መፍካት መፈንደቅ ደስ ፈቅ ማለት ከመብል ከመጠጥ ከምቾት ከብዕል ብዛት የተነሣ፡፡
english: To feel great happiness, joy, or satisfaction, often from luxury or abundance.
Someone who is joyful, comfortable, or prosperous.
A state of over-indulgence or being filled to excess.
Delight, joy, or physical comfort.
The state of being happy or delighted.
Great pleasure or physical enjoyment.
To give someone joy or provide comfort.

amharic: መፏገር መፍገርገር መፍጨርጨር ለመውጣት፡፡ መድከም ማረፍ መሞት ሬሳ መኾን፡፡
english: To struggle, become exhausted, or die.

amharic: ሕገ ጣዖት መካና ጣዖት ፍችው ከሢት ፈቲሕ ከሢተ ዕርቃን ፈቲሐ አፍ፡፡
english: A specific idol name or pagan deity associated with shameful or immodest behavior.

amharic: ዕዳ መክፈል ብድር መመለስ ዋጋ መስጠት፡፡
english: To pay a debt, repay a loan, or compensate.
A person who pays back a debt.

amharic: ጥሩ ብር ወርቅ ገንዘብ የሚያበድሩት የሚከፍሉት፡፡
english: Currency or wealth used for payment.
The means or process of payment.
To force or require someone to pay a debt.
To have been paid or received what is owed.
Payment, compensation, or a share.

amharic: በቁሙ በቀል ዋጋ ብድር ብድራት ፍርድ ቅጣት፡፡
english: Punishment, retribution, or the price paid for an action.
To choose, set aside, or distinguish something.

amharic: በቁሙ ልዩ ምርጥ ዘር ቀለም ምልክት አምሳል የድምፅና የቃል መልክ ሥዕል መግለጫ፡፡
english: A character, letter, or symbol that represents a sound.
To be abundant or to exceed a limit.
Something extra, a surplus, or an abundance.

amharic: መፈድፈድ መብዛት ከስፍር ከቍጥር ከልክ ከመጠን ማለፍ መትረፍ፡፡
english: To be very numerous, abundant, or overflowing.
Abundant, plentiful, or complete.

amharic: ብዛት መብዛት አበዛዝ ብልጫ ላቂያ ትርፍ፡፡
english: An abundance, surplus, or excess.
Greatness or a state of being very abundant.
Strength or a significant amount.
Very much, exceedingly, or more than enough.
To increase, strengthen, or make more abundant.
One who increases or something that is very numerous.

amharic: ማፋቅ ሕቅ ሕቅ ማለት ወደ ላይ መተንፈስ፡፡
english: Hiccuping or a gasping sound when breathing.
Someone who hiccups.
The sound or action of hiccuping.
To hiccup or to scrub/scrape something.
To dig into the ground.

amharic: የገጽና የምዕራፍ ማውጫ ምልክት፡፡ የሃይማኖተ አበው ታሪክ አንቀጽ በእንተ እገሌ እያለ ሊቃውንቱን በተራ የሚጥፍ፡፡
english: A table of contents, index, or a list of book sections and chapters.
Rotten or decayed.

amharic: መወልወል መሰንገል እድፉን ዝገቱን መጥረግ መፈግፈግ ማደስ መኵላት ፈጽሞ ማጥራት የወርቅ የብር የማዕድናት (አርጋ ፫ና ፭)፡፡
english: To polish, clean, or refine metals like gold and silver until they are shiny.

amharic: አፌዝ ቄፋዝ ጥሩ ወርቅ የአፌዝን ፍች ተመልከት፡፡ ወርቅ ለገንዘብ ኹሉ ይነገራል ስምነቱ አስተጋባኢ ነው ፋዝ ነው ለወርቅ ብቻ ነው ያውም ለጥሩው ለመዠመሪያው፡፡ የግእዝ መላሾች በቡዙ ቦታ ይልቁንም ከወርቅ ጋራ በሚጫፈርበት ዕንቍ ብልውታል፡፡ እምወርቅ ወእምዕንቍ፡፡ አክሊለ ዘእምዕንቍ (መዝ ፲፰፡፡ ፳፡፡ ምሳ፰ ፲፱)፡፡
english: High-quality, pure gold or a precious gem.

amharic: የሰው ስም (ጥሩ ወርቅ ማለት ይመስላል)፡፡ ወእምዝ ሖረ ኅበ ፉዝ ንጉሠ ህንደኬ ወቦቱ ለፉዝ ንጌያት መስተቃትላን (ዜና እስ)፡፡
english: A proper name, likely meaning 'pure gold'.
Fortune-telling or asking a diviner for a prediction.

amharic: ጠነቈለ አሟረተ፡፡ መሠርይ ወዘይትፋወል በፍሬ ዕፀው ወዛጐል ዲበ ሐመድ፡፡ ኢትኩን እምእለ የዐቅቡ ሰዓታተ ወኅራይያነ ዕለታት ወኢረኣዬ ከዋክብት ወኢእምእለ ይትፋወሉ (ፍ ነ ፲፩ ፩ና ፫)፡፡
english: To practice divination or fortune-telling.

amharic: ገድ መላ ጥንቈላ ሟርት በፍሬ በቅንጣት በጠጠር በዛጐል የሚኾን ሰውን ወደ አምልኮ ባዕድ የሚስብ የሰይጣን ፋሎ ወይም ልባብ ፋሎ ጋልኛ ነው፡፡ ፋላ ፊት ፋሎ የፊት፡፡ ቦ፡ እምኔሆሙ ሰብአ ፋል፡፡ አጽምዖ ፋል፡፡ አሕላም ወፋላት ከንቱ እሙንቱ ወሐሰት (ገድ ተክ፡፡ ቀሌ፡፡ ፈላስ)፡፡
english: Fortune-telling, superstition, or omens using items like pebbles or shells.
Thick or rich soil.

amharic: ባቄላ የባቄላ ዐይነት መላው ያበባ እኽል ኹሉ በውስጥ መንታነት ያለው የሚከካ የሚገመስ የሚፈለጥ የሚፈለቀጥ ቈርበታም ሟርተኞች እንዳሸዋና እንደ ጠጠር እያፈሡ እየበተኑ እየቃሙ እየተገሙ ፉል የሚያደርጉበት፡፡ ሖመርን ተመልከት ፉል በማለት ፈንታ ፉል ይላል የጣፊ ስሕተት ነው፡፡ ፉል ብሂል ባቄላ (ጥሬ ሰዋ)፡፡ ወብርስነ (ሕዝ፬ ፱)፡፡
english: A bean, specifically a fava bean.
Beans or flowering legumes.

amharic: ጕሬዛ ጠጕራም ነጭና ጥቍር ጭራው ፍጹም ነጭ የጦጣ ወገን በዛፍ ላይ የሚኖር ከዛፍ ወደ ዛፍ የሚዘል የሚወረወር፡፡ የጕሬዛ ዐይነት ወፍ ጕሬዝማ አሞራ፡፡ በፎቃንስ ፍነታ ፎንቃስ ይላል ከፊንክስ ጋራ ይስማማል፡፡ ፎንቃስ ወቋዓት (ሔኖ፹፱ ፲)፡፡
english: A colobus monkey, known for its long, flowing fur.

amharic: መፈወስ ማዳን ማሻር መድኅኒት መስጠት፡፡ ዐቃቤ ሥራይ ፈውስ ርእስከ፡፡ ከመ እፈውስከ፡፡ እፌውስክሙ ቍስለክሙ፡፡ ፈውስናሃ ለባቢሎን ወኢሐይወት፡፡ መኑ ይፌውስኪ (ሉቃ፬ ፳፫፡፡ ጦቢ፲፪ ፲፬፡፡ ኤር፫ ፳፪፡፡ ፳፰ ፱፡፡ ስቈ፪ ፲፫)፡፡
english: The act of healing, curing, or providing medicine.

amharic: የሚፈውስ ፈዋሽ ሐኪም፡፡ ፈዋሲሁ ለልብየ፡፡ ፈዋሴ ዱያን በንፍኅቱ (ኪዳ፡፡ ደራሲ)፡፡
english: A healer or a doctor.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ፡፡ መፈውስ ልብ፡፡ መፈውስ ልሳን ዕፀ ሕይወት፡፡ መፈውሰ ነፍስ ወመፈውስ ሥጋ፡፡ ካህናትኒ ለነፍስ መፈውሳን (ምሳ፲፬ ፴፡፡ ፲፭ ፬፡፡ ቅዳ መስተ፡፡ ተረ ቄር፩)፡፡
english: A medicine, remedy, or source of healing.

amharic: መካነ ፈውስ ቤተ ድዉያን ቤተ ክሲያን ጠበል ምዎት ፍል ውሃ፡፡ ቦ፡ እለ መጽኡ ውስተ ምፍዋስ ዘቤተ ክርስቲያን፡፡ ከመ ይስአሉ ዘእምኅቤከ ርቅየተ ወሕይወተ፡፡ ወሀውስተ ኢየሩሳሌም ምጥማቃት (ተረ ቄር፲፱፡፡ ሊጦን፡፡ ዮሐ፭ ፪-፬)፡፡
english: A place of healing, such as a holy water site or a hospital.

amharic: አስፈወሰ መድኅኒት አስደረገ፡፡ አፈውሶ እምለምጹ (፬ነገ ፭ ፮)፡፡
english: To cause someone to be healed.

amharic: በቁሙ ዳነ ሻረ ታከመ መድኅኒት ተደረገለት፡፡ ወለእለሂ ይፈቅዱ ይትፈወሱ አሕየዎሙ፡፡ ከመ ይትፈወስ እምቍስሉ፡፡ ተፈወሰ ውእቱ ማይ፡፡ ሀለወ ይትፌወስ ንድፈቶ፡፡ እንበለ ትሕምም ተፈወስ (ሉቃ፱ ፲፩፡፡ ፩ዜና ፳፪ ፮፡፡ ፬ነገ ፪ ፳፪፡፡ ፱ ፲፮፡፡ ሢራ፲፰ ፲፱)፡፡
english: To be healed or to recover from an illness.

amharic: የተፈወሰ የታከመ የሻረ የዳነ ደኅና ባለጤና፡፡
english: Healed, cured, or healthy.

amharic: ፈውስ ማግኘት መፈወስ አፈዋ ወስ ፍወሳ፡፡
english: Recovery or the process of obtaining a cure.

amharic: በቁሙ መልካም መድኅኒት የሚያድን የሚያሽር፡፡ ለገቢር ፈውስ፡፡ ፍሬሁ ለሲሳይ ወቈጽሉ ለፈውስ፡፡ አልባቲ ፈውስ ለቍስላ፡፡ ፈውስ ደዌሆሙ (አፈ ተ፱፡፡ ሕዝ፵፯ ፲፪፡፡ ሢራ፳፩ ፫፡፡ ኩፋ፲)፡፡
english: A good medicine or a remedy that heals.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ የመጽሐፍ ስም የቀኖና መጽሐፍ፡፡
english: A spiritual healing or the title of a religious book.

amharic: ሳተ ከሕግ ከመንገድ ወታ ጌገየን እይ፡፡
english: To go astray or lose one's way.

amharic: አዝመራ ሴት ጋለሞታ ስታ የምታስት የምታሳስት፡፡
english: A person who leads others astray or misleads.

amharic: የሞተች ነፍሷ የወጣ ሙት፡፡ ይችውም ባሕረ ጼው ናት፡፡ እምባሕረ ፍሕሕት እስከ ቤተ ሶን (ኩፋ ፳፱)፡፡
english: Something that has died or a deceased soul.

amharic: ማፈል መጐልመስ መሴሰን መቀንዘር መዝለል መከመር መቈጣት መቅበጥበጥ መፈናጠር መዳራት መቃበጥ መቀናጣት አእምሮ ማጣት፡፡ ፈሐልክሙ ከመ አልሕምት፡፡ ውእቱ አርዌ ይመጽእ እንዘ ይፍሕል፡፡ ፍሒሎትኪ ዐርገ ኅቤየ (ኤር፳፯ ፲፩፡፡ ሄርማ፡፡ ፬ነገ ፲፱ ፳፰)፡፡
english: To act restless, excited, wild, or out of control.
A male animal or a bull.

amharic: ዝሙት ሴሰን ቅንዝር መዐት ዋዕየ ፍትወት ስካር ቍንጣን፡፡ ሊቀ ፈሓል፡፡ ፈሓለ ዝሙት ኢበነፍስተ ሥጋ ምስለ ፈሓለ አንጕዕ ዘይክዑ እሳተ ዲበ አባል፡፡ ጽጋቡ ኢይምጽአኒ ወፈሓል ኢይክርየኒ፡፡ ፋሕሉ ለወይን (ቀኖ ሐዋ፡፡ አርጋ ፮፡፡ ሢራ፳፫ ፮፡፡ መቃ ገ፯)፡፡
english: Impurity, wild behavior, or intense passion/drunkenness.

amharic: መፋም መጋል መጋም መርሰን እሳት መኾን መንደርከክ መብሰል የንጨት የብረት፡፡ መክሰል መጥቈር ጥቀርሻ መምሰል፡፡ በዐረብና በትግሬ ግን ፈሀመ ብሎ ሰማ ተረዳ ይላል፡፡ ምስጢሩ ከዚያው ይገባል ምጣዱ ሰምቷል እንዲሉ ግሏል ሲሉ፡፡
english: To glow like hot charcoal or to burn/become black like coal.

amharic: በቁሙ ፍም እሳታዊ ምርት ዝግን በገል የሚታፈሥ ከፋይ ትንታግ፡፡ ነፋኅካሃ ለፍሕም ትነደድ፡፡ ወወሪዶሙ ምድረ ረከቡ ፍሕመ ብቁጸ ወዓሣ ጥቡበ፡፡ አቡየ ወአነ ወመንፈስ ቅዱስ እሳት ወነበልባል ወፍሕም፡፡ ማዕጠንት ዘወርቅ እልተ ጾርኪ ፍሕመ እሳት (ሢራ፳፰፡ ፲፪፡፡ ዮሐ፳፩፡ ፱፡፡ ቅዳ፡ ግሩ፡፡ ኤፍ፡ ፩)፡፡
english: Hot charcoal or glowing coal.

amharic: ፍሞች ከሰሎች፡፡ አፍሓመ እሳት ቅዴሁ ወወገሮ ውስተ እሳት ዘአፍሓም፡፡ መፍርህኬ አቅብዎ አናፍር ለዉሒጠ ለፍሓም ርሱን፡፡ አፍሓም ዘያንበለብል (ኤር፵፬ ፳፪-፳፫፡፡ ቅዳ ቄር፡፡ ዳን፯ ፱)፡፡
english: Pieces of charcoal or coals.

amharic: አጋለ አጋመ አፋመ አከሰለ ፍሙን ከሰል ከሰሉን ፍም አደረገ፡፡
english: To make something into charcoal or to heat it until it glows.
To hiccup.

amharic: መፋቅ መፈቅፈቅ መላግ ማንጠጥ መፈግፈግ ማለዘብ፡፡ ዘረቆ ወዘፈሐቆ ወዘሄዶ ውጉዘ ለይኩን፡፡ ፈሐቁ ቍስሎ በአጽርቅተ ጸጕር (ባለመጣፍ፡፡ ስንክ ሐም፲፪)፡፡
english: The act of scrubbing, scraping, or cleaning off.

amharic: የሚፍቅ ፋቂ አንጣጭ አለዛቢ፡፡ ከመ ዘየአኅድር ውስተ ቤተ ፈሓቂ፡፡ ወቀርተ እብን ወፈሐቅት (ማር ይሥ፡፡ ፩ዜና ፳፪ ፪)፡፡
english: Something or someone that scrubs or scrapes.

amharic: የሚፍቅ ፋቂ መፋቂያ መሣሪያ፡፡ መፍሐቀ ገበዋት (ስንክ ጥር፲፭)፡፡
english: A tool used for scrubbing or scraping.
A place for scrubbing or scraping.

amharic: የተፋቀ የተነጠጠ ንጥ ቅርጽ ልዝብ ልሙጽ፡፡ ከመ ማዕከክ ፍሑቅ፡፡ እደዊሁ ፍሑቃት እለ ወርቅ፡፡ አጻብዒሁ ፍሑቃት (ማሕ፭ ፲፬፡፡ ፯ ፫፡፡ ድጓ)፡፡ በፍሑቅ ፈንታ ፍሕቆ ይላል የመላሽ ስሕተት ነው፡፡ ቅፍለ ወርቅ ፍሕቆ፡፡ እምወርቅ ንጹሕ ፍርቆ ግብራ፡፡ ብሩር ዘፍሕቆ እሙንቱ (ዘፀ፳፭ ፲፰ና ፴፩፡፡ ኤር፲ ፭)፡፡
english: Polished, scraped, or smooth.

amharic: ፍሕቀት ፍቆሽ አፋፋቅ አቀራረጥ አነጣጠጥ ጌጥ ቅርጥ፡፡
english: A polish, a scrape, or an engraved decoration.

amharic: መፋር መቈፈር ማፍራት መፈለግ የጠፋን የተቀበረን እለ ይትሜነይዎ ለሞት ወይፍሕርዎ ከመ መድፍን (ኢዮ፫ ፳፩)፡፡ በቀበረ ፈንታ ፈሐረ ይላል ስሕተት ነው፡፡ ወይፍሕርዎሙ አሕዛበ ምድር (ሕዝ፴፱ ፲፫)፡፡
english: The act of digging, excavating, or searching for something buried.
A digger or excavator.
To dig.

amharic: ማሸት ማፍተልተል ማፍረጥረጥ ማዋሐድ ማዛመድ የቡሖ የቀለም፡፡ ማቅላት በቀይ ቀለም ማለል የልብስ የፈትል፡፡ ባለብሉዮች ግን ፈተለ ገመደ ጐነጐነ ብለው ይፈቱታል፡፡
english: To knead, mix, or blend materials like dough or paint.

amharic: ቈፈረ መረመረ አገላበጠ መላልሶ ጠየቀ የዳኛ የሐኪም፡፡
english: To investigate, examine carefully, or dig into a matter.

amharic: ታሸ ተዋሐደ ቀላ ታለለ ቀይ ቀለም ገባ ልብሱ ፈትሉ፡፡
english: To be kneaded, mixed, or blended.

amharic: የታለለ ቀለም የገባ፡፡ ቀይ ቀለም ደባባ የሮማን ፍሬ ዐይነት ቅላቱ በጣም ያልደመቀ፡፡
english: A muted or pale shade of red, similar to the color of a pomegranate seed.

amharic: ዝኒ ከማሁ ቀይ ቀለም ቀይ ፈትል ቀይ ሐር፡፡
english: A vivid red color, often referring to red thread or red silk.

amharic: ማጨት ሴት ልጅን መመኘት መፈለግ መሻት ስጡኝ ማለት ለሚስትነት፡፡ እሺ ካሰኙ በኋላ የጋብቻውን ውል ማሰር ማቆም ቃል ኪዳን መግባት መፈጣጠም፡፡
english: The act of asking for someone's hand in marriage, desiring to be betrothed, or establishing a marriage agreement.
A person who is engaged or seeking to be married (an fiancé).

amharic: ታጨ ተፈለገ ዕጮኛ ኾነ ለግቢ ተሰጠ፡፡
english: To become engaged or betrothed to someone.
Someone who is engaged or betrothed.
The state of being engaged or the process of formalizing a marriage agreement.

amharic: መፍጠን መቀልጠፍ መቸኰል መጣደፍ ማረበድ ቶሎ ቶሎ ማለት መቸኰል የሥራ፡፡
english: The act of moving quickly, rushing, or performing a task with speed.
Quick, fast, or prompt in action.

amharic: የፈጠነ የቸኰለ ፈጣን ችኵል ቅርብ ቶሎ፡፡
english: Speedy, urgent, or occurring very soon.
Quickly, fast, or without delay.

amharic: በቁሙ መፍጠን አፈጣጠን ችኰላ ቅልጥፍና ጥድሪያ፡፡
english: Speed, swiftness, or the quality of being fast.

amharic: አፈጠነ አስፈጠነ አስቸኰለ ቶሎ አደረገ አስደረገ፡፡
english: To make something go faster, to hurry, or to speed up a process.
Something that causes speed or an accelerator.
To hurry up or rush oneself.

amharic: አፋጠነ አፈጣጠነ አቻኰለ አቸኳኰለ እጅ እግሩን ሕዋሳቱን ወይም ሌላውን፡፡
english: To cause someone or something to hasten or act quickly.
Someone or something that is fast-moving or quick-acting.
